# File: src/blade_physics.rs
//! Opt-in one-sided sharp edge and finite kinematic blade contacts.
//! CPU fruit uses baked convex proxies and contact-point angular impulses.
//! Lazy GPU-resident pieces retain the bounds fallback without CPU readback.
use glam::{Mat4, Quat, Vec3};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct BladePhysics {
    pub edge: Vec3,
    pub half_width: f32,
    pub half_thickness: f32,
}
impl BladePhysics {
    pub(crate) fn validate(self, blade: [Vec3; 2]) -> Result<(), String> {
        if !self.edge.is_finite()
            || (self.edge.length_squared() - 1.).abs() > 0.002
            || self.edge.dot((blade[1] - blade[0]).normalize()).abs() > 0.001
            || !self.half_width.is_finite()
            || !self.half_thickness.is_finite()
            || self.half_width <= 0.
            || self.half_width > 1.
            || self.half_thickness <= 0.
            || self.half_thickness > self.half_width
        {
            return Err("Blade edge must be unit and perpendicular to its axis; finite dimensions require 0 < thickness <= width <= 1m".into());
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    pub(crate) fn scaled(self, scale: Vec3, blade: [Vec3; 2]) -> Self {
        let axis = (blade[1] - blade[0]).normalize();
        let edge = self.edge * scale;
        let scaled_axis = (axis * scale).normalize();
        Self {
            edge: (edge - scaled_axis * edge.dot(scaled_axis)).normalize(),
            half_width: self.half_width * edge.length(),
            half_thickness: self.half_thickness * (axis.cross(self.edge) * scale).length(),
        }
    }
    /// Assisted blades accept either edge direction, while rejecting flat sweeps.
    pub(crate) fn assisted_sharp(self, pose: Mat4, axis: Vec3, motion: Vec3) -> bool {
        let edge = pose.transform_vector3(self.edge).normalize();
        let flat = axis.normalize().cross(edge).normalize();
        let advance = motion.dot(edge).abs();
        advance > 1e-6 && advance > motion.dot(flat).abs() * 0.75
    }
    pub(crate) fn sharp(self, pose: Mat4, axis: Vec3, relative_motion: Vec3) -> bool {
        let edge = pose.transform_vector3(self.edge).normalize();
        let flat = axis.normalize().cross(edge).normalize();
        let forward = relative_motion.dot(edge);
        forward > 1e-6 && forward > relative_motion.dot(flat).abs() * 1.15
    }
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub(crate) fn contact(
    config: BladePhysics,
    blade: [Vec3; 2],
    from: Mat4,
    to: Mat4,
    old_center: Vec3,
    center: Vec3,
    radius: f32,
    oriented_bounds: Option<(Quat, Vec3)>,
    mut velocity: Vec3,
    bounce: f32,
    dt: f32,
    assisted: bool,
    edge_cut_eligible: bool,
) -> Option<(Vec3, Vec3)> {
    let axis_local = (blade[1] - blade[0]).normalize();
    let mid_local = (blade[0] + blade[1]) * 0.5;
    let half_length = blade[0].distance(blade[1]) * 0.5;
    let old_mid = from.transform_point3(mid_local);
    let new_mid = to.transform_point3(mid_local);
    let broad_radius = half_length + config.half_width + radius;
    let min = old_mid.min(new_mid) - Vec3::splat(broad_radius);
    let max = old_mid.max(new_mid) + Vec3::splat(broad_radius);
    if old_center.min(center).cmpgt(max).any() || old_center.max(center).cmplt(min).any() {
        return None;
    }
    let qa = Quat::from_mat4(&from).normalize();
    let qb = Quat::from_mat4(&to).normalize();
    let travel = old_mid.distance(new_mid)
        + center.distance(old_center)
        + qa.angle_between(qb).abs() * half_length;
    let steps = (travel / (radius * 0.2).clamp(0.002, 0.015))
        .ceil()
        .clamp(1., 256.) as u32;
    let mut correction = Vec3::ZERO;
    let mut touched = false;
    for i in 1..=steps {
        let t = i as f32 / steps as f32;
        let rotation = qa.slerp(qb, t).normalize();
        let pose = Mat4::from_rotation_translation(
            rotation,
            from.w_axis.truncate().lerp(to.w_axis.truncate(), t),
        );
        let mid = pose.transform_point3(mid_local);
        let axis = rotation * axis_local;
        let edge = rotation * config.edge;
        let flat = axis.cross(edge).normalize();
        let axes = [axis, edge, flat];
        let half = Vec3::new(half_length, config.half_width, config.half_thickness);
        let point = old_center.lerp(center, t) + correction;
        let relative = point - mid;
        let local = Vec3::new(relative.dot(axis), relative.dot(edge), relative.dot(flat));
        let closest = local.clamp(-half, half);
        let offset = local - closest;
        if offset.length_squared() > radius * radius {
            continue;
        }
        // Use the material point nearest this fruit, including angular motion.
        let material = mid_local
            + axis_local * closest.x
            + config.edge * closest.y
            + axis_local.cross(config.edge) * closest.z;
        let blade_velocity = (to.transform_point3(material) - from.transform_point3(material)) / dt;
        let relative_motion = blade_velocity * dt - (center - old_center);
        let (normal_local, depth) = if offset.length_squared() > 1e-12 {
            (offset.normalize(), radius - offset.length())
        } else {
            let gaps = half - local.abs();
            let k = if gaps.x < gaps.y && gaps.x < gaps.z {
                0
            } else if gaps.y < gaps.z {
                1
            } else {
                2
            };
            let mut n = Vec3::ZERO;
            n[k] = if local[k] < 0. { -1. } else { 1. };
            (n, radius + gaps[k])
        };
        let normal = axes[0] * normal_local.x + axes[1] * normal_local.y + axes[2] * normal_local.z;
        let flat_radius = oriented_bounds.map_or(radius, |(rotation, half)| {
            radius.min((rotation.conjugate() * flat).abs().dot(half))
        });
        // Edge-facing translation of a supporting flat is still a flat
        // contact. Only an edge approaching the fruit's interior cross-section
        // bypasses rigid response so the finite mesh cut can finish.
        let supporting_flat = normal_local.z.abs() > 0.75
            && local.z.abs() >= config.half_thickness + flat_radius * 0.8;
        if edge_cut_eligible
            && !supporting_flat
            && if assisted {
                config.assisted_sharp(pose, axis, blade_velocity * dt)
            } else {
                config.sharp(pose, axis, relative_motion)
            }
        {
            continue;
        }
        // Both the actual-vertex sphere and oriented bounds enclose the mesh.
        // Their intersection avoids hovering on flat faces of authored fruit.
        let support_radius = oriented_bounds.map_or(radius, |(rotation, half)| {
            radius.min((rotation.conjugate() * normal).abs().dot(half))
        });
        let depth = depth - (radius - support_radius);
        if depth < 0. {
            continue;
        }
        correction += normal * (depth + 1e-5);
        let relative_velocity = velocity - blade_velocity;
        let incoming = relative_velocity.dot(normal);
        if incoming < 0. {
            velocity -= normal * incoming * (1. + bounce);
            // Coulomb-like friction transfers supporting blade motion, bounded
            // by the normal impulse, and leaves release velocity intact.
            let tangent = relative_velocity - normal * incoming;
            let friction = (-incoming * 0.8).min(tangent.length());
            velocity -= tangent.normalize_or_zero() * friction;
        }
        touched = true;
    }
    touched.then_some((center + correction, velocity))
}

pub(crate) struct BodyContact {
    pub center: Vec3,
    pub velocity: Vec3,
    pub angular: Vec3,
}

/// Convex proxy versus finite blade box. All shape preparation is done at creation;
/// queries only transform up to 26 vertices and cached separating axes.
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub(crate) fn contact_shape(
    config: BladePhysics,
    blade: [Vec3; 2],
    from: Mat4,
    to: Mat4,
    old_center: Vec3,
    center: Vec3,
    shape: &crate::contact_shape::ContactShape,
    rotation: Quat,
    scale: Vec3,
    mut velocity: Vec3,
    mut angular: Vec3,
    bounce: f32,
    dt: f32,
    assisted: bool,
    edge_cut_eligible: bool,
) -> Option<BodyContact> {
    let axis_local = (blade[1] - blade[0]).normalize();
    let mid_local = (blade[0] + blade[1]) * 0.5;
    let half_length = blade[0].distance(blade[1]) * 0.5;
    let half = Vec3::new(half_length, config.half_width, config.half_thickness);
    let old_mid = from.transform_point3(mid_local);
    let new_mid = to.transform_point3(mid_local);
    let radius = (shape.half * scale.abs()).length();
    let broad_radius = half_length + config.half_width + radius;
    let min = old_mid.min(new_mid) - Vec3::splat(broad_radius);
    let max = old_mid.max(new_mid) + Vec3::splat(broad_radius);
    if old_center.min(center).cmpgt(max).any() || old_center.max(center).cmplt(min).any() {
        return None;
    }
    let qa = Quat::from_mat4(&from).normalize();
    let qb = Quat::from_mat4(&to).normalize();
    let travel = old_mid.distance(new_mid)
        + center.distance(old_center)
        + qa.angle_between(qb).abs() * half_length;
    let steps = (travel / (radius * 0.2).clamp(0.002, 0.015))
        .ceil()
        .clamp(1., 256.) as u32;
    let h = shape.half * scale.abs();
    // Unit-mass box inertia approximation; contact shape controls the lever arm.
    let inverse_inertia = Vec3::new(
        3. / (h.y * h.y + h.z * h.z).max(1e-8),
        3. / (h.x * h.x + h.z * h.z).max(1e-8),
        3. / (h.x * h.x + h.y * h.y).max(1e-8),
    );
    let inverse = |v: Vec3| rotation * (inverse_inertia * (rotation.conjugate() * v));
    let mut correction = Vec3::ZERO;
    let mut touched = false;
    for i in 1..=steps {
        let t = i as f32 / steps as f32;
        let q = qa.slerp(qb, t).normalize();
        let mid = from.w_axis.truncate().lerp(to.w_axis.truncate(), t) + q * mid_local;
        let axes = [
            q * axis_local,
            q * config.edge,
            q * axis_local.cross(config.edge),
        ];
        let to_local = |v: Vec3| Vec3::new(v.dot(axes[0]), v.dot(axes[1]), v.dot(axes[2]));
        let to_world = |v: Vec3| axes[0] * v.x + axes[1] * v.y + axes[2] * v.z;
        let point = old_center.lerp(center, t) + correction;
        let mut vertices = [Vec3::ZERO; 26];
        for (out, p) in vertices.iter_mut().zip(&shape.points) {
            *out = to_local(point - mid + rotation * (*p * scale));
        }
        let vertices = &vertices[..shape.points.len()];
        let mut depth = f32::INFINITY;
        let mut normal_local = Vec3::ZERO;
        let candidates = [Vec3::X, Vec3::Y, Vec3::Z]
            .into_iter()
            .chain(
                shape
                    .normals
                    .iter()
                    .map(|n| to_local(rotation * (*n / scale))),
            )
            .chain(shape.edges.iter().flat_map(|e| {
                let e = to_local(rotation * (*e * scale));
                [e.cross(Vec3::X), e.cross(Vec3::Y), e.cross(Vec3::Z)]
            }));
        let mut separated = false;
        for axis in candidates {
            if axis.length_squared() < 1e-10 {
                continue;
            }
            let axis = axis.normalize();
            let mut low = f32::INFINITY;
            let mut high = f32::NEG_INFINITY;
            for p in vertices {
                let d = p.dot(axis);
                low = low.min(d);
                high = high.max(d);
            }
            let extent = axis.abs().dot(half);
            let positive = extent - low;
            let negative = high + extent;
            if positive < 0. || negative < 0. {
                separated = true;
                break;
            }
            let (overlap, direction) = if positive < negative {
                (positive, axis)
            } else {
                (negative, -axis)
            };
            if overlap < depth {
                depth = overlap;
                normal_local = direction;
            }
        }
        if separated {
            continue;
        }
        let normal = to_world(normal_local);
        let support = vertices
            .iter()
            .map(|p| p.dot(normal_local))
            .fold(f32::INFINITY, f32::min);
        let mut surface = Vec3::ZERO;
        let mut count = 0.;
        for p in vertices {
            if p.dot(normal_local) < support + 0.0005 {
                surface += *p;
                count += 1.;
            }
        }
        surface /= count;
        let closest = surface.clamp(-half, half);
        let material = mid_local
            + axis_local * closest.x
            + config.edge * closest.y
            + axis_local.cross(config.edge) * closest.z;
        let blade_velocity = (to.transform_point3(material) - from.transform_point3(material)) / dt;
        let pose = Mat4::from_rotation_translation(q, mid - q * mid_local);
        let relative_motion = blade_velocity * dt - (center - old_center);
        // A face normal alone also occurs while the sharp edge is already
        // crossing the interior. Only the outer flat is a supporting contact.
        let center_flat = to_local(point - mid).z;
        let flat_radius = vertices
            .iter()
            .map(|p| (center_flat - p.z) * center_flat.signum())
            .fold(0., f32::max);
        let supporting_flat = normal_local.z.abs() > 0.75
            && center_flat.abs() >= config.half_thickness + flat_radius * 0.8;
        if edge_cut_eligible
            && !supporting_flat
            && if assisted {
                config.assisted_sharp(pose, axes[0], blade_velocity * dt)
            } else {
                config.sharp(pose, axes[0], relative_motion)
            }
        {
            continue;
        }

        // Clamp the manifold to the finite blade: an off-center landing must tip.
        let contact = closest + normal_local * (surface - closest).dot(normal_local);
        let lever = mid + to_world(contact) - point;
        correction += normal * (depth + 1e-5);
        let relative = velocity + angular.cross(lever) - blade_velocity;
        let incoming = relative.dot(normal);
        if incoming < 0. {
            let effective_mass = 1. + normal.dot(inverse(lever.cross(normal)).cross(lever));
            let restitution = if incoming < -0.5 { bounce } else { 0. };
            let impulse = -incoming * (1. + restitution) / effective_mass;
            velocity += normal * impulse;
            angular += inverse(lever.cross(normal * impulse));
            let relative = velocity + angular.cross(lever) - blade_velocity;
            let tangent = relative - normal * relative.dot(normal);
            if tangent.length_squared() > 1e-12 {
                let direction = tangent.normalize();
                let mass = 1. + direction.dot(inverse(lever.cross(direction)).cross(lever));
                let friction = -direction * (tangent.length() / mass).min(impulse * 0.8);
                velocity += friction;
                angular += inverse(lever.cross(friction));
            }
            // A small finite contact patch supplies static rolling resistance.
            // This prevents numerical drift on the apple's bottom pole without
            // cancelling the much larger moment of an off-center landing.
            let patch = (radius * 0.04).min(config.half_width * 0.5);
            let direction = angular.normalize_or_zero();
            let resistance = inverse(direction).length() * impulse * patch;
            angular -= direction * resistance.min(angular.length());
            // Additional material damping acts only while supported.
            angular *= (-5. * dt / steps as f32).exp();
        }
        touched = true;
    }
    touched.then_some(BodyContact {
        center: center + correction,
        velocity,
        angular,
    })
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    fn octahedron() -> crate::contact_shape::ContactShape {
        crate::contact_shape::ContactShape::new(
            &[Vec3::X, -Vec3::X, Vec3::Y, -Vec3::Y, Vec3::Z, -Vec3::Z],
            (-Vec3::ONE, Vec3::ONE),
            Vec3::ZERO,
        )
    }
    #[test]
    fn blade_physics_convex_proxy_rejects_empty_bounds_corner_and_handles_mirrored_scale() {
        let shape = octahedron();
        for scale in [Vec3::splat(0.1), Vec3::new(-0.1, 0.1, 0.1)] {
            let center = Vec3::new(0.15, 0.08, -0.5);
            assert!(
                contact_shape(
                    config(),
                    [Vec3::ZERO, -Vec3::Z],
                    Mat4::IDENTITY,
                    Mat4::IDENTITY,
                    center,
                    center,
                    &shape,
                    Quat::IDENTITY,
                    scale,
                    Vec3::ZERO,
                    Vec3::ZERO,
                    0.,
                    1. / 90.,
                    false,
                    false,
                )
                .is_none(),
                "empty AABB corner is not a surface"
            );
            let center = Vec3::new(0., 0.09, -0.5);
            let hit = contact_shape(
                config(),
                [Vec3::ZERO, -Vec3::Z],
                Mat4::IDENTITY,
                Mat4::IDENTITY,
                center,
                center,
                &shape,
                Quat::IDENTITY,
                scale,
                -Vec3::Y,
                Vec3::ZERO,
                0.,
                1. / 90.,
                false,
                false,
            )
            .unwrap();
            assert!((hit.center.y - 0.11001).abs() < 1e-4);
            assert!(hit.angular.length() < 1e-4);
        }
    }
    #[test]
    fn blade_physics_convex_fast_flat_sweep_does_not_tunnel() {
        let shape = octahedron();
        let center = Vec3::new(0., 0., -0.5);
        let result = contact_shape(
            config(),
            [Vec3::ZERO, -Vec3::Z],
            Mat4::from_translation(-Vec3::Y * 0.4),
            Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::Y * 0.4),
            center,
            center,
            &shape,
            Quat::IDENTITY,
            Vec3::splat(0.1),
            Vec3::ZERO,
            Vec3::ZERO,
            0.,
            0.05,
            false,
            false,
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(result.center.y > 0.5, "{:?}", result.center);
        assert!(result.velocity.y > 15.);
    }
    #[test]
    fn blade_physics_sharp_interior_is_not_a_supporting_flat() {
        let shape = octahedron();
        let center = Vec3::new(0., 0.02, -0.5);
        assert!(
            contact_shape(
                config(),
                [Vec3::ZERO, -Vec3::Z],
                Mat4::from_translation(-Vec3::X * 0.02),
                Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::X * 0.02),
                center,
                center,
                &shape,
                Quat::IDENTITY,
                Vec3::splat(0.1),
                Vec3::ZERO,
                Vec3::ZERO,
                0.,
                0.02,
                false,
                true,
            )
            .is_none(),
            "interior sharp traversal must remain available to the mesh cutter"
        );
    }
    #[test]
    fn blade_physics_asymmetric_fragment_keeps_its_near_supporting_face() {
        let points = [
            Vec3::new(-0.1, -0.025, -0.1),
            Vec3::new(0.1, -0.025, -0.1),
            Vec3::new(0., -0.025, 0.1),
            Vec3::new(0., 0.075, 0.),
        ];
        let shape = crate::contact_shape::ContactShape::new(
            &points,
            (Vec3::new(-0.1, -0.025, -0.1), Vec3::new(0.1, 0.075, 0.1)),
            Vec3::ZERO,
        );
        let center = Vec3::new(0., 0.0349, -0.5);
        assert!(
            contact_shape(
                config(),
                [Vec3::ZERO, -Vec3::Z],
                Mat4::IDENTITY,
                Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::X * 0.0003),
                center,
                center,
                &shape,
                Quat::IDENTITY,
                Vec3::ONE,
                -Vec3::Y * 0.1,
                Vec3::ZERO,
                0.,
                1. / 90.,
                false,
                true,
            )
            .is_some(),
            "the opposite distant vertex must not hide the supporting face"
        );
    }
    fn config() -> BladePhysics {
        BladePhysics {
            edge: Vec3::X,
            half_width: 0.08,
            half_thickness: 0.01,
        }
    }
    #[test]
    fn blade_physics_flat_support_carry_and_release() {
        let blade = [Vec3::ZERO, -Vec3::Z];
        let mut center = Vec3::new(0., 0.2, -0.5);
        let mut velocity = Vec3::ZERO;
        let dt = 1. / 90.;
        let mut pose = Mat4::IDENTITY;
        for frame in 0..180 {
            let previous = center;
            velocity.y -= 9.81 * dt;
            center += velocity * dt;
            let next = Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(0., 0., frame as f32 * 0.0005));
            if let Some((p, v)) = contact(
                config(),
                blade,
                pose,
                next,
                previous,
                center,
                0.1,
                None,
                velocity,
                0.,
                dt,
                false,
                true,
            ) {
                center = p;
                velocity = v;
            }
            pose = next;
        }
        assert!((center.y - 0.11).abs() < 0.002, "{center:?}");
        assert!(velocity.y.abs() < 0.002, "{velocity:?}");
        assert!(center.z > -0.45, "carried: {center:?}");
        // Removing tracking means no solver call: normal projectile gravity resumes.
        let y = center.y;
        for _ in 0..20 {
            velocity.y -= 9.81 * dt;
            center += velocity * dt;
        }
        assert!(center.y < y - 0.2);
    }
    #[test]
    fn blade_physics_fast_flat_sweep_does_not_tunnel() {
        let from = Mat4::from_translation(-Vec3::Y * 0.4);
        let to = Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::Y * 0.4);
        let center = Vec3::new(0., 0., -0.5);
        let (resolved, velocity) = contact(
            config(),
            [Vec3::ZERO, -Vec3::Z],
            from,
            to,
            center,
            center,
            0.1,
            None,
            Vec3::ZERO,
            0.,
            0.05,
            false,
            true,
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(resolved.y > 0.5, "{resolved:?}");
        assert!(velocity.y > 15.);
    }
    #[test]
    fn blade_physics_supporting_flat_keeps_friction_during_edge_facing_translation() {
        let center = Vec3::new(0., 0.1039, -0.5);
        let (_, velocity) = contact(
            BladePhysics {
                edge: Vec3::X,
                half_width: 0.0225,
                half_thickness: 0.004,
            },
            [Vec3::ZERO, -Vec3::Z],
            Mat4::IDENTITY,
            Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::X / 3000.),
            center,
            center,
            0.16,
            Some((Quat::IDENTITY, Vec3::new(0.15, 0.1, 0.15))),
            -Vec3::Y * (8. / 90.),
            0.,
            1. / 90.,
            false,
            true,
        )
        .expect("edge-facing board motion must preserve supporting flat contact");
        assert!(velocity.x > 0.025, "{velocity:?}");
        assert!(velocity.y.abs() < 1e-4, "{velocity:?}");
    }
    #[test]
    fn blade_physics_edge_and_flat_rotate_with_pose() {
        let c = config();
        let pose = Mat4::from_rotation_z(std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2);
        assert!(c.sharp(pose, -Vec3::Z, Vec3::Y));
        assert!(!c.sharp(pose, -Vec3::Z, -Vec3::Y));
        assert!(!c.sharp(pose, -Vec3::Z, Vec3::X));
        assert!(c.assisted_sharp(pose, -Vec3::Z, Vec3::Y));
        assert!(c.assisted_sharp(pose, -Vec3::Z, -Vec3::Y));
        assert!(!c.assisted_sharp(pose, -Vec3::Z, Vec3::X));
        assert!(!c.assisted_sharp(pose, -Vec3::Z, Vec3::ZERO));
    }
}


# File: src/collision.rs
//! Static AABB collisions. The scene owner rebuilds the BVH on collider revisions.
//!
//! Character motion resolves Y, then X, then Z. This deliberately provides no
//! stepping, triangle collision, or recovery from an initially overlapping box.

use glam::Vec3;

const LEAF_SIZE: usize = 4;
const CONTACT_EPSILON: f32 = 1.0e-4;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct Aabb {
    pub min: Vec3,
    pub max: Vec3,
}

impl Aabb {
    /// Rejects non-finite coordinates and zero or negative extents on any axis.
    pub fn new(min: Vec3, max: Vec3) -> Option<Self> {
        (min.is_finite() && max.is_finite() && max.cmpgt(min).all()).then_some(Self { min, max })
    }

    fn union(self, other: Self) -> Self {
        Self {
            min: self.min.min(other.min),
            max: self.max.max(other.max),
        }
    }

    // Inclusive broadphase overlap retains touching faces for support probing.
    fn intersects(self, other: Self) -> bool {
        self.min.cmple(other.max).all() && self.max.cmpge(other.min).all()
    }

    fn translated(self, offset: Vec3) -> Self {
        Self {
            min: self.min + offset,
            max: self.max + offset,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct Collider {
    pub id: u32,
    pub bounds: Aabb,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct SurfaceHit {
    pub position: Vec3,
    /// Outward face normal; zero when the segment starts inside a solid.
    pub normal: Vec3,
    pub fraction: f32,
    pub id: u32,
}

#[derive(Debug)]
enum NodeKind {
    Leaf { start: usize, end: usize },
    Branch { left: usize, right: usize },
}

#[derive(Debug)]
struct Node {
    bounds: Aabb,
    kind: NodeKind,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct CollisionWorld {
    colliders: Vec<Collider>,
    nodes: Vec<Node>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct MotionResult {
    pub position: Vec3,
    pub grounded: bool,
    pub hit_ceiling: bool,
    /// Exact broadphase query hits, after filtering out `ignore_id`.
    pub candidates: usize,
}

impl CollisionWorld {
    pub fn rebuild(&mut self, colliders: Vec<Collider>) {
        // Public AABB fields allow malformed boxes; do not let them poison BVH bounds.
        self.colliders = colliders
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|c| Aabb::new(c.bounds.min, c.bounds.max).is_some())
            .collect();
        self.nodes.clear();
        if !self.colliders.is_empty() {
            self.build_node(0, self.colliders.len());
        }
    }

    fn build_node(&mut self, start: usize, end: usize) -> usize {
        let bounds = self.colliders[start + 1..end]
            .iter()
            .fold(self.colliders[start].bounds, |b, c| b.union(c.bounds));
        let index = self.nodes.len();
        self.nodes.push(Node {
            bounds,
            kind: NodeKind::Leaf { start, end },
        });
        if end - start > LEAF_SIZE {
            let extent = bounds.max - bounds.min;
            let axis = if extent.x >= extent.y && extent.x >= extent.z {
                0
            } else if extent.y >= extent.z {
                1
            } else {
                2
            };
            let middle = start + (end - start) / 2;
            self.colliders[start..end].select_nth_unstable_by(middle - start, |a, b| {
                let center_a = a.bounds.min[axis] * 0.5 + a.bounds.max[axis] * 0.5;
                let center_b = b.bounds.min[axis] * 0.5 + b.bounds.max[axis] * 0.5;
                center_a.total_cmp(&center_b).then(a.id.cmp(&b.id))
            });
            let left = self.build_node(start, middle);
            let right = self.build_node(middle, end);
            self.nodes[index].kind = NodeKind::Branch { left, right };
        }
        index
    }

    /// Returns exact inclusive AABB overlaps; result order is unspecified.
    pub fn query(&self, bounds: Aabb, ignore_id: Option<u32>) -> Vec<Collider> {
        let mut hits = Vec::new();
        self.visit_query(bounds, ignore_id, |c| hits.push(c));
        hits
    }

    /// Finds the nearest solid along a segment, including its endpoints.
    pub fn cast_segment(&self, start: Vec3, end: Vec3) -> Option<SurfaceHit> {
        let delta = end - start;
        if !start.is_finite() || !end.is_finite() || !delta.is_finite() {
            return None;
        }
        // A segment may have zero extent on an axis, unlike a solid AABB.
        let bounds = Aabb {
            min: start.min(end),
            max: start.max(end),
        };
        let mut nearest: Option<SurfaceHit> = None;
        self.visit_query(bounds, None, |collider| {
            let Some((fraction, normal)) = segment_hit(start, delta, collider.bounds) else {
                return;
            };
            let replace = nearest.is_none_or(|previous| {
                fraction < previous.fraction
                    || (fraction == previous.fraction
                        && ((normal == Vec3::ZERO && previous.normal != Vec3::ZERO)
                            || ((normal == Vec3::ZERO) == (previous.normal == Vec3::ZERO)
                                && collider.id < previous.id)))
            });
            if replace {
                let mut position = start + delta * fraction;
                // Interpolation may round into the solid. Keep the hit face
                // exact so a character placed on it passes strict clearance.
                for axis in 0..3 {
                    if normal[axis] != 0.0 {
                        position[axis] = if normal[axis] > 0.0 {
                            collider.bounds.max[axis]
                        } else {
                            collider.bounds.min[axis]
                        };
                    }
                }
                nearest = Some(SurfaceHit {
                    position,
                    normal,
                    fraction,
                    id: collider.id,
                });
            }
        });
        nearest
    }

    /// Checks an upright box whose bottom is `feet.y`. Touching faces are clear.
    /// Invalid coordinates or non-positive half extents are never clear.
    pub fn character_clear(&self, feet: Vec3, half_extents: Vec3) -> bool {
        if !feet.is_finite() || !half_extents.is_finite() || !half_extents.cmpgt(Vec3::ZERO).all() {
            return false;
        }
        let horizontal = Vec3::new(half_extents.x, 0.0, half_extents.z);
        let Some(body) = Aabb::new(
            feet - horizontal,
            feet + horizontal + Vec3::Y * (half_extents.y * 2.0),
        ) else {
            return false;
        };
        let mut clear = true;
        self.visit_query(body, None, |collider| {
            if body.min.cmplt(collider.bounds.max).all()
                && body.max.cmpgt(collider.bounds.min).all()
            {
                clear = false;
            }
        });
        clear
    }

    // Returns leaf collider checks so native tests can verify actual BVH pruning.
    fn visit_query(
        &self,
        bounds: Aabb,
        ignore_id: Option<u32>,
        mut hit: impl FnMut(Collider),
    ) -> usize {
        if self.nodes.is_empty() {
            return 0;
        }
        let mut stack = vec![0];
        let mut checks = 0;
        while let Some(index) = stack.pop() {
            let node = &self.nodes[index];
            if !node.bounds.intersects(bounds) {
                continue;
            }
            match node.kind {
                NodeKind::Leaf { start, end } => {
                    for collider in &self.colliders[start..end] {
                        checks += 1;
                        if Some(collider.id) != ignore_id && collider.bounds.intersects(bounds) {
                            hit(*collider);
                        }
                    }
                }
                NodeKind::Branch { left, right } => {
                    stack.push(right);
                    stack.push(left);
                }
            }
        }
        checks
    }

    /// Sweeps an upright box with its bottom at `feet.y`, preserving wall sliding.
    /// Invalid motion inputs return the original feet without collision flags.
    pub fn move_character(
        &self,
        feet: Vec3,
        half_extents: Vec3,
        delta: Vec3,
        ignore_id: Option<u32>,
    ) -> MotionResult {
        let mut result = MotionResult {
            position: feet,
            grounded: false,
            hit_ceiling: false,
            candidates: 0,
        };
        if !feet.is_finite()
            || !half_extents.is_finite()
            || !half_extents.cmpgt(Vec3::ZERO).all()
            || !delta.is_finite()
            || !(feet + delta).is_finite()
        {
            return result;
        }
        let horizontal = Vec3::new(half_extents.x, 0.0, half_extents.z);
        let Some(mut body) = Aabb::new(
            feet - horizontal,
            feet + horizontal + Vec3::Y * (half_extents.y * 2.0),
        ) else {
            return result;
        };
        let destination = body.translated(delta);
        if !destination.min.is_finite() || !destination.max.is_finite() {
            return result;
        }
        let swept = body.union(destination);
        let candidates = self.query(
            Aabb {
                min: swept.min - Vec3::splat(CONTACT_EPSILON),
                max: swept.max + Vec3::splat(CONTACT_EPSILON),
            },
            ignore_id,
        );
        result.candidates = candidates.len();

        for axis in [1, 0, 2] {
            let requested = delta[axis];
            let mut travel = requested;
            let mut contact_face = None;
            for collider in &candidates {
                let obstacle = collider.bounds;
                if !overlaps_other_axes(body, obstacle, axis) {
                    continue;
                }
                if requested > 0.0 {
                    let gap = obstacle.min[axis] - body.max[axis];
                    if gap >= -CONTACT_EPSILON && gap <= travel {
                        travel = gap.max(0.0);
                        contact_face = Some(obstacle.min[axis]);
                    }
                } else if requested < 0.0 {
                    let gap = obstacle.max[axis] - body.min[axis];
                    if gap <= CONTACT_EPSILON && gap >= travel {
                        travel = gap.min(0.0);
                        contact_face = Some(obstacle.max[axis]);
                    }
                }
            }
            let mut offset = Vec3::ZERO;
            offset[axis] = travel;
            body = body.translated(offset);
            result.position[axis] += travel;
            if let Some(face) = contact_face {
                // Snap to the face to prevent subtraction/addition roundoff from
                // making the next sweep start just inside a thin obstacle.
                let size = half_extents[axis] * 2.0;
                if requested > 0.0 {
                    body.max[axis] = face;
                    body.min[axis] = face - size;
                } else {
                    body.min[axis] = face;
                    body.max[axis] = face + size;
                }
                result.position[axis] = if axis == 1 {
                    body.min[axis]
                } else if requested > 0.0 {
                    face - half_extents[axis]
                } else {
                    face + half_extents[axis]
                };
                if axis == 1 && requested > 0.0 {
                    result.hit_ceiling = true;
                }
            }
        }

        // Probe final support, after horizontal movement: landing then walking off
        // a platform in the same move must not leave a stale grounded flag.
        result.grounded = delta.y <= 0.0
            && candidates.iter().any(|c| {
                let gap = body.min.y - c.bounds.max.y;
                (-CONTACT_EPSILON..=CONTACT_EPSILON).contains(&gap)
                    && overlaps_other_axes(body, c.bounds, 1)
            });
        result
    }
}

fn segment_hit(start: Vec3, delta: Vec3, bounds: Aabb) -> Option<(f32, Vec3)> {
    if start.cmpgt(bounds.min).all() && start.cmplt(bounds.max).all() {
        return Some((0.0, Vec3::ZERO));
    }
    let mut enter = f32::NEG_INFINITY;
    let mut exit = 1.0_f32;
    let mut normal = Vec3::ZERO;
    for axis in 0..3 {
        if delta[axis] == 0.0 {
            if start[axis] < bounds.min[axis] || start[axis] > bounds.max[axis] {
                return None;
            }
            continue;
        }
        let a = (bounds.min[axis] - start[axis]) / delta[axis];
        let b = (bounds.max[axis] - start[axis]) / delta[axis];
        let near = a.min(b);
        exit = exit.min(a.max(b));
        if near > enter {
            enter = near;
            normal = Vec3::ZERO;
            normal[axis] = if delta[axis] > 0.0 { -1.0 } else { 1.0 };
        }
        if enter > exit {
            return None;
        }
    }
    if exit < 0.0 || enter > 1.0 {
        return None;
    }
    // A boundary origin moving away (or a stationary boundary point) still
    // blocks, but must not advertise a distant exit face as a landing surface.
    Some((
        enter.max(0.0),
        if enter < 0.0 { Vec3::ZERO } else { normal },
    ))
}

fn overlaps_other_axes(a: Aabb, b: Aabb, movement_axis: usize) -> bool {
    (0..3).filter(|axis| *axis != movement_axis).all(|axis| {
        // Strict overlap lets the character slide along an already touching face.
        a.min[axis] < b.max[axis] && a.max[axis] > b.min[axis]
    })
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    const HALF: Vec3 = Vec3::new(0.5, 1.0, 0.5);

    fn collider(id: u32, min: [f32; 3], max: [f32; 3]) -> Collider {
        Collider {
            id,
            bounds: Aabb::new(Vec3::from_array(min), Vec3::from_array(max)).unwrap(),
        }
    }

    fn world(colliders: Vec<Collider>) -> CollisionWorld {
        let mut world = CollisionWorld::default();
        world.rebuild(colliders);
        world
    }

    fn assert_position(actual: Vec3, expected: Vec3) {
        assert!(
            actual.abs_diff_eq(expected, 1.0e-4),
            "{actual:?} != {expected:?}"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn aabb_requires_finite_positive_extents() {
        assert!(Aabb::new(Vec3::ZERO, Vec3::ONE).is_some());
        for max in [Vec3::ZERO, Vec3::new(1.0, 0.0, 1.0), Vec3::NEG_ONE] {
            assert!(Aabb::new(Vec3::ZERO, max).is_none());
        }
        for value in [f32::NAN, f32::INFINITY, f32::NEG_INFINITY] {
            assert!(Aabb::new(Vec3::new(value, 0.0, 0.0), Vec3::ONE).is_none());
            assert!(Aabb::new(Vec3::ZERO, Vec3::new(1.0, value, 1.0)).is_none());
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn segment_reports_top_side_and_underside_outward_normals() {
        let world = world(vec![collider(7, [-1.0, 0.0, -1.0], [1.0, 1.0, 1.0])]);
        for (start, end, position, normal) in [
            (Vec3::Y * 3.0, Vec3::NEG_Y, Vec3::Y, Vec3::Y),
            (
                Vec3::new(-3.0, 0.5, 0.0),
                Vec3::new(1.0, 0.5, 0.0),
                Vec3::new(-1.0, 0.5, 0.0),
                Vec3::NEG_X,
            ),
            (Vec3::NEG_Y, Vec3::Y * 3.0, Vec3::ZERO, Vec3::NEG_Y),
        ] {
            let hit = world.cast_segment(start, end).unwrap();
            assert_position(hit.position, position);
            assert_eq!(hit.normal, normal);
            assert_eq!(hit.id, 7);
            assert!((hit.fraction - start.distance(position) / start.distance(end)).abs() < 1e-6);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn segment_nearest_hit_is_independent_of_insertion_order() {
        let near = collider(9, [-1.0, 2.0, -1.0], [1.0, 3.0, 1.0]);
        let far = collider(1, [-1.0, 0.0, -1.0], [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]);
        for colliders in [vec![far, near], vec![near, far]] {
            let hit = world(colliders)
                .cast_segment(Vec3::Y * 5.0, Vec3::NEG_Y)
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(hit.id, 9);
            assert_position(hit.position, Vec3::Y * 3.0);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn segment_face_position_is_exact_and_boundary_entry_keeps_normal() {
        for top in [0.1, 0.1337, 2.3333, 100.123] {
            let world = world(vec![collider(1, [-2.0, top - 1.0, -2.0], [2.0, top, 2.0])]);
            let hit = world
                .cast_segment(Vec3::Y * (top + 3.731), Vec3::Y * (top - 2.111))
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(hit.position.y, top);
            assert!(world.character_clear(hit.position, HALF));
            let entry = world
                .cast_segment(hit.position, hit.position - Vec3::Y)
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(entry.normal, Vec3::Y);
            assert_eq!(entry.fraction, 0.0);
            let departure = world
                .cast_segment(hit.position, hit.position + Vec3::Y)
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(departure.normal, Vec3::ZERO);
            assert_eq!(departure.fraction, 0.0);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn segment_parallel_miss_and_inside_origin_are_safe() {
        let world = world(vec![collider(1, [0.0; 3], [1.0; 3])]);
        assert!(world
            .cast_segment(Vec3::new(2.0, 3.0, 0.5), Vec3::new(2.0, -1.0, 0.5))
            .is_none());
        for end in [Vec3::Y * 4.0, Vec3::splat(0.5)] {
            let hit = world.cast_segment(Vec3::splat(0.5), end).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(hit.fraction, 0.0);
            assert_eq!(hit.normal, Vec3::ZERO);
            assert_position(hit.position, Vec3::splat(0.5));
        }
        assert!(world
            .cast_segment(Vec3::splat(2.0), Vec3::splat(2.0))
            .is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn character_clear_allows_roof_contact_but_blocks_headroom_and_walls() {
        let roof = collider(1, [-5.0, 0.0, -5.0], [5.0, 1.0, 5.0]);
        assert!(world(vec![roof]).character_clear(Vec3::Y, HALF));
        assert!(!world(vec![roof]).character_clear(Vec3::Y * 0.99, HALF));
        let ceiling = collider(2, [-5.0, 2.9, -5.0], [5.0, 3.1, 5.0]);
        assert!(!world(vec![roof, ceiling]).character_clear(Vec3::Y, HALF));
        let wall = collider(3, [0.4, 1.0, -5.0], [0.6, 5.0, 5.0]);
        assert!(!world(vec![roof, wall]).character_clear(Vec3::Y, HALF));
        assert!(!CollisionWorld::default().character_clear(Vec3::ZERO, Vec3::ZERO));
    }

    #[test]
    fn wall_sliding_preserves_tangent_motion_and_face_contact() {
        let world = world(vec![collider(1, [2.0, -5.0, -20.0], [2.1, 5.0, 20.0])]);
        let first = world.move_character(Vec3::ZERO, HALF, Vec3::new(8.0, 0.0, 3.0), None);
        assert_position(first.position, Vec3::new(1.5, 0.0, 3.0));
        let second = world.move_character(first.position, HALF, Vec3::new(4.0, 0.0, 2.0), None);
        assert_position(second.position, Vec3::new(1.5, 0.0, 5.0));
        assert!(!second.grounded && !second.hit_ceiling);
    }

    #[test]
    fn perpendicular_corner_blocks_both_horizontal_axes() {
        let world = world(vec![
            collider(1, [2.0, -2.0, -10.0], [2.1, 5.0, 10.0]),
            collider(2, [-10.0, -2.0, 2.0], [10.0, 5.0, 2.1]),
        ]);
        let result = world.move_character(Vec3::ZERO, HALF, Vec3::new(50.0, 0.0, 50.0), None);
        assert_position(result.position, Vec3::new(1.5, 0.0, 1.5));
        assert_eq!(result.candidates, 2);
    }

    #[test]
    fn high_speed_cannot_cross_thin_walls_in_either_direction() {
        let world = world(vec![collider(1, [2.0, -5.0, -5.0], [2.001, 5.0, 5.0])]);
        let positive = world.move_character(Vec3::ZERO, HALF, Vec3::X * 10000.0, None);
        assert_position(positive.position, Vec3::new(1.5, 0.0, 0.0));
        let negative = world.move_character(Vec3::X * 10.0, HALF, -Vec3::X * 10000.0, None);
        assert_position(negative.position, Vec3::new(2.501, 0.0, 0.0));
    }

    #[test]
    fn repeated_fractional_face_contacts_do_not_tunnel() {
        let world = world(vec![collider(
            1,
            [2.1337, -5.0, -1000.0],
            [2.1338, 5.0, 1000.0],
        )]);
        let half = Vec3::new(0.3, 0.8, 0.3);
        let mut feet = Vec3::new(0.123, 0.0, 0.0);
        for _ in 0..100 {
            feet = world
                .move_character(feet, half, Vec3::new(1000.0, 0.0, 0.125), None)
                .position;
            assert!((feet.x - (2.1337 - half.x)).abs() <= CONTACT_EPSILON);
        }
        assert_position(feet, Vec3::new(2.1337 - half.x, 0.0, 12.5));
    }

    #[test]
    fn z_sweep_blocks_a_thin_wall() {
        let world = world(vec![collider(1, [-5.0, -5.0, 2.0], [5.0, 5.0, 2.001])]);
        let result = world.move_character(Vec3::ZERO, HALF, Vec3::Z * 10000.0, None);
        assert_position(result.position, Vec3::new(0.0, 0.0, 1.5));
        let reverse = world.move_character(Vec3::Z * 10.0, HALF, -Vec3::Z * 10000.0, None);
        assert_position(reverse.position, Vec3::new(0.0, 0.0, 2.501));
    }

    #[test]
    fn floor_landing_and_zero_vertical_delta_keep_support() {
        let world = world(vec![collider(1, [-20.0, -0.01, -20.0], [20.0, 0.0, 20.0])]);
        let landing = world.move_character(Vec3::Y * 50.0, HALF, -Vec3::Y * 1000.0, None);
        assert_position(landing.position, Vec3::ZERO);
        assert!(landing.grounded && !landing.hit_ceiling);
        let standing = world.move_character(landing.position, HALF, Vec3::ZERO, None);
        assert!(standing.grounded);
        let walking = world.move_character(standing.position, HALF, Vec3::X * 4.0, None);
        assert_position(walking.position, Vec3::X * 4.0);
        assert!(walking.grounded);
    }

    #[test]
    fn highest_platform_catches_fall_before_floor() {
        let world = world(vec![
            collider(1, [-20.0, -1.0, -20.0], [20.0, 0.0, 20.0]),
            collider(2, [-2.0, 2.9, -2.0], [2.0, 3.0, 2.0]),
        ]);
        let result = world.move_character(Vec3::Y * 10.0, HALF, -Vec3::Y * 100.0, None);
        assert_position(result.position, Vec3::Y * 3.0);
        assert!(result.grounded);
        assert_eq!(result.candidates, 2);
    }

    #[test]
    fn ceiling_stops_head_at_high_speed_and_exact_contact() {
        let world = world(vec![collider(1, [-5.0, 4.0, -5.0], [5.0, 4.01, 5.0])]);
        for rise in [2.0, 1000.0] {
            let result = world.move_character(Vec3::ZERO, HALF, Vec3::Y * rise, None);
            assert_position(result.position, Vec3::Y * 2.0);
            assert!(result.hit_ceiling && !result.grounded);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn walking_off_support_clears_grounded_even_after_landing() {
        let world = world(vec![collider(1, [-1.0, -0.1, -1.0], [1.0, 0.0, 1.0])]);
        let edge = world.move_character(Vec3::ZERO, HALF, Vec3::X * 1.5, None);
        assert!(!edge.grounded); // Mere edge contact has no supporting footprint.
        let off = world.move_character(Vec3::Y * 2.0, HALF, Vec3::new(4.0, -5.0, 0.0), None);
        assert_position(off.position, Vec3::X * 4.0);
        assert!(!off.grounded);
        let fall = world.move_character(off.position, HALF, -Vec3::Y, None);
        assert_position(fall.position, Vec3::new(4.0, -1.0, 0.0));
        assert!(!fall.grounded);
    }

    #[test]
    fn support_probe_is_tiny_and_jumping_clears_support() {
        let world = world(vec![collider(1, [-5.0, -1.0, -5.0], [5.0, 0.0, 5.0])]);
        let near = world.move_character(Vec3::Y * (CONTACT_EPSILON * 0.5), HALF, Vec3::ZERO, None);
        assert!(near.grounded);
        let far = world.move_character(Vec3::Y * (CONTACT_EPSILON * 2.0), HALF, Vec3::ZERO, None);
        assert!(!far.grounded);
        let jump = world.move_character(Vec3::ZERO, HALF, Vec3::Y * (CONTACT_EPSILON * 0.5), None);
        assert!(!jump.grounded);
    }

    #[test]
    fn ignores_own_id_in_queries_motion_and_support() {
        let bounds = collider(7, [2.0, -1.0, -5.0], [2.1, 5.0, 5.0]);
        let world = world(vec![bounds]);
        assert_eq!(world.query(bounds.bounds, None).len(), 1);
        assert!(world.query(bounds.bounds, Some(7)).is_empty());
        let result = world.move_character(Vec3::ZERO, HALF, Vec3::X * 10.0, Some(7));
        assert_position(result.position, Vec3::X * 10.0);
        assert_eq!(result.candidates, 0);
        let floor = world.move_character(Vec3::new(2.0, 5.0, 0.0), HALF, Vec3::ZERO, Some(7));
        assert!(!floor.grounded);
    }

    #[test]
    fn no_auto_step_on_low_obstacle() {
        let world = world(vec![collider(1, [2.0, 0.0, -5.0], [3.0, 0.2, 5.0])]);
        let result = world.move_character(Vec3::ZERO, HALF, Vec3::X * 10.0, None);
        assert_position(result.position, Vec3::X * 1.5);
    }

    #[test]
    fn bvh_exactly_matches_brute_force_queries() {
        let mut seed = 0x1234_5678_u32;
        let mut random = || {
            seed = seed.wrapping_mul(1_664_525).wrapping_add(1_013_904_223);
            (seed >> 8) as f32 / 16_777_216.0
        };
        let mut colliders = Vec::new();
        for id in 0..257 {
            let min = Vec3::new(random(), random(), random()) * 100.0 - Vec3::splat(50.0);
            let extent = Vec3::new(random(), random(), random()) * 8.0 + Vec3::splat(0.01);
            colliders.push(Collider {
                id,
                bounds: Aabb::new(min, min + extent).unwrap(),
            });
        }
        let world = world(colliders.clone());
        for i in 0..200 {
            let min = Vec3::new(random(), random(), random()) * 100.0 - Vec3::splat(50.0);
            let bounds = Aabb::new(min, min + Vec3::splat(20.0)).unwrap();
            let ignore = (i % 2 == 0).then_some(i);
            let mut expected: Vec<_> = colliders
                .iter()
                .filter(|c| Some(c.id) != ignore && c.bounds.intersects(bounds))
                .map(|c| c.id)
                .collect();
            let mut actual: Vec<_> = world.query(bounds, ignore).iter().map(|c| c.id).collect();
            actual.sort_unstable();
            expected.sort_unstable();
            assert_eq!(actual, expected, "query {i}");
        }
        // Every collider's own bounds, including exact face/edge overlaps.
        for c in &colliders {
            let mut expected: Vec<_> = colliders
                .iter()
                .filter(|other| other.bounds.intersects(c.bounds))
                .map(|other| other.id)
                .collect();
            let mut actual: Vec<_> = world
                .query(c.bounds, None)
                .iter()
                .map(|other| other.id)
                .collect();
            actual.sort_unstable();
            expected.sort_unstable();
            assert_eq!(actual, expected);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn bvh_prunes_separated_colliders_and_rebuild_clears_old_nodes() {
        let mut world = world(
            (0..1024)
                .map(|id| {
                    let x = id as f32 * 10.0;
                    collider(id, [x, 0.0, 0.0], [x + 1.0, 1.0, 1.0])
                })
                .collect(),
        );
        let bounds = Aabb::new(Vec3::ZERO, Vec3::ONE).unwrap();
        let mut hits = Vec::new();
        let checks = world.visit_query(bounds, None, |c| hits.push(c.id));
        assert_eq!(hits, vec![0]);
        assert!(checks <= LEAF_SIZE, "tested {checks} of 1024 colliders");
        let motion = world.move_character(Vec3::new(-2.0, 0.0, 0.5), HALF, Vec3::X * 4.0, None);
        assert_eq!(motion.candidates, 1);
        world.rebuild(Vec::new());
        assert!(world.query(bounds, None).is_empty());
        assert!(world.nodes.is_empty());
        world.rebuild(vec![collider(9, [0.0; 3], [1.0; 3])]);
        assert_eq!(world.query(bounds, None)[0].id, 9);
    }

    #[test]
    fn empty_world_and_invalid_motion_are_stable() {
        let world = CollisionWorld::default();
        let result = world.move_character(Vec3::ZERO, HALF, Vec3::new(3.0, -2.0, 4.0), None);
        assert_position(result.position, Vec3::new(3.0, -2.0, 4.0));
        assert_eq!(result.candidates, 0);
        assert!(!result.grounded && !result.hit_ceiling);
        for half in [Vec3::ZERO, Vec3::NEG_ONE, Vec3::splat(f32::NAN)] {
            let result = world.move_character(Vec3::ONE, half, Vec3::X, None);
            assert_position(result.position, Vec3::ONE);
        }
    }
}


# File: src/combo_display.rs
//! Opt-in Rust-owned combo rows. Assets remain shared; only live rows own instances.
use crate::{scene::SceneManager as Scene, xr_round::ComboEvent};
use glam::Vec3;
use serde_json::{json, Value};

// A full authored minute has 140 targets; cap malformed external counts as well.
const MAX_CHAIN_ICONS: usize = 144;
const CHAIN_PULSE_SECONDS: f32 = 0.76;
const STOCK_FRAME_EMISSION: f32 = 8.;
const RETIRE_SECONDS: f32 = 0.95;

struct RetiredPart {
    id: u32,
    start: Vec3,
    scale: Vec3,
    target: Vec3,
}
struct RetiredRow {
    age: f32,
    parts: Vec<RetiredPart>,
    earned_bonus: u64,
    earned_points: u64,
    score_label: Option<u32>,
}

fn chain_arrival(progress: f32) -> (f32, f32) {
    let t = progress.clamp(0., 1.);
    if t < 0.45 {
        let remaining = (1. - t / 0.45).powi(3);
        (0.55 + 0.80 * (1. - remaining), remaining)
    } else if t < 0.72 {
        let u = (t - 0.45) / 0.27;
        let eased = u * u * (3. - 2. * u);
        (1.35 - 0.60 * eased, 0.)
    } else {
        let remaining = (1. - (t - 0.72) / 0.28).powi(3);
        (1. - 0.25 * remaining, 0.)
    }
}

fn chain_landing_glow(progress: f32) -> f32 {
    let t = if progress < 0.50 {
        (progress - 0.38) / 0.12
    } else {
        (1. - progress) / 0.50
    }
    .clamp(0., 1.);
    t * t * (3. - 2. * t)
}

struct Symbol {
    kind: String,
    asset: u32,
    variant: u32,
}
pub struct ComboDisplay {
    notice_seconds: f32,
    stack_score_panel: Option<u32>,
    stock_score_panels: Option<[u32; 2]>,
    retired: Option<RetiredRow>,
    pending_bonus: u64,
    stack_score_pulse: f32,
    chain_pulse: [f32; 2],
    pub chain_mode: bool,
    chain_rows: [Option<Row>; 2],
    symbols: Vec<Symbol>,
    frame_asset: u32,
    origin: Vec3,
    spacing: f32,
    row_gap: f32,
    fruit_scale: f32,
    frame_scale: Vec3,
    seconds: f32,
    pub timer_panel: u32,
    pub score_panel: u32,
    awards: [u32; 3],
    current: Option<Row>,
    history: Vec<Row>,
}
struct Row {
    kind: String,
    count: u32,
    success: bool,
    points: u32,
    age: f32,
    icons: Vec<u32>,
    frames: Vec<u32>,
}
impl Row {
    fn new(kind: String, count: u32, success: bool, points: u32) -> Self {
        Self {
            kind,
            count,
            success,
            points,
            age: 0.,
            icons: vec![],
            frames: vec![],
        }
    }
    fn remove(&mut self, scene: &mut Scene) {
        for id in self.icons.drain(..).chain(self.frames.drain(..)) {
            scene.remove_object(id);
        }
    }
    fn value(&self, seconds: f32, label: u32) -> Value {
        json!({"kind":self.kind,"count":self.count,"success":self.success,"points":self.points,
            "age":self.age,"opacity":(1.-self.age/seconds).clamp(0.,1.),"icons":self.icons,"frames":self.frames,"label":label})
    }
}
impl ComboDisplay {
    pub fn configure(scene: &Scene, input: &str) -> Option<Self> {
        let v: Value = serde_json::from_str(input).ok()?;
        let chain_mode = match v.get("mode").and_then(Value::as_str) {
            None if v.get("mode").is_none() => false,
            Some("legacy") => false,
            Some("chains") => true,
            _ => return None,
        };
        let id = |v: &Value| v.as_u64().and_then(|n| u32::try_from(n).ok());
        let vector = |key: &str, default: [f32; 3]| -> Option<Vec3> {
            let Some(v) = v.get(key) else {
                return Some(Vec3::from(default));
            };
            let a = v.as_array()?;
            if a.len() != 3 {
                return None;
            }
            let out = Vec3::new(
                a[0].as_f64()? as f32,
                a[1].as_f64()? as f32,
                a[2].as_f64()? as f32,
            );
            out.is_finite().then_some(out)
        };
        let number = |key: &str, default: f32| -> Option<f32> {
            let n = v
                .get(key)
                .map_or(Some(default), |n| n.as_f64().map(|n| n as f32))?;
            (n.is_finite() && n > 0. && n <= 100.).then_some(n)
        };
        let mut symbols = vec![];
        for s in v["symbols"].as_array()? {
            let kind = s["kind"].as_str()?.to_owned();
            let asset = id(&s["asset"])?;
            let variant = id(&s["variant"])?;
            if kind.is_empty()
                || symbols.iter().any(|s: &Symbol| s.kind == kind)
                || !scene
                    .mesh_variants
                    .get(&asset)
                    .is_some_and(|a| a.registered && (variant as usize) < a.variants.len())
            {
                return None;
            }
            symbols.push(Symbol {
                kind,
                asset,
                variant,
            });
        }
        if symbols.is_empty() || symbols.len() > 64 {
            return None;
        }
        let frame_asset = id(&v["frameAsset"])?;
        if !scene
            .mesh_variants
            .get(&frame_asset)
            .is_some_and(|a| a.registered)
        {
            return None;
        }
        let timer_panel = id(&v["timerPanel"])?;
        let score_panel = id(&v["scorePanel"])?;
        let a = v["awardPanels"].as_array()?;
        if a.len() != 3 {
            return None;
        }
        let awards = [id(&a[0])?, id(&a[1])?, id(&a[2])?];
        let panels = [timer_panel, score_panel, awards[0], awards[1], awards[2]];
        for (i, p) in panels.iter().enumerate() {
            let expected = match i {
                0 => crate::info_panel::PanelKind::Countdown,
                1 => crate::info_panel::PanelKind::Score,
                _ => crate::info_panel::PanelKind::ComboAward,
            };
            if panels[..i].contains(p)
                || !scene.info_panels.get(p).is_some_and(|panel| {
                    panel.kind == expected
                        || (i >= 2 && panel.kind == crate::info_panel::PanelKind::DebugText)
                })
            {
                return None;
            }
        }
        let stack_score_panel = match v.get("stackScorePanel") {
            None => None,
            Some(value) => {
                let id = id(value)?;
                if panels.contains(&id)
                    || !scene
                        .info_panels
                        .get(&id)
                        .is_some_and(|p| p.kind == crate::info_panel::PanelKind::ComboAward)
                {
                    return None;
                }
                Some(id)
            }
        };
        let stock_score_panels = match v.get("stockScorePanels") {
            None => None,
            Some(value) => {
                let values = value.as_array()?;
                if values.len() != 2 {
                    return None;
                }
                let ids = [id(&values[0])?, id(&values[1])?];
                if ids[0] == ids[1]
                    || ids.iter().any(|id| {
                        panels.contains(id)
                            || stack_score_panel == Some(*id)
                            || !scene
                                .info_panels
                                .get(id)
                                .is_some_and(|p| p.kind == crate::info_panel::PanelKind::ComboAward)
                    })
                {
                    return None;
                }
                Some(ids)
            }
        };
        Some(Self {
            stack_score_panel,
            stock_score_panels,
            retired: None,
            pending_bonus: 0,
            stack_score_pulse: 0.,
            notice_seconds: 0.,
            chain_pulse: [0.; 2],
            chain_mode,
            chain_rows: [None, None],
            symbols,
            frame_asset,
            origin: vector("origin", [0., 1.5, -2.])?,
            spacing: number("spacing", 0.4)?,
            row_gap: number("rowGap", 0.4)?,
            fruit_scale: number("fruitScale", 0.1)?,
            frame_scale: vector("frameScale", [0.15, 1., 1.])?,
            seconds: number("historySeconds", 2.)?,
            timer_panel,
            score_panel,
            awards,
            current: None,
            history: vec![],
        })
    }
    pub fn clear(&mut self, scene: &mut Scene) {
        self.clear_retired(scene);
        self.notice_seconds = 0.;
        self.pending_bonus = 0;
        self.stack_score_pulse = 0.;
        self.chain_pulse = [0.; 2];
        for row in self.chain_rows.iter_mut() {
            if let Some(mut row) = row.take() {
                row.remove(scene);
            }
        }
        if let Some(mut row) = self.current.take() {
            row.remove(scene);
        }
        for row in &mut self.history {
            row.remove(scene);
        }
        self.history.clear();
        for id in self
            .awards
            .into_iter()
            .chain(self.stack_score_panel)
            .chain(self.stock_score_panels.into_iter().flatten())
        {
            if let Some(panel) = scene.info_panels.get_mut(&id) {
                panel.update(vec![("", String::new())]);
            }
            scene.set_opacity(id, 0., 8., 0., -1.);
        }
    }
    pub fn sync_chains(
        &mut self,
        scene: &mut Scene,
        chains: &[Option<crate::xr_round::FruitChain>; 2],
    ) {
        let mut hit = false;
        for (index, chain) in chains.iter().enumerate() {
            let kind = chain.as_ref().map_or("", |c| c.kind.as_str());
            let count = chain.as_ref().map_or(0, |c| c.count);
            if count > 0
                && self.chain_rows[index]
                    .as_ref()
                    .is_some_and(|r| r.count > 0 && r.kind != kind)
            {
                let old = self.chain_rows[index].take().unwrap();
                self.retire_row(scene, old, index);
            }
            let row =
                self.chain_rows[index].get_or_insert_with(|| Row::new(String::new(), 0, false, 0));
            let new_hit = count > 0 && (row.kind != kind || count > row.count);
            hit |= new_hit;
            if count == 0 {
                self.chain_pulse[index] = 0.;
            } else if new_hit {
                self.chain_pulse[index] = CHAIN_PULSE_SECONDS;
            }
            if row.kind != kind {
                for id in row.icons.drain(..) {
                    scene.remove_object(id);
                }
                row.kind = kind.into();
            }
            row.count = count;
            row.points = chain.as_ref().map_or(0, |c| c.points);
            let frame_count = (count as usize).min(MAX_CHAIN_ICONS);
            while row.frames.len() > frame_count {
                if let Some(id) = row.frames.pop() {
                    scene.remove_object(id);
                }
            }
            while row.frames.len() < frame_count {
                let Ok(id) = scene.add_mesh_variant(self.frame_asset, 0) else {
                    break;
                };
                row.frames.push(id);
            }
            if let Some(symbol) = self.symbols.iter().find(|s| s.kind == kind) {
                while row.icons.len() > (count as usize).min(MAX_CHAIN_ICONS) {
                    if let Some(id) = row.icons.pop() {
                        scene.remove_object(id);
                    }
                }
                while row.icons.len() < (count as usize).min(MAX_CHAIN_ICONS) {
                    let Ok(id) = scene.add_mesh_variant(symbol.asset, symbol.variant) else {
                        break;
                    };
                    row.icons.push(id);
                }
            }
            let center = self.origin + Vec3::new(if index == 0 { -0.65 } else { 0.65 }, 0., 0.);
            let direction = if index == 0 { -1. } else { 1. };
            let step = self.spacing;
            let icon_scale = self.fruit_scale;
            for (ids, scale, icons) in [
                (&row.frames, self.frame_scale, false),
                (&row.icons, Vec3::splat(icon_scale), true),
            ] {
                for (slot, &id) in ids.iter().enumerate() {
                    scene.set_object_position(
                        id,
                        center
                            + Vec3::new(
                                direction * (slot as f32 * step - self.spacing),
                                0.,
                                if icons { 0.02 } else { 0. },
                            ),
                    );
                    scene.set_object_scale(id, scale);
                    scene.set_opacity(id, 1., 8., 0., -1.);
                    scene.set_emission(id, if icons { 3. } else { STOCK_FRAME_EMISSION });
                    scene.set_render_options(
                        id,
                        crate::scene::RenderOptions {
                            casts_shadow: false,
                            receives_shadow: false,
                            ..Default::default()
                        },
                    );
                }
            }
            let id = self.awards[index];
            if let Some(panel) = scene.info_panels.get_mut(&id) {
                panel.update(vec![(
                    "",
                    if count == 0 {
                        String::new()
                    } else {
                        count.to_string()
                    },
                )]);
            }
            let debug = scene
                .info_panels
                .get(&id)
                .is_some_and(|p| p.kind == crate::info_panel::PanelKind::DebugText);
            scene.set_object_position(
                id,
                center + Vec3::new(0., if debug { -0.14 } else { -0.23 }, 0.),
            );
            scene.set_opacity(id, if count == 0 { 0. } else { 1. }, 8., 0., -1.);
            scene.set_emission(id, if debug { 0. } else { 4. });
            self.sync_chain_pulse(scene, index);
            if let Some(ids) = self.stock_score_panels {
                let id = ids[index];
                let value = chain.as_ref().map_or(0, |c| c.total_points());
                if let Some(panel) = scene.info_panels.get_mut(&id) {
                    panel.update(vec![("", format!("+{value}"))]);
                }
                scene.set_object_position(
                    id,
                    self.origin + Vec3::new(if index == 0 { -0.32 } else { 0.32 }, -0.22, 0.04),
                );
                scene.set_opacity(id, if count > 0 { 1. } else { 0. }, 8., 0., -1.);
                self.sync_stock_score(scene, index);
            }
        }
        self.pending_bonus = chains
            .iter()
            .flatten()
            .fold(0_u64, |sum, c| sum.saturating_add(c.value()));
        if hit {
            self.stack_score_pulse = 0.42;
        }
        if chains.iter().all(Option::is_none) {
            self.stack_score_pulse = 0.;
        }
        if let Some(id) = self.stack_score_panel {
            if let Some(panel) = scene.info_panels.get_mut(&id) {
                panel.update(vec![("", format!("+{}", self.pending_bonus))]);
            }
            scene.set_object_position(id, self.origin + Vec3::new(0., 0., 0.04));
            scene.set_opacity(id, 1., 8., 0., -1.);
            self.sync_stack_score(scene);
        }
    }
    fn sync_stack_score(&self, scene: &mut Scene) {
        let Some(id) = self.stack_score_panel else {
            return;
        };
        let pulse = (self.stack_score_pulse / 0.42).powi(2);
        let sign = scene
            .objects()
            .get(&id)
            .map_or(1., |o| o.transform.scale.x.signum());
        let size = 1. + 0.12 * pulse;
        scene.set_object_scale(id, Vec3::new(sign * size, size, size));
        scene.set_emission(id, 4. + 4. * pulse);
    }
    fn sync_stock_score(&self, scene: &mut Scene, index: usize) {
        let Some(ids) = self.stock_score_panels else {
            return;
        };
        let id = ids[index];
        let pulse = (self.chain_pulse[index] / CHAIN_PULSE_SECONDS).powi(2);
        let sign = scene
            .objects()
            .get(&id)
            .map_or(1., |o| o.transform.scale.x.signum());
        scene.set_object_scale(
            id,
            Vec3::new(
                sign * (1. + 0.12 * pulse),
                1. + 0.12 * pulse,
                1. + 0.12 * pulse,
            ),
        );
        scene.set_emission(id, 4. + 4. * pulse);
    }
    fn clear_retired(&mut self, scene: &mut Scene) {
        if let Some(row) = self.retired.take() {
            for part in row.parts {
                scene.remove_object(part.id);
            }
        }
    }
    fn retire_row(&mut self, scene: &mut Scene, row: Row, index: usize) {
        // One outgoing row at most; transfer existing instances rather than clone them.
        self.clear_retired(scene);
        let center = scene
            .objects()
            .get(&self.score_panel)
            .map_or(self.origin + Vec3::Y * 0.24, |o| {
                o.transform.position - Vec3::Y * 0.24
            });
        let count = row.icons.len().max(row.frames.len());
        let mut parts = Vec::with_capacity(row.icons.len() + row.frames.len() + 1);
        for (ids, icons) in [(&row.icons, true), (&row.frames, false)] {
            for (index, &id) in ids.iter().enumerate() {
                if let Some(object) = scene.objects().get(&id) {
                    parts.push(RetiredPart {
                        id,
                        start: object.transform.position,
                        scale: object.transform.scale,
                        target: center
                            + Vec3::new(
                                (index as f32 - (count.saturating_sub(1)) as f32 * 0.5)
                                    * self.spacing
                                    * 0.65,
                                0.,
                                if icons { 0.04 } else { 0.02 },
                            ),
                    });
                }
            }
        }
        let earned_bonus = crate::xr_round::FruitChain {
            kind: row.kind,
            count: row.count,
            points: row.points,
        }
        .value();
        let earned_points = u64::from(row.count)
            .saturating_mul(crate::xr_round::CHAIN_HIT_POINTS)
            .saturating_add(earned_bonus);
        let mut score_label = None;
        if earned_points > 0 {
            if let Ok(id) = scene.add_info_panel("combo-award", 0.42, 0.12) {
                if let Some(panel) = scene.info_panels.get_mut(&id) {
                    panel.update(vec![("", format!("+{earned_points}"))]);
                }
                let source = self
                    .stock_score_panels
                    .map(|ids| ids[index])
                    .unwrap_or(self.score_panel);
                let sign = scene
                    .objects()
                    .get(&source)
                    .map_or(1., |o| o.transform.scale.x.signum());
                let start =
                    self.origin + Vec3::new(if index == 0 { -0.32 } else { 0.32 }, -0.22, 0.06);
                let scale = Vec3::new(sign, 1., 1.);
                scene.set_object_position(id, start);
                scene.set_object_scale(id, scale);
                scene.set_emission(id, 4.);
                scene.set_render_options(
                    id,
                    crate::scene::RenderOptions {
                        casts_shadow: false,
                        receives_shadow: false,
                        ..Default::default()
                    },
                );
                parts.push(RetiredPart {
                    id,
                    start,
                    scale,
                    target: center + Vec3::new(0., -0.11, 0.06),
                });
                score_label = Some(id);
            }
        }
        self.retired = Some(RetiredRow {
            age: 0.,
            parts,
            earned_bonus,
            earned_points,
            score_label,
        });
    }
    fn advance_retired(&mut self, scene: &mut Scene, dt: f32) {
        let Some(row) = &mut self.retired else {
            return;
        };
        row.age += dt;
        if row.age >= RETIRE_SECONDS {
            self.clear_retired(scene);
            return;
        }
        let t = row.age / RETIRE_SECONDS;
        let travel = 1. - (1. - (t / 0.6).min(1.)).powi(3);
        let fade = ((t - 0.35) / 0.65).clamp(0., 1.);
        let opacity = (1. - fade).powi(2);
        for part in &row.parts {
            scene.set_object_position(
                part.id,
                part.start.lerp(part.target, travel) + Vec3::Y * (0.05 * fade),
            );
            scene.set_object_scale(
                part.id,
                part.scale * (1. - 0.35 * travel) * (1. - 0.65 * fade * fade),
            );
            scene.set_opacity(part.id, opacity, 8., 0., -1.);
        }
    }
    fn sync_chain_pulse(&self, scene: &mut Scene, index: usize) {
        let Some(row) = &self.chain_rows[index] else {
            return;
        };
        let Some(&id) = row.icons.last() else {
            return;
        };
        // Arrival -> overshoot -> squash -> settle; one local highlight per hit.
        let remaining = self.chain_pulse[index] / CHAIN_PULSE_SECONDS;
        let landing = chain_landing_glow(1. - remaining);
        let (size, flight) = chain_arrival(1. - remaining);
        let direction = if index == 0 { -1. } else { 1. };
        let step = self.spacing;
        let center = self.origin + Vec3::new(direction * 0.65, 0., 0.);
        let destination = center
            + Vec3::new(
                direction * ((row.icons.len() - 1) as f32 * step - self.spacing),
                0.,
                0.02,
            );
        scene.set_object_position(
            id,
            destination + Vec3::new(direction * 0.90, 0., 0.) * flight,
        );
        let scale = self.fruit_scale;
        scene.set_object_scale(id, Vec3::splat(scale * size));
        for &fruit in &row.icons {
            scene.set_emission(fruit, 3. + if fruit == id { 5. } else { 2.5 } * landing);
        }
        // Fruit accents fade after landing; earned frame glow remains at its baseline.
        if let Some(&frame) = row.frames.get(row.icons.len() - 1) {
            scene.set_object_position(
                frame,
                destination - Vec3::new(0., 0., 0.02)
                    + Vec3::new(direction * 0.90, 0., 0.) * flight,
            );
            scene.set_object_scale(frame, self.frame_scale * size);
        }
    }
    pub fn notice(&mut self, scene: &mut Scene, label: String) {
        if !self.chain_mode {
            return;
        }
        self.notice_seconds = 0.5;
        let id = self.awards[2];
        if let Some(panel) = scene.info_panels.get_mut(&id) {
            panel.update(vec![("", label)]);
        }
        scene.set_object_position(id, self.origin + Vec3::new(0., -0.56, 0.));
        scene.set_opacity(id, 1., 8., 0., -1.);
        scene.set_emission(id, 4.);
    }
    pub fn reset(&mut self, scene: &mut Scene) {
        if self.chain_mode {
            self.clear(scene);
            self.sync_chains(scene, &[None, None]);
            return;
        }
        if let Some(mut r) = self.current.take() {
            r.remove(scene);
        }
        for r in &mut self.history {
            r.remove(scene);
        }
        self.history.clear();
        self.sync(scene);
    }
    pub fn event(&mut self, scene: &mut Scene, event: ComboEvent) {
        if let Some((kind, count)) = event.failed {
            if let Some(mut row) = self.current.take() {
                row.remove(scene);
            }
            self.history.insert(0, Row::new(kind, count, false, 0));
        }
        if let Some(mut row) = self.current.take() {
            row.remove(scene);
        }
        if event.success {
            self.history
                .insert(0, Row::new(event.kind, event.count, true, event.points));
        } else {
            self.current = Some(Row::new(event.kind, event.count, false, 0));
        }
        while self.history.len() > 3 {
            self.history.pop().unwrap().remove(scene);
        }
        self.sync(scene);
    }
    pub fn advance(&mut self, scene: &mut Scene, dt: f32) {
        if self.chain_mode {
            if !dt.is_finite() || dt <= 0. {
                return;
            }
            self.advance_retired(scene, dt);
            if self.stack_score_pulse > 0. {
                self.stack_score_pulse = (self.stack_score_pulse - dt).max(0.);
                self.sync_stack_score(scene);
            }
            for index in 0..2 {
                if self.chain_pulse[index] > 0. {
                    self.chain_pulse[index] = (self.chain_pulse[index] - dt).max(0.);
                    self.sync_chain_pulse(scene, index);
                    self.sync_stock_score(scene, index);
                }
            }
            if self.notice_seconds > 0. {
                self.notice_seconds = (self.notice_seconds - dt).max(0.);
                if self.notice_seconds == 0. {
                    if let Some(panel) = scene.info_panels.get_mut(&self.awards[2]) {
                        panel.update(vec![("", String::new())]);
                    }
                    scene.set_opacity(self.awards[2], 0., 8., 0., -1.);
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        if !dt.is_finite() || dt <= 0. || self.history.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        for r in &mut self.history {
            r.age += dt;
        }
        self.history.retain_mut(|r| {
            if r.age >= self.seconds {
                r.remove(scene);
                false
            } else {
                true
            }
        });
        self.sync(scene);
    }
    fn sync(&mut self, scene: &mut Scene) {
        for (row_index, row) in self
            .current
            .iter_mut()
            .map(|r| (0, r))
            .chain(self.history.iter_mut().enumerate().map(|(i, r)| (i + 1, r)))
        {
            let Some(symbol) = self.symbols.iter().find(|s| s.kind == row.kind) else {
                continue;
            };
            while row.icons.len() < row.count.min(3) as usize {
                let Ok(id) = scene.add_mesh_variant(symbol.asset, symbol.variant) else {
                    break;
                };
                row.icons.push(id);
            }
            while row.frames.len() < 3 {
                let Ok(id) = scene.add_mesh_variant(self.frame_asset, 0) else {
                    break;
                };
                row.frames.push(id);
            }
            let opacity = if row_index == 0 {
                1.
            } else {
                (1. - row.age / self.seconds).clamp(0., 1.)
            };
            for (ids, scale, emission, icons) in [
                (&row.icons, Vec3::splat(self.fruit_scale), 3., true),
                (&row.frames, self.frame_scale, 7., false),
            ] {
                for (slot, &id) in ids.iter().enumerate() {
                    scene.set_object_position(
                        id,
