                let count = (start.distance(end) / 0.16).ceil().max(1.) as usize;
                for step in 1..=count {
                    result.push(start.lerp(end, step as f32 / count as f32));
                    tangents.push(direction);
                }
            };
            for i in 1..points.len() - 1 {
                let incoming = (points[i] - points[i - 1]).normalize();
                let outgoing = (points[i + 1] - points[i]).normalize();
                if turns[i].abs() < 1e-6 {
                    line(&mut result, &mut tangents, points[i]);
                    continue;
                }
                let trim = radius * tan_half[i];
                let start = points[i] - incoming * trim;
                let end = points[i] + outgoing * trim;
                let center = start + incoming.perp() * turns[i].signum() * radius;
                let initial_angle = (start - center).to_angle();
                line(&mut result, &mut tangents, start);
                let count = (turns[i].abs() / (PI / 48.)).ceil().max(4.) as usize;
                for step in 1..=count {
                    let angle = initial_angle + turns[i] * step as f32 / count as f32;
                    result.push(if step == count {
                        end
                    } else {
                        center + Vec2::from_angle(angle) * radius
                    });
                    tangents.push(if step == count {
                        outgoing
                    } else {
                        Vec2::from_angle(angle).perp() * turns[i].signum()
                    });
                }
            }
            line(&mut result, &mut tangents, *points.last().unwrap());
            NumericStroke {
                points: result,
                tangents,
            }
        })
        .collect()
}

fn bound_mesh(mesh: &mut ImportedMesh) {
    for axis in 0..3 {
        mesh.bounds_min[axis] = mesh
            .vertices
            .iter()
            .map(|v| v.position[axis])
            .fold(f32::INFINITY, f32::min);
        mesh.bounds_max[axis] = mesh
            .vertices
            .iter()
            .map(|v| v.position[axis])
            .fold(f32::NEG_INFINITY, f32::max);
    }
}
fn tube_triangle(mesh: &mut ImportedMesh, vertices: [&ImportedVertex; 3]) {
    use glam::Vec3;
    let [a, b, c] = vertices.map(|v| Vec3::from_array(v.position));
    if (b - a).cross(c - a).length_squared() < 1e-14 {
        return;
    }
    let base = mesh.vertices.len() as u32;
    mesh.vertices.extend(vertices.into_iter().cloned());
    mesh.indices.extend([base, base + 1, base + 2]);
}
fn build_numeric_glyph(digit: u8) -> ImportedMesh {
    use glam::{Vec2, Vec3};
    use std::f32::consts::{FRAC_PI_2, TAU};
    let mut mesh = empty_mesh(5., 7.);
    for stroke in digit_paths(digit) {
        let points = stroke.points;
        let closed = points.first().unwrap().distance(*points.last().unwrap()) < 1e-5;
        let last = points.len() - 1;
        let tangent = |i: usize| stroke.tangents[i];
        let mut rings = Vec::new();
        let mut ring = |center: Vec2, dir: Vec2, cap: f32| {
            let side = Vec3::new(-dir.y, dir.x, 0.);
            let dir = dir.extend(0.);
            let mut vertices = Vec::with_capacity(TUBE_SIDES + 1);
            for j in 0..=TUBE_SIDES {
                let theta = (j % TUBE_SIDES) as f32 / TUBE_SIDES as f32 * TAU;
                let radial = side * theta.cos() + Vec3::Z * theta.sin();
                // Exact shared seams/poles keep every capsule watertight.
                let (cap_sin, cap_cos) = if cap.abs() == FRAC_PI_2 {
                    (cap.signum(), 0.)
                } else {
                    cap.sin_cos()
                };
                let normal = radial * cap_cos + dir * cap_sin;
                let mut position = center.extend(0.) + normal * TUBE_RADIUS;
                position.z = position.z / (2. * TUBE_RADIUS) - 0.5;
                let normal = Vec3::new(normal.x, normal.y, normal.z * 2. * TUBE_RADIUS).normalize();
                vertices.push(ImportedVertex {
                    position: position.to_array(),
                    normal: normal.to_array(),
                    // Internal numeric GPU payload: unit capsule axis packed as RGB.
                    color: (dir * 0.5 + Vec3::splat(0.5)).to_array(),
                });
            }
            rings.push(vertices);
        };
        if !closed {
            for i in 0..6 {
                ring(
                    points[0],
                    tangent(0),
                    -FRAC_PI_2 + (i as f32 / 6.) * FRAC_PI_2,
                );
            }
        }
        for (i, &point) in points.iter().enumerate() {
            ring(point, tangent(i), 0.);
        }
        if !closed {
            for i in 1..=6 {
                ring(points[last], tangent(last), (i as f32 / 6.) * FRAC_PI_2);
            }
        }
        for pair in rings.windows(2) {
            for j in 0..TUBE_SIDES {
                // Tangent x radial points outward for this winding.
                tube_triangle(&mut mesh, [&pair[0][j], &pair[1][j + 1], &pair[1][j]]);
                tube_triangle(&mut mesh, [&pair[0][j], &pair[0][j + 1], &pair[1][j + 1]]);
            }
        }
    }
    bound_mesh(&mut mesh);
    mesh
}
/// Canonical curved tube assets; cloned CPU diagnostics share exactly the same shape.
pub(crate) fn numeric_glyph(digit: u8) -> ImportedMesh {
    numeric_glyph_ref(digit).clone()
}
fn numeric_glyph_ref(digit: u8) -> &'static ImportedMesh {
    static GLYPHS: std::sync::OnceLock<[ImportedMesh; 10]> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();
    &GLYPHS.get_or_init(|| std::array::from_fn(|d| build_numeric_glyph(d as u8)))[digit as usize]
}
/// Narrow blue axis ribbons feed one soft halo through the existing cached pass.
#[cfg_attr(not(any(test, target_arch = "wasm32")), allow(dead_code))]
pub(crate) fn numeric_glyph_glow(digit: u8) -> ImportedMesh {
    let mut mesh = empty_mesh(5., 7.);
    for points in digit_curves(digit) {
        for pair in points.windows(2) {
            let side = (pair[1] - pair[0]).normalize().perp() * 0.0001;
            let base = mesh.vertices.len() as u32;
            for point in [
                pair[0] - side,
                pair[1] - side,
                pair[1] + side,
                pair[0] + side,
            ] {
                mesh.vertices.push(ImportedVertex {
                    position: [point.x, point.y, 0.001],
                    normal: [0., 0., 1.],
                    color: TIMER_BLUE,
                });
            }
            mesh.indices
                .extend([base, base + 1, base + 2, base, base + 2, base + 3]);
        }
    }
    bound_mesh(&mut mesh);
    mesh
}
fn numeric_layout(value: &str, width: f32, height: f32) -> Vec<(u8, f32, f32, f32)> {
    if value.is_empty() || !value.bytes().all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()) {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    let mut min = f32::INFINITY;
    let mut max = f32::NEG_INFINITY;
    for (i, d) in value.bytes().enumerate() {
        let mesh = numeric_glyph_ref(d - b'0');
        min = min.min(i as f32 * GLYPH_ADVANCE + mesh.bounds_min[0]);
        max = max.max(i as f32 * GLYPH_ADVANCE + mesh.bounds_max[0]);
    }
    let unit = (width * 0.94 / (max - min)).min(height * 0.90 / 7.);
    let center = (min + max) * 0.5;
    value
        .bytes()
        .enumerate()
        .map(|(i, d)| {
            (
                d - b'0',
                (i as f32 * GLYPH_ADVANCE - center) * unit,
                unit,
                2. * TUBE_RADIUS * unit,
            )
        })
        .collect()
}
fn numeric_geometry(width: f32, height: f32, value: &str) -> ImportedMesh {
    let mut mesh = empty_mesh(width, height);
    for (digit, x, unit, depth) in numeric_layout(value, width, height) {
        let glyph = numeric_glyph(digit);
        let base = mesh.vertices.len() as u32;
        mesh.indices.extend(glyph.indices.iter().map(|i| i + base));
        for mut v in glyph.vertices {
            // Public CPU diagnostics keep the visible palette; the canonical
            // render asset uses RGB only to carry its per-capsule axis.
            v.color = TIMER_BLUE;
            v.position = [
                v.position[0] * unit + x,
                v.position[1] * unit,
                v.position[2] * depth + 0.003,
            ];
            v.normal = glam::Vec3::new(v.normal[0] / unit, v.normal[1] / unit, v.normal[2] / depth)
                .normalize()
                .to_array();
            mesh.vertices.push(v);
        }
    }
    if !mesh.vertices.is_empty() {
        bound_mesh(&mut mesh);
    }
    mesh
}
impl InfoPanel {
    pub(crate) fn numeric(&self) -> bool {
        self.font3d_bound
            || matches!(
                self.kind,
                PanelKind::Countdown | PanelKind::Score | PanelKind::NumericText
            )
    }
    pub(crate) fn set_font3d_bound(&mut self, bound: bool) {
        self.font3d_bound = bound;
        if !bound {
            self.mesh = geometry(self.kind, self.width, self.height, &self.rows);
            self.dirty = true;
        }
    }
    pub(crate) fn font3d_value(&self) -> Result<&str, String> {
        if !matches!(
            self.kind,
            PanelKind::Countdown
                | PanelKind::Score
                | PanelKind::NumericText
                | PanelKind::ComboAward
                | PanelKind::DebugText
        ) {
            return Err("Font binding requires a single-value text panel".into());
        }
        Ok(self.rows.first().map_or("", |row| row.1.as_str()))
    }
    pub(crate) fn numeric_layout(&self) -> Vec<(u8, f32, f32, f32)> {
        numeric_layout(
            self.rows.first().map_or("", |row| row.1.as_str()),
            self.width,
            self.height,
        )
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod numeric_tube_tests {
    use super::*;
    use glam::Vec3;
    #[test]
    fn info_panel_numeric_tubes_preserve_axis_payload_and_immutable_cache() {
        for digit in 0..10 {
            let canonical = numeric_glyph_ref(digit);
            assert!(std::ptr::eq(canonical, numeric_glyph_ref(digit)));
            let mut clone = numeric_glyph(digit);
            let mut varying_axis = false;
            for triangle in clone.indices.as_chunks::<3>().0 {
                let axes = triangle.map(|index| {
                    Vec3::from_array(clone.vertices[index as usize].color) * 2. - Vec3::ONE
                });
                assert!(axes
                    .iter()
                    .all(|axis| (axis.length() - 1.).abs() < 1e-5 && axis.z.abs() < 1e-6));
                varying_axis |= !axes[0].abs_diff_eq(axes[1], 1e-5);
            }
            assert!(
                digit == 1 || varying_axis,
                "digit {digit} lost its smooth bend axis gradient"
            );
            let diagnostics = numeric_geometry(4., 0.7, &char::from(b'0' + digit).to_string());
            assert!(diagnostics
                .vertices
                .iter()
                .all(|vertex| vertex.color == TIMER_BLUE));
            let original = canonical.vertices[0].color;
            clone.vertices[0].color = [0.; 3];
            assert_eq!(numeric_glyph_ref(digit).vertices[0].color, original);
            assert_eq!(clone.bounds_min, canonical.bounds_min);
            assert_eq!(clone.bounds_max, canonical.bounds_max);
            assert_eq!(clone.indices, canonical.indices);
        }
        assert!(digit_curves(0).iter().all(|stroke| stroke.len() > 24));
    }
    #[test]
    fn info_panel_separate_stencil_strokes_have_real_surface_gaps() {
        use glam::Vec2;
        let point_gap = |p: Vec2, a: Vec2, b: Vec2| {
            let axis = b - a;
            p.distance(a + axis * ((p - a).dot(axis) / axis.length_squared()).clamp(0., 1.))
        };
        for digit in 0..10 {
            let strokes = digit_curves(digit);
            for i in 0..strokes.len() {
                for j in i + 1..strokes.len() {
                    let mut gap = f32::INFINITY;
                    for a in strokes[i].windows(2) {
                        for b in strokes[j].windows(2) {
                            let cross = (a[1] - a[0]).perp_dot(b[1] - b[0]);
                            if cross.abs() > 1e-7 {
                                let t = (b[0] - a[0]).perp_dot(b[1] - b[0]) / cross;
                                let u = (b[0] - a[0]).perp_dot(a[1] - a[0]) / cross;
                                assert!(
                                    !((0. ..=1.).contains(&t) && (0. ..=1.).contains(&u)),
                                    "digit {digit} has crossing stencil strokes"
                                );
                            }
                            gap = gap
                                .min(point_gap(a[0], b[0], b[1]))
                                .min(point_gap(a[1], b[0], b[1]))
                                .min(point_gap(b[0], a[0], a[1]))
                                .min(point_gap(b[1], a[0], a[1]));
                        }
                    }
                    assert!(
                        gap > 2. * TUBE_RADIUS + 0.01,
                        "digit {digit}: capped strokes overlap at axis gap {gap}"
                    );
                }
            }
        }
    }
    #[test]
    fn info_panel_numeric_capsules_are_closed_with_middle_diameter_and_axis_halo() {
        for digit in 0..10 {
            let mesh = numeric_glyph_ref(digit);
            let capsule = &digit_curves(digit)[0];
            let side = (capsule[1] - capsule[0]).normalize().perp();
            let ends = [capsule[0] + side * 0.58, capsule[0] - side * 0.58];
            for point in ends {
                assert!(mesh
                    .vertices
                    .iter()
                    .any(|v| Vec3::from_array(v.position).distance(point.extend(-0.5)) < 1e-5));
            }
            assert!((ends[0].distance(ends[1]) - 1.16).abs() < 1e-5);
            let halo = numeric_glyph_glow(digit);
            for (points, source) in halo.vertices.as_chunks::<4>().0.iter().zip(
                digit_curves(digit)
                    .iter()
                    .flat_map(|stroke| stroke.windows(2)),
            ) {
                let axis = source[1] - source[0];
                for vertex in points {
                    let point = glam::Vec2::new(vertex.position[0], vertex.position[1]);
                    let t = (point - source[0]).dot(axis) / axis.length_squared();
                    assert!((-1e-5..=1. + 1e-5).contains(&t));
                    assert!((point.distance(source[0] + axis * t) - 0.0001).abs() < 1e-5);
                }
            }
            for triangle in halo.indices.as_chunks::<3>().0 {
                let [a, b, c] =
                    triangle.map(|index| Vec3::from_array(halo.vertices[index as usize].position));
                assert!((b - a).cross(c - a).z > 0.);
            }
            let mut edges = std::collections::BTreeMap::<[[u32; 3]; 2], usize>::new();
            for triangle in mesh.indices.as_chunks::<3>().0 {
                let points = triangle.map(|index| {
                    mesh.vertices[index as usize].position.map(|v| {
                        if v == 0. {
                            0
                        } else {
                            v.to_bits()
                        }
                    })
                });
                for (a, b) in [(0, 1), (1, 2), (2, 0)] {
                    let mut edge = [points[a], points[b]];
                    edge.sort_unstable();
                    *edges.entry(edge).or_default() += 1;
                }
            }
            assert!(
                edges.values().all(|count| count % 2 == 0),
                "open capsule for {digit}"
            );
            let panel = numeric_geometry(4., 0.7, &char::from(b'0' + digit).to_string());
            assert!(panel.bounds_max[0] - panel.bounds_min[0] <= 4. * 0.94 + 1e-5);
            assert!(panel.bounds_max[1] - panel.bounds_min[1] <= 0.7 + 1e-5);
        }
    }
    #[test]
    fn info_panel_extended_numbers_fit_long_values_without_touching() {
        let zero = numeric_glyph_ref(0);
        assert!(zero.bounds_max[0] - zero.bounds_min[0] > 6.5);
        for value in ["30", "120", "12345678", "888888888888"] {
            let layout = numeric_layout(value, 1.55, 0.25);
            let mesh = numeric_geometry(1.55, 0.25, value);
            assert!(mesh.bounds_max[0] - mesh.bounds_min[0] <= 1.55 * 0.94 + 1e-5);
            for pair in layout.windows(2) {
                let a = numeric_glyph_ref(pair[0].0);
                let b = numeric_glyph_ref(pair[1].0);
                assert!(
                    pair[0].1 + a.bounds_max[0] * pair[0].2
                        < pair[1].1 + b.bounds_min[0] * pair[1].2
                );
            }
        }
    }
    #[test]
    fn info_panel_numeric_tubes_have_smooth_round_surfaces_and_blue_axis_halos() {
        for digit in 0..10 {
            let mesh = numeric_glyph(digit);
            assert!(mesh.vertices.len() > 1000);
            assert!((mesh.bounds_max[2] - mesh.bounds_min[2] - 1.).abs() < 1e-5);
            assert!(mesh.vertices.iter().all(|vertex| {
                let axis = Vec3::from_array(vertex.color) * 2. - Vec3::ONE;
                axis.is_finite() && (axis.length() - 1.).abs() < 1e-5
            }));
            for tri in mesh.indices.as_chunks::<3>().0 {
                let [a, b, c] = tri.map(|i| Vec3::from_array(mesh.vertices[i as usize].position));
                let n = tri
                    .map(|i| Vec3::from_array(mesh.vertices[i as usize].normal))
                    .into_iter()
                    .sum::<Vec3>();
                assert!(a.is_finite() && b.is_finite() && c.is_finite());
                assert!(
                    (b - a).cross(c - a).dot(n) > 0.,
                    "inward triangle for {digit}"
                );
            }
            for stroke in digit_curves(digit) {
                for points in stroke.windows(3) {
                    let a = points[0].distance(points[1]);
                    let b = points[1].distance(points[2]);
                    let c = points[0].distance(points[2]);
                    let twice_area = (points[1] - points[0])
                        .perp_dot(points[2] - points[0])
                        .abs();
                    if twice_area > 1e-7 {
                        let radius = a * b * c / (2. * twice_area);
                        assert!(
                            radius > TUBE_RADIUS,
                            "digit {digit} has unsafe bend radius {radius}"
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
            let halo = numeric_glyph_glow(digit);
            assert!(halo.vertices.iter().all(|v| v.color == TIMER_BLUE));
            // One font unit scales XY; normalized depth must restore the same diameter.
            let layout = numeric_layout("0", 1.2, 0.3);
            assert!((layout[0].3 / layout[0].2 - 1.16).abs() < 1e-6);
        }
    }
}

// Active panel storage only: geometric growth, shrink below one quarter, no
// inactive pool. All current payloads are 4-byte aligned. Device limit is kept.
#[cfg(any(target_arch = "wasm32", test))]
pub(crate) fn buffer_capacity(required: u64, current: u64, limit: u64) -> u64 {
    let needed = required.max(4);
    if needed > current || needed < current / 4 {
        needed.next_power_of_two().min(limit).max(needed)
    } else {
        current
    }
}
#[cfg(test)]
mod buffer_capacity_tests {
    use super::buffer_capacity;
    #[test]
    fn grows_shrinks_and_keeps_active_capacity_bounded() {
        let mut capacity = 0;
        for size in [0, 4, 36, 1000, 500, 100, 0, 1000, 4] {
            capacity = buffer_capacity(size, capacity, 4096);
            assert!(capacity >= size.max(4));
            assert!(capacity <= size.max(4) * 4);
            assert_eq!(capacity % 4, 0);
        }
        assert_eq!(buffer_capacity(3000, 0, 3072), 3072);
        assert_eq!(buffer_capacity(1024, 4096, 8192), 4096);
        assert_eq!(buffer_capacity(1020, 4096, 8192), 1024);
    }
}


# File: src/input/active_camera.rs
use crate::input::camera::{Camera, CameraController};
use crate::input::character::CharacterController;
use crate::input::orbit_camera::OrbitCamera;
use glam::{Mat4, Vec3};

#[derive(Copy, Clone)]
pub enum CameraType {
    Free,
    Orbit,
}

pub struct ActiveCamera {
    free: Camera,
    orbit: OrbitCamera,
    active: CameraType,
    character: Option<CharacterController>,
    pending_characters: Vec<CharacterController>,
    aspect: f32,
}

impl ActiveCamera {
    pub fn new(aspect: f32) -> Self {
        Self {
            free: Camera::new(aspect),
            orbit: OrbitCamera::new(aspect),
            active: CameraType::Orbit,
            character: None,
            pending_characters: Vec::new(),
            aspect,
        }
    }

    pub fn set_type(&mut self, ty: CameraType) {
        self.clear_input();
        self.detach_character();
        self.active = ty;
    }

    fn detach_character(&mut self) {
        if let Some(character) = self.character.take() {
            self.pending_characters.push(character);
        }
    }

    pub fn set_view(&mut self, position: Vec3, target: Vec3) -> bool {
        if !self.free.set_view(position, target) {
            return false;
        }
        self.set_type(CameraType::Free);
        true
    }

    pub fn set_orbit_view(&mut self, position: Vec3, target: Vec3) -> bool {
        if !self.orbit.set_view(position, target) {
            return false;
        }
        self.set_type(CameraType::Orbit);
        true
    }

    pub fn adjust_orbit(&mut self, dx: f32, dy: f32, zoom: f32) -> bool {
        if !matches!(self.active, CameraType::Orbit) || self.character.is_some() {
            return false;
        }
        self.orbit.adjust(dx, dy, zoom)
    }

    pub fn orbit_target(&self) -> Option<Vec3> {
        (matches!(self.active, CameraType::Orbit) && self.character.is_none())
            .then(|| self.orbit.target())
    }

    pub fn set_aspect(&mut self, aspect: f32) {
        self.aspect = aspect;
        self.free.set_aspect(aspect);
        self.orbit.set_aspect(aspect);
        if let Some(character) = &mut self.character {
            character.set_aspect(aspect);
        }
    }

    /// Clips are ordered idle, walk, run. Invalid options leave the current view intact.
    pub fn follow_object(
        &mut self,
        id: u32,
        position: Vec3,
        speed: f32,
        run_speed: f32,
        model_yaw: f32,
        clips: [Option<usize>; 3],
    ) -> bool {
        let Some(character) = CharacterController::new(
            id,
            position,
            speed,
            run_speed,
            model_yaw,
            clips,
            self.aspect,
        ) else {
            return false;
        };
        self.clear_input();
        self.detach_character();
        self.character = Some(character);
        true
    }

    /// Call before reading matrix() each frame; update() alone never moves a character.
    pub fn update_scene(&mut self, scene: &mut crate::scene::SceneManager, dt: f32) {
        // Complete old ownership first, so a rebind wins even within the same frame.
        for character in self.pending_characters.drain(..) {
            character.finish(scene);
        }
        if let Some(character) = &mut self.character {
            if !character.update_scene(scene, dt) {
                self.clear_input();
                self.character = None;
            }
        }
    }

    pub fn character_state(&self) -> Option<(u32, Vec3, bool, bool)> {
        self.character.as_ref().map(CharacterController::state)
    }

    pub fn set_character_physics(
        &mut self,
        physics: crate::input::character::CharacterPhysics,
    ) -> bool {
        self.character
            .as_mut()
            .is_some_and(|character| character.set_physics(physics))
    }

    pub fn character_physics_state(&self) -> Option<(bool, f32, usize)> {
        self.character
            .as_ref()
            .map(CharacterController::physics_state)
    }

    fn active_mut(&mut self) -> &mut dyn CameraController {
        if let Some(character) = &mut self.character {
            return character;
        }
        match self.active {
            CameraType::Free => &mut self.free,
            CameraType::Orbit => &mut self.orbit,
        }
    }

    fn active_ref(&self) -> &dyn CameraController {
        if let Some(character) = &self.character {
            return character;
        }
        match self.active {
            CameraType::Free => &self.free,
            CameraType::Orbit => &self.orbit,
        }
    }
}

impl CameraController for ActiveCamera {
    fn clear_input(&mut self) {
        self.free.clear_input();
        self.orbit.clear_input();
        if let Some(character) = &mut self.character {
            character.clear_input();
        }
    }

    fn key_down(&mut self, code: String) {
        self.active_mut().key_down(code);
    }

    fn key_up(&mut self, code: String) {
        self.active_mut().key_up(code);
    }

    fn mouse_move(&mut self, dx: f32, dy: f32) {
        self.active_mut().mouse_move(dx, dy);
    }

    fn update(&mut self, dt: f32) {
        self.active_mut().update(dt);
    }

    fn matrix(&self) -> Mat4 {
        self.active_ref().matrix()
    }

    fn position(&self) -> Vec3 {
        self.active_ref().position()
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn explicit_free_view_projects_target_and_rejects_invalid_input() {
        let mut camera = ActiveCamera::new(1.0);
        let position = Vec3::new(12.0, 3.0, 0.0);
        let target = Vec3::new(-8.0, 5.0, 0.0);
        assert!(camera.set_view(position, target));
        assert_eq!(camera.position(), position);
        let clip = camera.matrix() * target.extend(1.0);
        assert!(clip.x.abs() < 1e-5 && clip.y.abs() < 1e-5 && clip.w > 0.0);
        let previous = camera.matrix();
        for bad in [position, Vec3::splat(f32::NAN), position + Vec3::Y] {
            assert!(!camera.set_view(position, bad));
            assert_eq!(camera.matrix(), previous);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn switching_camera_releases_held_keys() {
        let mut camera = ActiveCamera::new(16.0 / 9.0);
        camera.set_type(CameraType::Free);
        camera.key_down("KeyW".into());
        camera.update(0.5);
        let position = camera.position();
        camera.set_type(CameraType::Orbit);
        camera.key_up("KeyW".into());
        camera.set_type(CameraType::Free);
        camera.update(0.5);
        assert_eq!(camera.position(), position);
    }

    #[test]
    fn clearing_input_stops_movement_in_both_modes() {
        for mode in [CameraType::Free, CameraType::Orbit] {
            let mut camera = ActiveCamera::new(16.0 / 9.0);
            camera.set_type(mode);
            camera.key_down("KeyW".into());
            let before = camera.position();
            camera.update(0.25);
            assert_ne!(camera.position(), before);
            camera.clear_input();
            let stopped = camera.position();
            camera.update(1.0);
            assert_eq!(camera.position(), stopped);
            assert!(camera.matrix().is_finite());
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn camera_projects_target_in_webgpu_depth_range() {
        let camera = ActiveCamera::new(16.0 / 9.0);
        let target = camera.matrix().project_point3(Vec3::ZERO);
        assert!(target.x.abs() < 1e-5 && target.y.abs() < 1e-5);
        assert!((0.0..1.0).contains(&target.z));
    }

    #[test]
    fn orbit_commands_seed_switch_and_reject_other_modes() {
        let mut camera = ActiveCamera::new(1.0);
        camera.set_type(CameraType::Free);
        assert!(!camera.adjust_orbit(1.0, 1.0, 0.0));
        assert_eq!(camera.orbit_target(), None);
        let position = Vec3::new(10.0, 5.0, 3.0);
        let target = Vec3::new(1.0, 1.0, -2.0);
        assert!(camera.set_orbit_view(position, target));
        assert!(camera.position().distance(position) < 1e-5);
        assert_eq!(camera.orbit_target(), Some(target));
        camera.key_down("KeyW".into());
        assert!(camera.set_orbit_view(position, target));
        let stopped = camera.position();
        camera.update(1.0);
        assert_eq!(camera.position(), stopped);
        assert!(camera.adjust_orbit(20.0, 0.0, 0.0));
        camera.set_type(CameraType::Free);
        assert_eq!(camera.orbit_target(), None);
        assert!(!camera.adjust_orbit(0.0, 0.0, 0.0));
    }
}


# File: src/input/camera.rs
use glam::{Mat4, Vec3};
use std::collections::HashSet;

pub trait CameraController {
    fn key_down(&mut self, code: String);
    fn key_up(&mut self, code: String);
    fn mouse_move(&mut self, dx: f32, dy: f32);
    fn clear_input(&mut self);

    fn update(&mut self, dt: f32);
    fn matrix(&self) -> Mat4;
    fn position(&self) -> Vec3;
}

pub struct Camera {
    pub position: Vec3,
    yaw: f32,
    pitch: f32,
    pub speed: f32,
    pub sensitivity: f32,
    pressed: HashSet<String>,
    aspect: f32,
}

impl Camera {
    pub fn new(aspect: f32) -> Self {
        Self {
            position: Vec3::new(5.0, 3.0, 5.0),
            yaw: -3.0 * std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_4,
            pitch: -0.4,
            speed: 2.0,
            sensitivity: 0.002,
            pressed: HashSet::new(),
            aspect,
        }
    }

    /// Configure a free-camera view. All orientation calculations remain in Rust.
    pub fn set_view(&mut self, position: Vec3, target: Vec3) -> bool {
        let direction = target - position;
        if !position.is_finite()
            || !target.is_finite()
            || !direction.is_finite()
            || direction.length_squared() < 1e-8
            || !direction.length_squared().is_finite()
        {
            return false;
        }
        let forward = direction.normalize();
        if forward.x * forward.x + forward.z * forward.z < 1e-4 {
            return false;
        }
        self.position = position;
        self.yaw = forward.z.atan2(forward.x);
        self.pitch = forward.y.asin();
        self.pressed.clear();
        true
    }

    pub fn set_aspect(&mut self, aspect: f32) {
        self.aspect = aspect;
    }

    pub fn key_down(&mut self, code: String) {
        self.pressed.insert(code);
    }

    pub fn key_up(&mut self, code: String) {
        self.pressed.remove(&code);
    }

    pub fn mouse_move(&mut self, dx: f32, dy: f32) {
        self.yaw -= dx * self.sensitivity;
        self.pitch = (self.pitch + dy * self.sensitivity).clamp(-1.54, 1.54);
    }

    pub fn update(&mut self, dt: f32) {
        let speed = self.speed
            * if self.pressed.contains("ShiftLeft") || self.pressed.contains("ShiftRight") {
                4.0
            } else {
                1.0
            };
        let forward = self.forward();
        let right = Vec3::Y.cross(forward).normalize();
        if self.pressed.contains("KeyW") {
            self.position += forward * speed * dt;
        }
        if self.pressed.contains("KeyS") {
            self.position -= forward * speed * dt;
        }
        if self.pressed.contains("KeyA") {
            self.position -= right * speed * dt;
        }
        if self.pressed.contains("KeyD") {
            self.position += right * speed * dt;
        }
        if self.pressed.contains("KeyE") {
            self.position.y += speed * dt;
        }
        if self.pressed.contains("KeyQ") {
            self.position.y -= speed * dt;
        }
    }

    pub fn matrix(&self) -> Mat4 {
        let view = glam::camera::lh::view::look_at_mat4(
            self.position,
            self.position + self.forward(),
            Vec3::Y,
        );
        let proj = glam::camera::lh::proj::directx::perspective(
            std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_4,
            self.aspect,
            0.1,
            100.0,
        );
        proj * view
    }

    fn forward(&self) -> Vec3 {
        Vec3::new(
            self.yaw.cos() * self.pitch.cos(),
            self.pitch.sin(),
            self.yaw.sin() * self.pitch.cos(),
        )
        .normalize()
    }
}

impl CameraController for Camera {
    fn clear_input(&mut self) {
        self.pressed.clear();
    }

    fn key_down(&mut self, code: String) {
        Camera::key_down(self, code);
    }

    fn key_up(&mut self, code: String) {
        Camera::key_up(self, code);
    }

    fn mouse_move(&mut self, dx: f32, dy: f32) {
        Camera::mouse_move(self, dx, dy);
    }

    fn update(&mut self, dt: f32) {
        Camera::update(self, dt);
    }

    fn matrix(&self) -> Mat4 {
        Camera::matrix(self)
    }

    fn position(&self) -> Vec3 {
        self.position
    }
}


# File: src/input/character.rs
//! Native third-person movement and chase camera, independent of browser listeners.
use super::camera::CameraController;
use crate::scene::SceneManager;
use glam::{Mat4, Vec3};
use std::collections::HashSet;

const DISTANCE: f32 = 7.0;
const TARGET_HEIGHT: f32 = 1.2;
const MAX_DT: f32 = 0.1;
const SENSITIVITY: f32 = 0.002;
const PHYSICS_STEP: f32 = 1.0 / 120.0;

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct CharacterPhysics {
    pub half_extents: Vec3,
    pub gravity: f32,
    pub jump_speed: f32,
}
impl CharacterPhysics {
    fn valid(self) -> bool {
        self.half_extents.is_finite()
            && self.half_extents.min_element() > 0.0
            && self.gravity.is_finite()
            && self.gravity > 0.0
            && self.jump_speed.is_finite()
            && self.jump_speed > 0.0
    }
}

pub struct CharacterController {
    id: u32,
    root: Vec3,
    speed: f32,
    run_speed: f32,
    model_yaw: f32,
    clips: [Option<usize>; 3],
    animation_state: Option<usize>,
    owned_playback: Option<(usize, u64)>,
    yaw: f32,
    pitch: f32,
    aspect: f32,
    pressed: HashSet<String>,
    moving: bool,
    running: bool,
    physics: Option<CharacterPhysics>,
    vertical_velocity: f32,
    grounded: bool,
    jump_requested: bool,
    collision_candidates: usize,
}

impl CharacterController {
    pub fn new(
        id: u32,
        position: Vec3,
        speed: f32,
        run_speed: f32,
        model_yaw: f32,
        clips: [Option<usize>; 3],
        aspect: f32,
    ) -> Option<Self> {
        if !position.is_finite()
            || !speed.is_finite()
            || speed <= 0.0
            || !run_speed.is_finite()
            || run_speed <= 0.0
            || !model_yaw.is_finite()
        {
            return None;
        }
        Some(Self {
            id,
            root: position,
            speed,
            run_speed,
            model_yaw,
            clips,
            animation_state: None,
            owned_playback: None,
            yaw: 0.0,
            pitch: 0.35,
            aspect,
            pressed: HashSet::new(),
            moving: false,
            running: false,
            physics: None,
            vertical_velocity: 0.0,
            grounded: false,
            jump_requested: false,
            collision_candidates: 0,
        })
    }

    pub fn set_aspect(&mut self, aspect: f32) {
        self.aspect = aspect;
    }

    pub fn state(&self) -> (u32, Vec3, bool, bool) {
        (self.id, self.root, self.moving, self.running)
    }

    pub fn set_physics(&mut self, physics: CharacterPhysics) -> bool {
        if !physics.valid() {
            return false;
        }
        self.physics = Some(physics);
        self.vertical_velocity = 0.0;
        self.grounded = false;
        self.jump_requested = false;
        true
    }

    pub fn physics_state(&self) -> (bool, f32, usize) {
        (
            self.grounded,
            self.vertical_velocity,
            self.collision_candidates,
        )
    }

    /// False means the target was removed; the owner must detach and clear all inputs.
    pub fn update_scene(&mut self, scene: &mut SceneManager, dt: f32) -> bool {
        let Some(object) = scene.objects().get(&self.id) else {
            self.clear_input();
            return false;
        };
        let transform = object.transform;
        if transform.position != self.root {
            // Teleports are commands from the application, not accumulated physics.
            self.vertical_velocity = 0.0;
            self.grounded = false;
            self.jump_requested = false;
        }
        // Scene commands remain authoritative, including teleports while paused.
        self.root = transform.position;
        if scene.paused {
            self.clear_input();
            // Pause suppresses movement and animation mutations, but still follows the root.
            return true;
        }
        if !dt.is_finite() || dt < 0.0 {
            return true;
        }
        let dt = dt.min(MAX_DT);
        let axis = |positive: &str, negative: &str| {
            i32::from(self.pressed.contains(positive)) as f32
                - i32::from(self.pressed.contains(negative)) as f32
        };
        let forward = Vec3::new(self.yaw.sin(), 0.0, self.yaw.cos());
        let right = Vec3::Y.cross(forward);
        let direction =
            (forward * axis("KeyW", "KeyS") + right * axis("KeyD", "KeyA")).normalize_or_zero();
        self.moving = direction != Vec3::ZERO && dt > 0.0;
        self.running = self.moving
            && (self.pressed.contains("ShiftLeft") || self.pressed.contains("ShiftRight"));
        let mut rotation = transform.rotation;
        let mut position = self.root;
        if self.moving {
            let speed = if self.running {
                self.run_speed
            } else {
                self.speed
            };
            if self.physics.is_none() {
                position += direction * speed * dt;
            }
            rotation.y = direction.x.atan2(direction.z) + self.model_yaw;
        }
        if let Some(physics) = self.physics {
            let world = scene.collision_world();
            let support =
                world.move_character(position, physics.half_extents, Vec3::ZERO, Some(self.id));
            self.grounded = support.grounded;
            self.collision_candidates = support.candidates;
            if self.jump_requested && self.grounded && dt > 0.0 {
                self.vertical_velocity = physics.jump_speed;
                self.grounded = false;
            }
            if dt > 0.0 {
                self.jump_requested = false;
            }
            let speed = if self.running {
                self.run_speed
            } else {
                self.speed
            };
            let steps = (dt / PHYSICS_STEP).ceil() as usize;
            let step = if steps > 0 { dt / steps as f32 } else { 0.0 };
            for _ in 0..steps {
                self.vertical_velocity -= physics.gravity * step;
                let delta = direction * speed * step + Vec3::Y * self.vertical_velocity * step;
                let motion =
                    world.move_character(position, physics.half_extents, delta, Some(self.id));
                position = motion.position;
                self.grounded = motion.grounded;
                self.collision_candidates = self.collision_candidates.max(motion.candidates);
                if (motion.grounded && self.vertical_velocity < 0.0)
                    || (motion.hit_ceiling && self.vertical_velocity > 0.0)
                {
                    self.vertical_velocity = 0.0;
                }
            }
            self.moving = (position - self.root).with_y(0.0).length_squared() > 1e-10;
            self.running &= self.moving;
        }
        // One mutation for position + facing; keep the authored scale and X/Z rotation.
        if (position != transform.position || rotation != transform.rotation)
            && !scene.set_object_transform(self.id, position, rotation, transform.scale)
        {
            self.clear_input();
            return true;
        }
        self.root = position;
        let state = if self.running {
            2
        } else if self.moving {
            1
        } else {
            0
        };
        if self.animation_state != Some(state) {
            if let Some(clip) = self.clips[state] {
                // Optional clips may be absent/invalid; never retry/restart every frame.
                if scene.play_model_animation(self.id, clip, true, 1.0).is_ok() {
                    self.owned_playback = scene
                        .model(self.id)
                        .map(|model| (clip, model.playback_revision));
                }
            } else if self.owns_playback(scene) {
                let _ = scene.stop_model_animation(self.id);
                self.owned_playback = None;
            }
            self.animation_state = Some(state);
        }
        true
    }

    fn owns_playback(&self, scene: &SceneManager) -> bool {
        self.owned_playback.is_some_and(|(clip, revision)| {
            scene.model(self.id).is_some_and(|model| {
                model.playback_revision == revision
                    && model
                        .playback
                        .as_ref()
                        .is_some_and(|playback| playback.clip == clip)
            })
        })
    }

    /// Consumed once after detaching. Missing/replaced playback is left alone.
    /// While paused, freeze owned playback without changing the pose or scene revisions.
    /// Otherwise select idle, or stop if idle is missing/invalid.
    pub fn finish(self, scene: &mut SceneManager) {
        if !self.owns_playback(scene) {
            return;
        }
        if scene.paused {
            let _ = scene.pause_model_animation(self.id, true);
        } else if self.owned_playback.map(|(clip, _)| clip) != self.clips[0] {
            if let Some(idle) = self.clips[0] {
                if scene.play_model_animation(self.id, idle, true, 1.0).is_ok() {
                    return;
                }
            }
            let _ = scene.stop_model_animation(self.id);
        }
    }

    fn target(&self) -> Vec3 {
        self.root + Vec3::Y * TARGET_HEIGHT
    }
}

impl CameraController for CharacterController {
    fn key_down(&mut self, code: String) {
        if code == "Space" && self.physics.is_some() {
            if self.pressed.insert(code) {
                self.jump_requested = true;
            }
            return;
        }
        if matches!(
            code.as_str(),
            "KeyW" | "KeyA" | "KeyS" | "KeyD" | "ShiftLeft" | "ShiftRight"
        ) {
            self.pressed.insert(code);
        }
    }

    fn key_up(&mut self, code: String) {
        self.pressed.remove(&code);
    }

    fn mouse_move(&mut self, dx: f32, dy: f32) {
        if dx.is_finite() && dy.is_finite() {
            self.yaw = (self.yaw + dx * SENSITIVITY).rem_euclid(std::f32::consts::TAU);
            self.pitch = (self.pitch + dy * SENSITIVITY).clamp(0.08, 1.2);
        }
    }

    fn clear_input(&mut self) {
        self.pressed.clear();
        self.moving = false;
        self.running = false;
        self.jump_requested = false;
    }

    fn update(&mut self, _dt: f32) {
        // Movement requires SceneManager and is deliberately handled by update_scene only.
    }

    fn matrix(&self) -> Mat4 {
        let view = glam::camera::lh::view::look_at_mat4(self.position(), self.target(), Vec3::Y);
        let proj = glam::camera::lh::proj::directx::perspective(
            std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_4,
            self.aspect,
            0.1,
            100.0,
        );
        proj * view
    }

    fn position(&self) -> Vec3 {
        self.target()
            + DISTANCE
                * Vec3::new(
                    -self.yaw.sin() * self.pitch.cos(),
                    self.pitch.sin(),
                    -self.yaw.cos() * self.pitch.cos(),
                )
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::input::active_camera::{ActiveCamera, CameraType};

    fn setup() -> (SceneManager, ActiveCamera, u32) {
        let mut scene = SceneManager::default();
        let id = scene.add_cube(Vec3::ZERO);
        let mut camera = ActiveCamera::new(1.0);
        assert!(camera.follow_object(id, Vec3::ZERO, 2.0, 6.0, 0.0, [None; 3]));
        (scene, camera, id)
    }

    #[test]
    fn forward_is_positive_z_and_diagonals_have_equal_speed() {
        let (mut scene, mut camera, id) = setup();
        assert!(camera.position().z < 0.0);
        camera.key_down("KeyW".into());
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.1);
        let straight = scene.objects()[&id].transform.position;
        assert!((straight - Vec3::Z * 0.2).length() < 1e-6);
        let (mut scene, mut camera, id) = setup();
        camera.key_down("KeyW".into());
        camera.key_down("KeyD".into());
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.1);
        let diagonal = scene.objects()[&id].transform.position;
        assert!((diagonal.length() - straight.length()).abs() < 1e-6);
        assert!((diagonal.x - diagonal.z).abs() < 1e-6 && diagonal.x > 0.0);
        assert!(
            (scene.objects()[&id].transform.rotation.y - std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_4).abs() < 1e-6
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn opposing_keys_cancel_and_shift_only_runs_when_moving() {
        let (mut scene, mut camera, id) = setup();
        camera.key_down("ShiftRight".into());
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.1);
        assert_eq!(
            camera.character_state(),
            Some((id, Vec3::ZERO, false, false))
        );
        camera.key_down("KeyW".into());
        camera.key_down("KeyS".into());
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.1);
        assert_eq!(scene.objects()[&id].transform.position, Vec3::ZERO);
        camera.key_up("KeyS".into());
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.1);
        assert!((scene.objects()[&id].transform.position.z - 0.6).abs() < 1e-6);
        assert!(camera.character_state().unwrap().3);
        camera.key_up("ShiftRight".into());
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.1);
        assert!((scene.objects()[&id].transform.position.z - 0.8).abs() < 1e-6);
    }

    #[test]
    fn blur_clear_stops_motion_and_update_alone_never_moves_root() {
        let (mut scene, mut camera, id) = setup();
        camera.key_down("KeyW".into());
        camera.update(0.1);
        assert_eq!(camera.character_state().unwrap().1, Vec3::ZERO);
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.1);
        let position = scene.objects()[&id].transform.position;
        camera.clear_input();
        let revision = scene.render_revision();
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.1);
        assert_eq!(camera.character_state(), Some((id, position, false, false)));
        assert_eq!(scene.render_revision(), revision);
    }

    #[test]
    fn mouse_changes_camera_relative_movement_and_limits_pitch() {
        let (mut scene, mut camera, id) = setup();
        camera.mouse_move(std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2 / SENSITIVITY, 0.0);
        assert!(camera.position().x < 0.0);
        camera.key_down("KeyW".into());
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.1);
        assert!((scene.objects()[&id].transform.position - Vec3::X * 0.2).length() < 1e-6);
        for dy in [1e6, -1e6] {
            camera.mouse_move(0.0, dy);
            assert!(camera.matrix().is_finite());
            let root = camera.character_state().unwrap().1;
            let target = root + Vec3::Y * TARGET_HEIGHT;
            assert!(camera.position().y > target.y);
            let clip = camera.matrix() * target.extend(1.0);
            assert!(clip.x.abs() < 1e-5 && clip.y.abs() < 1e-5 && clip.w > 0.0);
        }
        let before = camera.matrix();
        camera.mouse_move(f32::NAN, f32::INFINITY);
        assert_eq!(camera.matrix(), before);
    }

    #[test]
    fn pause_clears_keys_and_does_not_mutate_scene() {
        let (mut scene, mut camera, id) = setup();
        camera.key_down("KeyW".into());
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.1);
        let position = scene.objects()[&id].transform.position;
        scene.paused = true;
        let revision = scene.render_revision();
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.1);
        camera.key_down("KeyW".into());
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.1);
        assert_eq!(scene.render_revision(), revision);
        assert_eq!(camera.character_state(), Some((id, position, false, false)));
        let teleported = Vec3::new(5.0, 2.0, -4.0);
        assert!(scene.set_object_position(id, teleported));
        let revision = scene.render_revision();
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.1);
        assert_eq!(
            camera.character_state(),
            Some((id, teleported, false, false))
        );
        assert_eq!(scene.render_revision(), revision);
        scene.paused = false;
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.1);
        assert_eq!(scene.objects()[&id].transform.position, teleported);
    }

    #[test]
    fn removal_or_clear_detaches_without_transferring_held_keys() {
        for clear in [false, true] {
            let (mut scene, mut camera, id) = setup();
            camera.key_down("KeyW".into());
            if clear {
                scene.clear();
            } else {
                assert!(scene.remove_object(id));
            }
            camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.1);
            assert!(camera.character_state().is_none());
            let before = camera.position();
            camera.update(0.1);
            assert_eq!(camera.position(), before);
            let replacement = scene.add_cube(Vec3::ZERO);
            assert!(camera.follow_object(replacement, Vec3::ZERO, 2.0, 6.0, 0.0, [None; 3]));
            camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.1);
            assert_eq!(scene.objects()[&replacement].transform.position, Vec3::ZERO);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn scene_position_is_authoritative_and_movement_preserves_scale() {
        let (mut scene, mut camera, id) = setup();
        let rotation = Vec3::new(0.2, 0.0, -0.3);
        let scale = Vec3::new(0.01, 0.02, 0.03);
        let root = Vec3::new(4.0, 0.5, 3.0);
        assert!(scene.set_object_transform(id, root, rotation, scale));
        // An outdated initial camera position must never reposition the scene object.
        assert!(camera.follow_object(id, Vec3::ZERO, 2.0, 6.0, 0.4, [None; 3]));
        let revision = scene.render_revision();
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.1);
        assert_eq!(scene.objects()[&id].transform.position, root);
        assert_eq!(camera.character_state().unwrap().1, root);
        assert_eq!(scene.render_revision(), revision);
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.1);
        assert_eq!(scene.render_revision(), revision);
        camera.key_down("KeyD".into());
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.1);
        let transform = scene.objects()[&id].transform;
        assert_eq!(transform.scale, scale);
        assert_eq!(transform.rotation.x, rotation.x);
        assert_eq!(transform.rotation.z, rotation.z);
        assert!((transform.rotation.y - std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2 - 0.4).abs() < 1e-6);
        camera.clear_input();
        let external = Vec3::new(1.0, 2.0, 3.0);
        assert!(scene.set_object_position(id, external));
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.1);
        assert_eq!(camera.character_state().unwrap().1, external);
    }

    #[test]
    fn suspended_tab_dt_is_clamped_and_invalid_dt_is_ignored() {
        let (mut scene, mut camera, id) = setup();
        camera.key_down("KeyW".into());
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 60.0);
        assert!((scene.objects()[&id].transform.position.z - 0.2).abs() < 1e-6);
        let revision = scene.render_revision();
        for dt in [f32::NAN, f32::INFINITY, -1.0] {
            camera.update_scene(&mut scene, dt);
        }
        assert_eq!(scene.render_revision(), revision);
    }

    #[test]
    fn invalid_options_preserve_controller_and_explicit_views_detach() {
        let (mut scene, mut camera, id) = setup();
        let before = camera.matrix();
        assert!(!camera.follow_object(id, Vec3::splat(f32::NAN), 2.0, 6.0, 0.0, [None; 3]));
        for bad in [0.0, -1.0, f32::NAN, f32::INFINITY] {
            assert!(!camera.follow_object(id, Vec3::ZERO, bad, 6.0, 0.0, [None; 3]));
            assert!(!camera.follow_object(id, Vec3::ZERO, 2.0, bad, 0.0, [None; 3]));
        }
        assert!(!camera.follow_object(id, Vec3::ZERO, 2.0, 6.0, f32::NAN, [None; 3]));
        assert_eq!(camera.matrix(), before);
        assert!(!camera.set_view(Vec3::ZERO, Vec3::ZERO));
        assert!(camera.character_state().is_some());
        camera.key_down("KeyW".into());
        camera.set_type(CameraType::Free);
        assert!(camera.character_state().is_none());
        let free_position = camera.position();
        camera.update(0.1);
        assert_eq!(camera.position(), free_position);
        assert!(camera.follow_object(id, Vec3::ZERO, 2.0, 6.0, 0.0, [None; 3]));
        assert!(camera.set_view(Vec3::new(3.0, 2.0, -3.0), Vec3::ZERO));
        assert!(camera.character_state().is_none());
        let revision = scene.render_revision();
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.1);
        assert_eq!(scene.render_revision(), revision);
    }

    #[test]
    fn animation_clips_change_only_on_idle_walk_run_transitions() {
        use crate::gltf_model::AnimationClip;
        let mut asset = crate::gltf_loader::parse_model(
            include_bytes!("../../tests/fixtures/gltf/triangle.gltf"),
            &[include_bytes!("../../tests/fixtures/gltf/triangle.bin").to_vec()],
            &[],
        )
        .unwrap();
        asset.animations = (0..3)
            .map(|_| AnimationClip {
                name: None,
                channels: vec![],
                duration: 2.0,
            })
            .collect();
        let mut scene = SceneManager::default();
        let id = scene.add_model(std::sync::Arc::new(asset)).unwrap();
        let mut camera = ActiveCamera::new(1.0);
        assert!(camera.follow_object(id, Vec3::ZERO, 2.0, 6.0, 0.0, [Some(0), Some(1), Some(2)]));
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.05);
        assert_eq!(scene.model(id).unwrap().playback.as_ref().unwrap().clip, 0);
        scene.update(0.05);
        let revision = scene.render_revision();
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.05);
        assert_eq!(scene.render_revision(), revision);
        assert_eq!(
            scene.model(id).unwrap().playback.as_ref().unwrap().time,
            0.05
        );
        camera.key_down("KeyW".into());
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.05);
        assert_eq!(scene.model(id).unwrap().playback.as_ref().unwrap().clip, 1);
        scene.update(0.05);
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.05);
        assert_eq!(
            scene.model(id).unwrap().playback.as_ref().unwrap().time,
            0.05
        );
        camera.key_down("ShiftLeft".into());
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.05);
        assert_eq!(scene.model(id).unwrap().playback.as_ref().unwrap().clip, 2);
        camera.clear_input();
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.05);
        assert_eq!(scene.model(id).unwrap().playback.as_ref().unwrap().clip, 0);
    }

    fn fox_asset() -> std::sync::Arc<crate::gltf_model::ModelAsset> {
        let asset = crate::gltf_loader::parse_model(
            include_bytes!("../../assets/models/fox/Fox.glb"),
            &[],
            &[],
        )
        .unwrap();
        let names: Vec<_> = asset
            .animations
            .iter()
            .map(|clip| clip.name.as_deref())
            .collect();
        assert_eq!(names, vec![Some("Survey"), Some("Walk"), Some("Run")]);
        std::sync::Arc::new(asset)
    }

    fn start_fox(
        asset: std::sync::Arc<crate::gltf_model::ModelAsset>,
        running: bool,
        idle: Option<usize>,
    ) -> (SceneManager, ActiveCamera, u32) {
        let mut scene = SceneManager::default();
        let id = scene.add_model(asset).unwrap();
        let mut camera = ActiveCamera::new(1.0);
        assert!(camera.follow_object(id, Vec3::ZERO, 2.0, 6.0, 0.0, [idle, Some(1), Some(2)]));
        camera.key_down("KeyW".into());
        if running {
            camera.key_down("ShiftLeft".into());
        }
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.05);
        assert_eq!(
            scene.model(id).unwrap().playback.as_ref().unwrap().clip,
            if running { 2 } else { 1 }
        );
        (scene, camera, id)
    }

    #[test]
    fn fox_detach_finishes_walk_run_once_for_mode_and_view_switches() {
        let asset = fox_asset();
        for running in [false, true] {
            for view in [false, true] {
                for idle in [Some(0), None, Some(usize::MAX)] {
                    let (mut scene, mut camera, id) = start_fox(asset.clone(), running, idle);
                    if view {
                        assert!(camera.set_view(Vec3::new(3.0, 2.0, -3.0), Vec3::ZERO));
                    } else {
                        camera.set_type(CameraType::Orbit);
                    }
                    assert!(camera.character_state().is_none());
                    camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.05);
                    let model = scene.model(id).unwrap();
                    if idle == Some(0) {
                        assert_eq!(model.playback.as_ref().unwrap().clip, 0);
                    } else {
                        assert!(model.playback.is_none());
                    }
                    let revision = scene.render_revision();
                    let model_revision = model.revision;
                    for _ in 0..3 {
                        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.05);
                    }
                    assert_eq!(scene.render_revision(), revision);
                    assert_eq!(scene.model(id).unwrap().revision, model_revision);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn fox_repeated_switches_and_rebinds_finish_before_new_owner() {
        let (mut scene, mut camera, id) = start_fox(fox_asset(), true, Some(0));
        camera.set_type(CameraType::Free);
        assert!(camera.follow_object(id, Vec3::ZERO, 2.0, 6.0, 0.0, [Some(0), Some(1), Some(2)]));
        camera.set_type(CameraType::Orbit);
        camera.set_type(CameraType::Free);
        assert!(camera.follow_object(id, Vec3::ZERO, 2.0, 6.0, 0.0, [Some(0), Some(1), Some(2)]));
        // Replacing a live controller also queues its completion, without dropping older work.
        assert!(camera.follow_object(id, Vec3::ZERO, 2.0, 6.0, 0.0, [Some(0), Some(1), Some(2)]));
        camera.key_down("KeyW".into());
        camera.key_down("ShiftLeft".into());
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.05);
        assert_eq!(scene.model(id).unwrap().playback.as_ref().unwrap().clip, 2);
        scene.update(0.05);
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.05);
        assert_eq!(
            scene.model(id).unwrap().playback.as_ref().unwrap().time,
            0.05
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn fox_detach_while_paused_freezes_pose_and_never_resumes_stale_playback() {
        let (mut scene, mut camera, id) = start_fox(fox_asset(), true, Some(0));
        scene.update(0.05);
        scene.paused = true;
        camera.set_type(CameraType::Free);
        let revision = scene.render_revision();
        let model_revision = scene.model(id).unwrap().revision;
        let transform = scene.objects()[&id].transform;
        let time = scene.model(id).unwrap().playback.as_ref().unwrap().time;
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.05);
        assert!(!scene.model(id).unwrap().playback.as_ref().unwrap().playing);
        assert_eq!(scene.render_revision(), revision);
        assert_eq!(scene.model(id).unwrap().revision, model_revision);
        assert_eq!(scene.objects()[&id].transform.position, transform.position);
        assert_eq!(scene.objects()[&id].transform.rotation, transform.rotation);
        scene.paused = false;
        scene.update(0.05);
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.05);
        assert_eq!(
            scene.model(id).unwrap().playback.as_ref().unwrap().time,
            time
        );
        assert_eq!(scene.render_revision(), revision);
    }

    #[test]
    fn fox_pending_finish_ignores_removed_target_and_external_playback() {
        let asset = fox_asset();
        for removed in [false, true] {
            let (mut scene, mut camera, id) = start_fox(asset.clone(), true, Some(0));
            camera.set_type(CameraType::Orbit);
            if removed {
                assert!(scene.remove_object(id));
            } else {
                // A scene command supersedes the clip last selected by this controller.
                scene.play_model_animation(id, 1, true, 1.0).unwrap();
            }
            let revision = scene.render_revision();
            camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.05);
            assert_eq!(scene.render_revision(), revision);
            if !removed {
                assert_eq!(scene.model(id).unwrap().playback.as_ref().unwrap().clip, 1);
            }
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn fox_pending_finish_preserves_external_same_clip_speed() {
        let (mut scene, mut camera, id) = start_fox(fox_asset(), true, Some(0));
        camera.set_type(CameraType::Orbit);
        scene.play_model_animation(id, 2, true, 0.5).unwrap();
        let revision = scene.render_revision();
        let playback_revision = scene.model(id).unwrap().playback_revision;
        for _ in 0..2 {
            camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.05);
        }
        let model = scene.model(id).unwrap();
        let playback = model.playback.as_ref().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(playback.clip, 2);
        assert_eq!(playback.speed, 0.5);
        assert!(playback.playing);
        assert_eq!(model.playback_revision, playback_revision);
        assert_eq!(scene.render_revision(), revision);
    }

    #[test]
    fn fox_pending_finish_preserves_external_pause_command_authority() {
        let asset = fox_asset();
        for paused in [false, true] {
            let (mut scene, mut camera, id) = start_fox(asset.clone(), true, Some(0));
            scene.paused = true;
            camera.set_type(CameraType::Free);
            scene.pause_model_animation(id, paused).unwrap();
            let revision = scene.render_revision();
            let playback_revision = scene.model(id).unwrap().playback_revision;
            camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.05);
            let model = scene.model(id).unwrap();
            let playback = model.playback.as_ref().unwrap();
            assert_eq!(playback.clip, 2);
            assert_eq!(playback.playing, !paused);
            assert_eq!(model.playback_revision, playback_revision);
            assert_eq!(scene.render_revision(), revision);
            scene.paused = false;
            camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.05);
            assert_eq!(
                scene.model(id).unwrap().playback_revision,
                playback_revision
            );
            assert_eq!(scene.render_revision(), revision);
        }
    }

    fn physics_setup() -> (SceneManager, ActiveCamera, u32, u32) {
        let mut scene = SceneManager::default();
        let floor = scene.add_cube(Vec3::new(0.0, -0.5, 0.0));
        scene.set_object_scale(floor, Vec3::new(20.0, 1.0, 20.0));
        scene.set_box_collider(floor, Vec3::splat(0.5), Vec3::ZERO);
        let id = scene.add_cube(Vec3::ZERO);
        let mut camera = ActiveCamera::new(1.0);
        camera.follow_object(id, Vec3::ZERO, 2.5, 5.0, 0.0, [None; 3]);
        assert!(camera.set_character_physics(CharacterPhysics {
            half_extents: Vec3::new(0.4, 0.8, 0.8),
            gravity: 18.0,
            jump_speed: 7.0,
        }));
        (scene, camera, id, floor)
    }

    fn physics_tick(scene: &mut SceneManager, camera: &mut ActiveCamera, frames: usize) {
        for _ in 0..frames {
            camera.update_scene(scene, 1.0 / 60.0);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn physics_blocks_walk_then_jumps_and_lands_without_held_key_bouncing() {
        let (mut scene, mut camera, id, _) = physics_setup();
        let platform = scene.add_cube(Vec3::new(0.0, 0.3, 3.0));
        scene.set_object_scale(platform, Vec3::new(2.6, 0.6, 2.0));
        scene.set_box_collider(platform, Vec3::splat(0.5), Vec3::ZERO);
        camera.key_down("KeyW".into());
        physics_tick(&mut scene, &mut camera, 60);
        assert!((scene.objects()[&id].transform.position.z - 1.2).abs() < 1e-4);
        assert!(camera.character_physics_state().unwrap().0);
        camera.key_down("Space".into());
        physics_tick(&mut scene, &mut camera, 12);
        assert!(scene.objects()[&id].transform.position.y > 0.5);
        assert!(!camera.character_physics_state().unwrap().0);
        physics_tick(&mut scene, &mut camera, 18);
        camera.key_up("KeyW".into());
        physics_tick(&mut scene, &mut camera, 60);
        assert!((scene.objects()[&id].transform.position.y - 0.6).abs() < 1e-4);
        camera.key_down("Space".into());
        physics_tick(&mut scene, &mut camera, 30);
        assert!((scene.objects()[&id].transform.position.y - 0.6).abs() < 1e-4);
        assert!(camera.character_physics_state().unwrap().0);
        camera.key_up("Space".into());
        camera.key_down("Space".into());
        physics_tick(&mut scene, &mut camera, 12);
        assert!(scene.objects()[&id].transform.position.y > 1.1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn physics_pause_teleport_and_removed_floor_do_not_keep_stale_motion_or_support() {
        let (mut scene, mut camera, id, floor) = physics_setup();
        physics_tick(&mut scene, &mut camera, 1);
        camera.key_down("Space".into());
        physics_tick(&mut scene, &mut camera, 12);
        let before = camera.character_state();
        let velocity = camera.character_physics_state().unwrap().1;
        scene.paused = true;
        physics_tick(&mut scene, &mut camera, 20);
        assert_eq!(camera.character_state().unwrap().1, before.unwrap().1);
        assert_eq!(camera.character_physics_state().unwrap().1, velocity);
        scene.set_object_position(id, Vec3::ZERO);
        scene.paused = false;
        physics_tick(&mut scene, &mut camera, 1);
        assert!(camera.character_physics_state().unwrap().0);
        assert_eq!(camera.character_physics_state().unwrap().1, 0.0);
        assert!(!camera.set_character_physics(CharacterPhysics {
            half_extents: Vec3::ZERO,
            gravity: 18.0,
            jump_speed: 7.0,
        }));
        scene.remove_collider(floor);
        physics_tick(&mut scene, &mut camera, 8);
        assert!(scene.objects()[&id].transform.position.y < 0.0);
        assert!(!camera.character_physics_state().unwrap().0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn physics_zero_delta_does_not_consume_a_queued_jump() {
        let (mut scene, mut camera, id, _) = physics_setup();
        physics_tick(&mut scene, &mut camera, 1);
        camera.key_down("Space".into());
        camera.update_scene(&mut scene, 0.0);
        assert_eq!(scene.objects()[&id].transform.position, Vec3::ZERO);
        physics_tick(&mut scene, &mut camera, 1);
        assert!(scene.objects()[&id].transform.position.y > 0.0);
    }
}


# File: src/input/keyboard.rs
#![cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]

use std::{cell::RefCell, rc::Rc};
use wasm_bindgen::{closure::Closure, JsCast};
use web_sys::{EventTarget, Window};

use crate::input::camera::CameraController;

pub struct Listener {
    target: EventTarget,
    name: &'static str,
    callback: Closure<dyn FnMut(web_sys::Event)>,
}
impl Listener {
    pub fn new(
        target: &EventTarget,
        name: &'static str,
        callback: impl FnMut(web_sys::Event) + 'static,
    ) -> Result<Self, wasm_bindgen::JsValue> {
        let callback = Closure::wrap(Box::new(callback) as Box<dyn FnMut(web_sys::Event)>);
        target.add_event_listener_with_callback(name, callback.as_ref().unchecked_ref())?;
        Ok(Self {
            target: target.clone(),
            name,
            callback,
        })
    }
}
impl Drop for Listener {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        let _ = self
            .target
            .remove_event_listener_with_callback(self.name, self.callback.as_ref().unchecked_ref());
    }
}

pub fn attach<T>(
    window: &Window,
    cam: Rc<RefCell<T>>,
) -> Result<Vec<Listener>, wasm_bindgen::JsValue>
where
    T: CameraController + 'static,
{
    let down = cam.clone();
    let up = cam.clone();
    Ok(vec![
        Listener::new(window.as_ref(), "keydown", move |e| {
            let event = e.unchecked_into::<web_sys::KeyboardEvent>();
            // Jump is a fresh key press, never an auto-repeat after pause/blur.
            if event.code() != "Space" || !event.repeat() {
                down.borrow_mut().key_down(event.code());
            }
        })?,
        Listener::new(window.as_ref(), "keyup", move |e| {
            up.borrow_mut()
                .key_up(e.unchecked_into::<web_sys::KeyboardEvent>().code())
        })?,
        Listener::new(window.as_ref(), "blur", move |_| {
            cam.borrow_mut().clear_input()
        })?,
    ])
}

# File: src/input/mouse.rs
#![cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]

use std::{cell::RefCell, rc::Rc};
use wasm_bindgen::JsCast;
use web_sys::{HtmlCanvasElement, MouseEvent, PointerEvent, Window};

use crate::input::camera::CameraController;

pub fn attach<T>(
    window: &Window,
    canvas: &HtmlCanvasElement,
    cam: Rc<RefCell<T>>,
) -> Result<Vec<super::keyboard::Listener>, wasm_bindgen::JsValue>
where
    T: CameraController + 'static,
{
    use super::keyboard::Listener;
    let dragging = Rc::new(RefCell::new(false));
    let down = dragging.clone();
    let up = dragging.clone();
    let target: web_sys::EventTarget = canvas.clone().into();
    let movement_canvas = canvas.clone();
    let document = window
        .document()
        .ok_or_else(|| wasm_bindgen::JsValue::from_str("Browser document unavailable"))?;
    Ok(vec![
        Listener::new(canvas.as_ref(), "pointerdown", move |e| {
            let e = e.unchecked_into::<PointerEvent>();
            if e.buttons() & 1 == 1 && e.target().as_ref() == Some(&target) {
                *down.borrow_mut() = true;
            }
        })?,
        Listener::new(window.as_ref(), "pointerup", move |_| {
            *up.borrow_mut() = false
        })?,
        Listener::new(window.as_ref(), "mousemove", move |e| {
            let e = e.unchecked_into::<MouseEvent>();
            let locked = document
                .pointer_lock_element()
                .as_ref()
                .is_some_and(|element| {
                    element == movement_canvas.unchecked_ref::<web_sys::Element>()
                });
            if locked || (*dragging.borrow() && e.buttons() & 1 == 1) {
                cam.borrow_mut()
                    .mouse_move(e.movement_x() as f32, e.movement_y() as f32);
            }
        })?,
    ])
}


# File: src/input/orbit_camera.rs
use glam::{Mat4, Vec3};
use std::collections::HashSet;

pub struct OrbitCamera {
    pub position: Vec3,
    target: Vec3,
    radius: f32,
    yaw: f32,
    pitch: f32,
    pub speed: f32,
    pub sensitivity: f32,
    pressed: HashSet<String>,
    aspect: f32,
}

impl OrbitCamera {
    pub fn new(aspect: f32) -> Self {
        let radius: f32 = 8.0;
        let yaw: f32 = std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_4;
        let pitch: f32 = 0.35;
        let target = Vec3::ZERO;
        let position = target
            + Vec3::new(
                radius * yaw.cos() * pitch.cos(),
                radius * pitch.sin(),
                radius * yaw.sin() * pitch.cos(),
            );
        Self {
            position,
            target,
            radius,
            yaw,
            pitch,
            speed: 2.0,
            sensitivity: 0.002,
            pressed: HashSet::new(),
            aspect,
        }
    }

    pub fn set_aspect(&mut self, aspect: f32) {
        self.aspect = aspect;
    }

    /// Seed an orbit view from a camera location and its look target.
    pub fn set_view(&mut self, position: Vec3, target: Vec3) -> bool {
        let offset = position - target;
        let radius = offset.length();
        if !position.is_finite()
            || !target.is_finite()
            || !offset.is_finite()
            || !radius.is_finite()
            || radius < 1e-4
        {
            return false;
        }
        let direction = offset / radius;
        if direction.x * direction.x + direction.z * direction.z < 1e-4 {
            return false;
        }
        let yaw = direction.z.atan2(direction.x);
        let pitch = direction.y.asin();
        self.target = target;
        self.radius = radius;
        self.yaw = yaw;
        self.pitch = pitch;
        self.position = self.orbit_position();
        self.pressed.clear();
        true
    }

    pub fn target(&self) -> Vec3 {
        self.target
    }

    pub fn adjust(&mut self, dx: f32, dy: f32, zoom: f32) -> bool {
        if !dx.is_finite() || !dy.is_finite() || !zoom.is_finite() {
            return false;
        }
        let yaw = self.yaw - dx * 0.005;
        let pitch = (self.pitch + dy * 0.005).clamp(0.08, 1.45);
        let radius = (self.radius * (zoom * 0.001).exp()).clamp(2.0, 45.0);
        if !yaw.is_finite() || !radius.is_finite() {
            return false;
        }
        self.yaw = yaw;
        self.pitch = pitch;
        self.radius = radius;
        self.position = self.orbit_position();
        true
    }

    fn orbit_position(&self) -> Vec3 {
        self.target
            + Vec3::new(
                self.radius * self.yaw.cos() * self.pitch.cos(),
                self.radius * self.pitch.sin(),
                self.radius * self.yaw.sin() * self.pitch.cos(),
            )
    }

    pub fn key_down(&mut self, code: String) {
        self.pressed.insert(code);
    }

    pub fn key_up(&mut self, code: String) {
        self.pressed.remove(&code);
    }

    pub fn mouse_move(&mut self, dx: f32, dy: f32) {
        self.yaw -= dx * self.sensitivity;
        self.pitch = (self.pitch + dy * self.sensitivity).clamp(-1.54, 1.54);
    }

    pub fn update(&mut self, dt: f32) {
        // Directions relative to the current camera orientation
        let forward = (self.target - self.position).normalize();
        let right = Vec3::Y.cross(forward).normalize();

        if self.pressed.contains("KeyW") {
            self.target += forward * self.speed * dt;
        }
        if self.pressed.contains("KeyS") {
            self.target -= forward * self.speed * dt;
        }
        if self.pressed.contains("KeyA") {
            self.target -= right * self.speed * dt;
        }
        if self.pressed.contains("KeyD") {
            self.target += right * self.speed * dt;
        }
        if self.pressed.contains("Equal") || self.pressed.contains("NumpadAdd") {
            self.radius = (self.radius - self.speed * dt).max(0.5);
        }
        if self.pressed.contains("Minus") || self.pressed.contains("NumpadSubtract") {
            self.radius += self.speed * dt;
        }
        if self.pressed.contains("KeyQ") {
            self.pitch = (self.pitch - self.speed * dt * 0.25).clamp(0.08, 1.45);
        }
        if self.pressed.contains("KeyE") {
            self.pitch = (self.pitch + self.speed * dt * 0.25).clamp(0.08, 1.45);
        }
        // recalc position
        self.position = self.target
            + Vec3::new(
                self.radius * self.yaw.cos() * self.pitch.cos(),
                self.radius * self.pitch.sin(),
                self.radius * self.yaw.sin() * self.pitch.cos(),
            );
    }

    pub fn matrix(&self) -> Mat4 {
        let view = glam::camera::lh::view::look_at_mat4(self.position, self.target, Vec3::Y);
        let proj = glam::camera::lh::proj::directx::perspective(
            std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_4,
            self.aspect,
            0.1,
            100.0,
        );
        proj * view
    }
}

use crate::input::camera::CameraController;
impl CameraController for OrbitCamera {
    fn clear_input(&mut self) {
        self.pressed.clear();
    }
    fn key_down(&mut self, code: String) {
        OrbitCamera::key_down(self, code);
    }
    fn key_up(&mut self, code: String) {
        OrbitCamera::key_up(self, code);
    }
    fn mouse_move(&mut self, dx: f32, dy: f32) {
        OrbitCamera::mouse_move(self, dx, dy);
    }
    fn update(&mut self, dt: f32) {
        OrbitCamera::update(self, dt);
    }
    fn matrix(&self) -> Mat4 {
        OrbitCamera::matrix(self)
    }
    fn position(&self) -> Vec3 {
        self.position
    }
}

        let mut camera = OrbitCamera::new(1.0);

            assert_eq!((camera.position, camera.target()), before);

        assert!(camera.adjust(0.0, 10_000.0, 100_000.0));

        assert!(((camera.position.y - target.y) / 45.0 - 1.45_f32.sin()).abs() < 1e-5);
    }
