# File: src/instance_upload.rs
//! Exact instance upload address ranges. No visibility or record mapping changes.
//! Modes are diagnostic policies: union=0, coalesced=1, full active span=2.
const MAX_RANGES: usize = 4096; // One scratch list, at most64KiB on64-bit hosts.
#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct DirtyRanges {
    pub mode: u32,
    pub gap: usize,
    #[cfg_attr(not(target_arch = "wasm32"), allow(dead_code))]
    pub diagnostic: bool,
    union: Option<(usize, usize)>,
    spans: Vec<(usize, usize)>,
    single: [(usize, usize); 1],
    pub changed_records_bytes: usize,
    pub overflow: bool,
}
impl DirtyRanges {
    pub fn clear(&mut self) {
        self.union = None;
        self.spans.clear();
        self.changed_records_bytes = 0;
        self.overflow = false;
    }
    // Call in monotonically increasing, disjoint record order for one buffer.
    pub fn mark(&mut self, start: usize, end: usize) {
        debug_assert!(start < end && start.is_multiple_of(4) && end.is_multiple_of(4));
        debug_assert!(self.union.is_none_or(|(_, previous)| start >= previous));
        self.changed_records_bytes += end - start;
        self.union = Some(self.union.map_or((start, end), |(first, _)| (first, end)));
        if self.mode != 1 || self.overflow {
            return;
        }
        if let Some(last) = self.spans.last_mut() {
            if start - last.1 <= self.gap {
                last.1 = end;
                return;
            }
        }
        if self.spans.len() == MAX_RANGES {
            self.overflow = true;
            self.spans.clear(); // Keep union valid, never discard changed records.
        } else {
            self.spans.push((start, end));
        }
    }
    pub fn writes(&mut self, active_bytes: usize) -> &[(usize, usize)] {
        let Some((start, end)) = self.union else {
            return &[];
        };
        assert!(end <= active_bytes);
        if self.mode == 1 && !self.overflow {
            return &self.spans;
        }
        self.single[0] = if self.mode == 2 {
            (0, active_bytes)
        } else {
            (start, end)
        };
        &self.single
    }
    pub fn retained_bytes(&self) -> usize {
        self.spans.capacity() * std::mem::size_of::<(usize, usize)>()
    }
}
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn exact_publication_across_gaps_layouts_and_shrink() {
        for stride in [16, 112] {
            for mode in 0..3 {
                for gap in [0, 256] {
                    let mut ranges = DirtyRanges {
                        mode,
                        gap,
                        ..Default::default()
                    };
                    let mut gpu = vec![17u8; stride * 20];
                    let mut cpu = gpu.clone();
                    for records in [vec![0, 3, 19], vec![2, 3, 4], vec![], vec![0]] {
                        ranges.clear();
                        for i in records {
                            cpu[i * stride..(i + 1) * stride].fill(91);
                            ranges.mark(i * stride, (i + 1) * stride);
                        }
                        for &(a, b) in ranges.writes(cpu.len()) {
                            gpu[a..b].copy_from_slice(&cpu[a..b]);
                        }
                        assert_eq!(gpu, cpu);
                    }
                    ranges.clear();
                    assert!(ranges.writes(0).is_empty());
                }
            }
        }
    }
    #[test]
    fn coalesces_only_allowed_gaps_and_bounds_scratch() {
        let mut r = DirtyRanges {
            mode: 1,
            gap: 16,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        r.mark(0, 16);
        r.mark(32, 48);
        r.mark(80, 96);
        assert_eq!(r.changed_records_bytes, 48);
        assert_eq!(r.writes(128), &[(0, 48), (80, 96)]);
        r.clear();
        r.gap = 0;
        for i in 0..MAX_RANGES + 10 {
            r.mark(i * 32, i * 32 + 16);
        }
        assert!(r.overflow);
        assert_eq!(
            r.writes((MAX_RANGES + 10) * 32),
            &[(0, (MAX_RANGES + 9) * 32 + 16)]
        );
        assert!(r.retained_bytes() <= MAX_RANGES * 16);
    }
}

# File: src/melee_encounter.rs
//! Serial melee encounters. Tracking, navigation and hit decisions remain native.
use crate::scene::{SceneManager, Transform};
use glam::{Mat4, Quat, Vec2, Vec3};
use serde::Deserialize;
use serde_json::{json, Value};

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Deserialize)]
pub struct Config {
    pub enemies: Vec<u32>,
    pub swords: [u32; 2],
    pub spawns: Vec<[f32; 3]>,
    /// [minimum X, maximum X, minimum Z, maximum Z], in world meters.
    pub bounds: [f32; 4],
    pub obstacles: Vec<[f32; 4]>,
}

struct Enemy {
    id: u32,
    original: Transform,
    // Idle, Run, Attack, Explode.
    clips: [usize; 4],
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct BladeSample {
    points: [Vec3; 2],
    hand: Vec3,
    orientation: Quat,
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
enum Phase {
    Chase,
    Attack,
    Dying,
    Stopped,
}

pub struct Encounter {
    config: Config,
    enemies: Vec<Enemy>,
    active: usize,
    phase: Phase,
    position: Vec3,
    kills: u32,
    death_time: f32,
    blades: [Option<BladeSample>; 2],
    last_head: Option<Vec3>,
    nav_obstacles: Vec<[f32; 4]>,
    nav_corners: Vec<Vec2>,
    nav_waypoint: Option<Vec2>,
    nav_goal: Vec2,
    nav_age: f32,
}

impl Config {
    pub fn validate(&self, scene: &SceneManager) -> Result<(), String> {
        self.prepare(scene).map(|_| ())
    }
    fn prepare(&self, scene: &SceneManager) -> Result<Vec<Enemy>, String> {
        if self.enemies.is_empty() || self.spawns.len() != self.enemies.len() {
            return Err("Encounter needs one spawn per enemy".into());
        }
        if !valid_rect(self.bounds)
            || self.obstacles.iter().any(|r| !valid_rect(*r))
            || self.spawns.iter().flatten().any(|v| !v.is_finite())
        {
            return Err("Encounter bounds, obstacles and spawns must be finite and ordered".into());
        }
        if self.swords[0] == self.swords[1]
            || self
                .swords
                .iter()
                .any(|id| !scene.object_exists(*id) || scene.tracked_blade(*id).is_none())
        {
            return Err("Encounter requires two distinct tracked sword objects".into());
        }
        let mut enemies = Vec::new();
        for &id in &self.enemies {
            if enemies.iter().any(|e: &Enemy| e.id == id) || self.swords.contains(&id) {
                return Err("Encounter enemy IDs must be distinct".into());
            }
            let model = scene
                .model(id)
                .ok_or("Encounter enemy must be a loaded model")?;
            let mut clips = [0; 4];
            for (slot, name) in ["Idle", "Run", "Attack", "Explode"].iter().enumerate() {
                clips[slot] = model
                    .asset
                    .animations
                    .iter()
                    .position(|c| {
                        c.name
                            .as_deref()
                            .is_some_and(|n| n.eq_ignore_ascii_case(name))
                    })
                    .ok_or_else(|| format!("Enemy {id} has no {name} clip"))?;
            }
            enemies.push(Enemy {
                id,
                original: scene.objects()[&id].transform,
                clips,
            });
        }
        Ok(enemies)
    }
}

impl Encounter {
    pub fn new(config: Config, scene: &mut SceneManager) -> Result<Self, String> {
        let enemies = config.prepare(scene)?;
        // Inflate geometry for an approximately 80cm-wide enemy. Visibility graph
        // corners are cached; shortest paths avoid the local-steering barricade trap.
        let nav_obstacles: Vec<_> = config
            .obstacles
            .iter()
            .map(|r| [r[0] - 0.4, r[1] + 0.4, r[2] - 0.4, r[3] + 0.4])
            .collect();
        let mut nav_corners = Vec::new();
        for r in &nav_obstacles {
            for x in [r[0] - 0.02, r[1] + 0.02] {
                for z in [r[2] - 0.02, r[3] + 0.02] {
                    let p = Vec2::new(x, z);
                    if inside(p, config.bounds) && !nav_obstacles.iter().any(|b| inside(p, *b)) {
                        nav_corners.push(p);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        let mut encounter = Self {
            position: Vec3::from_array(config.spawns[0]),
            config,
            enemies,
            active: 0,
            phase: Phase::Chase,
            kills: 0,
            death_time: 0.,
            blades: [None; 2],
            last_head: None,
            nav_obstacles,
            nav_corners,
            nav_waypoint: None,
            nav_goal: Vec2::ZERO,
            nav_age: 0.,
        };
        for i in 0..encounter.enemies.len() {
            encounter.hide(scene, i);
        }
        encounter.spawn(scene);
        Ok(encounter)
    }

    pub fn reset_tracking(&mut self) {
        self.blades = [None; 2];
        self.last_head = None;
    }
    pub fn state(&self) -> Value {
        json!({"phase": match self.phase {Phase::Chase=>"chase", Phase::Attack=>"attack",
            Phase::Dying=>"dying", Phase::Stopped=>"stopped"},
            "active":self.active, "id": self.enemies[self.active].id, "kills":self.kills,
            "position": self.position.to_array(), "hp": if self.phase == Phase::Dying {0} else {1}})
    }
    pub fn stop(&mut self, scene: &mut SceneManager) {
        for enemy in &self.enemies {
            let t = enemy.original;
            scene.set_object_transform(enemy.id, t.position, t.rotation, t.scale);
            let _ = scene.play_model_animation(enemy.id, enemy.clips[0], true, 1.);
        }
        self.phase = Phase::Stopped;
        self.reset_tracking();
    }
    fn hide(&self, scene: &mut SceneManager, i: usize) {
        let enemy = &self.enemies[i];
        scene.set_object_position(enemy.id, Vec3::new(0., -10000., 0.));
        // Start then pause even if the caller had no playback yet.
        let _ = scene.play_model_animation(enemy.id, enemy.clips[0], true, 1.);
        let _ = scene.pause_model_animation(enemy.id, true);
    }
    fn spawn(&mut self, scene: &mut SceneManager) {
        self.position = Vec3::from_array(self.config.spawns[self.active]);
        let enemy = &self.enemies[self.active];
        scene.set_object_transform(
            enemy.id,
            self.position,
            enemy.original.rotation,
            enemy.original.scale,
        );
        self.phase = Phase::Chase;
        self.death_time = 0.;
        self.nav_waypoint = None;
        self.nav_age = 0.25;
        self.reset_tracking();
        self.play(scene, 1, true);
    }
    fn play(&self, scene: &mut SceneManager, slot: usize, looping: bool) {
        let enemy = &self.enemies[self.active];
        let _ = scene.play_model_animation(enemy.id, enemy.clips[slot], looping, 1.);
    }
    pub fn tick(
        &mut self,
        scene: &mut SceneManager,
        dt: f32,
        head: Option<Mat4>,
        hands: [Option<Mat4>; 2],
    ) {
        self.tick_timed(scene, dt, dt, head, hands);
    }
    /// Simulation can be slowed; tracking continuity always uses real elapsed time.
    pub fn tick_timed(
        &mut self,
        scene: &mut SceneManager,
        dt: f32,
        tracking_dt: f32,
        head: Option<Mat4>,
        hands: [Option<Mat4>; 2],
    ) {
        if self.phase == Phase::Stopped {
            return;
        }
        let Some(head) = head.filter(|h| h.is_finite()) else {
            self.reset_tracking();
            return;
        };
        if !dt.is_finite()
            || dt <= 0.
            || dt > 0.25
            || !tracking_dt.is_finite()
            || tracking_dt <= 0.
            || tracking_dt > 0.25
        {
            self.reset_tracking();
            return;
        }
        let head = head.w_axis.truncate();
        if self.last_head.is_some_and(|p| p.distance(head) > 1.5) {
            self.reset_tracking();
        }
        self.last_head = Some(head);
        if self.phase == Phase::Dying {
            self.death_time += dt;
            if self.death_time >= 3. {
                self.hide(scene, self.active);
                self.active = (self.active + 1) % self.enemies.len();
                self.spawn(scene);
            }
            return;
        }
        let p = Vec2::new(self.position.x, self.position.z);
        let goal = Vec2::new(
            head.x.clamp(self.config.bounds[0], self.config.bounds[1]),
            head.z.clamp(self.config.bounds[2], self.config.bounds[3]),
        );
        let near = p.distance(goal) <= 1.1;
        let next_phase = if near { Phase::Attack } else { Phase::Chase };
        if self.phase != next_phase {
            self.phase = next_phase;
            self.play(scene, if near { 2 } else { 1 }, true);
        }
        if !near {
            self.nav_age += dt;
            let reached_or_blocked = self
                .nav_waypoint
                .is_some_and(|w| p.distance(w) < 0.04 || blocked(p, w, &self.nav_obstacles));
            if reached_or_blocked
                || self.nav_waypoint.is_none() && self.nav_age >= 0.25
                || self.nav_age >= 0.25 && self.nav_goal.distance(goal) > 0.25
            {
                self.nav_waypoint = next_waypoint(p, goal, &self.nav_obstacles, &self.nav_corners);
                self.nav_goal = goal;
                self.nav_age = 0.;
            }
            if let Some(waypoint) = self.nav_waypoint {
                let delta = waypoint - p;
                let step = delta.normalize_or_zero()
                    * dt.min(delta.length()).min((p.distance(goal) - 1.1).max(0.));
                self.position.x += step.x;
                self.position.z += step.y;
            }
        }
        let id = self.enemies[self.active].id;
        scene.set_object_position(id, self.position);
        let direction = goal - Vec2::new(self.position.x, self.position.z);
        if direction.length_squared() > 0.0001 {
            let mut rotation = self.enemies[self.active].original.rotation;
            rotation.y = direction.x.atan2(direction.y);
            scene.set_object_rotation(id, rotation);
        }
        let mut hit = false;
        for (i, hand) in hands.into_iter().enumerate() {
            let sample = hand.filter(|h| h.is_finite()).and_then(|h| {
                let sword = self.config.swords[i];
                let matrix = scene.objects().get(&sword)?.transform.model();
                let points = scene
                    .tracked_blade(sword)?
                    .map(|p| matrix.transform_point3(p));
                points.iter().all(|p| p.is_finite()).then_some(BladeSample {
                    points,
                    hand: h.w_axis.truncate(),
                    orientation: Quat::from_mat4(&h).normalize(),
                })
            });
            if let (Some(previous), Some(current)) = (self.blades[i], sample) {
                hit |= swing_hit(previous, current, self.position, tracking_dt);
            }
            self.blades[i] = sample;
        }
        if hit {
            self.kills = self.kills.saturating_add(1);
            self.phase = Phase::Dying;
            self.death_time = 0.;
            self.blades = [None; 2];
            self.play(scene, 3, false);
        }
    }
}
fn valid_rect(r: [f32; 4]) -> bool {
    r.iter().all(|x| x.is_finite()) && r[0] < r[1] && r[2] < r[3]
}
fn inside(p: Vec2, r: [f32; 4]) -> bool {
    p.x >= r[0] && p.x <= r[1] && p.y >= r[2] && p.y <= r[3]
}
fn blocked(a: Vec2, b: Vec2, obstacles: &[[f32; 4]]) -> bool {
    obstacles.iter().any(|r| {
        let mut lo: f32 = 0.;
        let mut hi: f32 = 1.;
        for (start, delta, min, max) in [(a.x, b.x - a.x, r[0], r[1]), (a.y, b.y - a.y, r[2], r[3])]
        {
            if delta.abs() < 1e-6 {
                if start < min || start > max {
                    return false;
                }
            } else {
                let u = (min - start) / delta;
                let v = (max - start) / delta;
                lo = lo.max(u.min(v));
                hi = hi.min(u.max(v));
            }
        }
        lo <= hi
    })
}
fn next_waypoint(
    start: Vec2,
    goal: Vec2,
    obstacles: &[[f32; 4]],
    corners: &[Vec2],
) -> Option<Vec2> {
    if !blocked(start, goal, obstacles) {
        return Some(goal);
    }
    let nodes: Vec<_> = [start, goal]
        .into_iter()
        .chain(corners.iter().copied())
        .collect();
    let mut distances = vec![f32::INFINITY; nodes.len()];
    let mut previous = vec![0; nodes.len()];
    let mut visited = vec![false; nodes.len()];
    distances[0] = 0.;
    for _ in 0..nodes.len() {
        let i = (0..nodes.len())
            .filter(|&i| !visited[i])
            .min_by(|&a, &b| distances[a].total_cmp(&distances[b]))?;
        if !distances[i].is_finite() {
            return None;
        }
        if i == 1 {
            let mut j = 1;
            while previous[j] != 0 {
                j = previous[j];
            }
            return Some(nodes[j]);
        }
        visited[i] = true;
        for j in 1..nodes.len() {
            if visited[j] || blocked(nodes[i], nodes[j], obstacles) {
                continue;
            }
            let d = distances[i] + nodes[i].distance(nodes[j]);
            if d < distances[j] {
                distances[j] = d;
                previous[j] = i;
            }
        }
    }
    None
}
fn point_segment_distance(p: Vec3, a: Vec3, b: Vec3) -> f32 {
    let d = b - a;
    p.distance(a + d * ((p - a).dot(d) / d.length_squared().max(1e-9)).clamp(0., 1.))
}
fn swing_hit(previous: BladeSample, current: BladeSample, enemy: Vec3, dt: f32) -> bool {
    let travel = previous.points[0]
        .distance(current.points[0])
        .max(previous.points[1].distance(current.points[1]));
    let hand_travel = previous.hand.distance(current.hand);
    let angle = previous
        .orientation
        .angle_between(current.orientation)
        .abs();
    if hand_travel > (15. * dt + 0.025).min(1.)
        || angle > (45. * dt + 0.03).min(1.5)
        || travel < 0.025
        || travel / dt < 0.35
        || travel > 1.5
        || previous.hand.distance(current.hand) > 1.5
    {
        return false;
    }
    // Sample the swept ruled surface at <= 3cm, then test the enemy's vertical
    // torso capsule. This covers both longitudinal and transverse fast swings.
    let steps = (travel / 0.03).ceil() as usize;
    (0..=steps).any(|i| {
        let t = i as f32 / steps as f32;
        let a = previous.points[0].lerp(current.points[0], t);
        let b = previous.points[1].lerp(current.points[1], t);
        (0..=12)
            .any(|j| point_segment_distance(enemy + Vec3::Y * (0.3 + j as f32 * 0.1), a, b) <= 0.43)
    })
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::scene::MeshKind;
    fn sample(x: f32) -> BladeSample {
        BladeSample {
            points: [Vec3::new(x, 0.8, -0.8), Vec3::new(x, 0.8, 0.8)],
            hand: Vec3::new(x, 1., 0.),
            orientation: Quat::IDENTITY,
        }
    }
    fn fixture() -> (SceneManager, Encounter) {
        let mut scene = SceneManager::default();
        let asset = std::sync::Arc::new(
            crate::gltf_loader::parse_model(
                include_bytes!("../assets/models/neon-enemies/drone-orbiter-pink.glb"),
                &[],
                &[],
            )
            .unwrap(),
        );
        let enemies = (0..3)
            .map(|_| scene.add_model(asset.clone()).unwrap())
            .collect();
        let swords = std::array::from_fn(|_| {
            let id = scene.add_object(
                MeshKind::Cube,
                Transform::new(Vec3::new(-0.7, 0., 0.), Vec3::ZERO, Vec3::ONE),
            );
            scene
                .set_cutter(
                    id,
                    Some([Vec3::new(0., 0.8, -0.8), Vec3::new(0., 0.8, 0.8)]),
                )
                .unwrap();
            id
        });
        let encounter = Encounter::new(
            Config {
                enemies,
                swords,
                spawns: vec![[0., 0., 0.]; 3],
                bounds: [-10., 10., -10., 10.],
                obstacles: vec![],
            },
            &mut scene,
        )
        .unwrap();
        (scene, encounter)
    }
    fn tick(scene: &mut SceneManager, e: &mut Encounter) {
        e.tick(
            scene,
            0.1,
            Some(Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(0., 1.7, 1.))),
            [Some(Mat4::IDENTITY); 2],
        );
    }
    #[test]
    fn stationary_sword_and_teleport_never_hit_fast_sweep_does() {
        assert!(!swing_hit(sample(0.), sample(0.), Vec3::ZERO, 0.01));
        assert!(!swing_hit(sample(-2.), sample(2.), Vec3::ZERO, 0.01));
        let mut jumped = sample(0.7);
        jumped.hand = Vec3::splat(10.);
        assert!(!swing_hit(sample(-0.7), jumped, Vec3::ZERO, 0.02));
        assert!(swing_hit(sample(-0.5), sample(0.5), Vec3::ZERO, 0.1));
        assert!(!swing_hit(sample(-0.7), sample(0.3), Vec3::ZERO, 1. / 72.));
        let mut rotated = sample(0.3);
        rotated.orientation = Quat::from_rotation_y(2.0);
        assert!(!swing_hit(sample(-0.7), rotated, Vec3::ZERO, 0.1));
    }
    #[test]
    fn slow_simulation_keeps_real_tracking_time() {
        let (mut scene, mut e) = fixture();
        let head = Some(Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(0., 1.7, 1.)));
        e.tick_timed(
            &mut scene,
            0.1 / 72.,
            1. / 72.,
            head,
            [Some(Mat4::IDENTITY); 2],
        );
        scene.set_object_position(e.config.swords[0], Vec3::new(-0.5, 0., 0.));
        e.tick_timed(
            &mut scene,
            0.1 / 72.,
            1. / 72.,
            head,
            [
                Some(Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(0.2, 0., 0.))),
                Some(Mat4::IDENTITY),
            ],
        );
        scene.set_object_position(e.config.swords[0], Vec3::new(-0.3, 0., 0.));
        e.tick_timed(
            &mut scene,
            0.1 / 72.,
            1. / 72.,
            head,
            [
                Some(Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(0.4, 0., 0.))),
                Some(Mat4::IDENTITY),
            ],
        );
        assert_eq!(e.kills, 1);
    }
    #[test]
    fn serial_death_waits_three_seconds_and_wraps() {
        let (mut scene, mut e) = fixture();
        for expected in [0, 1, 2, 0] {
            assert_eq!(e.active, expected);
            for i in 0..3 {
                assert_eq!(
                    scene.objects()[&e.enemies[i].id].transform.position.y < -9000.,
                    i != expected
                );
            }
            tick(&mut scene, &mut e);
            for sword in e.config.swords {
                scene.set_object_position(sword, Vec3::new(0.7, 0., 0.));
            }
            tick(&mut scene, &mut e);
            assert_eq!(e.state()["phase"], "dying");
            for _ in 0..29 {
                tick(&mut scene, &mut e);
            }
            assert_eq!(e.active, expected);
            assert_eq!(e.state()["phase"], "dying");
            tick(&mut scene, &mut e);
            tick(&mut scene, &mut e);
            assert_eq!(e.active, (expected + 1) % 3);
            for sword in e.config.swords {
                scene.set_object_position(sword, Vec3::new(-0.7, 0., 0.));
            }
        }
        assert_eq!(e.kills, 4);
        e.stop(&mut scene);
        assert!(e
            .enemies
            .iter()
            .all(|enemy| scene.objects()[&enemy.id].transform.position == enemy.original.position));
    }
    #[test]
    fn each_sword_can_hit_and_tracking_loss_resets_history() {
        for hand in 0..2 {
            let (mut scene, mut e) = fixture();
            tick(&mut scene, &mut e);
            let mut hands = [Some(Mat4::IDENTITY); 2];
            hands[hand] = None;
            e.tick(&mut scene, 0.1, Some(Mat4::IDENTITY), hands);
            scene.set_object_position(e.config.swords[hand], Vec3::new(0.7, 0., 0.));
            tick(&mut scene, &mut e); // Reacquisition does not sweep across the gap.
            assert_eq!(e.kills, 0);
            scene.set_object_position(e.config.swords[hand], Vec3::new(-0.7, 0., 0.));
            tick(&mut scene, &mut e);
            assert_eq!(e.kills, 1);
        }
    }
    #[test]
    fn missing_head_and_head_teleport_discard_sweep() {
        let (mut scene, mut e) = fixture();
        tick(&mut scene, &mut e);
        e.tick(&mut scene, 0.1, None, [Some(Mat4::IDENTITY); 2]);
        scene.set_object_position(e.config.swords[0], Vec3::new(0.7, 0., 0.));
        tick(&mut scene, &mut e);
        assert_eq!(e.kills, 0);
        scene.set_object_position(e.config.swords[0], Vec3::new(-0.7, 0., 0.));
        e.tick(
            &mut scene,
            0.1,
            Some(Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(3., 1.7, 1.))),
            [Some(Mat4::IDENTITY); 2],
        );
        assert_eq!(e.kills, 0);
    }
    #[test]
    fn navigation_walks_around_barricade_without_crossing_it() {
        let obstacles = [[-1., 1., -0.5, 0.5]];
        let corners = [
            Vec2::new(-1.02, -0.52),
            Vec2::new(1.02, -0.52),
            Vec2::new(-1.02, 0.52),
            Vec2::new(1.02, 0.52),
        ];
        let mut p = Vec2::new(0., -3.);
        let goal = Vec2::new(0., 3.);
        for _ in 0..150 {
            let next = next_waypoint(p, goal, &obstacles, &corners).unwrap();
            let delta = next - p;
            let moved = p + delta.normalize_or_zero() * 0.1f32.min(delta.length());
            assert!(!blocked(p, moved, &obstacles));
            p = moved;
        }
        assert!(p.distance(goal) < 0.01);
    }
    #[test]
    fn city_layout_spawns_reach_player_without_crossing_geometry() {
        let layout: Value =
            serde_json::from_str(include_str!("../assets/models/cyberpunk-alley/layout.json"))
                .unwrap();
        let bounds: [f32; 4] = serde_json::from_value(layout["walkableBounds"].clone()).unwrap();
        let target: [f32; 3] = serde_json::from_value(layout["spawn"].clone()).unwrap();
        let obstacles: Vec<[f32; 4]> = layout["obstacles"]
            .as_array()
            .unwrap()
            .iter()
            .map(|o| {
                let c: [f32; 3] = serde_json::from_value(o["center"].clone()).unwrap();
                let h: [f32; 3] = serde_json::from_value(o["halfExtents"].clone()).unwrap();
                [c[0] - h[0], c[0] + h[0], c[2] - h[2], c[2] + h[2]]
            })
            .collect();
        for spawn in layout["modelSpawns"].as_array().unwrap() {
            let (mut scene, mut old) = fixture();
            old.stop(&mut scene);
            let mut config = old.config.clone();
            config.bounds = bounds;
            config.obstacles = obstacles.clone();
            let spawn: [f32; 3] = serde_json::from_value(spawn["position"].clone()).unwrap();
            config.spawns = vec![spawn; 3];
            let mut e = Encounter::new(config, &mut scene).unwrap();
            let head = Some(Mat4::from_translation(
                Vec3::from_array(target) + Vec3::Y * 1.7,
            ));
            for _ in 0..650 {
                let previous = Vec2::new(e.position.x, e.position.z);
                e.tick(&mut scene, 0.1, head, [None; 2]);
                assert!(!blocked(
                    previous,
                    Vec2::new(e.position.x, e.position.z),
                    &e.nav_obstacles
                ));
            }
            assert!(
                Vec2::new(e.position.x - target[0], e.position.z - target[2]).length() < 1.12,
                "spawn {spawn:?} stuck at {:?}",
                e.position
            );
        }
    }
    #[test]
    fn chase_moves_at_one_meter_per_second_and_stops_near_head() {
        let (mut scene, mut e) = fixture();
        let hands = [None; 2];
        let head = Some(Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(0., 1.7, 4.)));
        for _ in 0..10 {
            e.tick(&mut scene, 0.1, head, hands);
        }
        assert!((e.position.z - 1.).abs() < 0.001);
        for _ in 0..50 {
            e.tick(&mut scene, 0.1, head, hands);
        }
        assert!((e.position.z - 2.9).abs() < 0.001);
        assert_eq!(e.state()["phase"], "attack");
    }

# File: src/numeric_font.rs
//! Scene-owned opt-in numeric font. Immutable glyph assets, ordinary shared instances.
use super::*;
use std::collections::BTreeSet;
#[derive(Default)]
pub(super) struct NumericFont {
    assets: Option<[u32; 10]>,
    panels: BTreeMap<u32, Panel>,
    children: BTreeSet<u32>,
}
#[derive(PartialEq)]
struct Key {
    revision: u64,
    matrix: [f32; 16],
    options: RenderOptions,
    material: [f32; 7],
}
struct Panel {
    key: Key,
    children: Vec<(u8, u32)>,
}
impl SceneManager {
    pub(crate) fn is_numeric_panel(&self, id: u32) -> bool {
        self.font3d.texts.contains_key(&id)
            || self.info_panels.get(&id).is_some_and(|p| p.numeric())
    }
    pub(crate) fn is_numeric_glyph(&self, id: u32) -> bool {
        self.numeric_font.children.contains(&id)
    }
    pub(crate) fn is_text_object(&self, id: u32) -> bool {
        self.info_panels.contains_key(&id)
            || self.numeric_font.children.contains(&id)
            || self.font3d.children.contains(&id)
    }
    #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
    pub(crate) fn numeric_font_digit(&self, handle: u32) -> Option<u8> {
        self.numeric_font
            .assets
            .as_ref()?
            .iter()
            .position(|&id| id == handle)
            .map(|digit| digit as u8)
    }
    #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
    pub(crate) fn numeric_font_assets(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &u32> {
        self.numeric_font.assets.iter().flatten()
    }
    #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
    pub(crate) fn numeric_font_children(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &u32> {
        self.numeric_font.children.iter()
    }
    pub fn numeric_font_stats(&self) -> (usize, usize, usize) {
        (
            self.numeric_font.assets.as_ref().map_or(0, |_| 10),
            self.numeric_font.children.len(),
            self.numeric_font.panels.len(),
        )
    }
    pub(super) fn remove_numeric_panel(&mut self, id: u32) {
        let Some(panel) = self.numeric_font.panels.remove(&id) else {
            return;
        };
        for (_, child) in panel.children {
            self.numeric_font.children.remove(&child);
            self.remove_object(child);
        }
        if self.numeric_font.panels.is_empty() {
            if let Some(assets) = self.numeric_font.assets.take() {
                for asset in assets {
                    self.remove_mesh_variants(asset);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    /// Glyph instances share immutable render-only topology. They do not consume
    /// the scene's per-object cutting budget or enter the public cuttable API.
    pub(super) fn add_numeric_glyph_instance(&mut self, handle: u32) -> Result<u32, String> {
        let mesh = self
            .mesh_variants
            .get(&handle)
            .filter(|asset| asset.registered)
            .and_then(|asset| asset.variants.first())
            .ok_or("Invalid numeric glyph asset")?
            .clone();
        let (min, max) = mesh.bounds();
        let id = self.add_imported(min, max);
        if id == INVALID_ID {
            return Err("Object IDs exhausted".into());
        }
        self.triangle_meshes.insert(
            id,
            TriangleObject {
                mesh,
                cuttable: false,
                cap_color: Vec3::ONE,
            },
        );
        self.variant_instances.insert(id, (handle, 0));
        let object = self.objects.get_mut(&id).unwrap();
        object.mesh = MeshKind::Imported(handle);
        object.refresh_render_data();
        Ok(id)
    }
    /// Call before uploading/extracting a frame. Unchanged panels allocate nothing.
    pub fn sync_numeric_font(&mut self) {
        let mut font = std::mem::take(&mut self.numeric_font);
        // Use the panel map directly on the unchanged path: no per-frame ID collection.
        let mut cursor = None;
        loop {
            let next = self
                .info_panels
                .iter()
                .find(|(id, p)| {
                    p.numeric() && !p.font3d_bound && cursor.is_none_or(|previous| **id > previous)
                })
                .map(|(&id, _)| id);
            let Some(id) = next else {
                break;
            };
            cursor = Some(id);
            let parent = &self.objects[&id];
            let key = Key {
                revision: self.info_panels[&id].revision,
                matrix: parent.transform.model().to_cols_array(),
                options: parent.render_options,
                material: [
                    parent.emission,
                    parent.color_cutout,
                    parent.opacity,
                    parent.opaque_above,
                    parent.opacity_variation,
                    parent.opacity_coverage,
                    parent.cut_assist,
                ],
            };
            if font.panels.get(&id).is_some_and(|p| p.key == key) {
                continue;
            }
            if font.assets.is_none() {
                let mut handles = [0; 10];
                for (digit, handle) in handles.iter_mut().enumerate() {
                    let mesh = crate::info_panel::numeric_glyph(digit as u8);
                    let source = crate::cutting_mesh::MeshData::from(
                        crate::cutting::CutMesh::from_render_mesh(&mesh),
                    );
                    let id = self.allocate_id().expect("numeric glyph asset ID");
                    self.mesh_variants.insert(
                        id,
                        MeshVariants {
                            colors: mesh
                                .indices
                                .as_chunks::<3>()
                                .0
                                .iter()
                                .map(|tri| {
                                    let c = mesh.vertices[tri[0] as usize].color;
                                    [c[0], c[1], c[2], 1.]
                                })
                                .collect(),
                            variants: vec![source],
                            registered: true,
                            varying_triangles: vec![],
                        },
                    );
                    *handle = id;
                }
                font.assets = Some(handles);
            }
            let layout = self.info_panels[&id].numeric_layout();
            let transform = self.objects[&id].transform;
            let mut children = font
                .panels
                .remove(&id)
                .map_or_else(Vec::new, |p| p.children);
            while children.len() > layout.len() {
                let (_, child) = children.pop().unwrap();
                font.children.remove(&child);
                self.remove_object(child);
            }
            for (index, &(digit, x, unit, depth)) in layout.iter().enumerate() {
                if index < children.len() && children[index].0 != digit {
                    let child = children[index].1;
                    let handle = font.assets.unwrap()[digit as usize];
                    let mesh = self.mesh_variants[&handle].variants[0].clone();
                    let (min, max) = mesh.bounds();
                    self.triangle_meshes.get_mut(&child).unwrap().mesh = mesh;
                    self.variant_instances.insert(child, (handle, 0));
                    let object = self.objects.get_mut(&child).unwrap();
                    object.mesh = MeshKind::Imported(handle);
                    object.local_bounds = Some((min, max));
                    children[index].0 = digit;
                } else if index == children.len() {
                    let child = self
                        .add_numeric_glyph_instance(font.assets.unwrap()[digit as usize])
                        .expect("numeric glyph instance");
                    font.children.insert(child);
                    children.push((digit, child));
                }
                let child = self.objects.get_mut(&children[index].1).unwrap();
                child.transform = Transform::new(
                    transform.model().transform_point3(Vec3::new(x, 0., 0.003)),
                    transform.rotation,
                    transform.scale * Vec3::new(unit, unit, depth),
                );
                self.shadow_revisions.changed(child.render_options);
                self.shadow_revisions.changed(key.options);
                child.render_options = key.options;
                [
                    child.emission,
                    child.color_cutout,
                    child.opacity,
                    child.opaque_above,
                    child.opacity_variation,
                    child.opacity_coverage,
                    child.cut_assist,
                ] = key.material;
                child.refresh_render_data();
            }
            self.render_revision = self.render_revision.wrapping_add(1);
            // A static numeric parent may change content or pose too.
            if key.options.is_static {
                self.static_revision = self.static_revision.wrapping_add(1);
            }
            font.panels.insert(id, Panel { key, children });
        }
        self.numeric_font = font;
    }
}

        );

        {

                * Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(x, 0., 0.003))
                * Mat4::from_scale(Vec3::new(unit, unit, depth));

            assert_eq!(child.opacity, 0.3);

        for (_, child) in &scene.numeric_font.panels[&id].children {
            assert_eq!(scene.objects[child].opacity, 0.6);
        }
        let revision = scene.render_revision();
        scene.sync_numeric_font();

        assert!(scene.remove_object(id));
        assert_eq!(scene.numeric_font_stats(), (0, 0, 0));
        assert!(scene.objects.is_empty());
        assert!(scene.mesh_variants.is_empty());
        let id = scene.add_info_panel("score", 1., 1.).unwrap();
        scene.sync_numeric_font();
        assert!(scene.object_exists(id));
        scene.clear_scene();
        assert_eq!(scene.numeric_font_stats(), (0, 0, 0));
        assert!(scene.variant_instances.is_empty());
    }

# File: src/ordinal_merge.rs
//! Stable draw-ordinal transpose; does not choose visibility or batch boundaries.
const ORDINAL_LIMIT: usize = 65536;
const ITEM_BYTES_LIMIT: usize = 4 * 1024 * 1024;

pub(crate) fn merge<T: Copy>(
    items: &[T],
    ordinals: usize,
    ordinal: impl Fn(T) -> usize,
    offsets: &mut Vec<usize>,
    ordered: &mut Vec<T>,
) -> bool {
    if ordinals > ORDINAL_LIMIT
        || items.len().saturating_mul(std::mem::size_of::<T>()) > ITEM_BYTES_LIMIT
    {
        return false;
    }
    offsets.clear();
    offsets.reserve_exact(ordinals.saturating_sub(offsets.len()));
    offsets.resize(ordinals, 0);
    ordered.clear();
    for &item in items {
        let index = ordinal(item);
        if index >= ordinals {
            return false;
        }
        offsets[index] += 1;
    }
    let mut next = 0;
    for count in offsets.iter_mut() {
        let n = *count;
        *count = next;
        next += n;
    }
    if let Some(&first) = items.first() {
        ordered.reserve_exact(items.len().saturating_sub(ordered.len()));
        ordered.resize(items.len(), first);
        // Input is model-major. Stable scatter preserves the original model
        // order within each ordinal, including absent/culled primitives.
        for &item in items {
            let offset = &mut offsets[ordinal(item)];
            ordered[*offset] = item;
            *offset += 1;
        }
    }
    true
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn same_as_cursor_merge_with_gaps_and_empty_models() {
        let mut counts = Vec::new();
        let mut ordered = Vec::new();
        let mut random = 1337u32;
        for roots in [0, 1, 7, 67, 1025] {
            for width in [0, 1, 3, 67] {
                let mut lists = vec![Vec::new(); roots];
                for (model, list) in lists.iter_mut().enumerate() {
                    for draw in 0..width {
                        random = random.wrapping_mul(1664525).wrapping_add(1013904223);
                        if !random.is_multiple_of(3) {
                            list.push((model, draw));
                        }
                    }
                }
                let input: Vec<_> = lists.iter().flatten().copied().collect();
                let mut reference = Vec::new();
                let mut cursors = vec![0; roots];
                let mut ordinal = 0;
                loop {
                    let mut next = usize::MAX;
                    for (model, list) in lists.iter().enumerate() {
                        if list.get(cursors[model]).is_some_and(|i| i.1 == ordinal) {
                            reference.push(list[cursors[model]]);
                            cursors[model] += 1;
                        }
                        if let Some(item) = list.get(cursors[model]) {
                            next = next.min(item.1);
                        }
                    }
                    if next == usize::MAX {
                        break;
                    }
                    ordinal = next;
                }
                assert!(merge(&input, width, |i| i.1, &mut counts, &mut ordered));
                assert_eq!(ordered, reference);
            }
        }
    }
    #[test]
    fn bounded_fallback_and_reuse() {
        let mut counts = Vec::new();
        let mut ordered = Vec::new();
        assert!(!merge(
            &[0usize],
            ORDINAL_LIMIT + 1,
            |v| v,
            &mut counts,
            &mut ordered
        ));
        assert!(!merge(&[2usize], 2, |v| v, &mut counts, &mut ordered));
        assert!(merge(&[1usize, 0, 1], 2, |v| v, &mut counts, &mut ordered));
        assert_eq!(ordered, [0, 1, 1]);
        assert!(merge(&[], 0, |v| v, &mut counts, &mut ordered));
        assert!(ordered.is_empty());
    }
}


# File: src/postprocess_plan.rs
//! Declarative postprocessing chain. GPU allocation and command encoding live in
//! render/, so dependency/lifetime decisions can be tested without a GPU.
use crate::frame_graph::{CompiledGraph, Graph, Lifetime, PassId, ResourceDesc, ResourceId};

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct EffectSpec {
    pub index: usize,
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub reads_depth: bool,
    pub half_trace: bool,
}

pub struct EffectStep {
    pub effect: usize,
    pub source: ResourceId,
    pub destination: ResourceId,
    pub trace: Option<ResourceId>,
    pub pass: PassId,
    pub trace_pass: Option<PassId>,
}

pub struct PostprocessPlan {
    pub graph: Graph,
    pub compiled: CompiledGraph,
    pub scene_color: ResourceId,
    pub output: ResourceId,
    pub steps: Vec<EffectStep>,
}

impl PostprocessPlan {
    pub fn new(
        effects: &[EffectSpec],
        width: u32,
        height: u32,
        format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
        uniform_bytes: u64,
    ) -> Result<Self, String> {
        let mut graph = Graph::default();
        let texture = |width, height, format| ResourceDesc::Texture {
            width,
            height,
            layers: 1,
            samples: 1,
            format,
            usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT | wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING,
        };
        let scene_color = graph.resource(
            "scene.color",
            texture(width, height, format),
            Lifetime::External,
        );
        let depth = graph.resource(
            "scene.depth",
            texture(width, height, wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth32Float),
            Lifetime::External,
        );
        let output = if effects.is_empty() {
            scene_color
        } else {
            graph.resource(
                "view.completed.color",
                texture(width, height, format),
                Lifetime::External,
            )
        };
        let mut source = scene_color;
        let mut steps = Vec::with_capacity(effects.len());
        for (order, effect) in effects.iter().enumerate() {
            // A logical version per effect/view execution. Its caller-owned buffer
            // must not be overwritten before the corresponding submit (or it must
            // use a distinct buffer range when batching views).
            let uniform = graph.resource(
                format!("{}.uniform.current-view", effect.name),
                ResourceDesc::Buffer {
                    size: uniform_bytes,
                    usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
                },
                Lifetime::External,
            );
            let destination = if order + 1 == effects.len() {
                output
            } else {
                graph.resource(
                    format!("{}.color", effect.name),
                    texture(width, height, format),
                    Lifetime::Transient,
                )
            };
            let mut reads = vec![source, uniform];
            if effect.reads_depth {
                reads.push(depth);
            }
            let (trace, trace_pass) = if effect.half_trace {
                let trace = graph.resource(
                    format!("{}.trace", effect.name),
                    texture(width.div_ceil(2), height.div_ceil(2), format),
                    Lifetime::Transient,
                );
                let pass = graph.pass(format!("{}.trace", effect.name), &reads, &[trace], false)?;
                reads.push(trace);
                (Some(trace), Some(pass))
            } else {
                (None, None)
            };
            let pass = graph.pass(
                format!("{}.compose", effect.name),
                &reads,
                &[destination],
                false,
            )?;
            steps.push(EffectStep {
                effect: effect.index,
                source,
                destination,
                trace,
                pass,
                trace_pass,
            });
            source = destination;
        }
        let compiled = graph.compile(&[output])?;
        // The encoder executes exactly this chain. Reject a planner/encoder drift
        // instead of silently treating the graph as diagnostic-only metadata.
        let expected: Vec<_> = steps
            .iter()
            .flat_map(|step| step.trace_pass.into_iter().chain(Some(step.pass)))
            .collect();
        if expected != compiled.ordered_passes {
            return Err("postprocess execution differs from compiled dependencies".into());
        }
        Ok(Self {
            graph,
            compiled,
            scene_color,
            output,
            steps,
        })
    }
}

# File: src/projectile.rs
//! CPU sphere proxies. Scratch storage is retained between frames.
use glam::Vec3;

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(crate) struct Body {
    pub id: u32,
    /// Nonzero for pieces from the same solid; overlapping sphere proxies are false contacts.
    pub family: u64,
    pub position: Vec3,
    pub velocity: Vec3,
    pub gravity: f32,
    pub bounce: f32,
    pub radius: f32,
}

fn collide(a: &mut Body, b: &mut Body) -> (u32, bool) {
    if a.family != 0 && a.family == b.family {
        return (0, false);
    }
    let delta = b.position - a.position;
    let radii = a.radius + b.radius;
    let squared = delta.length_squared();
    if squared >= radii * radii {
        return (0, false);
    }
    let distance = squared.sqrt();
    let normal = if distance > 1e-6 {
        delta / distance
    } else {
        Vec3::X
    };
    let correction = normal * ((radii - distance) * 0.5 + 1e-5);
    a.position -= correction;
    b.position += correction;
    let closing_speed = (b.velocity - a.velocity).dot(normal);
    if closing_speed >= 0.0 {
        return (0, true);
    }
    let impulse = normal * (-(1.0 + 0.75) * closing_speed * 0.5);
    a.velocity -= impulse;
    b.velocity += impulse;
    (1, true)
}

pub(crate) fn simulate(
    bodies: &mut [Body],
    order: &mut Vec<usize>,
    pairs: &mut Vec<(usize, usize)>,
    dt: f32,
) -> u32 {
    if bodies.is_empty() {
        return 0;
    }
    let duration = dt.min(0.25);
    let steps = (duration / (1.0 / 240.0)).ceil().max(1.0) as u32;
    let step = duration / steps as f32;
    let friction = (-0.9 * step).exp();
    let max_radius = bodies.iter().map(|b| b.radius).fold(0.0, f32::max);
    let mut contacts: u32 = 0;
    order.clear();
    order.extend(0..bodies.len());
    for _ in 0..steps {
        for body in bodies.iter_mut() {
            body.velocity.y -= body.gravity * step;
            body.position += body.velocity * step;
            if body.position.y < body.radius {
                body.position.y = body.radius;
                if body.velocity.y < 0.0 {
                    body.velocity.y = -body.velocity.y * body.bounce;
                }
                body.velocity.x *= friction;
                body.velocity.z *= friction;
            }
        }
        // Corrections can create secondary contacts; rebuild the broad phase.
        for _ in 0..4 {
            let mut corrected = false;
            if bodies.len() <= 16 {
                // Tiny groups are cheaper without sorting or a spatial index.
                for i in 0..bodies.len() {
                    let (before, after) = bodies.split_at_mut(i + 1);
                    for b in after {
                        let (hits, moved) = collide(&mut before[i], b);
                        contacts = contacts.saturating_add(hits);
                        corrected |= moved;
                    }
                }
            } else {
                // Sweep sorted X bounds; build candidates before any contact correction.
                order.sort_unstable_by(|&a, &b| {
                    bodies[a].position.x.total_cmp(&bodies[b].position.x)
                });
                pairs.clear();
                for (offset, &a) in order.iter().enumerate() {
                    for &b in &order[offset + 1..] {
                        let delta = bodies[b].position - bodies[a].position;
                        if delta.x > bodies[a].radius + max_radius {
                            break;
                        }
                        let reach = bodies[a].radius + bodies[b].radius;
                        if delta.x > reach || delta.y.abs() > reach || delta.z.abs() > reach {
                            continue;
                        }
                        pairs.push((a.min(b), a.max(b)));
                    }
                }
                // Stable ID order keeps collision results independent of sorting ties.
                pairs.sort_unstable();
                for &(a, b) in pairs.iter() {
                    let (before, after) = bodies.split_at_mut(b);
                    let (hits, moved) = collide(&mut before[a], &mut after[0]);
                    contacts = contacts.saturating_add(hits);
                    corrected |= moved;
                }
            }
            if !corrected {
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    contacts
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn projectile_sibling_proxies_never_inject_a_false_impulse() {
        let body = Body {
            id: 1,
            family: 42,
            position: Vec3::Y * 3.,
            velocity: Vec3::X * 0.1,
            gravity: 0.,
            bounce: 0.,
            radius: 0.2,
        };
        let mut bodies = [
            body,
            Body {
                id: 2,
                velocity: -Vec3::X * 0.1,
                ..body
            },
        ];
        let contacts = simulate(&mut bodies, &mut Vec::new(), &mut Vec::new(), 1. / 90.);
        assert_eq!(contacts, 0);
        assert_eq!(bodies[0].velocity, body.velocity);
        assert!(bodies[0].position.distance(bodies[1].position) < 0.003);
        bodies[1].family = 43;
        bodies[0].position.x = -0.02;
        bodies[1].position.x = 0.02;
        let contacts = simulate(&mut bodies, &mut Vec::new(), &mut Vec::new(), 1. / 90.);
        assert!(contacts > 0);
        assert!(bodies[0].position.distance(bodies[1].position) >= 0.4);
    }

    #[test]
    fn sweep_rebuilds_after_correction_creates_secondary_contact() {
        let mut bodies: Vec<_> = (0..17)
            .map(|id| Body {
                id,
                family: 0,
                position: Vec3::new(
                    match id {
                        0 => 0.0,
                        1 => 1.0,
                        2 => 3.1,
                        _ => id as f32 * 10.0,
                    },
                    4.0,
                    0.0,
                ),
                velocity: Vec3::ZERO,
                gravity: 0.0,
                bounce: 0.0,
                radius: 1.0,
            })
            .collect();
        simulate(&mut bodies, &mut Vec::new(), &mut Vec::new(), 1.0 / 240.0);
        assert!((bodies[2].position - bodies[1].position).length() >= 2.0 - 1e-4);
    }
    #[test]
    fn sweep_keeps_contacts_across_mixed_radii_and_equal_x() {
        let mut bodies: Vec<_> = (0..40)
            .map(|i| Body {
                id: i,
                family: 0,
                position: Vec3::new((i / 2) as f32 * 4.0, 4.0 + (i % 2) as f32 * 0.4, 0.0),
                velocity: if i % 2 == 0 { Vec3::Y } else { -Vec3::Y },
                radius: if i % 2 == 0 { 0.2 } else { 0.5 },
                gravity: 0.0,
                bounce: 0.0,
            })
            .collect();
        let contacts = simulate(&mut bodies, &mut Vec::new(), &mut Vec::new(), 1.0 / 240.0);
        assert_eq!(contacts, 20);
        for pair in bodies.as_chunks::<2>().0 {
            assert!((pair[1].position - pair[0].position).length() >= 0.7 - 1e-5);
        }
    }
}


# File: src/render/appearance.wgsl
// ACES RRT/ODT fit by Stephen Hill, matrix/exposure convention used by Three.js
// r170 (MIT): src/renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/tonemapping_pars_fragment.glsl.js.
// This is an opt-in per-material display transform, before output sRGB encoding.
fn appearance_color(input:vec3<f32>, view_depth:f32)->vec3<f32> {
    if(scene.appearance_sky.w<0.5 || scene.appearance_sun.w<=0.0) {return input;}
    let aces_in=mat3x3<f32>(vec3(0.59719,0.07600,0.02840),vec3(0.35458,0.90834,0.13383),vec3(0.04823,0.01566,0.83777));
    let aces_out=mat3x3<f32>(vec3(1.60475,-0.10208,-0.00327),vec3(-0.53108,1.10813,-0.07276),vec3(-0.07367,-0.00605,1.07602));
    let v=aces_in*(max(input,vec3(0.0))*(scene.appearance_sun.w/0.6));
    let fitted=(v*(v+vec3(0.0245786))-vec3(0.000090537))/(v*(0.983729*v+vec3(0.4329510))+vec3(0.238081));
    let mapped=clamp(aces_out*fitted,vec3(0.0),vec3(1.0));
    let fog=smoothstep(scene.appearance_fog.w,scene.appearance_params.x,view_depth);
    return mix(mapped,scene.appearance_fog.rgb,fog);
}
fn appearance_ambient(normal:vec3<f32>)->vec3<f32> {
    return mix(scene.appearance_ground.rgb,scene.appearance_sky.rgb,normal.y*0.5+0.5)/3.14159265;
}


# File: src/render/cut_feedback.wgsl
struct SceneUniforms { view_projection: mat4x4<f32> };
@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> scene: SceneUniforms;
@group(1) @binding(0) var ring_texture: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(1) @binding(1) var ring_sampler: sampler;

struct VertexOutput {
    @builtin(position) position: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) uv: vec2<f32>,
    @location(1) @interpolate(flat) fade: f32,
    @location(2) local_z: f32,
    @location(3) @interpolate(flat) top_surface: f32,
};
@vertex fn vs_main(
    @location(0) position: vec3<f32>,
    @location(2) normal: vec3<f32>,
    @location(3) model0: vec4<f32>,
    @location(4) model1: vec4<f32>,
    @location(5) model2: vec4<f32>,
    @location(6) model3: vec4<f32>,
    @location(12) emission: vec4<f32>,
    @location(13) surface_params: vec4<f32>,
) -> VertexOutput {
    var out: VertexOutput;
    let world = mat4x4<f32>(model0, model1, model2, model3) * vec4<f32>(position, 1.0);
    out.position = scene.view_projection * world;
    out.local_z = position.z;
    out.top_surface = normal.z;
    out.uv = position.xy / 2.16 + vec2<f32>(0.5);
    out.fade = clamp(emission.x / 2.8, 0.0, 1.0);
    return out;
}
fn sampled(input: VertexOutput) -> vec4<f32> {
    // Use one cap of the closed pooled mesh as a double-sided planar decal.
    // Discard the other cap and sidewalls so alpha is applied exactly once.
    if input.local_z < 0.006 || input.top_surface < 0.9 { discard; }
    let texel = textureSample(ring_texture, ring_sampler, input.uv);
    let alpha = texel.a * input.fade;
    if alpha < 0.003 { discard; }
    return vec4<f32>(texel.rgb, alpha);
}
@fragment fn fs_main(input: VertexOutput) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> { return sampled(input); }
struct MaskOutput { @location(0) color: vec4<f32>, @location(1) mask: vec4<f32> };
@fragment fn fs_mask(input: VertexOutput) -> MaskOutput {
    var out: MaskOutput;
    out.color = sampled(input);
    out.mask = vec4<f32>(0.0);
    return out;
}
