                stats.instance_upload_calls += 1;
                stats.uniform_upload_bytes += (end - start) as u64;
                stats.instance_upload_bytes += (end - start) as u64;
                sent += (end - start) as u64;
            }
            stats.instance_gap_upload_bytes += sent - dirty_bytes;
            self.counters.set(stats);
            if fine.is_none() && sent > 0 {
                std::mem::swap(&mut s.last, &mut s.scratch);
            }
            self.instance_streams.insert((storage_key, view_slot), s);
        }
        if !blend {
            self.active_instance_pages
                .insert((storage_key, view_slot), page_index);
        }
        stages.switch(Some(4));
        let mut stats = self.counters.get();
        stats.queue_scratch_growths += capacities_before
            .into_iter()
            .zip(scratch.capacities())
            .filter(|(before, after)| before < after)
            .count() as u64;
        self.counters.set(stats);
        self.queue_scratch = scratch;
        let prepared = PreparedDraws {
            draws: Rc::new(prepared_draws),
            upload_bytes: (self.counters.get().uniform_upload_bytes - upload_before) as usize,
        };
        if let Some(view) = fine {
            let bytes = view.bytes();
            if bytes <= PLAN_BYTES {
                let mut entries = self.fine_views.borrow_mut();
                let mut total = entries.iter().flatten().map(FineView::bytes).sum::<usize>();
                for entry in entries.iter_mut() {
                    if total + bytes <= PLAN_BYTES {
                        break;
                    }
                    if let Some(old) = entry.take() {
                        total -= old.bytes();
                    }
                }
                entries[view_slot] = Some(view);
            } else {
                let mut stats = self.counters.get();
                stats.fine_cache_budget_fallbacks += 1;
                self.counters.set(stats);
            }
        }
        if cache_enabled {
            plan_key.content = self.content_epoch.get();
            self.plan_cache.borrow_mut().store(
                view_slot,
                plan_key,
                &models,
                prepared.draws.clone(),
            );
        }
        if !blend {
            self.trim_instance_pool();
        }
        if let Some(times) = stages.finish() {
            let mut stats = self.counters.get();
            stats.prepare_timed_calls += 1;
            for (total, elapsed) in stats.prepare_stage_ms.iter_mut().zip(times) {
                *total += elapsed;
            }
            self.counters.set(stats);
        }
        prepared
    }
    pub fn draw_prepared(
        &self,
        pass: &mut wgpu::RenderPass<'_>,
        prepared: &PreparedDraws,
        key: PipelineKey,
        view_slot: usize,
    ) -> usize {
        let mut stats = self.counters.get();
        if key.shadow {
            pass.set_bind_group(1, &self.empty_bind, &[]);
            stats.bind_group_changes += 1;
        }
        let mut last_variant = None;
        let mut last_textures = None;
        for d in prepared.draws.iter() {
            let Some(pipeline) = self.pipelines.get(&d.variant) else {
                continue;
            };
            if last_variant != Some(d.variant) {
                pass.set_pipeline(pipeline);
                stats.pipeline_changes += 1;
                last_variant = Some(d.variant);
            }
            // Track the canonical Rust owner; preparation clones only an Rc,
            // rather than a backend BindGroup handle for every prepared draw.
            let texture_identity = Rc::as_ptr(&d.textures);
            if last_textures != Some(texture_identity) {
                pass.set_bind_group(2, d.textures.as_ref(), &[]);
                stats.bind_group_changes += 1;
                last_textures = Some(texture_identity);
            }
            pass.set_bind_group(3, &d.bind, &[]);
            stats.bind_group_changes += 1;
            pass.set_vertex_buffer(0, d.vertex.slice(..));
            if let Some(binding) = &d.instance {
                pass.set_vertex_buffer(
                    1,
                    binding
                        .buffer
                        .slice(binding.offset..binding.offset + binding.bytes),
                );
            } else if let Some(buffer) = &d.skin {
                pass.set_vertex_buffer(1, buffer.slice(..));
            }
            pass.set_index_buffer(d.index.slice(..), d.index_format);
            pass.draw_indexed(0..d.count, 0, 0..d.instances);
            stats.draw_calls += 1;
            stats.instances_drawn += d.instances as u64;
            stats.triangles_drawn += match d.variant.topology {
                wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList => d.count / 3,
                wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleStrip => d.count.saturating_sub(2),
                _ => 0,
            } as u64
                * d.instances as u64;
            if d.variant.translated {
                stats.translated_draw_calls += 1;
                stats.translated_instances += d.instances as u64;
            }
            if d.instances > 1 {
                stats.instanced_draw_calls += 1;
            }
            if self.diagnostics.get() {
                let mut r = self.draw_records.borrow_mut();
                if r.len() < 20000 {
                    r.push(DrawRecord {
                        object: d.records[0].0,
                        node: d.records[0].1,
                        primitive: d.records[0].2,
                        indices: d.count,
                        instances: d.instances,
                        objects: d.records.iter().map(|r| r.0).collect(),
                        view_slot,
                        shadow: key.shadow,
                        reflected: key.reflected,
                        blend: d.variant.blend,
                        material_mask: key.material_mask,
                    });
                }
            }
        }
        self.counters.set(stats);
        prepared.draws.len()
    }
}
// Replace sample expressions before compilation so absent maps incur no texture
// operation on either backend. Raw fallback texels preserve the original decoder.
fn material_shader_source(key: ShaderKey) -> String {
    let ShaderKey {
        cheap_fragment,
        omit_color,
        texture_mask,
        shadow,
        opaque_unclipped,
        skinned,
        instanced,
        translated,
        single_static_shadow,
        light_class,
    } = key;
    let mut source = concat!(
        include_str!("gltf_pbr.wgsl"),
        "\n",
        include_str!("appearance.wgsl")
    )
    .to_owned();
    if single_static_shadow && !shadow {
        // Like Three's light/shadow program parameters, specialize only a proven
        // uniform state. Keep the same ordered 3x3 bilinear PCF kernel and bias.
        let start = source.find("fn shadow_visibility(").expect("shadow helper");
        let end = start + source[start..].find("struct Material").expect("material");
        source.replace_range(start..end, r#"fn shadow_visibility(index:u32,world:vec3<f32>,normal:vec3<f32>,light_direction:vec3<f32>)->f32 {
    if(index!=0u) { return 1.0; }
    let shadow_world=world+normal*scene.appearance_ground.w;
    let clip=effects.shadow_matrices[0]*vec4(shadow_world,1.0);
    let ndc=clip.xyz/clip.w;
    if (clip.w<=0.0 || ndc.z<=0.0 || ndc.z>=1.0 || any(abs(ndc.xy)>vec2(1.0))) {return 1.0;}
    let uv=ndc.xy*vec2(0.5,-0.5)+vec2(0.5);
    let bias=effects.params.w*(1.0+2.0*(1.0-max(dot(normal,light_direction),0.0)));
    let depth=ndc.z-bias;
    let texel=1.0/vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(static_shadow));
    var visibility=0.0;
    for(var y=-1;y<=1;y++) {for(var x=-1;x<=1;x++) {
        let sample_uv=uv+vec2<f32>(f32(x),f32(y))*texel;
        visibility+=textureSampleCompareLevel(static_shadow,shadow_sampler,sample_uv,depth);
    }}
    return visibility/9.0;
}

"#);
    }
    if !shadow {
        light_class.specialize(&mut source);
    }
    if skinned {
        source = source.replacen("@location(8) color:vec4<f32> };", "@location(8) color:vec4<f32>, @location(9) joints0:vec4<u32>, @location(10) joints1:vec4<u32>, @location(11) weights0:vec4<f32>, @location(12) weights1:vec4<f32> };", 1);
        source = source.replace("    // GPU_SKIN_VERTEX", "    let deformed=skin_vertex(v); local_position=deformed.position; local_normal=deformed.normal; local_tangent=deformed.tangent;");
    } else {
        // Exclude the entire palette/helper declarations from rigid variants.
        let start = source.find("// GPU_SKIN_BEGIN").expect("skin helper start");
        let end =
            source.find("// GPU_SKIN_END").expect("skin helper end") + "// GPU_SKIN_END".len();
        source.replace_range(start..end, "");
    }
    for (i, (sample, fallback)) in [
        ("textureSample(base_map,base_sampler,uv)", "vec4<f32>(1.0)"),
        ("textureSample(mr_map,mr_sampler,uv)", "vec4<f32>(1.0)"),
        (
            "textureSample(normal_map,normal_sampler,uv)",
            "vec4<f32>(128.0/255.0,128.0/255.0,1.0,1.0)",
        ),
        ("textureSample(ao_map,ao_sampler,uv)", "vec4<f32>(1.0)"),
        (
            "textureSample(emissive_map,emissive_sampler,uv)",
            "vec4<f32>(1.0)",
        ),
    ]
    .iter()
    .enumerate()
    {
        if texture_mask & (1 << i) == 0 {
            source = source.replace(sample, fallback);
        }
    }
    if texture_mask & (1 << 2) == 0 {
        // glTF without normalTexture uses the authored shading normal. Do not
        // decode an artificial 128/255 normal or construct an unused tangent frame.
        let start = source
            .find("    let mapped=sample_normal(v.uv2)")
            .expect("normal-map start");
        let end = start + source[start..].find("    let mr=").expect("normal-map end");
        source.replace_range(start..end, "");
        let derivatives = " let u1=dpdx(v.uv2); let u2=dpdy(v.uv2);";
        assert_eq!(
            source.matches(derivatives).count(),
            1,
            "normal-map derivatives"
        );
        source = source.replace(derivatives, "");
        // A tangent affects only the removed normal-map branch. Omit its input
        // fetch/layout as Three does for materials without a normal map. Keep
        // unused deformation helper outputs well-typed without altering position
        // or normal calculations, including the skinning path.
        source = source.replacen("@location(2) tangent:vec4<f32>, ", "", 1);
        source = source.replace("v.tangent", "vec4<f32>(0.0,0.0,0.0,1.0)");
    }
    source = source.replace(
        "fn uv(v:Output,index:u32)->vec2<f32> { return select(v.uv0,v.uv1,index==1u); }",
        "",
    );
    for (i, name) in ["base", "mr", "normal", "ao", "emissive"]
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
    {
        if texture_mask & (1 << i) != 0 {
            continue;
        }
        source = source.replace(&format!("sample_{name}(v.uv{i})"), "vec4<f32>(1.0)");
        source = source.replace(&format!("@location({}) uv{i}:vec2<f32>, ", i + 3), "");
        source = source.replace(&format!("o.uv{i}=v.uv{i}; "), "");
    }
    if translated {
        source = source.replacen(
            "@location(8) color:vec4<f32> };",
            "@location(8) color:vec4<f32>, @location(9) translation:vec4<f32> };",
            1,
        );
        let a = source
            .find("    if(material.transform.y>0.5) {")
            .expect("rigid transform");
        let b = a + source[a..].find("    o.pos=").expect("vertex projection");
        source.replace_range(a..b,"    let model=material.model;\n    let normal=mat3x3<f32>(material.normal[0].xyz,material.normal[1].xyz,material.normal[2].xyz);\n    o.world=(model*vec4(local_position,1.0)).xyz+v.translation.xyz;\n    o.normal=transform_unit(normal*local_normal);\n    o.tangent=vec4(transform_unit((model*vec4(local_tangent.xyz,0.0)).xyz),local_tangent.w*material.transform.x);\n");
    } else if instanced {
        source=source.replacen("@location(8) color:vec4<f32> };", "@location(8) color:vec4<f32>, @location(9) model0:vec4<f32>, @location(10) model1:vec4<f32>, @location(11) model2:vec4<f32>, @location(12) model3:vec4<f32>, @location(13) normal0:vec4<f32>, @location(14) normal1:vec4<f32>, @location(15) normal2:vec4<f32> };",1);
        let a = source
            .find("    if(material.transform.y>0.5) {")
            .expect("rigid transform");
        let b = a + source[a..].find("    o.pos=").expect("vertex projection");
        source.replace_range(a..b,"    let model=mat4x4<f32>(v.model0,v.model1,v.model2,v.model3);\n    let normal=mat3x3<f32>(v.normal0.xyz,v.normal1.xyz,v.normal2.xyz);\n    o.world=(model*vec4(local_position,1.0)).xyz;\n    o.normal=transform_unit(normal*local_normal);\n    o.tangent=vec4(transform_unit((model*vec4(local_tangent.xyz,0.0)).xyz),local_tangent.w*v.normal0.w);\n");
    }
    if omit_color {
        assert!(!skinned, "color omission is rigid-only");
        // Do this after skin/instance declarations have been injected. Omit the
        // input fetch, but retain the color interpolator: replacing its smooth
        // perspective result with fragment constant 1 changed a repeatable XR
        // pixel (max 2/255). Keep the original finite-precision fragment path.
        source = source.replacen(", @location(8) color:vec4<f32>", "", 1);
        source = source.replace("o.color=v.color;", "o.color=vec4<f32>(1.0);");
    }
    if cheap_fragment && !shadow {
        let start = source
            .find("fn surface(v:Output,front:bool)->vec4<f32> {")
            .expect("surface entry");
        let end = start
            + source[start..]
                .find("@fragment fn fs_main")
                .expect("surface end");
        source.replace_range(start..end, "fn surface(v:Output,front:bool)->vec4<f32> {\n    let base=base_color(v);\n    surface_alpha_clip(v,base.a);\n    return base;\n}\n");
    }
    if opaque_unclipped && !shadow {
        // Remove only the color entrypoints' discard call. fs_shadow continues
        // to reach alpha_test and retains MASK/BLEND shadow coverage.
        source = source.replace("    surface_alpha_clip(v,base.a);", "");
    }
    if shadow {
        source = source
            .replace(
                "var<uniform> scene: SceneUniforms;",
                "var<uniform> shadow_view: mat4x4<f32>;",
            )
            .replace("scene.view_projection", "shadow_view")
            .replace("scene.camera_pos", "vec3(0.0)")
            .replace("scene.lights[i]", "Light(vec3(0.0),0.0,vec3(0.0),0.0)");
        // Shadow variants expose only the view matrix. Color-only helpers are
        // still parsed by both backends even though fs_shadow cannot reach them.
        for field in ["sky", "ground", "sun", "fog", "params", "shadow"] {
            // Keep fog edges distinct: WebGPU rejects constant smoothstep(0,0).
            let value = if field == "params" {
                "vec4<f32>(1.0)"
            } else {
                "vec4<f32>(0.0)"
            };
            source = source.replace(&format!("scene.appearance_{field}"), value);
        }
    }

    source
}
/// Optional diagnostic work counts. No per-primitive writes in clean runs.
#[derive(Default, serde::Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct BlendSelectionStats {
    pub gltf_models_visited: u64,
    pub gltf_primitives_visited: u64,
    pub gltf_active_tests: u64,
    pub gltf_immutable_rejects: u64,
    pub gltf_no_pose_rejects: u64,
}

/// Presence, not a published pose count. The rejection class is immutable;
/// models containing BLEND still consult the live active set, including after
/// a failed pose update. Visibility and transparent ordering stay downstream.
pub fn has_blend_draw<const DIAGNOSTICS: bool>(
    model: &GpuModel,
    reference: bool,
    stats: &mut BlendSelectionStats,
) -> bool {
    if DIAGNOSTICS {
        stats.gltf_models_visited += 1;
    }
    if model.last_pose.is_none() {
        if DIAGNOSTICS {
            stats.gltf_no_pose_rejects += 1;
        }
        return false;
    }
    if reference {
        if !DIAGNOSTICS {
            return draw_count(model, true) > 0;
        }
        // Match the original full-count traversal and active-before-alpha order.
        let mut count = 0;
        for draw in &model.draws {
            stats.gltf_primitives_visited += 1;
            stats.gltf_active_tests += 1;
            if model.active.contains(&draw.node)
                && model.materials[draw.material].alpha == AlphaMode::Blend
            {
                count += 1;
            }
        }
        return count > 0;
    }
    if !model.has_blend_draws {
        if DIAGNOSTICS {
            stats.gltf_immutable_rejects += 1;
        }
        return false;
    }
    model.draws.iter().any(|draw| {
        if DIAGNOSTICS {
            stats.gltf_primitives_visited += 1;
        }
        if model.materials[draw.material].alpha != AlphaMode::Blend {
            return false;
        }
        if DIAGNOSTICS {
            stats.gltf_active_tests += 1;
        }
        model.active.contains(&draw.node)
    })
}

pub fn draw_count(model: &GpuModel, blend: bool) -> usize {
    model
        .last_pose
        .as_ref()
        .map(|_| {
            model
                .draws
                .iter()
                .filter(|d| {
                    model.active.contains(&d.node)
                        && (model.materials[d.material].alpha == AlphaMode::Blend) == blend
                })
                .count()
        })
        .unwrap_or(0)
}
fn wrap(mode: Option<WrapMode>) -> wgpu::AddressMode {
    match mode.unwrap_or(WrapMode::Repeat) {
        WrapMode::ClampToEdge => wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
        WrapMode::MirroredRepeat => wgpu::AddressMode::MirrorRepeat,
        WrapMode::Repeat => wgpu::AddressMode::Repeat,
    }
}
fn topology(mode: PrimitiveMode) -> wgpu::PrimitiveTopology {
    match mode {
        PrimitiveMode::Points => wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::PointList,
        PrimitiveMode::Lines => wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::LineList,
        PrimitiveMode::LineStrip => wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::LineStrip,
        PrimitiveMode::Triangles => wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList,
        PrimitiveMode::TriangleStrip => wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleStrip,
        PrimitiveMode::LineLoop | PrimitiveMode::TriangleFan => {
            unreachable!("normalized index topology")
        }
    }
}

fn material_slots(asset: &ModelAsset, primitive: &ModelPrimitive) -> [Option<TextureSlot>; 5] {
    primitive
        .material
        .and_then(|m| asset.materials.get(m))
        .map(|m| {
            [
                m.base_color_texture,
                m.metallic_roughness_texture,
                m.normal_texture,
                m.occlusion_texture,
                m.emissive_texture,
            ]
        })
        .unwrap_or([None; 5])
}
fn packed_vertex(
    v: &ModelVertex,
    pos: Vec3,
    n: Vec3,
    t: Vec3,
    sign: f32,
    slots: &[Option<TextureSlot>; 5],
) -> Vertex {
    Vertex {
        position: pos.into(),
        normal: n.into(),
        tangent: [t.x, t.y, t.z, v.tangent[3] * sign],
        uvs: std::array::from_fn(|i| {
            v.tex_coords
                .get(slots[i].map(|s| s.tex_coord as usize).unwrap_or(0))
                .copied()
                .unwrap_or([0.0; 2])
        }),
        color: v.color,
    }
}

// Preparation is one-off per immutable primitive. Keep nonzero influence order:
// merging duplicates or renormalizing would change the authoritative CPU math.
fn prepare_skin(
    asset: &ModelAsset,
    primitive: &ModelPrimitive,
    slots: &[Option<TextureSlot>; 5],
) -> Option<PreparedSkin> {
    let source = &asset.vertices[primitive.vertices.clone()];
    let mut vertices = Vec::with_capacity(source.len());
    let mut influences = Vec::with_capacity(source.len());
    let mut terms = vec![Vec4::ZERO; MAX_GPU_JOINTS];
    let mut identity = Vec4::ZERO;
    for v in source {
        let mut packed = SkinInfluences {
            joints0: [0; 4],
            joints1: [0; 4],
            weights0: [0.0; 4],
            weights1: [0.0; 4],
        };
        let mut count = 0;
        let mut mass = 0.0;
        if v.influences.is_empty() {
            identity += Vec3::from(v.position).extend(1.0);
        }
        for &(joint, weight) in &v.influences {
            if !weight.is_finite() || weight < 0.0 {
                return None;
            }
            if weight == 0.0 {
                continue;
            }
            if count >= 8 || joint as usize >= MAX_GPU_JOINTS {
                return None;
            }
            if count < 4 {
                packed.joints0[count] = joint;
                packed.weights0[count] = weight;
            } else {
                packed.joints1[count - 4] = joint;
                packed.weights1[count - 4] = weight;
            }
            terms[joint as usize] += Vec3::from(v.position).extend(1.0) * weight;
            mass += weight;
            count += 1;
        }
        if !v.influences.is_empty() && (!mass.is_finite() || mass <= 0.0) {
            return None;
        }
        vertices.push(packed_vertex(
            v,
            Vec3::from(v.position),
            Vec3::from(v.normal),
            Vec3::from_slice(&v.tangent[..3]),
            1.0,
            slots,
        ));
        influences.push(packed);
    }
    let divisor = source.len().max(1) as f32;
    let terms = terms
        .into_iter()
        .enumerate()
        .filter(|(_, q)| *q != Vec4::ZERO)
        .map(|(j, q)| (j, q / divisor))
        .collect();
    Some(PreparedSkin {
        vertices,
        influences,
        mean_terms: terms,
        identity_mean: identity / divisor,
    })
}


# File: src/render/gltf_pbr.wgsl
struct Light {
    position: vec3<f32>,
    _pad_p: f32,
    color: vec3<f32>,
    _pad_c: f32,
};

const LIGHT_COUNT: u32 = 4u;

struct SceneUniforms {
    view_projection: mat4x4<f32>,
    camera_pos: vec3<f32>,
    _pad0: f32,
    lights: array<Light, LIGHT_COUNT>,
    guide_padding: array<vec4<f32>,3>,
    appearance_sky: vec4<f32>,
    appearance_ground: vec4<f32>,
    appearance_sun: vec4<f32>,
    appearance_fog: vec4<f32>,
    appearance_params: vec4<f32>,
    appearance_shadow: vec4<f32>,
};

@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> scene: SceneUniforms;

struct EffectsUniforms {
    shadow_matrices:array<mat4x4<f32>,4>, reflection_matrix:mat4x4<f32>,
    clip_plane:vec4<f32>, params:vec4<f32>, shadow_layers:vec4<u32>,
};
@group(1) @binding(0) var<uniform> effects:EffectsUniforms;
@group(1) @binding(1) var static_shadow:texture_depth_2d;
@group(1) @binding(2) var dynamic_shadow:texture_depth_2d;
@group(1) @binding(3) var shadow_sampler:sampler_comparison;
@group(1) @binding(4) var reflection_texture:texture_2d<f32>;
@group(1) @binding(5) var reflection_sampler:sampler;
@group(1) @binding(6) var static_shadow_1:texture_depth_2d;
@group(1) @binding(7) var dynamic_shadow_1:texture_depth_2d;
@group(1) @binding(8) var static_shadow_2:texture_depth_2d;
@group(1) @binding(9) var dynamic_shadow_2:texture_depth_2d;
@group(1) @binding(10) var static_shadow_3:texture_depth_2d;
@group(1) @binding(11) var dynamic_shadow_3:texture_depth_2d;
// Select resources and occupied layers once; preserve all nine ordered PCF taps.
fn filter_shadow_0(uv:vec2<f32>,depth:f32,texel:vec2<f32>,layers:u32)->f32 {
    if(layers==1u) {
        var visibility=0.0;
        for(var y=-1;y<=1;y++) {for(var x=-1;x<=1;x++) {
            let sample_uv=uv+vec2<f32>(f32(x),f32(y))*texel;
            visibility+=textureSampleCompareLevel(static_shadow,shadow_sampler,sample_uv,depth);
        }}
        return visibility/9.0;
    }
    if(layers==2u) {
        var visibility=0.0;
        for(var y=-1;y<=1;y++) {for(var x=-1;x<=1;x++) {
            let sample_uv=uv+vec2<f32>(f32(x),f32(y))*texel;
            visibility+=min(1.0,textureSampleCompareLevel(dynamic_shadow,shadow_sampler,sample_uv,depth));
        }}
        return visibility/9.0;
    }
    if(layers==3u) {
        var visibility=0.0;
        for(var y=-1;y<=1;y++) {for(var x=-1;x<=1;x++) {
            let sample_uv=uv+vec2<f32>(f32(x),f32(y))*texel;
            visibility+=min(textureSampleCompareLevel(static_shadow,shadow_sampler,sample_uv,depth),textureSampleCompareLevel(dynamic_shadow,shadow_sampler,sample_uv,depth));
        }}
        return visibility/9.0;
    }
    return 1.0;
}

// Select resources and occupied layers once; preserve all nine ordered PCF taps.
fn filter_shadow_1(uv:vec2<f32>,depth:f32,texel:vec2<f32>,layers:u32)->f32 {
    if(layers==1u) {
        var visibility=0.0;
        for(var y=-1;y<=1;y++) {for(var x=-1;x<=1;x++) {
            let sample_uv=uv+vec2<f32>(f32(x),f32(y))*texel;
            visibility+=textureSampleCompareLevel(static_shadow_1,shadow_sampler,sample_uv,depth);
        }}
        return visibility/9.0;
    }
    if(layers==2u) {
        var visibility=0.0;
        for(var y=-1;y<=1;y++) {for(var x=-1;x<=1;x++) {
            let sample_uv=uv+vec2<f32>(f32(x),f32(y))*texel;
            visibility+=min(1.0,textureSampleCompareLevel(dynamic_shadow_1,shadow_sampler,sample_uv,depth));
        }}
        return visibility/9.0;
    }
    if(layers==3u) {
        var visibility=0.0;
        for(var y=-1;y<=1;y++) {for(var x=-1;x<=1;x++) {
            let sample_uv=uv+vec2<f32>(f32(x),f32(y))*texel;
            visibility+=min(textureSampleCompareLevel(static_shadow_1,shadow_sampler,sample_uv,depth),textureSampleCompareLevel(dynamic_shadow_1,shadow_sampler,sample_uv,depth));
        }}
        return visibility/9.0;
    }
    return 1.0;
}

// Select resources and occupied layers once; preserve all nine ordered PCF taps.
fn filter_shadow_2(uv:vec2<f32>,depth:f32,texel:vec2<f32>,layers:u32)->f32 {
    if(layers==1u) {
        var visibility=0.0;
        for(var y=-1;y<=1;y++) {for(var x=-1;x<=1;x++) {
            let sample_uv=uv+vec2<f32>(f32(x),f32(y))*texel;
            visibility+=textureSampleCompareLevel(static_shadow_2,shadow_sampler,sample_uv,depth);
        }}
        return visibility/9.0;
    }
    if(layers==2u) {
        var visibility=0.0;
        for(var y=-1;y<=1;y++) {for(var x=-1;x<=1;x++) {
            let sample_uv=uv+vec2<f32>(f32(x),f32(y))*texel;
            visibility+=min(1.0,textureSampleCompareLevel(dynamic_shadow_2,shadow_sampler,sample_uv,depth));
        }}
        return visibility/9.0;
    }
    if(layers==3u) {
        var visibility=0.0;
        for(var y=-1;y<=1;y++) {for(var x=-1;x<=1;x++) {
            let sample_uv=uv+vec2<f32>(f32(x),f32(y))*texel;
            visibility+=min(textureSampleCompareLevel(static_shadow_2,shadow_sampler,sample_uv,depth),textureSampleCompareLevel(dynamic_shadow_2,shadow_sampler,sample_uv,depth));
        }}
        return visibility/9.0;
    }
    return 1.0;
}

// Select resources and occupied layers once; preserve all nine ordered PCF taps.
fn filter_shadow_3(uv:vec2<f32>,depth:f32,texel:vec2<f32>,layers:u32)->f32 {
    if(layers==1u) {
        var visibility=0.0;
        for(var y=-1;y<=1;y++) {for(var x=-1;x<=1;x++) {
            let sample_uv=uv+vec2<f32>(f32(x),f32(y))*texel;
            visibility+=textureSampleCompareLevel(static_shadow_3,shadow_sampler,sample_uv,depth);
        }}
        return visibility/9.0;
    }
    if(layers==2u) {
        var visibility=0.0;
        for(var y=-1;y<=1;y++) {for(var x=-1;x<=1;x++) {
            let sample_uv=uv+vec2<f32>(f32(x),f32(y))*texel;
            visibility+=min(1.0,textureSampleCompareLevel(dynamic_shadow_3,shadow_sampler,sample_uv,depth));
        }}
        return visibility/9.0;
    }
    if(layers==3u) {
        var visibility=0.0;
        for(var y=-1;y<=1;y++) {for(var x=-1;x<=1;x++) {
            let sample_uv=uv+vec2<f32>(f32(x),f32(y))*texel;
            visibility+=min(textureSampleCompareLevel(static_shadow_3,shadow_sampler,sample_uv,depth),textureSampleCompareLevel(dynamic_shadow_3,shadow_sampler,sample_uv,depth));
        }}
        return visibility/9.0;
    }
    return 1.0;
}
fn shadow_visibility(index:u32,world:vec3<f32>,normal:vec3<f32>,light_direction:vec3<f32>)->f32 {
    if(effects.shadow_layers[index]==0u) { return 1.0; }
    // Receiver normal offset follows the authored shadow profile; zero for legacy scenes.
    let shadow_world=world+normal*scene.appearance_ground.w;
    let clip=effects.shadow_matrices[index]*vec4(shadow_world,1.0);
    let ndc=clip.xyz/clip.w;
    if (clip.w<=0.0 || ndc.z<=0.0 || ndc.z>=1.0 || any(abs(ndc.xy)>vec2(1.0))) {return 1.0;}
    let uv=ndc.xy*vec2(0.5,-0.5)+vec2(0.5);
    let bias=effects.params.w*(1.0+2.0*(1.0-max(dot(normal,light_direction),0.0)));
    let depth=ndc.z-bias;
    let texel=1.0/vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(static_shadow));
    let layers=effects.shadow_layers[index];
    switch index {
        case 0u: { return filter_shadow_0(uv,depth,texel,layers); }
        case 1u: { return filter_shadow_1(uv,depth,texel,layers); }
        case 2u: { return filter_shadow_2(uv,depth,texel,layers); }
        case 3u: { return filter_shadow_3(uv,depth,texel,layers); }
        default: { return 1.0; }
    }
}


struct Material { base:vec4<f32>, emissive:vec4<f32>, factors:vec4<f32>, uv:vec4<u32>, extra:vec4<f32>, options:vec4<f32>, model:mat4x4<f32>, normal:mat4x4<f32>, transform:vec4<f32> };
@group(3) @binding(0) var<uniform> material:Material;
@group(2) @binding(0) var base_map:texture_2d<f32>;
@group(2) @binding(1) var base_sampler:sampler;
@group(2) @binding(2) var mr_map:texture_2d<f32>;
@group(2) @binding(3) var mr_sampler:sampler;
@group(2) @binding(4) var normal_map:texture_2d<f32>;
@group(2) @binding(5) var normal_sampler:sampler;
@group(2) @binding(6) var ao_map:texture_2d<f32>;
@group(2) @binding(7) var ao_sampler:sampler;
@group(2) @binding(8) var emissive_map:texture_2d<f32>;
@group(2) @binding(9) var emissive_sampler:sampler;
struct Input { @location(0) position:vec3<f32>, @location(1) normal:vec3<f32>, @location(2) tangent:vec4<f32>, @location(3) uv0:vec2<f32>, @location(4) uv1:vec2<f32>, @location(5) uv2:vec2<f32>, @location(6) uv3:vec2<f32>, @location(7) uv4:vec2<f32>, @location(8) color:vec4<f32> };
struct Output { @builtin(position) pos:vec4<f32>, @location(0) world:vec3<f32>, @location(1) normal:vec3<f32>, @location(2) tangent:vec4<f32>, @location(3) uv0:vec2<f32>, @location(4) uv1:vec2<f32>, @location(5) uv2:vec2<f32>, @location(6) uv3:vec2<f32>, @location(7) uv4:vec2<f32>, @location(8) color:vec4<f32> };
// CPU-deformed draws retain the existing world-space path.
fn transform_unit(v:vec3<f32>)->vec3<f32> {
    let length_squared=dot(v,v);
    if(length_squared>0.0) {
        let inverse_length=1.0/sqrt(length_squared);
        // Match normalize_or_zero for overflow/underflow as well as zero.
        if(inverse_length>0.0 && inverse_length<=3.402823466e38) { return v*inverse_length; }
    }
    return vec3(0.0);
}
@vertex fn vs_main(v:Input)->Output {
    var o:Output;
    var local_position=v.position; var local_normal=v.normal; var local_tangent=v.tangent;
    // GPU_SKIN_VERTEX
    o.world=local_position; o.normal=local_normal; o.tangent=local_tangent;
    if(material.transform.y>0.5) {
        o.world=(material.model*vec4(local_position,1.0)).xyz;
        o.normal=transform_unit((material.normal*vec4(local_normal,0.0)).xyz);
        o.tangent=vec4(transform_unit((material.model*vec4(local_tangent.xyz,0.0)).xyz),local_tangent.w*material.transform.x);
    }
    o.pos=scene.view_projection*vec4(o.world,1.0);
    o.uv0=v.uv0; o.uv1=v.uv1; o.uv2=v.uv2; o.uv3=v.uv3; o.uv4=v.uv4; o.color=v.color;
    return o;
}
fn uv(v:Output,index:u32)->vec2<f32> { return select(v.uv0,v.uv1,index==1u); }
fn linear_color(c:vec3<f32>)->vec3<f32> { return select(c/12.92,pow((c+vec3(0.055))/1.055,vec3(2.4)),c>vec3(0.04045)); }
// Rust specializes these sample expressions by actual map presence. Keep the
// fallback normal decoder and complete derivative/TBN path in surface unchanged.
fn sample_base(uv:vec2<f32>)->vec4<f32> { return textureSample(base_map,base_sampler,uv); }
fn sample_mr(uv:vec2<f32>)->vec4<f32> { return textureSample(mr_map,mr_sampler,uv); }
fn sample_normal(uv:vec2<f32>)->vec4<f32> { return textureSample(normal_map,normal_sampler,uv); }
fn sample_ao(uv:vec2<f32>)->vec4<f32> { return textureSample(ao_map,ao_sampler,uv); }
fn sample_emissive(uv:vec2<f32>)->vec4<f32> { return textureSample(emissive_map,emissive_sampler,uv); }
fn base_color(v:Output)->vec4<f32> { let t=sample_base(v.uv0); return t*material.base*v.color; }
fn alpha_test(alpha:f32) { if(material.extra.y==1.0 && alpha<material.extra.x) { discard; } }
// Only the opaque, unclipped color variant omits this call. Shadow alpha tests
// remain separate so their material coverage is never specialized away.
fn surface_alpha_clip(v:Output,alpha:f32) {
    alpha_test(alpha);
    if(effects.params.z>0.5 && dot(effects.clip_plane,vec4(v.world,1.0)) < -0.001) { discard; }
}
fn unit(v:vec3<f32>)->vec3<f32> { return v*inverseSqrt(max(dot(v,v),0.000000000001)); }
fn surface(v:Output,front:bool)->vec4<f32> {
    let normal_variation=max(abs(dpdx(unit(v.normal))),abs(dpdy(unit(v.normal))));
    let p1=dpdx(v.world); let p2=dpdy(v.world); let u1=dpdx(v.uv2); let u2=dpdy(v.uv2);
    let base=base_color(v); let emission=sample_emissive(v.uv4).rgb*material.emissive.rgb;
    surface_alpha_clip(v,base.a);
    if(material.extra.w>0.5) { return vec4(appearance_color(base.rgb+emission,1.0/v.pos.w),base.a); }
    var n=unit(v.normal); let view=unit(scene.camera_pos-v.world);
    if(material.options.w>0.5) {
        let geometric=cross(p1,p2);
        if(dot(geometric,geometric)>0.0000000001) {
            n=unit(geometric);
            if(dot(n,view)<0.0) { n=-n; }
        }
    }
    // Screen-space handedness differs between LH main and reflected passes.
    if(material.extra.z>0.5 && dot(n,view)<0.0) { n=-n; }
    let mapped=sample_normal(v.uv2).xyz*2.0-vec3(1.0);
    let scaled=vec3(mapped.xy*material.factors.z,mapped.z);
    var t=unit(v.tangent.xyz-n*dot(n,v.tangent.xyz));
    var b=cross(n,t)*v.tangent.w;
    if(dot(v.tangent.xyz,v.tangent.xyz)<0.01) {
        let det=u1.x*u2.y-u1.y*u2.x;
        if(abs(det)>0.0000001) { t=unit((p1*u2.y-p2*u1.y)/det); b=unit((-p1*u2.x+p2*u1.x)/det); }
        else { t=unit(cross(select(vec3(0.0,1.0,0.0),vec3(1.0,0.0,0.0),abs(n.y)>0.9),n)); b=cross(n,t); }
    }
    n=unit(t*scaled.x+b*scaled.y+n*scaled.z);
    let mr=sample_mr(v.uv1);
    let metallic=clamp(material.factors.x*mr.b,0.0,1.0); let rough=clamp(max(0.045,material.factors.y*mr.g)+select(0.0,max(max(normal_variation.x,normal_variation.y),normal_variation.z),scene.appearance_sky.w>0.5 && scene.appearance_params.y>0.5),0.045,1.0);
    let ao=mix(1.0,sample_ao(v.uv3).r,material.factors.w);
    let f0=mix(vec3(0.04),base.rgb,metallic); let nv=max(dot(n,view),0.0001); let a=rough*rough; let a2=a*a;
    var color=base.rgb*(1.0-metallic)*select(vec3(0.1),appearance_ambient(n),scene.appearance_sky.w>0.5)*ao;
    for(var i=0u;i<LIGHT_COUNT;i++) {
        if(all(scene.lights[i].color==vec3(0.0))) {continue;}
        let delta=scene.lights[i].position-v.world; let l=select(unit(delta),scene.appearance_sun.xyz,scene.appearance_sky.w>0.5 && i==0u); let h=unit(l+view); let nl=max(dot(n,l),0.0); let nh=max(dot(n,h),0.0); let vh=max(dot(view,h),0.0);
        let d=a2/(3.14159265*pow(nh*nh*(a2-1.0)+1.0,2.0));
        let gv=2.0*nv/(nv+sqrt(a2+(1.0-a2)*nv*nv)); let gl=2.0*nl/max(nl+sqrt(a2+(1.0-a2)*nl*nl),0.0001);
        let f=f0+(vec3(1.0)-f0)*pow(1.0-vh,5.0); let spec=d*gv*gl*f/max(4.0*nv*nl,0.0001);
        var visibility=1.0; if(nl>0.0 && i<u32(effects.params.x) && material.options.y>0.5) { visibility=shadow_visibility(i,v.world,n,l); }
        color+=((vec3(1.0)-f)*(1.0-metallic)*base.rgb/3.14159265+spec)*scene.lights[i].color*nl*visibility;
    }
    color+=emission;
    if(effects.params.y>0.5 && material.options.z>0.5 && material.options.x>0.0) {
        let r=effects.reflection_matrix*vec4(v.world,1.0); let u=r.xy/r.w*vec2(0.5,-0.5)+vec2(0.5);
        if(r.w>0.0 && all(u>=vec2(0.0)) && all(u<=vec2(1.0))) { color=mix(color,textureSampleLevel(reflection_texture,reflection_sampler,u,0.0).rgb,material.options.x); }
    }
    return vec4(appearance_color(color,1.0/v.pos.w),base.a);
}
@fragment fn fs_main(v:Output,@builtin(front_facing) front:bool)->@location(0) vec4<f32> { let c=surface(v,front); return vec4(c.rgb,select(1.0,c.a,material.extra.y==2.0)); }
@fragment fn fs_material_mask(v:Output,@builtin(front_facing) front:bool)->@location(0) vec4<f32> { let c=surface(v,front); return vec4(c.rgb,material.options.x); }
struct PostSurface { @location(0) color:vec4<f32>, @location(1) depth:vec4<f32> };
@fragment fn fs_postprocess(v:Output,@builtin(front_facing) front:bool)->PostSurface { var o:PostSurface; let c=surface(v,front); o.color=vec4(c.rgb,material.options.x); var e=fract(min(v.pos.z,0.9999999)*vec3(1.0,255.0,65025.0)); e-=e.yzz*vec3(1.0/255.0,1.0/255.0,0.0); o.depth=vec4(e,1.0); return o; }
@fragment fn fs_shadow(v:Output) { alpha_test(base_color(v).a); if(material.extra.y==2.0 && base_color(v).a<0.5) { discard; } }

// GPU_SKIN_BEGIN
@group(3) @binding(1) var<uniform> skin_palette:array<mat4x4<f32>,128>;
struct DeformedVertex { position:vec3<f32>, normal:vec3<f32>, tangent:vec4<f32> };
fn finite_vector(v:vec3<f32>)->bool { return all(abs(v)<=vec3(3.402823466e38)); }
fn skin_vertex(v:Input)->DeformedVertex {
    var skin=mat4x4<f32>(vec4(0.0),vec4(0.0),vec4(0.0),vec4(0.0));
    var influenced=false;
    for(var i=0u;i<4u;i=i+1u) {
        if(v.weights0[i]!=0.0) { skin=skin+skin_palette[v.joints0[i]]*v.weights0[i]; influenced=true; }
    }
    for(var i=0u;i<4u;i=i+1u) {
        if(v.weights1[i]!=0.0) { skin=skin+skin_palette[v.joints1[i]]*v.weights1[i]; influenced=true; }
    }
    if(!influenced) { skin=mat4x4<f32>(vec4(1.0,0.0,0.0,0.0),vec4(0.0,1.0,0.0,0.0),vec4(0.0,0.0,1.0,0.0),vec4(0.0,0.0,0.0,1.0)); }
    let linear=mat3x3<f32>(skin[0].xyz,skin[1].xyz,skin[2].xyz);
    let cofactors=mat3x3<f32>(cross(linear[1],linear[2]),cross(linear[2],linear[0]),cross(linear[0],linear[1]));
    let determinant=dot(linear[0],cofactors[0]);
    var n=linear*v.normal;
    if(determinant!=0.0) {
        let inverse_transpose=cofactors*(1.0/determinant);
        if(finite_vector(inverse_transpose[0]) && finite_vector(inverse_transpose[1]) && finite_vector(inverse_transpose[2])) { n=inverse_transpose*v.normal; }
    }
    n=transform_unit(n);
    if(dot(n,n)==0.0) { n=vec3(0.0,1.0,0.0); }
    let transformed_tangent=linear*v.tangent.xyz;
    let t=transform_unit(transformed_tangent-n*dot(n,transformed_tangent));
    return DeformedVertex((skin*vec4(v.position,1.0)).xyz,n,vec4(t,v.tangent.w*select(1.0,-1.0,determinant<0.0)));
}
// GPU_SKIN_END


# File: src/render/graph_probe.rs
//! Explicit GPU acceptance probe for graph-allocated storage buffers.
use super::graph_resources::GraphResources;
use crate::frame_graph::{Graph, Lifetime, ResourceDesc};
use wasm_bindgen::JsValue;
use wasm_bindgen_futures::JsFuture;

const VALUES: u32 = 64;
const BYTES: u64 = VALUES as u64 * 4;
const SHADER: &str = r#"
@group(0) @binding(0) var<storage, read_write> destination: array<u32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var<storage, read> source: array<u32>;
@compute @workgroup_size(64)
fn fill(@builtin(global_invocation_id) id: vec3<u32>) {
    destination[id.x] = id.x + 1u;
}
@compute @workgroup_size(64)
fn double_values(@builtin(global_invocation_id) id: vec3<u32>) {
    destination[id.x] = source[id.x] * 2u;
}
"#;

struct Mapping(wgpu::Buffer);
impl Drop for Mapping {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.0.unmap();
    }
}

pub async fn run(device: wgpu::Device, queue: wgpu::Queue) -> Result<serde_json::Value, String> {
    if device.limits().max_compute_workgroups_per_dimension == 0 {
        return Ok(serde_json::json!({
            "supported": false, "reason": "compute shaders unavailable on this backend"
        }));
    }
    let mut graph = Graph::default();
    let descriptor = ResourceDesc::Buffer {
        size: BYTES,
        usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_SRC,
    };
    let a = graph.resource("first.input", descriptor.clone(), Lifetime::Transient);
    let b = graph.resource("first.export", descriptor.clone(), Lifetime::Transient);
    let c = graph.resource("later.input", descriptor.clone(), Lifetime::Transient);
    let d = graph.resource("later.export", descriptor, Lifetime::Transient);
    let first_fill = graph.pass("first.fill", &[], &[a], false)?;
    let first_double = graph.pass("first.double", &[a], &[b], false)?;
    let later_fill = graph.pass("later.fill", &[], &[c], false)?;
    let later_double = graph.pass("later.double", &[c], &[d], false)?;
    let plan = graph.compile(&[b, d])?;
    if plan.resource_slots[a.0] == plan.resource_slots[b.0]
        || plan.resource_slots[c.0] == plan.resource_slots[d.0]
        || plan.resource_slots[a.0] != plan.resource_slots[c.0]
        || plan.resource_slots[b.0] == plan.resource_slots[c.0]
        || plan.resource_slots[b.0] == plan.resource_slots[d.0]
        || plan.resource_lifetimes[b.0].map(|range| range.last_use) != Some(3)
    {
        return Err("storage buffer aliasing or exported-output lifetime is invalid".into());
    }
    let resources = GraphResources::new(&device, &plan)?;
    if resources.buffer_count() != 3 || resources.texture_count() != 0 {
        return Err("expected three physical storage buffers for four logical buffers".into());
    }
    let shader = device.create_shader_module(wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor {
        label: Some("frame graph buffer acceptance"),
        source: wgpu::ShaderSource::Wgsl(SHADER.into()),
    });
    let pipeline = |entry| {
        device.create_compute_pipeline(&wgpu::ComputePipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some(entry),
            layout: None,
            module: &shader,
            entry_point: Some(entry),
            compilation_options: Default::default(),
            cache: None,
        })
    };
    let fill = pipeline("fill");
    let double = pipeline("double_values");
    let fill_group = |resource| -> Result<wgpu::BindGroup, String> {
        Ok(device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("frame graph fill buffer"),
            layout: &fill.get_bind_group_layout(0),
            entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 0,
                resource: resources.buffer(resource)?.as_entire_binding(),
            }],
        }))
    };
    let double_group = |source, destination| -> Result<wgpu::BindGroup, String> {
        Ok(device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("frame graph double buffers"),
            layout: &double.get_bind_group_layout(0),
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    resource: resources.buffer(destination)?.as_entire_binding(),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    resource: resources.buffer(source)?.as_entire_binding(),
                },
            ],
        }))
    };
    let first_fill_group = fill_group(a)?;
    let later_fill_group = fill_group(c)?;
    let first_double_group = double_group(a, b)?;
    let later_double_group = double_group(c, d)?;
    let readback = Mapping(device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
        label: Some("frame graph exports readback"),
        size: BYTES * 2,
        usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST | wgpu::BufferUsages::MAP_READ,
        mapped_at_creation: false,
    }));
    let mut encoder = device.create_command_encoder(&wgpu::CommandEncoderDescriptor {
        label: Some("compiled frame graph buffer execution"),
    });
    for id in &plan.ordered_passes {
        let (pipeline, bindings) = if *id == first_fill {
            (&fill, &first_fill_group)
        } else if *id == first_double {
            (&double, &first_double_group)
        } else if *id == later_fill {
            (&fill, &later_fill_group)
        } else if *id == later_double {
            (&double, &later_double_group)
        } else {
            return Err(format!("missing GPU handler for compiled pass {}", id.0));
        };
        let mut pass = encoder.begin_compute_pass(&wgpu::ComputePassDescriptor {
            label: graph.pass_name(*id),
            timestamp_writes: None,
        });
        pass.set_pipeline(pipeline);
        pass.set_bind_group(0, bindings, &[]);
        pass.dispatch_workgroups(1, 1, 1);
    }
    encoder.copy_buffer_to_buffer(resources.buffer(b)?, 0, &readback.0, 0, BYTES);
    encoder.copy_buffer_to_buffer(resources.buffer(d)?, 0, &readback.0, BYTES, BYTES);
    queue.submit(Some(encoder.finish()));
    let promise = js_sys::Promise::new(&mut |resolve, reject| {
        readback
            .0
            .slice(..)
            .map_async(wgpu::MapMode::Read, move |result| match result {
                Ok(()) => {
                    let _ = resolve.call0(&JsValue::UNDEFINED);
                }
                Err(error) => {
                    let _ =
                        reject.call1(&JsValue::UNDEFINED, &JsValue::from_str(&error.to_string()));
                }
            });
    });
    JsFuture::from(promise)
        .await
        .map_err(|error| format!("buffer readback map failed: {error:?}"))?;
    let data = readback
        .0
        .slice(..)
        .get_mapped_range()
        .map_err(|error| error.to_string())?;
    for (index, bytes) in data.as_chunks::<4>().0.iter().enumerate() {
        let actual = u32::from_le_bytes(*bytes);
        let expected = 2 * (index as u32 % VALUES + 1);
        if actual != expected {
            return Err(format!(
                "buffer export {} element {}: expected {expected}, received {actual}",
                index / VALUES as usize,
                index % VALUES as usize
            ));
        }
    }
    drop(data);
    Ok(serde_json::json!({
        "supported": true,
        "verifiedValues": VALUES * 2,
        "logicalBuffers": 4,
        "physicalBuffers": resources.buffer_count(),
        "allocatedBytesEstimate": resources.allocated_bytes_estimate(),
        "overlapSeparated": true,
        "nonoverlapAliased": true,
        "exportRetained": true,
        "graph": graph.debug_summary(&plan),
    }))
}


# File: src/render/graph_resources.rs
//! Owns actual GPU allocations for a compiled graph's transient slots.
//! Keep this object alongside cached render targets; rebuild on plan/size changes.
use crate::frame_graph::{CompiledGraph, ResourceDesc, ResourceId};

enum Slot {
    Texture {
        texture: wgpu::Texture,
        view: wgpu::TextureView,
    },
    Buffer(wgpu::Buffer),
}

pub struct GraphResources {
    resource_slots: Vec<Option<usize>>,
    slots: Vec<Slot>,
    allocated_bytes_estimate: u64,
}

impl GraphResources {
    /// External and persistent resources remain caller-owned. No usage flags
    /// are added to the declarations and no device-global cache is installed.
    /// Device-specific format/usage support is still validated by wgpu.
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device, plan: &CompiledGraph) -> Result<Self, String> {
        let limits = device.limits();
        for slot in plan.resource_slots.iter().flatten() {
            if *slot >= plan.slots.len() {
                return Err(format!(
                    "frame graph maps a resource to missing slot {slot}"
                ));
            }
        }
        // Validate the whole plan before creating the first allocation.
        for (index, desc) in plan.slots.iter().enumerate() {
            validate_slot(desc, &limits)
                .map_err(|error| format!("frame graph slot {index}: {error}"))?;
        }
        let mut slots = Vec::with_capacity(plan.slots.len());
        let mut allocated_bytes_estimate = 0u64;
        for (index, desc) in plan.slots.iter().enumerate() {
            let label = format!("frame graph transient slot {index}");
            allocated_bytes_estimate =
                allocated_bytes_estimate.saturating_add(estimate_bytes(desc));
            slots.push(match *desc {
                ResourceDesc::Texture {
                    width,
                    height,
                    layers,
                    samples,
                    format,
                    usage,
                } => {
                    let texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
                        label: Some(&label),
                        size: wgpu::Extent3d {
                            width,
                            height,
                            depth_or_array_layers: layers,
                        },
                        mip_level_count: 1,
                        sample_count: samples,
                        dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
                        format,
                        usage,
                        view_formats: &[],
                    });
                    let view = texture.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor::default());
                    Slot::Texture { texture, view }
                }
                ResourceDesc::Buffer { size, usage } => {
                    Slot::Buffer(device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
                        label: Some(&label),
                        size,
                        usage,
                        mapped_at_creation: false,
                    }))
                }
            });
        }
        Ok(Self {
            resource_slots: plan.resource_slots.clone(),
            slots,
            allocated_bytes_estimate,
        })
    }

    pub fn view(&self, resource: ResourceId) -> Result<&wgpu::TextureView, String> {
        match self.slot(resource)? {
            Slot::Texture { view, .. } => Ok(view),
            Slot::Buffer(_) => Err(format!(
                "resource {} is a buffer, not a texture",
                resource.0
            )),
        }
    }

    pub fn texture(&self, resource: ResourceId) -> Result<&wgpu::Texture, String> {
        match self.slot(resource)? {
            Slot::Texture { texture, .. } => Ok(texture),
            Slot::Buffer(_) => Err(format!(
                "resource {} is a buffer, not a texture",
                resource.0
            )),
        }
    }

    pub fn buffer(&self, resource: ResourceId) -> Result<&wgpu::Buffer, String> {
        match self.slot(resource)? {
            Slot::Buffer(buffer) => Ok(buffer),
            Slot::Texture { .. } => Err(format!(
                "resource {} is a texture, not a buffer",
                resource.0
            )),
        }
    }

    pub fn texture_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.slots
            .iter()
            .filter(|slot| matches!(slot, Slot::Texture { .. }))
            .count()
    }

    pub fn buffer_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.slots.len() - self.texture_count()
    }

    /// Texel/block payload only: excludes implementation alignment and metadata.
    /// Opaque depth/stencil formats use an approximate 4/8 bytes per texel.
    pub fn allocated_bytes_estimate(&self) -> u64 {
        self.allocated_bytes_estimate
    }

    fn slot(&self, resource: ResourceId) -> Result<&Slot, String> {
        let slot = self.resource_slots.get(resource.0)
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("unknown frame graph resource {}", resource.0))?
            .ok_or_else(|| format!(
                "resource {} has no transient allocation (unused or caller-owned external/persistent resource)", resource.0
            ))?;
        Ok(&self.slots[slot])
    }
}

fn validate_slot(desc: &ResourceDesc, limits: &wgpu::Limits) -> Result<(), String> {
    match *desc {
        ResourceDesc::Texture {
            width,
            height,
            layers,
            samples,
            format,
            usage,
        } => {
            if width == 0
                || height == 0
                || layers == 0
                || width > limits.max_texture_dimension_2d
                || height > limits.max_texture_dimension_2d
                || layers > limits.max_texture_array_layers
            {
                return Err("invalid 2D texture extent or device texture limit exceeded".into());
            }
            if !matches!(samples, 1 | 2 | 4 | 8 | 16) || (samples > 1 && layers != 1) {
                return Err("invalid sample count or multisampled array texture".into());
            }
            if usage.is_empty() || format.is_multi_planar_format() {
                return Err("texture requires nonempty usage and a single-plane format".into());
            }
            let (block_width, block_height) = format.block_dimensions();
            if !width.is_multiple_of(block_width) || !height.is_multiple_of(block_height) {
                return Err("texture dimensions must align to format block dimensions".into());
            }
        }
        ResourceDesc::Buffer { size, usage } => {
            if size == 0 || size > limits.max_buffer_size || usage.is_empty() {
                return Err("invalid buffer size/usage or device buffer limit exceeded".into());
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn estimate_bytes(desc: &ResourceDesc) -> u64 {
    match *desc {
        ResourceDesc::Buffer { size, .. } => size,
        ResourceDesc::Texture {
            width,
            height,
            layers,
            samples,
            format,
            ..
        } => {
            let (block_width, block_height) = format.block_dimensions();
            let block_size = format.block_copy_size(None).unwrap_or_else(|| {
                if format == wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth32FloatStencil8 {
                    8
                } else {
                    4
                }
            });
            u64::from(width.div_ceil(block_width))
                .saturating_mul(u64::from(height.div_ceil(block_height)))
                .saturating_mul(u64::from(layers))
                .saturating_mul(u64::from(samples))
                .saturating_mul(u64::from(block_size))
        }
    }
}


# File: src/render/hud.rs
//! Optional final-output pass. No resources exist until first enabled.
use super::target::RenderTarget;
use crate::debug_overlay::HudRect;

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct DebugHud {
    pipeline: Option<(wgpu::TextureFormat, wgpu::RenderPipeline)>,
    buffer: Option<wgpu::Buffer>,
    capacity: usize,
    count: u32,
    size: (u32, u32),
    xr: bool,
    elapsed: f32,
    pub frames: u64,
    pub refreshes: u64,
}
impl DebugHud {
    pub fn invalidate(&mut self) {
        self.size = (0, 0);
    }
    pub fn render(
        &mut self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        queue: &wgpu::Queue,
        target: &RenderTarget<'_>,
        dt: f32,
        xr: bool,
        content: impl FnOnce() -> crate::debug_overlay::HudContent,
    ) -> usize {
        self.elapsed += dt.clamp(0.0, 0.25);
        let mut uploaded = 0;
        if self.size != (target.width, target.height) || self.xr != xr || self.elapsed >= 0.25 {
            let rects = match content() {
                crate::debug_overlay::HudContent::Desktop(lines) => {
                    crate::debug_overlay::geometry(&lines, target.width, target.height)
                }
                crate::debug_overlay::HudContent::Xr(content) => {
                    crate::debug_overlay::geometry_xr_tables(&content, target.width, target.height)
                }
            };
            if rects.len() > self.capacity {
                self.capacity = rects.len().next_power_of_two();
                self.buffer = Some(device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
                    label: Some("debug HUD pixels"),
                    size: (self.capacity * std::mem::size_of::<HudRect>()) as u64,
                    usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::VERTEX | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
                    mapped_at_creation: false,
                }));
            }
            let bytes = bytemuck::cast_slice(&rects);
            queue.write_buffer(self.buffer.as_ref().unwrap(), 0, bytes);
            uploaded = bytes.len();
            self.count = rects.len() as u32;
            self.size = (target.width, target.height);
            self.xr = xr;
            self.elapsed = 0.0;
            self.refreshes += 1;
        }
        if self.pipeline.as_ref().map(|p| p.0) != Some(target.color_format) {
            let shader = device.create_shader_module(wgpu::include_wgsl!("hud.wgsl"));
            let layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
                label: Some("debug HUD layout"),
                bind_group_layouts: &[],
                immediate_size: 0,
            });
            let pipeline = device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
                label: Some("debug HUD"),
                layout: Some(&layout),
                vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
                    module: &shader,
                    entry_point: Some("vs"),
                    compilation_options: Default::default(),
                    buffers: &[Some(wgpu::VertexBufferLayout {
                        array_stride: std::mem::size_of::<HudRect>() as u64,
                        step_mode: wgpu::VertexStepMode::Instance,
                        attributes: &wgpu::vertex_attr_array![0 => Float32x4, 1 => Float32x4],
                    })],
                },
                fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
                    module: &shader,
                    entry_point: Some("fs"),
                    compilation_options: Default::default(),
                    targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                        format: target.color_format,
                        blend: Some(wgpu::BlendState::ALPHA_BLENDING),
                        write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
                    })],
                }),
                primitive: Default::default(),
                depth_stencil: None,
                multisample: Default::default(),
                multiview_mask: None,
                cache: None,
            });
            self.pipeline = Some((target.color_format, pipeline));
        }
        let mut encoder = device.create_command_encoder(&wgpu::CommandEncoderDescriptor {
            label: Some("debug HUD"),
        });
        {
            let stamp = super::profiler::stamp("hud");
            let mut pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
                label: Some("debug HUD"),
                color_attachments: &[Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                    view: target.color,
                    depth_slice: None,
                    resolve_target: None,
                    ops: wgpu::Operations {
                        load: wgpu::LoadOp::Load,
                        store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                    },
                })],
                depth_stencil_attachment: None,
                timestamp_writes: stamp.as_ref().map(|stamp| stamp.writes()),
                occlusion_query_set: None,
                multiview_mask: None,
            });
            pass.set_pipeline(&self.pipeline.as_ref().unwrap().1);
            pass.set_vertex_buffer(0, self.buffer.as_ref().unwrap().slice(..));
            pass.draw(0..6, 0..self.count);
        }
        queue.submit(Some(encoder.finish()));
        self.frames += 1;
        uploaded
    }
}


# File: src/render/hud.wgsl
struct Output { @builtin(position) position: vec4<f32>, @location(0) color: vec4<f32> };
@vertex fn vs(@builtin(vertex_index) vertex: u32,
    @location(0) rect: vec4<f32>, @location(1) color: vec4<f32>) -> Output {
    let corners = array<vec2<f32>, 6>(vec2(0.,0.), vec2(1.,0.), vec2(0.,1.),
        vec2(0.,1.), vec2(1.,0.), vec2(1.,1.));
    var out: Output;
    out.position = vec4(rect.xy + corners[vertex] * rect.zw, 0., 1.);
    out.color = color;
    return out;
}
@fragment fn fs(input: Output) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> { return input.color; }

# File: src/render/neon_glow.rs
//! Texture-free halos drawn over actual bright mesh edges.
use super::{data::Vertex, target::RenderView};
use crate::{gltf_loader::ImportedMesh, visibility::InstanceData};
use glam::Vec3;
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, HashMap};
use wgpu::util::DeviceExt;

pub struct GlowMesh {
    pub buffer: wgpu::Buffer,
    pub vertices: u32,
    pub index_buffer: wgpu::Buffer,
    pub indices: u32,
}
struct GlowEdge {
    color_sum: Vec3,
    count: usize,
    first_normal: Vec3,
    crease: bool,
}
impl GlowMesh {
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device, mesh: &ImportedMesh) -> Option<Self> {
        let mut vertices = Vec::new();
        let mut indices = Vec::<u32>::new();
        let mut edges = BTreeMap::<[[u32; 3]; 2], GlowEdge>::new();
        let max_vertices = (device.limits().max_buffer_size / std::mem::size_of::<Vertex>() as u64)
            .min(u32::MAX as u64) as usize;
        for triangle in mesh.indices.as_chunks::<3>().0 {
            let Some(a) = mesh.vertices.get(triangle[0] as usize) else {
                continue;
            };
            let Some(b) = mesh.vertices.get(triangle[1] as usize) else {
                continue;
            };
            let Some(c) = mesh.vertices.get(triangle[2] as usize) else {
                continue;
            };
            let color = (Vec3::from(a.color) + Vec3::from(b.color) + Vec3::from(c.color)) / 3.0;
            let points = [
                Vec3::from(a.position),
                Vec3::from(b.position),
                Vec3::from(c.position),
            ];
            let face_normal = (points[1] - points[0]).cross(points[2] - points[0]);
            let normal_length_squared = face_normal.length_squared();
            if !color.is_finite()
                || color.max_element() < 0.25
                || points.iter().any(|p| !p.is_finite())
                || !normal_length_squared.is_finite()
                || normal_length_squared <= 1e-20
            {
                continue;
            }
            let face_normal = face_normal / normal_length_squared.sqrt();
            // Weld split mesh vertices by exact position, including signed zero.
            let bits = |p: Vec3| {
                p.to_array()
                    .map(|value| if value == 0.0 { 0 } else { value.to_bits() })
            };
            for (a, b) in [(0, 1), (1, 2), (2, 0)] {
                let length_squared = points[a].distance_squared(points[b]);
                if !length_squared.is_finite() || length_squared <= 1e-20 {
                    continue;
                }
                let mut ends = [bits(points[a]), bits(points[b])];
                ends.sort_unstable();
                edges
                    .entry(ends)
                    .and_modify(|edge| {
                        edge.color_sum += color;
                        edge.count += 1;
                        // Winding supplies consistently outward face normals.
                        edge.crease |= edge.first_normal.dot(face_normal) < 0.95;
                    })
                    .or_insert(GlowEdge {
                        color_sum: color,
                        count: 1,
                        first_normal: face_normal,
                        crease: false,
                    });
            }
        }
        // Ordered keys make generated capsules stable across builds and runs.
        for (ends, edge) in edges {
            // Bright/dark boundaries and creases glow; coplanar diagonals do not.
            if edge.count != 1 && !edge.crease {
                continue;
            }
            let vertex = Vertex {
                position: ends[0].map(f32::from_bits),
                color: (edge.color_sum / edge.count as f32).to_array(),
                normal: ends[1].map(f32::from_bits),
            };
            if vertices.len().checked_add(4)? > max_vertices
                || indices.len().checked_add(6)? > u32::MAX as usize
            {
                return None;
            }
            let base = u32::try_from(vertices.len()).ok()?;
            vertices.extend_from_slice(&[vertex; 4]);
            indices.extend_from_slice(&[base, base + 1, base + 2, base, base + 2, base + 3]);
        }
        if vertices.is_empty() {
            return None;
        }
        let count = u32::try_from(vertices.len()).ok()?;
        Some(Self {
            buffer: device.create_buffer_init(&wgpu::util::BufferInitDescriptor {
                label: Some("neon glow edge capsules"),
                contents: bytemuck::cast_slice(&vertices),
                usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::VERTEX,
            }),
            vertices: count,
            indices: u32::try_from(indices.len()).ok()?,
            index_buffer: device.create_buffer_init(&wgpu::util::BufferInitDescriptor {
                label: Some("neon glow capsule indices"),
                contents: bytemuck::cast_slice(&indices),
                usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::INDEX,
            }),
        })
    }
}
impl Drop for GlowMesh {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.buffer.destroy();
        self.index_buffer.destroy();
    }
}

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, bytemuck::Pod, bytemuck::Zeroable)]
struct Uniforms {
    view_projection: [[f32; 4]; 4],
    // Pixel viewport dimensions, strength, projected radius at unit clip w.
    params: [f32; 4],
    // Base halo world radius and canonical glyph radius, shared with CPU geometry.
    font_profile: [f32; 4],
}
type PipelineKey = (wgpu::TextureFormat, wgpu::TextureFormat);

pub struct NeonGlow {
    strength: f32,
    radius: f32,
    uniform: wgpu::Buffer,
    layout: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    bind_group: wgpu::BindGroup,
    pipelines: HashMap<PipelineKey, wgpu::RenderPipeline>,
    active: Option<PipelineKey>,
}
impl NeonGlow {
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device) -> Self {
        let uniform = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
            label: Some("neon glow view uniform"),
            size: std::mem::size_of::<Uniforms>() as u64,
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
            mapped_at_creation: false,
        });
        let layout = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("neon glow view layout"),
            entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                binding: 0,
                visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::VERTEX_FRAGMENT,
                ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
                    ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform,
                    has_dynamic_offset: false,
                    min_binding_size: None,
                },
                count: None,
            }],
        });
        let bind_group = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("neon glow view"),
            layout: &layout,
            entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 0,
                resource: uniform.as_entire_binding(),
            }],
        });
        Self {
            strength: 0.0,
            radius: 0.015,
            uniform,
            layout,
            bind_group,
            pipelines: HashMap::new(),
            active: None,
        }
    }

    pub fn configure(&mut self, strength: f32, radius: f32) -> bool {
        if !strength.is_finite()
            || !radius.is_finite()
            || !(0.0..=2.0).contains(&strength)
            || !(0.001..=0.05).contains(&radius)
        {
            return false;
        }
        self.strength = strength;
        self.radius = radius;
        true
    }
    pub fn enabled(&self) -> bool {
        self.strength > 0.0
    }

    pub fn prepare(
        &mut self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        queue: &wgpu::Queue,
        view: RenderView,
        target: &super::target::RenderTarget<'_>,
    ) {
        let color_format = target.color_format;
        let depth_format = target.depth_format;
        debug_assert!(target.auxiliary.is_none());
        let width = target.viewport.width;
        let height = target.viewport.height;
        if !self.enabled() || width == 0 || height == 0 {
            self.active = None;
            return;
        }
        let key = (color_format, depth_format);
        self.pipelines.entry(key).or_insert_with(|| {
            let shader = device.create_shader_module(wgpu::include_wgsl!("neon_glow.wgsl"));
            let layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
                label: Some("neon glow pipeline layout"),
                bind_group_layouts: &[Some(&self.layout)],
                immediate_size: 0,
            });
            let targets = vec![Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                format: color_format,
                blend: Some(wgpu::BlendState {
                    color: wgpu::BlendComponent {
                        src_factor: wgpu::BlendFactor::One,
                        dst_factor: wgpu::BlendFactor::One,
                        operation: wgpu::BlendOperation::Max,
                    },
                    alpha: wgpu::BlendComponent {
                        src_factor: wgpu::BlendFactor::Zero,
                        dst_factor: wgpu::BlendFactor::One,
                        operation: wgpu::BlendOperation::Add,
                    },
                }),
                // Preserve alpha via the blend equation, while leaving the WebGL
                // color mask complete for browser surface presentation/readback.
                write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
            })];
            device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
                label: Some("neon glow max-blended capsules"),
                layout: Some(&layout),
                vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
                    module: &shader,
                    entry_point: Some("vs_main"),
                    compilation_options: Default::default(),
                    buffers: &[Some(Vertex::layout()), Some(InstanceData::layout())],
                },
                fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
                    module: &shader,
                    entry_point: Some("fs_main"),
                    compilation_options: Default::default(),
                    targets: &targets,
                }),
                primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState {
                    cull_mode: None,
                    ..Default::default()
                },
                depth_stencil: Some(wgpu::DepthStencilState {
                    format: depth_format,
                    depth_write_enabled: Some(false),
                    depth_compare: Some(wgpu::CompareFunction::LessEqual),
                    stencil: Default::default(),
                    bias: Default::default(),
                }),
                multisample: Default::default(),
                multiview_mask: None,
                cache: None,
            })
        });
        let vp = view.view_projection;
        let projection_x =
            Vec3::new(vp.x_axis.x, vp.y_axis.x, vp.z_axis.x).length() * width as f32 * 0.5;
        let projection_y =
            Vec3::new(vp.x_axis.y, vp.y_axis.y, vp.z_axis.y).length() * height as f32 * 0.5;
        queue.write_buffer(
            &self.uniform,
            0,
            bytemuck::bytes_of(&Uniforms {
                view_projection: view.view_projection.to_cols_array_2d(),
                params: [
                    width as f32,
                    height as f32,
                    self.strength,
                    self.radius * projection_x.max(projection_y),
                ],
                font_profile: [self.radius, crate::info_panel::TUBE_RADIUS, 0., 0.],
            }),
        );
        self.active = Some(key);
    }

    /// Bind once for the contiguous glow mesh batch.
    pub fn bind<'a>(&'a self, pass: &mut wgpu::RenderPass<'a>) -> bool {
        if !self.enabled() {
            return false;
        }
        let Some(key) = self.active else { return false };
        pass.set_pipeline(&self.pipelines[&key]);
        pass.set_bind_group(0, &self.bind_group, &[]);
        true
    }

    pub fn draw<'a>(
        &'a self,
        pass: &mut wgpu::RenderPass<'a>,
        mesh: &'a GlowMesh,
        instance_buffer: wgpu::BufferSlice<'a>,
        instance_count: u32,
    ) {
        pass.set_vertex_buffer(0, mesh.buffer.slice(..));
        pass.set_vertex_buffer(1, instance_buffer);
        pass.set_index_buffer(mesh.index_buffer.slice(..), wgpu::IndexFormat::Uint32);
        pass.draw_indexed(0..mesh.indices, 0, 0..instance_count);
    }
}
impl Drop for NeonGlow {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.uniform.destroy();
    }
}
