    pub fn set_output_mode(&mut self, mode: &str) -> bool {
        match mode {
            "canvas" => self.output.offscreen = false,
            "texture" => self.output.offscreen = true,
            _ => return false,
        }
        true
    }
    pub fn update(&mut self, dt: f32, camera_matrix: Mat4, camera_pos: Vec3) {
        self.update_timed(dt, dt, camera_matrix, camera_pos);
    }
    pub fn update_timed(&mut self, elapsed: f32, dt: f32, camera_matrix: Mat4, camera_pos: Vec3) {
        super::profiler::begin_frame();
        self.frame_dt = dt;
        if let Some(display) = &mut self.combo_display {
            display.advance(&mut self.renderer.scene, dt);
        }
        self.renderer.advance_scene_with_elapsed(elapsed, dt);
        self.refresh_info_panels(elapsed);
        self.view = RenderView {
            view_projection: camera_matrix,
            camera_position: camera_pos,
        };
        if let Some((id, node)) = self.model_camera {
            if let Some(view) = self.imported_camera_view(id, node) {
                self.view = view;
            } else {
                self.model_camera = None;
            }
        }
    }
    pub fn clear_model_camera(&mut self) {
        self.model_camera = None;
    }
    pub fn screen_to_plane(&self, u: f32, v: f32, height: f32) -> Option<Vec3> {
        crate::render_math::screen_to_horizontal_plane(self.view.view_projection, u, v, height)
    }
    pub fn world_to_screen(&self, point: Vec3) -> Option<[f32; 2]> {
        let p = self.view.view_projection * point.extend(1.0);
        if !p.is_finite() || p.w <= 0.0 {
            return None;
        }
        let p = p.truncate() / p.w;
        (p.x.abs() <= 1.0 && p.y.abs() <= 1.0 && (0.0..=1.0).contains(&p.z))
            .then_some([(p.x + 1.0) * 0.5, (1.0 - p.y) * 0.5])
    }
    pub fn use_model_camera(&mut self, id: u32, node: usize) -> bool {
        if self.imported_camera_view(id, node).is_none() {
            return false;
        }
        self.model_camera = Some((id, node));
        true
    }
    fn imported_camera_view(&self, id: u32, node: usize) -> Option<RenderView> {
        let model = self.scene.model(id)?;
        if !model.pose.active_nodes.contains(&node) {
            return None;
        }
        let camera = model.asset.nodes.get(node)?.camera?;
        let root = self.scene.objects().get(&id)?.transform.model();
        let world = root * model.pose.world_matrices[node];
        if world.determinant().abs() < 1e-10 {
            return None;
        }
        let projection = match &model.asset.cameras[camera] {
            crate::gltf_model::ModelCamera::Perspective {
                yfov,
                aspect_ratio,
                znear,
                zfar,
                ..
            } => match zfar {
                Some(far) => glam::camera::rh::proj::directx::perspective(
                    *yfov,
                    aspect_ratio.unwrap_or(self.aspect),
                    *znear,
                    *far,
                ),
                None => glam::camera::rh::proj::directx::perspective_infinite(
                    *yfov,
                    aspect_ratio.unwrap_or(self.aspect),
                    *znear,
                ),
            },
            crate::gltf_model::ModelCamera::Orthographic {
                xmag,
                ymag,
                znear,
                zfar,
                ..
            } => glam::camera::rh::proj::directx::orthographic(
                -*xmag, *xmag, -*ymag, *ymag, *znear, *zfar,
            ),
        };
        Some(RenderView {
            view_projection: projection * world.inverse(),
            camera_position: world.transform_point3(Vec3::ZERO),
        })
    }
    pub fn set_debug_overlay(&mut self, enabled: bool) {
        self.debug_enabled = enabled;
        self.sync_info_diagnostics();
        if enabled {
            if let Some(hud) = &mut self.debug_hud {
                hud.invalidate();
            }
        }
    }
    fn sync_info_diagnostics(&mut self) {
        let scene_panel = self.renderer.scene.info_panels.values().any(|p| {
            matches!(
                p.kind,
                crate::info_panel::PanelKind::Scene | crate::info_panel::PanelKind::Diagnostics
            )
        });
        self.renderer
            .set_debug_diagnostics(self.debug_enabled || scene_panel);
    }
    pub fn add_info_panel(&mut self, kind: &str, width: f32, height: f32) -> Result<u32, JsValue> {
        let id = self
            .renderer
            .scene
            .add_info_panel(kind, width, height)
            .map_err(|e| JsValue::from_str(&e))?;
        self.info_panel_elapsed = 0.25;
        self.info_round_dirty = true;
        self.sync_info_diagnostics();
        self.refresh_info_panels(0.0);
        Ok(id)
    }
    fn refresh_info_panels(&mut self, dt: f32) {
        use crate::info_panel::PanelKind;
        self.sync_info_diagnostics();
        if self.renderer.scene.info_panels.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        if dt.is_finite() && dt > 0. {
            self.info_panel_elapsed += dt;
        }
        if self.info_panel_elapsed >= 0.25 {
            self.info_panel_elapsed = 0.;
            let rows = self
                .renderer
                .xr_debug_content(self.xr_cuts, self.xr_round)
                .scene;
            self.renderer
                .scene
                .update_info_panels(PanelKind::Scene, &rows);
            let mut diagnostics = self.renderer.info_diagnostic_rows();
            diagnostics.insert(0, ("RENDER", format!("RUST {}", self.backend)));
            if let Some(count) = crate::web::rim_stress_count() {
                diagnostics.insert(1, ("ZATEZ NAVIC", count.to_string()));
            }
            self.renderer
                .scene
                .update_info_panels(PanelKind::Diagnostics, &diagnostics);
        }
        self.renderer.scene.update_info_panels(
            PanelKind::Countdown,
            &[(
                "",
                self.xr_round
                    .map_or(30, |r| r.remaining.ceil() as u32)
                    .to_string(),
            )],
        );
        self.renderer.scene.update_info_panels(
            PanelKind::Score,
            &[("", self.combo_score.score.to_string())],
        );
        if self.info_round_dirty {
            let mut rows = if self.combo_score.enabled {
                vec![
                    ("SKORE", self.combo_score.score.to_string()),
                    (
                        "SERIE",
                        format!(
                            "{} {}/3",
                            if self.combo_score.kind.is_empty() {
                                if self.combo_score.streak > 0 {
                                    "WILD"
                                } else {
                                    "CEKA"
                                }
                            } else {
                                &self.combo_score.kind
                            },
                            self.combo_score.streak
                        ),
                    ),
                ]
            } else {
                vec![("ROZKROJENO", self.xr_cuts.to_string())]
            };
            if let Some(round) = self.xr_round {
                rows.push(("CAS", format!("{} S", round.remaining.ceil() as u32)));
                rows.push((
                    "STAV",
                    if round.finished() { "HOTOVO" } else { "HRA" }.into(),
                ));
            }
            self.renderer
                .scene
                .update_info_panels(PanelKind::Round, &rows);
            self.info_round_dirty = false;
        }
        self.renderer.sync_numeric_font_meshes();
    }
    pub fn debug_stats(&self) -> String {
        let mut value = self.renderer.debug_values();
        value["enabled"] = self.debug_enabled.into();
        value["hudFrames"] = self.debug_hud.as_ref().map_or(0, |h| h.frames).into();
        value["hudRefreshes"] = self.debug_hud.as_ref().map_or(0, |h| h.refreshes).into();
        value["xrCuts"] = self.xr_cuts.into();
        value["xrRoundRemaining"] = self.xr_round.map(|r| r.remaining).into();
        value.to_string()
    }
    pub fn xr_round_finished(&self) -> bool {
        self.xr_round.is_some_and(|round| round.finished())
    }
    pub fn configure_combo_display(&mut self, input: &str) -> bool {
        let Some(mut display) =
            crate::combo_display::ComboDisplay::configure(&self.renderer.scene, input)
        else {
            return false;
        };
        self.clear_combo_display();
        if self.combo_score.chain_mode != display.chain_mode {
            self.combo_score.set_chain_mode(display.chain_mode);
        }
        display.reset(&mut self.renderer.scene);
        if display.chain_mode {
            display.sync_chains(&mut self.renderer.scene, &self.combo_score.chains);
        }
        self.combo_display = Some(display);
        self.xr_scene_pending = true;
        self.invalidate_xr_hud();
        true
    }
    pub fn clear_combo_display(&mut self) {
        if let Some(mut display) = self.combo_display.take() {
            display.clear(&mut self.renderer.scene);
        }
    }
    pub fn combo_display_state(&self) -> String {
        self.combo_display
            .as_ref()
            .map_or_else(|| "null".into(), |d| d.state())
    }
    pub fn clear_combo_indicators(&mut self) {
        self.combo_indicators.clear();
    }
    pub fn bind_combo_indicator(&mut self, id: u32, kind: &str, slot: u32) -> bool {
        if slot > 2
            || kind.is_empty()
            || kind.len() > 16
            || !kind.bytes().all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == b' ')
        {
            return false;
        }
        let Some(object) = self.renderer.scene.objects().get(&id) else {
            return false;
        };
        let scale = self
            .combo_indicators
            .iter()
            .find(|item| item.id == id)
            .map_or(object.transform.scale, |item| item.scale);
        self.combo_indicators.retain(|item| item.id != id);
        self.combo_indicators.push(ComboIndicator {
            id,
            kind: kind.into(),
            slot,
            scale,
        });
        self.refresh_combo_indicators();
        true
    }
    fn refresh_combo_indicators(&mut self) {
        let (kind, count) = self.combo_score.display_progress();
        self.combo_indicators
            .retain(|item| self.renderer.scene.object_exists(item.id));
        for item in &self.combo_indicators {
            let active = if self.combo_score.chain_mode {
                self.combo_score
                    .chains
                    .iter()
                    .flatten()
                    .any(|c| c.kind == item.kind && item.slot < c.count)
            } else {
                item.kind == kind && item.slot < count
            };
            self.renderer
                .scene
                .set_emission(item.id, if active { 8.0 } else { 0.65 });
            self.renderer
                .scene
                .set_object_scale(item.id, item.scale * if active { 1.32 } else { 1.0 });
        }
    }
    pub fn start_xr_round(&mut self, seconds: f32) -> Result<(), JsValue> {
        let round = crate::xr_round::RoundClock::new(seconds)
            .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("Round duration must be 1..3600 seconds"))?;
        self.xr_round = Some(round);
        self.xr_cuts = 0;
        self.xr_cut_rewards.clear();
        self.combo_score.reset();
        if let Some(display) = &mut self.combo_display {
            display.reset(&mut self.renderer.scene);
        }
        let live: std::collections::BTreeSet<_> =
            self.renderer.scene.objects().keys().copied().collect();
        self.combo_score.targets.retain(|id, _| live.contains(id));
        self.invalidate_xr_hud();
        Ok(())
    }
    pub fn xr_pending_bonus(&self) -> u64 {
        if self.combo_score.chain_mode {
            self.combo_score.pending_bonus()
        } else {
            0
        }
    }
    pub fn xr_round_state(&self) -> String {
        self.xr_round
            .map(|round| {
                serde_json::json!({
                    "duration": round.duration, "remaining": round.remaining,
                    "finished": round.finished(), "cuts": self.xr_cuts,
                    "score": self.combo_score.score, "streak": self.combo_score.streak,
                    "fruit": self.combo_score.kind, "triples": self.combo_score.triples,
                    "mode": if self.combo_score.chain_mode { "chains" } else { "legacy" },
                    "chains": self.combo_score.chains.iter().map(|c|c.as_ref().map(|c|serde_json::json!({"kind":c.kind,"count":c.count,"points":c.points,"potential":c.value()}))).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
                    "rejected": self.combo_score.rejected,
                    "pendingBonus": self.xr_pending_bonus(),
                })
            })
            .unwrap_or(serde_json::Value::Null)
            .to_string()
    }
    fn invalidate_xr_hud(&mut self) {
        self.refresh_combo_indicators();
        self.info_round_dirty = true;
        if let Some(hud) = &mut self.debug_hud {
            hud.invalidate();
        }
    }
    pub fn xr_cut_rewards(&self) -> &[XRCutReward] {
        &self.xr_cut_rewards
    }
    pub fn record_xr_cuts(&mut self, removed: &[u32]) {
        self.xr_cut_rewards.clear();
        let count = removed.len();
        if count > 0 {
            // Controller input follows advance_xr; new halves must be visible in
            // this same stereo frame instead of disappearing for one frame.
            self.xr_scene_pending = true;
        }
        if count > 0 && !self.xr_round_finished() {
            self.xr_cuts = self.xr_cuts.saturating_add(count as u64);
            for id in removed {
                if self.combo_score.chain_mode {
                    let before = self.combo_score.score;
                    if let Some(accepted) = self.combo_score.hit_chain(*id) {
                        if self.xr_cut_rewards.len() < 32 {
                            self.xr_cut_rewards.push(XRCutReward {
                                original: *id,
                                points: self.combo_score.score.saturating_sub(before),
                                total_points: self.combo_score.last_chain_total_points(),
                            });
                        }
                        if let Some(display) = &mut self.combo_display {
                            display.sync_chains(&mut self.renderer.scene, &self.combo_score.chains);
                            if !accepted {
                                display.notice(&mut self.renderer.scene, "PLNO".into());
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    continue;
                }
                if let Some(event) = self.combo_score.hit_event(*id) {
                    if let Some(display) = &mut self.combo_display {
                        display.event(&mut self.renderer.scene, event);
                    }
                }
            }
            self.invalidate_xr_hud();
        }
    }
    pub fn bank_xr_chain(&mut self, index: usize) -> bool {
        if !self.combo_score.chain_mode || self.xr_round.is_none() || self.xr_round_finished() {
            return false;
        }
        let Some(_) = self.combo_score.bank_chain(index) else {
            return false;
        };
        if let Some(display) = &mut self.combo_display {
            display.sync_chains(&mut self.renderer.scene, &self.combo_score.chains);
        }
        if let Some(display) = &mut self.combo_display {
            display.notice(&mut self.renderer.scene, "SERIE ULOZENA".into());
        }
        self.xr_scene_pending = true;
        self.invalidate_xr_hud();
        true
    }
    pub fn frame_dt(&self) -> f32 {
        self.frame_dt
    }
    pub fn advance_xr(&mut self, dt: f32, time_scale: f32) {
        self.frame_dt = dt;
        self.xr_hud_pending = true;
        self.xr_eye_count = 0;
        self.xr_view_slot = 0;
        if let Some(round) = &mut self.xr_round {
            let before = round.remaining.ceil();
            let was_finished = round.finished();
            round.advance(dt);
            if !was_finished && round.finished() && self.combo_score.chain_mode {
                self.combo_score.bank_all();
                if let Some(display) = &mut self.combo_display {
                    display.sync_chains(&mut self.renderer.scene, &self.combo_score.chains);
                }
            }
            if before != round.remaining.ceil() {
                self.invalidate_xr_hud();
            }
        }
        // FPS and the clock use elapsed time; only physics has a bounded step.
        if let Some(present) = &mut self.xr_present {
            present.reset_frame();
        }
        if let Some(present) = &mut self.xr_gl_present {
            present.reset_frame();
        }
        super::profiler::begin_frame();
        if let Some(display) = &mut self.combo_display {
            display.advance(&mut self.renderer.scene, dt);
        }
        self.renderer.advance_xr_scene(dt, time_scale);
        self.xr_scene_pending = true;
        self.refresh_info_panels(dt);
    }
    pub fn render_xr_eye(&mut self, matrix: Mat4, position: Vec3) -> Result<(), JsValue> {
        if self.xr_eye_count >= 2 {
            return Err(JsValue::from_str("XR frame supports at most two eyes"));
        }
        self.xr_view_slot = self.xr_eye_count + 1;
        self.xr_eye_count += 1;
        if self.xr_scene_pending {
            self.renderer.finish_scene_updates();
            self.xr_scene_pending = false;
        }
        let saved = self.view;
        let saved_xr = self.xr_rendering;
        self.xr_rendering = true;
        self.view = RenderView {
            view_projection: matrix,
            camera_position: position,
        };
        let result = self.render();
        self.view = saved;
        self.xr_rendering = saved_xr;
        result
    }
    pub fn render(&mut self) -> Result<(), JsValue> {
        self.render_to(None, true)
    }
    pub fn xr_gl_context(&self) -> Result<JsValue, JsValue> {
        if self.backend != "Gl" || self.output.color_format() != wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba8UnormSrgb
        {
            return Err(JsValue::from_str(
                "Shared XR requires the WebGL RGBA8 sRGB renderer",
            ));
        }
        Ok(super::xr_gl_output::context(&self.renderer.device)?.into())
    }
    pub fn release_xr_gl(&mut self) {
        self.xr_gl_present = None;
    }
    pub fn render_xr_gl_eye(
        &mut self,
        matrix: Mat4,
        position: Vec3,
        index: usize,
        width: u32,
        height: u32,
    ) -> Result<(), JsValue> {
        self.xr_gl_context()?;
        if index >= 2 || index != self.xr_eye_count as usize {
            return Err(JsValue::from_str("Invalid WebGL XR eye order"));
        }
        self.xr_view_slot = index as u32 + 1;
        self.xr_eye_count += 1;
        let mut present = self
            .xr_gl_present
            .take()
            .unwrap_or_else(|| super::xr_gl_output::GlXrOutput::new(&self.renderer.device));
        let result = (|| {
            present.ensure_eye(&self.renderer.device, index, width, height)?;
            self.render_xr_gpu_eye(matrix, position, &present.target(index), false)?;
            present.mark_ready(index);
            Ok(())
        })();
        self.xr_gl_present = Some(present);
        result
    }
    pub fn present_xr_gl(
        &mut self,
        framebuffer: JsValue,
        width: u32,
        height: u32,
        viewports: &[super::target::Viewport],
    ) -> Result<(), JsValue> {
        let present = self
            .xr_gl_present
            .as_mut()
            .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("WebGL XR eyes not staged"))?;
        self.renderer.draw_calls += present.present(
            &self.renderer.device,
            &self.renderer.queue,
            framebuffer,
            width,
            height,
            viewports,
        )?;
        Ok(())
    }
    pub fn xr_gpu_supported(&self) -> bool {
        self.output.xr_compatible
    }
    pub fn xr_device(&self) -> Result<JsValue, JsValue> {
        if !self.output.xr_compatible {
            return Err(JsValue::from_str(
                "XR-compatible WebGPU adapter unavailable; use WebGL",
            ));
        }
        self.renderer
            .device
            .as_webgpu()
            .map(|device| device.clone().into())
            .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("WebGPU device unavailable"))
    }
    pub fn xr_color_format(&self) -> String {
        match self.output.color_format().remove_srgb_suffix() {
            wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba8Unorm => "rgba8unorm",
            wgpu::TextureFormat::Bgra8Unorm => "bgra8unorm",
            _ => "unsupported",
        }
        .into()
    }
    pub fn render_xr_gpu_image(
        &mut self,
        matrix: Mat4,
        position: Vec3,
        image: &JsValue,
    ) -> Result<(), JsValue> {
        // Validate the frame-scoped image without importing browser textures:
        // the staged path only needs dimensions/format until final presentation.
        let write_depth = js_sys::Reflect::get(image, &JsValue::from_str("ignoreDepthValues"))?
            .as_bool()
            != Some(true);
        // Even without effects, keep linear blending + sRGB output encoding in
        // owned targets; browser UNORM views cannot safely be reinterpreted.
        let info = super::xr_output::XrAttachments::inspect(image)?;
        let index = info.layer as usize;
        if index >= 2 {
            return Err(JsValue::from_str("XR frame supports at most two eyes"));
        }
        self.xr_view_slot = index as u32 + 1;
        // Own the complete output of each eye until both are ready. Browser
        // attachments are never retained here or touched by intermediate passes.
        let mut present = self.xr_present.take().unwrap_or_else(|| {
            super::xr_present::XrPresent::new(&self.renderer.device, info.format)
        });
        let result = (|| {
            present
                .ensure_eye(&self.renderer.device, index, info.width, info.height)
                .map_err(|e| JsValue::from_str(&e))?;
            self.render_xr_gpu_eye(
                matrix,
                position,
                &present.target(index).map_err(|e| JsValue::from_str(&e))?,
                write_depth,
            )?;
            present
                .mark_ready(index, write_depth)
                .map_err(|e| JsValue::from_str(&e))
        })();
        self.xr_present = Some(present);
        result
    }
    pub fn present_xr_gpu_frame(&mut self, images: &js_sys::Array) -> Result<(), JsValue> {
        let Some(present) = &mut self.xr_present else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        let mut attachments = Vec::with_capacity(images.length() as usize);
        let mut indices = Vec::with_capacity(images.length() as usize);
        if images.length() == 0 || images.length() > 2 {
            return Err(JsValue::from_str(
                "XR presentation requires one or two eyes",
            ));
        }
        for image in images.iter() {
            let descriptor = js_sys::Reflect::get(&image, &JsValue::from_str("viewDescriptor"))?;
            let index = js_sys::Reflect::get(&descriptor, &JsValue::from_str("baseArrayLayer"))?
                .as_f64()
                .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("Missing XR eye layer"))?
                as usize;
            if !present.is_ready(index) {
                return Err(JsValue::from_str("XR eye has not been rendered"));
            }
            attachments.push(super::xr_output::XrAttachments::new(
                &self.renderer.device,
                &image,
            )?);
            indices.push(index);
        }
        let targets: Vec<_> = indices
            .into_iter()
            .zip(attachments.iter().map(|a| a.target()))
            .collect();
        self.renderer.draw_calls += present
            .present(&self.renderer.device, &self.renderer.queue, &targets)
            .map_err(|e| JsValue::from_str(&e))?;
        Ok(())
    }
    pub fn render_xr_gpu_eye(
        &mut self,
        matrix: Mat4,
        position: Vec3,
        target: &super::target::RenderTarget<'_>,
        write_depth: bool,
    ) -> Result<(), JsValue> {
        if target.color_format.remove_srgb_suffix()
            != self.output.color_format().remove_srgb_suffix()
        {
            return Err(JsValue::from_str(
                "XR layer format must match xr_gpu_color_format",
            ));
        }
        if self.xr_scene_pending {
            self.renderer.finish_scene_updates();
            self.xr_scene_pending = false;
        }
        let saved = self.view;
        let saved_xr = self.xr_rendering;
        self.xr_rendering = true;
        self.view = RenderView {
            view_projection: matrix,
            camera_position: position,
        };
        let result = self.render_to(Some(target), write_depth);
        self.view = saved;
        self.xr_rendering = saved_xr;
        result
    }
    fn render_to(
        &mut self,
        external: Option<&super::target::RenderTarget<'_>>,
        write_external_depth: bool,
    ) -> Result<(), JsValue> {
        self.refresh_info_panels(0.0);
        self.renderer.draw_calls = 0;
        self.renderer.main_draw_calls = 0;
        self.renderer.reset_translucency_metrics();
        if let Some(probe) = &mut self.environment {
            probe
                .update(&mut self.renderer)
                .map_err(|e| JsValue::from_str(&e))?;
        }
        let frame = if external.is_none() {
            let Some(frame) = self.output.acquire(&self.renderer.device)? else {
                return Ok(());
            };
            self.output.ensure_target(&self.renderer.device);
            Some(frame)
        } else {
            None
        };
        if let Some(compute) = &mut self.cutting_compute {
            compute.retain(|id| self.renderer.scene.triangle_meshes().contains_key(&id));
        }
        self.resident_sources
            .retain(|id, _| self.renderer.scene.object_exists(*id));
        let canvas_target = frame.as_ref().map(|frame| self.output.target(frame));
        let target = external.or(canvas_target.as_ref()).expect("render target");
        let target = super::target::RenderTarget {
            color_load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(self.background),
            ..*target
        };
        // Collect only the main view. Auxiliary shadow/reflection passes still
        // submit before shared uniforms are rewritten for this view.
        let main_view_slot = if self.xr_rendering {
            self.xr_view_slot
        } else {
            0
        };
        let mut commands = Vec::with_capacity(3);
        let mut postprocessed = false;
        if self
            .postprocess
            .needs_render(self.view, target.width, target.height)
        {
            self.postprocess
                .ensure_size(&self.renderer.device, target.width, target.height)
                .map_err(|e| JsValue::from_str(&e))?;
            let mut scene_target = self.postprocess.target();
            scene_target.color_load = wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(self.background);
            commands.push(
                self.renderer
                    .render_view_slot(self.view, &scene_target, main_view_slot)
                    .map_err(|e| JsValue::from_str(&e))?,
            );
            // Effects lazily replaces fallback maps when shadows are first enabled.
            // Rebind by resource identity; unchanged maps do not allocate a new bind group.
            let (static_map, dynamic_map) = self.renderer.shadow_maps();
            self.postprocess
                .set_shadow_maps(&self.renderer.device, static_map, dynamic_map);
            let light = self.renderer.scene.lights().values().next();
            let (position, color) = light
                .map(|l| (l.position, l.color))
                .unwrap_or((Vec3::ZERO, Vec3::ZERO));
            let overlay_depth = self.postprocess.target().depth.clone();
            let (passes, postprocess_command, final_draw) = self.postprocess.render(
                &self.renderer.device,
                &self.renderer.queue,
                self.view,
                position,
                color,
                &target,
                self.renderer.shadows_enabled(),
                self.xr_rendering,
                if self.xr_rendering {
                    self.xr_view_slot
                } else {
                    0
                },
            );
            self.renderer.draw_calls += passes;
            if let Some(command) = postprocess_command {
                commands.push(command);
            }
            let overlays = super::target::RenderTarget {
                depth: &overlay_depth,
                auxiliary: None,
                material_mask: false,
                ..target
            };
            if let Some(final_draw) = final_draw {
                commands.push(
                    self.renderer
                        .draw_postprocess_overlays(&overlays, &final_draw)
                        .map_err(|e| JsValue::from_str(&e))?,
                );
                postprocessed = true;
            }
        } else {
            self.postprocess.skip_render();
            if !self.postprocess.enabled() {
                self.xr_depth_resolve = None;
            }
            commands.push(
                self.renderer
                    .render_view_slot(self.view, &target, main_view_slot)
                    .map_err(|e| JsValue::from_str(&e))?,
            );
        }
        // Flush before depth resolve, HUD, presentation or preparing another eye:
        // those steps may read these attachments or overwrite shared uniforms.
        {
            let _scope = super::profiler::cpu_scope("render.submit");
            self.renderer.queue.submit(commands);
        }
        if postprocessed {
            self.postprocess.record_submission();
        }
        if postprocessed && external.is_some() && write_external_depth {
            // Postprocessing writes only color. Supply the compositor with the
            // actual scene depth, including any depth-writing overlays above.
            let resolve = self.xr_depth_resolve.get_or_insert_with(|| {
                super::depth_resolve::DepthResolve::new(&self.renderer.device)
            });
            self.renderer.draw_calls += resolve.render(
                &self.renderer.device,
                &self.renderer.queue,
                self.postprocess.target().depth,
                target.depth,
            );
        }
        // Include the imminent HUD and final texture blit in the displayed total.
        self.renderer.draw_calls +=
            usize::from(self.debug_enabled) + usize::from(frame.is_some() && self.output.offscreen);
        if self.debug_enabled {
            let renderer = &self.renderer;
            let xr = self.xr_rendering;
            let cuts = self.xr_cuts;
            let round = self.xr_round;
            self.renderer.upload_bytes +=
                self.debug_hud.get_or_insert_with(Default::default).render(
                    &renderer.device,
                    &renderer.queue,
                    &target,
                    if !self.xr_rendering || self.xr_hud_pending {
                        self.frame_dt
                    } else {
                        0.0
                    },
                    self.xr_rendering,
                    || {
                        if xr {
                            crate::debug_overlay::HudContent::Xr(
                                renderer.xr_debug_content(cuts, round),
                            )
                        } else {
                            crate::debug_overlay::HudContent::Desktop(renderer.debug_lines())
                        }
                    },
                );
            self.xr_hud_pending = false;
        }
        if let Some(frame) = frame {
            self.output
                .present(frame, &self.renderer.device, &self.renderer.queue);
        }
        if !self.xr_rendering {
            super::profiler::end_frame(&self.renderer.device, &self.renderer.queue);
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}


# File: src/render/target.rs
//! Render inputs independent of any browser canvas or surface.
use glam::{Mat4, Vec3};

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct RenderView {
    pub view_projection: Mat4,
    pub camera_position: Vec3,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct Viewport {
    pub x: u32,
    pub y: u32,
    pub width: u32,
    pub height: u32,
}
impl Viewport {
    pub fn full(width: u32, height: u32) -> Self {
        Self {
            x: 0,
            y: 0,
            width,
            height,
        }
    }
    pub fn validate(self, width: u32, height: u32) -> Result<(), String> {
        if self.width == 0 || self.height == 0 || width == 0 || height == 0 {
            return Err("Render target and viewport must have nonzero dimensions".into());
        }
        if self
            .x
            .checked_add(self.width)
            .is_none_or(|right| right > width)
            || self
                .y
                .checked_add(self.height)
                .is_none_or(|bottom| bottom > height)
        {
            return Err("Viewport must fit inside the render target".into());
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

/// Single-sample color and depth attachments. Their formats and dimensions
/// must match this descriptor; wgpu validates the underlying GPU resources.
pub struct RenderTarget<'a> {
    pub color: &'a wgpu::TextureView,
    /// Store reflectivity in color alpha and defer presentation overlays.
    pub material_mask: bool,
    /// Optional packed depth attachment for portable screen-space effects.
    pub auxiliary: Option<&'a wgpu::TextureView>,
    pub depth: &'a wgpu::TextureView,
    pub color_format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
    pub depth_format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
    pub width: u32,
    pub height: u32,
    pub viewport: Viewport,
    /// Use Load for additional views sharing an attachment; Clear clears the whole attachment.
    pub color_load: wgpu::LoadOp<wgpu::Color>,
    pub depth_load: wgpu::LoadOp<f32>,
}
impl RenderTarget<'_> {
    pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<(), String> {
        self.viewport.validate(self.width, self.height)
    }
}

/// A reusable depth-only pass target, e.g. a shadow map or depth prepass.
pub struct DepthRenderTarget<'a> {
    pub depth: &'a wgpu::TextureView,
    pub format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
    pub width: u32,
    pub height: u32,
    pub viewport: Viewport,
    pub load: wgpu::LoadOp<f32>,
}
impl DepthRenderTarget<'_> {
    pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<(), String> {
        self.viewport.validate(self.width, self.height)?;
        if !self.format.has_depth_aspect() {
            return Err("Depth target requires a depth format".into());
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn viewport_accepts_full_target_and_subrect() {
        assert!(Viewport::full(800, 600).validate(800, 600).is_ok());
        assert!(Viewport {
            x: 400,
            y: 100,
            width: 400,
            height: 500
        }
        .validate(800, 600)
        .is_ok());
    }
    #[test]
    fn viewport_rejects_empty_outside_and_overflow() {
        assert!(Viewport::full(0, 600).validate(800, 600).is_err());
        assert!(Viewport::full(800, 600).validate(0, 600).is_err());
        assert!(Viewport {
            x: 401,
            y: 0,
            width: 400,
            height: 600
        }
        .validate(800, 600)
        .is_err());
        assert!(Viewport {
            x: u32::MAX,
            y: 0,
            width: 1,
            height: 1
        }
        .validate(u32::MAX, 600)
        .is_err());
    }
}

//! Owned, reusable single-sample render attachments, independent of presentation.
use super::target::{DepthRenderTarget, RenderTarget, Viewport};
pub struct DepthTarget {
    pub texture: wgpu::Texture,
    pub view: wgpu::TextureView,
    pub size: u32,
}
impl DepthTarget {
    pub const FORMAT: wgpu::TextureFormat = wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth32Float;
    pub fn target(&self) -> DepthRenderTarget<'_> {
        DepthRenderTarget {
            depth: &self.view,
            format: Self::FORMAT,
            width: self.size,
            height: self.size,
            viewport: Viewport::full(self.size, self.size),
            load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(1.0),
        }
    }
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device, label: &str, size: u32) -> Self {
        let texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
            label: Some(label),
            size: wgpu::Extent3d {
                width: size,
                height: size,
                depth_or_array_layers: 1,
            },
            mip_level_count: 1,
            sample_count: 1,
            dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
            format: Self::FORMAT,
            usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT | wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING,
            view_formats: &[],
        });
        let view = texture.create_view(&Default::default());
        Self {
            texture,
            view,
            size,
        }
    }
}
pub struct ColorTarget {
    pub texture: wgpu::Texture,
    pub color: wgpu::TextureView,
    pub depth_texture: wgpu::Texture,
    pub depth: wgpu::TextureView,
    pub width: u32,
    pub height: u32,
    pub format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
}
impl ColorTarget {
    pub fn new(
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        label: &str,
        width: u32,
        height: u32,
        format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
    ) -> Self {
        Self::new_with_view_formats(device, label, width, height, format, &[])
    }
    /// Owned targets may explicitly allow compatible views (e.g. sRGB render /
    /// UNORM byte-preserving presentation). Browser XR textures do not allow this.
    pub fn new_with_view_formats(
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        label: &str,
        width: u32,
        height: u32,
        format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
        view_formats: &[wgpu::TextureFormat],
    ) -> Self {
        assert!(width > 0 && height > 0);
        let texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
            label: Some(label),
            size: wgpu::Extent3d {
                width,
                height,
                depth_or_array_layers: 1,
            },
            mip_level_count: 1,
            sample_count: 1,
            dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
            format,
            usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT | wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING,
            view_formats,
        });
        let color = texture.create_view(&Default::default());
        let (depth_texture, depth) =
            super::depth::create(device, width, height, DepthTarget::FORMAT);
        Self {
            texture,
            color,
            depth_texture,
            depth,
            width,
            height,
            format,
        }
    }
    pub fn target(&self) -> RenderTarget<'_> {
        RenderTarget {
            color: &self.color,
            depth: &self.depth,
            auxiliary: None,
            material_mask: false,
            color_format: self.format,
            depth_format: DepthTarget::FORMAT,
            width: self.width,
            height: self.height,
            viewport: Viewport::full(self.width, self.height),
            color_load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color {
                r: 0.1,
                g: 0.1,
                b: 0.3,
                a: 1.0,
            }),
            depth_load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(1.0),
        }
    }
}


# File: src/render/view_uniforms.rs
//! Separate uniform ranges for desktop/left/right views. A cached bind group
//! references one value-sized range; the caller selects its dynamic offset.
pub struct ViewUniforms {
    buffer: wgpu::Buffer,
    stride: u32,
    bytes: u64,
    slots: u32,
}
impl ViewUniforms {
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device, label: &str, bytes: u64, slots: u32) -> Self {
        let alignment = device.limits().min_uniform_buffer_offset_alignment as u64;
        let stride = bytes.div_ceil(alignment) * alignment;
        assert!(bytes > 0 && slots > 0 && stride * slots as u64 <= device.limits().max_buffer_size);
        assert!(bytes <= device.limits().max_uniform_buffer_binding_size);
        let buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
            label: Some(label),
            size: stride * slots as u64,
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
            mapped_at_creation: false,
        });
        Self {
            buffer,
            stride: u32::try_from(stride).expect("uniform stride"),
            bytes,
            slots,
        }
    }
    pub fn binding(&self) -> wgpu::BindingResource<'_> {
        wgpu::BindingResource::Buffer(wgpu::BufferBinding {
            buffer: &self.buffer,
            offset: 0,
            size: wgpu::BufferSize::new(self.bytes),
        })
    }
    pub fn write(&self, queue: &wgpu::Queue, slot: u32, bytes: &[u8]) -> u32 {
        assert!(slot < self.slots && bytes.len() as u64 == self.bytes);
        let offset = slot * self.stride;
        queue.write_buffer(&self.buffer, offset as u64, bytes);
        offset
    }
}


# File: src/render/xr_gl_output.rs
//! Opt-in WebGL XR: owned sRGB eye targets and a borrowed, render-only XR FBO.
//! No raw GL binds; the pinned GLES backend owns state transitions and submission.
use super::{
    target::{RenderTarget, Viewport},
    textures::ColorTarget,
};
use wasm_bindgen::{JsCast, JsValue};

pub fn context(device: &wgpu::Device) -> Result<web_sys::WebGl2RenderingContext, JsValue> {
    // SAFETY: clone the context handle only; never mutate/destroy HAL resources.
    unsafe { device.as_hal::<wgpu::hal::api::Gles>() }
        .map(|hal| hal.context().webgl2_context.clone())
        .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("WebGL device unavailable"))
}
struct Eye {
    target: ColorTarget,
    source: wgpu::BindGroup,
    ready: bool,
}
pub struct GlXrOutput {
    layout: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    sampler: wgpu::Sampler,
    pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    eyes: [Option<Eye>; 2],
}
impl GlXrOutput {
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device) -> Self {
        let layout = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("WebGL XR source layout"),
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                        sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float { filterable: true },
                        view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                        multisampled: false,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Sampler(wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering),
                    count: None,
                },
            ],
        });
        let sampler = device.create_sampler(&wgpu::SamplerDescriptor::default());
        let shader = device.create_shader_module(wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor {
            label: Some("WebGL XR encoded presentation"),
            source: wgpu::ShaderSource::Wgsl(include_str!("xr_gl_present.wgsl").into()),
        });
        let pipeline_layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("WebGL XR presentation"),
            bind_group_layouts: &[Some(&layout)],
            immediate_size: 0,
        });
        let pipeline = device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some("WebGL XR borrowed framebuffer"),
            layout: Some(&pipeline_layout),
            vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
                module: &shader,
                entry_point: Some("vs_main"),
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
                buffers: &[],
            },
            fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
                module: &shader,
                entry_point: Some("fs_main"),
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
                targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                    format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba8Unorm,
                    blend: Some(wgpu::BlendState::REPLACE),
                    write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
                })],
            }),
            primitive: Default::default(),
            depth_stencil: None,
            multisample: Default::default(),
            multiview_mask: None,
            cache: None,
        });
        Self {
            layout,
            sampler,
            pipeline,
            eyes: [None, None],
        }
    }
    pub fn reset_frame(&mut self) {
        for eye in self.eyes.iter_mut().flatten() {
            eye.ready = false;
        }
    }
    pub fn ensure_eye(
        &mut self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        index: usize,
        width: u32,
        height: u32,
    ) -> Result<(), JsValue> {
        if index >= 2
            || width == 0
            || height == 0
            || width > device.limits().max_texture_dimension_2d
            || height > device.limits().max_texture_dimension_2d
        {
            return Err(JsValue::from_str("Invalid WebGL XR eye dimensions"));
        }
        let slot = &mut self.eyes[index];
        if slot.as_ref().is_some_and(|e| e.ready) {
            return Err(JsValue::from_str("Duplicate WebGL XR eye"));
        }
        if slot
            .as_ref()
            .is_none_or(|e| (e.target.width, e.target.height) != (width, height))
        {
            let target = ColorTarget::new(
                device,
                "WebGL XR owned eye",
                width,
                height,
                wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba8UnormSrgb,
            );
            let source = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
                label: Some("WebGL XR source"),
                layout: &self.layout,
                entries: &[
                    wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                        binding: 0,
                        resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&target.color),
                    },
                    wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                        binding: 1,
                        resource: wgpu::BindingResource::Sampler(&self.sampler),
                    },
                ],
            });
            *slot = Some(Eye {
                target,
                source,
                ready: false,
            });
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    pub fn target(&self, index: usize) -> RenderTarget<'_> {
        self.eyes[index]
            .as_ref()
            .expect("validated eye")
            .target
            .target()
    }
    pub fn mark_ready(&mut self, index: usize) {
        self.eyes[index].as_mut().expect("validated eye").ready = true;
    }
    pub fn present(
        &mut self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        queue: &wgpu::Queue,
        framebuffer: JsValue,
        width: u32,
        height: u32,
        viewports: &[Viewport],
    ) -> Result<usize, JsValue> {
        if viewports.is_empty()
            || viewports.len() > 2
            || width > device.limits().max_texture_dimension_2d
            || height > device.limits().max_texture_dimension_2d
        {
            return Err(JsValue::from_str("Invalid WebGL XR framebuffer dimensions"));
        }
        for (index, v) in viewports.iter().enumerate() {
            v.validate(width, height)
                .map_err(|e| JsValue::from_str(&e))?;
            if self.eyes[index].as_ref().is_none_or(|e| {
                !e.ready || (e.target.width, e.target.height) != (v.width, v.height)
            }) {
                return Err(JsValue::from_str("WebGL XR eye is not ready"));
            }
            if viewports[..index].iter().any(|a| {
                a.x < v.x + v.width
                    && v.x < a.x + a.width
                    && a.y < v.y + v.height
                    && v.y < a.y + a.height
            }) {
                return Err(JsValue::from_str("Overlapping WebGL XR viewports"));
            }
        }
        if self.eyes[viewports.len()..]
            .iter()
            .flatten()
            .any(|e| e.ready)
        {
            return Err(JsValue::from_str("Missing WebGL XR eye viewport"));
        }
        let framebuffer = framebuffer
            .dyn_into::<web_sys::WebGlFramebuffer>()
            .map_err(|_| JsValue::from_str("Invalid WebGL XR framebuffer"))?;
        let gl = context(device)?;
        if gl.is_context_lost() || !gl.is_framebuffer(Some(&framebuffer)) {
            return Err(JsValue::from_str(
                "WebGL XR framebuffer must belong to the renderer context",
            ));
        }
        let format = wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba8Unorm;
        let desc = wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
            label: Some("borrowed WebGL XR framebuffer"),
            size: wgpu::Extent3d {
                width,
                height,
                depth_or_array_layers: 1,
            },
            mip_level_count: 1,
            sample_count: 1,
            dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
            format,
            usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT,
            view_formats: &[],
        };
        let raw = wgpu::hal::gles::Texture {
            inner: wgpu::hal::gles::TextureInner::ExternalFramebuffer { inner: framebuffer },
            mip_level_count: 1,
            array_layer_count: 1,
            format,
            format_desc: wgpu::hal::gles::TextureFormatDesc {
                internal: web_sys::WebGl2RenderingContext::RGBA8,
                external: web_sys::WebGl2RenderingContext::RGBA,
                data_type: web_sys::WebGl2RenderingContext::UNSIGNED_BYTE,
            },
            copy_size: wgpu::hal::CopyExtent {
                width,
                height,
                depth: 1,
            },
            drop_guard: None,
        };
        // SAFETY: same device/context verified above; XR host supplies the active
        // frame's single-sampled normalized RGB(A)8 layer (alpha is opaque). Render-only wrapper, no sampling,
        // read/copy or attachment modification. HAL ExternalFramebuffer drop is
        // a no-op; wgpu-core registers its counter via add_raw_texture. Commands
        // are submitted synchronously inside the XR callback; no handle retained.
        let texture = unsafe {
            device.create_texture_from_hal::<wgpu::hal::api::Gles>(
                raw,
                &desc,
                wgpu::TextureUses::COLOR_TARGET,
            )
        };
        let view = texture.create_view(&Default::default());
        let mut encoder = device.create_command_encoder(&wgpu::CommandEncoderDescriptor {
            label: Some("WebGL XR presentation"),
        });
        {
            let mut pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
                label: Some("WebGL XR final stereo"),
                color_attachments: &[Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                    view: &view,
                    resolve_target: None,
                    depth_slice: None,
                    ops: wgpu::Operations {
                        load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color {
                            r: 0.1,
                            g: 0.1,
                            b: 0.3,
                            a: 1.0,
                        }),
                        store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                    },
                })],
                depth_stencil_attachment: None,
                timestamp_writes: None,
                occlusion_query_set: None,
                multiview_mask: None,
            });
            pass.set_pipeline(&self.pipeline);
            for (index, v) in viewports.iter().enumerate() {
                // Pinned GLES set_viewport/set_scissor forward GL coordinates.
                pass.set_viewport(
                    v.x as f32,
                    v.y as f32,
                    v.width as f32,
                    v.height as f32,
                    0.0,
                    1.0,
                );
                pass.set_scissor_rect(v.x, v.y, v.width, v.height);
                pass.set_bind_group(0, &self.eyes[index].as_ref().unwrap().source, &[]);
                pass.draw(0..3, 0..1);
            }
        }
        queue.submit(Some(encoder.finish()));
        self.reset_frame();
        Ok(viewports.len())
    }
}


# File: src/render/xr_gl_present.wgsl
// GLES eye storage is sRGB: sampling decodes it. Encode once for the RGBA8
// XR framebuffer, like the pinned HAL's canvas sRGB presentation shader.
@group(0) @binding(0) var image: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var image_sampler: sampler;
struct Output { @builtin(position) position:vec4f, @location(0) uv:vec2f };
@vertex fn vs_main(@builtin(vertex_index) i:u32)->Output {
    let positions=array<vec2f,3>(vec2f(-1.,-1.),vec2f(3.,-1.),vec2f(-1.,3.));
    let p=positions[i];var o:Output;o.position=vec4f(p,0.,1.);
    o.uv=vec2f((p.x+1.)*.5,(1.+p.y)*.5);return o;
}
@fragment fn fs_main(i:Output)->@location(0) vec4f {
    let linear=textureSample(image,image_sampler,i.uv).rgb;
    let selector=ceil(linear-vec3f(.0031308));
    let encoded=mix(12.92*linear,1.055*pow(linear,vec3f(.41666))-.055,selector);
    return vec4f(encoded,1.);
}


# File: src/render/xr_output.rs
//! Frame-scoped wrappers of browser-owned XR projection attachments.
//! Dropping a wgpu wrapper never destroys the compositor's GPUTexture.
use super::target::{RenderTarget, Viewport};
use wasm_bindgen::{JsCast, JsValue};

fn property(object: &JsValue, key: &str) -> Result<JsValue, JsValue> {
    js_sys::Reflect::get(object, &JsValue::from_str(key))
}
fn uint(object: &JsValue, key: &str) -> Result<u32, JsValue> {
    let n = property(object, key)?
        .as_f64()
        .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("Invalid XR texture metadata"))?;
    if !n.is_finite() || n < 0. || n > u32::MAX as f64 || n.fract() != 0. {
        return Err(JsValue::from_str("Invalid XR texture dimensions"));
    }
    Ok(n as u32)
}
fn format(value: &JsValue) -> Result<wgpu::TextureFormat, JsValue> {
    match property(value, "format")?.as_string().as_deref() {
        Some("rgba8unorm") => Ok(wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba8Unorm),
        Some("rgba8unorm-srgb") => Ok(wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba8UnormSrgb),
        Some("bgra8unorm") => Ok(wgpu::TextureFormat::Bgra8Unorm),
        Some("bgra8unorm-srgb") => Ok(wgpu::TextureFormat::Bgra8UnormSrgb),
        Some("depth32float") => Ok(wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth32Float),
        _ => Err(JsValue::from_str("Unsupported XR attachment format")),
    }
}
struct AttachmentInfo {
    width: u32,
    height: u32,
    layers: u32,
    format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
    usage: wgpu::TextureUsages,
}
fn inspect_attachment(
    value: &JsValue,
    layer: u32,
    opaque_color: bool,
) -> Result<AttachmentInfo, JsValue> {
    let width = uint(value, "width")?;
    let height = uint(value, "height")?;
    let layers = uint(value, "depthOrArrayLayers")?;
    let mut mip_levels = uint(value, "mipLevelCount")?;
    let mut samples = uint(value, "sampleCount")?;
    let mut usage = wgpu::TextureUsages::from_bits_truncate(uint(value, "usage")?);
    // Quest Browser 149 returns all three as zero for compositor-owned color
    // textures. The projection layer is explicitly created single-sampled,
    // single-mip, with RENDER_ATTACHMENT usage. Do not relax other metadata or
    // apply this compatibility path to ordinary/depth textures.
    if opaque_color && mip_levels == 0 && samples == 0 && usage.is_empty() {
        mip_levels = 1;
        samples = 1;
        usage = wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT;
    }
    let format = format(value)?;
    if width == 0
        || height == 0
        || layer >= layers
        || samples != 1
        || mip_levels != 1
        || property(value, "dimension")?.as_string().as_deref() != Some("2d")
        || !usage.contains(wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT)
    {
        return Err(JsValue::from_str("Invalid XR projection attachment"));
    }
    Ok(AttachmentInfo {
        width,
        height,
        layers,
        format,
        usage,
    })
}
fn wrap(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    value: JsValue,
    info: &AttachmentInfo,
    layer: u32,
) -> wgpu::TextureView {
    let texture = device.create_texture_from_webgpu_handle(
        value.unchecked_into(),
        &wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
            label: Some("browser-owned XR attachment"),
            size: wgpu::Extent3d {
                width: info.width,
                height: info.height,
                depth_or_array_layers: info.layers,
            },
            mip_level_count: 1,
            sample_count: 1,
            dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
            format: info.format,
            usage: info.usage,
            view_formats: &[],
        },
        None,
    );
    texture.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor {
        dimension: Some(wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2),
        base_array_layer: layer,
        array_layer_count: Some(1),
        ..Default::default()
    })
}
/// Validated projection metadata without browser handles or GPU resources.
pub struct XrImageInfo {
    pub width: u32,
    pub height: u32,
    pub format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
    pub layer: u32,
}
struct InspectedImage {
    color: JsValue,
    depth: JsValue,
    color_info: AttachmentInfo,
    depth_info: AttachmentInfo,
    layer: u32,
}
impl InspectedImage {
    fn info(&self) -> XrImageInfo {
        XrImageInfo {
            width: self.color_info.width,
            height: self.color_info.height,
            format: self.color_info.format,
            layer: self.layer,
        }
    }
}
pub struct XrAttachments {
    color: wgpu::TextureView,
    depth: wgpu::TextureView,
    format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
    width: u32,
    height: u32,
}
fn inspect_image(image: &JsValue) -> Result<InspectedImage, JsValue> {
    let descriptor = property(image, "viewDescriptor")?;
    let layer = uint(&descriptor, "baseArrayLayer")?;
    if property(&descriptor, "dimension")?.as_string().as_deref() != Some("2d")
        || uint(&descriptor, "arrayLayerCount")? != 1
    {
        return Err(JsValue::from_str("XR requires one 2d array layer per eye"));
    }
    let color = property(image, "colorTexture")?;
    let color_info = inspect_attachment(&color, layer, true)?;
    let depth = property(image, "depthStencilTexture")?;
    let depth_info = inspect_attachment(&depth, layer, false)?;
    let (width, height) = (color_info.width, color_info.height);
    let viewport = property(image, "viewport")?;
    // Projection layers have an independent full-size array slice per eye.
    // Reject an atlas explicitly: postprocessing must never overwrite the other eye.
    if depth_info.format != wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth32Float
        || (width, height) != (depth_info.width, depth_info.height)
        || uint(&viewport, "x")? != 0
        || uint(&viewport, "y")? != 0
        || uint(&viewport, "width")? != width
        || uint(&viewport, "height")? != height
    {
        return Err(JsValue::from_str(
            "XR projection requires matching full-size color/depth slices",
        ));
    }
    Ok(InspectedImage {
        color,
        depth,
        color_info,
        depth_info,
        layer,
    })
}
impl XrAttachments {
    /// Validate an eye's attachments without importing textures or creating views.
    pub fn inspect(image: &JsValue) -> Result<XrImageInfo, JsValue> {
        Ok(inspect_image(image)?.info())
    }
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device, image: &JsValue) -> Result<Self, JsValue> {
        if device.as_webgpu().is_none() {
            return Err(JsValue::from_str("XR projection requires WebGPU"));
        }
        let inspected = inspect_image(image)?;
        let info = inspected.info();
        let color = wrap(device, inspected.color, &inspected.color_info, info.layer);
        let depth = wrap(device, inspected.depth, &inspected.depth_info, info.layer);
        Ok(Self {
            color,
            depth,
            format: info.format,
            width: info.width,
            height: info.height,
        })
    }
    pub fn target(&self) -> RenderTarget<'_> {
        RenderTarget {
            color: &self.color,
            depth: &self.depth,
            auxiliary: None,
            material_mask: false,
            color_format: self.format,
            depth_format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth32Float,
            width: self.width,
            height: self.height,
            viewport: Viewport::full(self.width, self.height),
            color_load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color::BLACK),
            depth_load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(1.),
        }
    }
}


# File: src/render/xr_present.rs
//! Stage both eyes in owned textures before touching compositor attachments.
//! Browser views are used only by `present`, in one final queue submission.
use super::{target::RenderTarget, textures::ColorTarget};

struct EyeStage {
    target: ColorTarget,
    source: wgpu::BindGroup,
    ready: bool,
    write_depth: bool,
}

pub struct XrPresent {
    format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
    layout: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    color_pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    depth_pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    eyes: [Option<EyeStage>; 2],
}

impl XrPresent {
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device, format: wgpu::TextureFormat) -> Self {
        let layout = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("XR stereo presentation sources"),
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                        sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float { filterable: false },
                        view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                        multisampled: false,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                        sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Depth,
                        view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                        multisampled: false,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
            ],
        });
        let shader = device.create_shader_module(wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor {
            label: Some("XR stereo presentation shader"),
            source: wgpu::ShaderSource::Wgsl(include_str!("xr_present.wgsl").into()),
        });
        let pipeline_layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("XR stereo presentation layout"),
            bind_group_layouts: &[Some(&layout)],
            immediate_size: 0,
        });
        let pipeline = |write_depth: bool| {
            device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
                label: Some("XR stereo presentation"),
                layout: Some(&pipeline_layout),
                vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
                    module: &shader,
                    entry_point: Some("vs_main"),
                    compilation_options: Default::default(),
                    buffers: &[],
                },
                fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
                    module: &shader,
                    entry_point: Some(if write_depth { "fs_depth" } else { "fs_color" }),
                    compilation_options: Default::default(),
                    targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                        format,
                        blend: Some(wgpu::BlendState::REPLACE),
                        write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
                    })],
                }),
                primitive: Default::default(),
                depth_stencil: write_depth.then_some(wgpu::DepthStencilState {
                    format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth32Float,
                    depth_write_enabled: Some(write_depth),
                    depth_compare: Some(wgpu::CompareFunction::Always),
                    stencil: Default::default(),
                    bias: Default::default(),
                }),
                multisample: Default::default(),
                multiview_mask: None,
                cache: None,
            })
        };
        Self {
            format,
            color_pipeline: pipeline(false),
            depth_pipeline: pipeline(true),
            layout,
            eyes: [None, None],
        }
    }

    pub fn ensure_eye(
        &mut self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        index: usize,
        width: u32,
        height: u32,
    ) -> Result<(), String> {
        let eye = self
            .eyes
            .get_mut(index)
            .ok_or("XR presentation eye index must be 0 or 1")?;
        if width == 0
            || height == 0
            || width > device.limits().max_texture_dimension_2d
            || height > device.limits().max_texture_dimension_2d
        {
            return Err("Invalid XR presentation stage dimensions".into());
        }
        if eye.as_ref().is_some_and(|eye| eye.ready) {
            return Err("XR presentation eye is already staged for this frame".into());
        }
        if eye
            .as_ref()
            .is_none_or(|eye| (eye.target.width, eye.target.height) != (width, height))
        {
            // Match canvas/PBR linear blending and hardware sRGB encoding.
            // The second UNORM view reads the encoded bytes without decoding them
            // again before the XR compositor consumes its UNORM texture.
            let target = ColorTarget::new_with_view_formats(
                device,
                "XR eye presentation stage",
                width,
                height,
                self.format.add_srgb_suffix(),
                &[self.format],
            );
            let encoded_color = target.texture.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor {
                label: Some("XR encoded color source"),
                format: Some(self.format),
                ..Default::default()
            });
            let source = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
                label: Some("XR eye presentation source"),
                layout: &self.layout,
                entries: &[
                    wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                        binding: 0,
                        resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&encoded_color),
                    },
                    wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                        binding: 1,
                        resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&target.depth),
                    },
                ],
            });
            *eye = Some(EyeStage {
                target,
                source,
                ready: false,
                write_depth: false,
            });
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn target(&self, index: usize) -> Result<RenderTarget<'_>, String> {
        self.eyes
            .get(index)
            .and_then(Option::as_ref)
            .ok_or_else(|| "XR presentation eye stage is not initialized".into())
            .map(|eye| eye.target.target())
    }

    /// Called only after the complete eye render, including postprocessing.
    pub fn mark_ready(&mut self, index: usize, write_depth: bool) -> Result<(), String> {
        let eye = self
            .eyes
            .get_mut(index)
            .and_then(Option::as_mut)
            .ok_or("XR presentation eye stage is not initialized")?;
        if eye.ready {
            return Err("XR presentation eye is already staged for this frame".into());
        }
        eye.ready = true;
        eye.write_depth = write_depth;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn reset_frame(&mut self) {
        for eye in self.eyes.iter_mut().flatten() {
            eye.ready = false;
        }
    }

    pub fn is_ready(&self, index: usize) -> bool {
        self.eyes
            .get(index)
            .and_then(Option::as_ref)
            .is_some_and(|eye| eye.ready)
    }

    /// Validate the complete batch before recording any browser attachment use.
    /// Each supplied eye writes its color/depth slice once; no COPY_DST is needed.
    pub fn present(
        &mut self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        queue: &wgpu::Queue,
        targets: &[(usize, RenderTarget<'_>)],
    ) -> Result<usize, String> {
        if targets.is_empty() || targets.len() > self.eyes.len() {
            return Err("XR presentation requires one or two staged eyes".into());
        }
        let mut seen = [false; 2];
        for (index, target) in targets {
            target.validate()?;
            let eye = self
                .eyes
                .get(*index)
                .and_then(Option::as_ref)
                .ok_or("XR presentation eye stage is not initialized")?;
            if !eye.ready || seen[*index] {
                return Err("XR presentation requires unique ready eyes".into());
            }
            seen[*index] = true;
            if target.color_format != self.format
                || target.depth_format != wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth32Float
                || (target.width, target.height) != (eye.target.width, eye.target.height)
                || target.viewport.x != 0
                || target.viewport.y != 0
                || (target.viewport.width, target.viewport.height) != (target.width, target.height)
                || target.auxiliary.is_some()
                || target.material_mask
            {
                return Err(
                    "XR presentation requires matching full-size color/depth slices".into(),
                );
            }
            // No destination may alias either owned source or another destination.
            if self.eyes.iter().flatten().any(|source| {
                target.color == &source.target.color || target.depth == &source.target.depth
            }) || targets.iter().any(|(other_index, other)| {
                other_index != index && (target.color == other.color || target.depth == other.depth)
            }) {
                return Err(
                    "XR presentation source and destination slices must be distinct".into(),
                );
            }
        }
        if self
            .eyes
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
            .any(|(index, eye)| eye.as_ref().is_some_and(|eye| eye.ready) != seen[index])
        {
            return Err("XR presentation must include every staged eye".into());
        }
        let mut encoder = device.create_command_encoder(&wgpu::CommandEncoderDescriptor {
            label: Some("XR final stereo presentation encoder"),
        });
        for (index, target) in targets {
            let eye = self.eyes[*index].as_ref().unwrap();
            let stamp = super::profiler::stamp("xr.present");
            let mut pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
                label: Some("XR final eye presentation"),
                color_attachments: &[Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                    view: target.color,
                    resolve_target: None,
                    depth_slice: None,
                    ops: wgpu::Operations {
                        load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color::BLACK),
                        store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                    },
                })],
                depth_stencil_attachment: eye.write_depth.then_some(
                    wgpu::RenderPassDepthStencilAttachment {
                        view: target.depth,
                        depth_ops: Some(wgpu::Operations {
                            load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(1.0),
                            store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                        }),
                        stencil_ops: None,
                    },
                ),
                timestamp_writes: stamp.as_ref().map(|stamp| stamp.writes()),
                occlusion_query_set: None,
                multiview_mask: None,
            });
            pass.set_pipeline(if eye.write_depth {
                &self.depth_pipeline
            } else {
                &self.color_pipeline
            });
            pass.set_bind_group(0, &eye.source, &[]);
            pass.draw(0..3, 0..1);
        }
        queue.submit(Some(encoder.finish()));
        self.reset_frame();
        Ok(targets.len())
    }
}


# File: src/render/xr_present.wgsl
// scene_color is an UNORM view of our sRGB render target: already encoded bytes.
// Do not sample the sRGB view or apply another transfer function here.
@group(0) @binding(0) var scene_color: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var scene_depth: texture_depth_2d;

@vertex
fn vs_main(@builtin(vertex_index) index: u32) -> @builtin(position) vec4f {
    let positions = array<vec2f, 3>(vec2f(-1.0, -1.0), vec2f(3.0, -1.0), vec2f(-1.0, 3.0));
    return vec4f(positions[index], 0.0, 1.0);
}

@fragment
fn fs_color(@builtin(position) position: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f {
    return vec4f(textureLoad(scene_color, vec2i(position.xy), 0).rgb, 1.0);
}

struct DepthOutput {
    @location(0) color: vec4f,
    @builtin(frag_depth) depth: f32,
};

@fragment
fn fs_depth(@builtin(position) position: vec4f) -> DepthOutput {
    var output: DepthOutput;
    output.color = vec4f(textureLoad(scene_color, vec2i(position.xy), 0).rgb, 1.0);
    output.depth = textureLoad(scene_depth, vec2i(position.xy), 0);
    return output;
}


# File: src/render_appearance.rs
//! Explicit scene appearance; disabled by default to preserve existing scenes.
use glam::{Mat4, Vec3};
use serde::Deserialize;
#[derive(Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase", deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct Config {
    pub sky: [f32; 3],
    pub ground: [f32; 3],
    pub sun_direction: [f32; 3],
    pub exposure: f32,
    pub fog_color: [f32; 3],
    pub fog_near: f32,
    pub fog_far: f32,
    pub shadow_extent: f32,
    pub shadow_target: [f32; 3],
    pub shadow_near: f32,
    pub shadow_far: f32,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub shadow_normal_bias: f32,
    #[serde(rename = "specularAA")]
    pub specular_aa: bool,
}
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Default, PartialEq, bytemuck::Pod, bytemuck::Zeroable)]
pub struct Appearance {
    pub sky: [f32; 4],
    pub ground: [f32; 4],
    pub sun: [f32; 4],
    pub fog: [f32; 4],
    pub params: [f32; 4],
    pub shadow: [f32; 4],
}
impl Appearance {
    pub fn from_config(c: Config) -> Result<Self, String> {
        let colors = [c.sky, c.ground, c.fog_color];
        let numbers = [
            c.exposure,
            c.fog_near,
            c.fog_far,
            c.shadow_extent,
            c.shadow_near,
            c.shadow_far,
            c.shadow_normal_bias,
        ];
        let direction = Vec3::from_array(c.sun_direction);
        if colors
            .iter()
            .flatten()
            .any(|v| !v.is_finite() || *v < 0.0 || *v > 100.0)
            || numbers.iter().any(|v| !v.is_finite())
            || !direction.is_finite()
            || !direction.length_squared().is_finite()
            || direction.length_squared() < 1e-8
            || !Vec3::from_array(c.shadow_target).is_finite()
            || Vec3::from_array(c.shadow_target).abs().max_element() > 1e6
            || c.exposure <= 0.0
            || c.exposure > 16.0
            || c.fog_near < 0.0
            || c.fog_far - c.fog_near < 0.001
            || c.fog_far > 1e6
            || c.shadow_extent < 0.001
            || c.shadow_extent > 10000.0
            || c.shadow_near < 0.001
            || c.shadow_far - c.shadow_near < 0.001
            || c.shadow_far > 1e6
            || c.shadow_normal_bias < 0.0
            || c.shadow_normal_bias > 1.0
        {
            return Err("Invalid scene appearance".into());
        }
        let d = direction.normalize();
        if !d.is_finite() {
            return Err("Invalid sun direction".into());
        }
        Ok(Self {
            sky: [c.sky[0], c.sky[1], c.sky[2], 1.0],
            ground: [c.ground[0], c.ground[1], c.ground[2], c.shadow_normal_bias],
            sun: [d.x, d.y, d.z, c.exposure],
            fog: [c.fog_color[0], c.fog_color[1], c.fog_color[2], c.fog_near],
            params: [
                c.fog_far,
                f32::from(c.specular_aa),
                c.shadow_extent,
                c.shadow_far,
            ],
            shadow: [
                c.shadow_target[0],
                c.shadow_target[1],
                c.shadow_target[2],
                c.shadow_near,
            ],
        })
    }
    pub fn enabled(&self) -> bool {
        self.sky[3] > 0.5
    }
    pub fn shadow_matrix(&self, position: Vec3) -> Mat4 {
        let direction = Vec3::from_array([self.sun[0], self.sun[1], self.sun[2]]);
        // A directional light uses a parallel projection; position anchors the volume.
        let center = Vec3::new(self.shadow[0], self.shadow[1], self.shadow[2]);
        let position = center + direction * position.distance(center).max(self.shadow[3] + 1.0);
        let target = position - direction;
        let up = if direction.dot(Vec3::Y).abs() > 0.99 {
            Vec3::Z
        } else {
            Vec3::Y
        };
        let extent = self.params[2];
        glam::camera::lh::proj::directx::orthographic(
            -extent,
            extent,
            -extent,
            extent,
            self.shadow[3],
            self.params[3],
        ) * glam::camera::lh::view::look_at_mat4(position, target, up)
    }
}
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    fn config() -> Config {
        Config {
            sky: [1.0; 3],
            ground: [0.2; 3],
            sun_direction: [-45.0, 75.0, 50.0],
            exposure: 1.25,
            shadow_normal_bias: 0.12,
            fog_color: [0.5; 3],
            fog_near: 90.0,
            fog_far: 245.0,
            shadow_extent: 95.0,
            shadow_target: [0.0, 0.0, -15.0],
            shadow_near: 1.0,
            shadow_far: 220.0,
            specular_aa: true,
        }
    }
    #[test]
    fn appearance_validates_and_preserves_disabled_default() {
        assert!(!Appearance::default().enabled());
        let a = Appearance::from_config(config()).unwrap();
        assert!(a.enabled());
        assert_eq!(std::mem::size_of::<Appearance>(), 96);
        let m = a.shadow_matrix(Vec3::new(-45.0, 75.0, 35.0));
        let p = m.project_point3(Vec3::ZERO);

        let mut c = config();

        assert!(Appearance::from_config(c).is_err());
        let mut c = config();

        assert!(Appearance::from_config(c).is_err());
