        c.sun_direction = [1e20, 0.0, 0.0];
        assert!(Appearance::from_config(c).is_err());
        let mut c = config();
        c.shadow_extent = 1e-40;
        assert!(Appearance::from_config(c).is_err());
    }
}


# File: src/render_batch.rs
//! View-local scheduling for explicitly order-independent opaque model runs.
//! Instance-page capacity is separate from spatial scheduling: a dense nearby
//! group may contain many roots, while a long depth chain is split early.
use glam::{Mat4, Vec3};

type Bounds = (Vec3, Vec3);
const MAX_DEPTH_RATIO: f32 = 2.0;

pub(crate) struct DepthWindow {
    camera: Vec3,
    forward: Vec3,
    near: f32,
    far: f32,
}
impl DepthWindow {
    pub fn new(view_projection: Mat4, camera: Vec3, bounds: Bounds) -> Option<Self> {
        if !view_projection.is_finite() || !camera.is_finite() {
            return None;
        }
        let rows = view_projection.transpose();
        // Perspective clip-w is forward depth. Orthographic clip-w is constant;
        // its clip-z normal supplies the view axis instead. No inverse per root.
        let forward = rows
            .w_axis
            .truncate()
            .try_normalize()
            .or_else(|| rows.z_axis.truncate().try_normalize())?;
        let mut window = Self {
            camera,
            forward,
            near: 0.0,
            far: 0.0,
        };
        (window.near, window.far) = window.interval(bounds)?;
        Some(window)
    }
    fn interval(&self, (min, max): Bounds) -> Option<(f32, f32)> {
        if !min.is_finite() || !max.is_finite() || !min.cmple(max).all() {
            return None;
        }
        let center = (min + max) * 0.5;
        let radius = self.forward.abs().dot((max - min) * 0.5);
        let depth = self.forward.dot(center - self.camera);
        let near = depth - radius;
        let far = depth + radius;
        (near > 0.0 && near.is_finite() && far.is_finite()).then_some((near, far))
    }
    /// A rejection does not mutate the accepted run. Only reorderable rigid
    /// opaque draws may use this cost policy; it grants no ordering permission.
    pub fn include(&mut self, bounds: Bounds) -> bool {
        let Some((near, far)) = self.interval(bounds) else {
            return false;
        };
        let near = self.near.min(near);
        let far = self.far.max(far);
        if far / near > MAX_DEPTH_RATIO {
            return false;
        }
        self.near = near;
        self.far = far;
        true
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    fn bounds(z: f32) -> Bounds {
        (Vec3::new(-0.2, -0.2, z - 0.1), Vec3::new(0.2, 0.2, z + 0.1))
    }
    fn projection() -> Mat4 {
        glam::camera::rh::proj::directx::perspective(1.0, 1.5, 0.08, 200.0)
    }
    #[test]
    fn dense_roots_do_not_split_at_an_arbitrary_object_count() {
        let mut w = DepthWindow::new(projection(), Vec3::ZERO, bounds(-4.0)).unwrap();
        for i in 0..2048 {
            assert!(w.include(bounds(-4.0 - (i % 512) as f32 * 0.005)));
        }
        assert!(!w.include(bounds(-30.0)));
        assert!(w.include(bounds(-5.0))); // Rejection did not poison the run.
    }
    #[test]
    fn camera_rotation_translation_and_orthographic_depth_are_view_local() {
        let camera = Vec3::new(8.0, 2.0, -3.0);
        let view = glam::camera::rh::view::look_at_mat4(camera, camera + Vec3::X, Vec3::Y);
        let local = |x: f32| {
            (
                camera + Vec3::new(x - 0.1, -0.2, -0.2),
                camera + Vec3::new(x + 0.1, 0.2, 0.2),
            )
        };
        for p in [
            projection(),
            glam::camera::rh::proj::directx::orthographic(-4.0, 4.0, -3.0, 3.0, 0.08, 200.0),
        ] {
            let mut w = DepthWindow::new(p * view, camera, local(4.0)).unwrap();
            assert!(w.include(local(6.0)));
            assert!(!w.include(local(30.0)));
            assert!(!w.include(local(-2.0)));
        }
    }
    #[test]
    fn frustum_containment_never_accepts_partial_touching_or_invalid_bounds() {
        let f = crate::visibility::Frustum::from_view_projection(Mat4::IDENTITY);
        assert!(f.fully_contains_aabb(Vec3::new(0.0, 0.0, 0.5), Vec3::splat(0.2)));
        for (c, e) in [
            (Vec3::new(0.99, 0.0, 0.5), Vec3::splat(0.1)),
            (Vec3::new(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), Vec3::ZERO),
            (Vec3::new(0.0, 0.0, 0.95), Vec3::splat(0.1)),
        ] {
            assert!(f.intersects_aabb(c, e));
            assert!(!f.fully_contains_aabb(c, e));
        }
        assert!(!f.fully_contains_aabb(Vec3::splat(f32::NAN), Vec3::ONE));
        assert!(!f.fully_contains_aabb(Vec3::ZERO, -Vec3::ONE));
    }
    #[test]
    fn invalid_and_camera_crossing_bounds_are_conservative() {
        assert!(DepthWindow::new(Mat4::ZERO, Vec3::ZERO, bounds(-4.0)).is_none());
        assert!(DepthWindow::new(projection(), Vec3::ZERO, bounds(0.0)).is_none());
        assert!(DepthWindow::new(projection(), Vec3::ZERO, (Vec3::ONE, Vec3::ZERO)).is_none());
        let mut w = DepthWindow::new(projection(), Vec3::ZERO, bounds(-4.0)).unwrap();
        assert!(!w.include((Vec3::splat(f32::NAN), Vec3::ONE)));
        assert!(!w.include(bounds(0.0)));
        assert!(w.include(bounds(-5.0)));
    }
}


# File: src/render_lights.rs
//! Shader program identity derived from the exact uploaded light uniforms.
//! Slot order is retained: shadow maps refer to the original light index.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub(crate) struct LightClass {
    active: u8,
    directional_first: bool,
}
impl LightClass {
    pub(crate) fn from_colors(colors: [[f32; 3]; 4], appearance: bool) -> Self {
        let active = colors.iter().enumerate().fold(0, |mask, (i, color)| {
            mask | (u8::from(color.iter().any(|&v| v != 0.0)) << i)
        });
        Self {
            active,
            directional_first: appearance && active & 1 != 0,
        }
    }
    pub(crate) fn specialize(self, source: &mut String) {
        let start = source
            .find("    for(var i=0u;i<LIGHT_COUNT;i++) {")
            .expect("light loop");
        let end = source[start..]
            .find("    color+=emission;")
            .expect("light loop end")
            + start;
        let loop_source = &source[start..end];
        let body_start = loop_source.find("        let delta=").expect("light body");
        let body_end = loop_source.rfind("    }").expect("light loop close");
        let body = &loop_source[body_start..body_end];
        let mut specialized = String::new();
        for i in 0..4 {
            if self.active & (1 << i) == 0 {
                continue;
            }
            // Separate lexical scope preserves the original per-light locals.
            specialized.push_str("    {\n");
            let direction = if i == 0 && self.directional_first {
                "let l=scene.appearance_sun.xyz;"
            } else {
                "let delta=scene.lights[i].position-v.world; let l=unit(delta);"
            };
            let body = body.replace("let delta=scene.lights[i].position-v.world; let l=select(unit(delta),scene.appearance_sun.xyz,scene.appearance_sky.w>0.5 && i==0u);", direction)
                // Naga suffixes repeated locals. `gl_1` is reserved in GLSL;
                // rename this original short local before emitting scoped copies.
                .replace("let gl=", "let geometry_light=")
                .replace("d*gv*gl*f", "d*gv*geometry_light*f")
                .replace("scene.lights[i]", &format!("scene.lights[{i}]"))
                .replace("i<u32(effects.params.x)", &format!("{i}u<u32(effects.params.x)"))
                .replace("shadow_visibility(i,", &format!("shadow_visibility({i}u,"));
            specialized.push_str(&body);
            specialized.push_str("    }\n");
        }
        source.replace_range(start..end, &specialized);
    }
}
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn light_class_uses_exact_nonzero_slots_and_preserves_order() {
        for mask in 0..16u8 {
            for appearance in [false, true] {
                let colors = std::array::from_fn(|i| {
                    if mask & (1 << i) != 0 {
                        [0.0, 0.2, 0.0]
                    } else {
                        [-0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
                    }
                });
                let class = LightClass::from_colors(colors, appearance);
                assert_eq!(class.active, mask);
                assert_eq!(class.directional_first, appearance && mask & 1 != 0);
                let mut source = include_str!("render/gltf_pbr.wgsl").to_owned();
                class.specialize(&mut source);
                assert!(!source.contains("scene.lights[i]"));
                assert!(!source.contains("let gl="));
                assert!(!source.contains("i<u32(effects.params.x)"));
                assert!(!source.contains("for(var i=0u;i<LIGHT_COUNT"));
                let body = source.split("fn surface(v:").nth(1).unwrap();
                let mut previous = 0;
                for i in 0..4 {
                    let needle = format!("shadow_visibility({i}u,");
                    assert_eq!(body.contains(&needle), mask & (1 << i) != 0);
                    if let Some(index) = body.find(&needle) {
                        assert!(index >= previous);
                        previous = index;
                    }
                }
                assert_eq!(
                    body.contains("let l=scene.appearance_sun.xyz;"),
                    class.directional_first
                );
            }
        }
    }
    #[test]
    fn light_class_color_changes_reuse_program_but_zero_and_type_changes_do_not() {
        let mut colors = [[0.0; 3]; 4];
        colors[2] = [1.0, 0.0, 0.0];
        let a = LightClass::from_colors(colors, false);
        colors[2] = [0.0, 1e-30, 0.0];
        assert_eq!(a, LightClass::from_colors(colors, true));
        colors[0] = [1.0; 3];
        assert_ne!(a, LightClass::from_colors(colors, true));
        assert_ne!(
            LightClass::from_colors(colors, false),
            LightClass::from_colors(colors, true)
        );
        colors[2] = [0.0; 3];
        assert_ne!(a, LightClass::from_colors(colors, false));
    }
}


# File: src/render_math.rs
//! View math shared by shadow/mirror passes and native tests.
use glam::{Mat4, Vec3, Vec4};

/// Normalized DOM coordinates (left/top=0) projected onto world horizontal plane.
pub fn screen_to_horizontal_plane(matrix: Mat4, u: f32, v: f32, height: f32) -> Option<Vec3> {
    if !u.is_finite()
        || !v.is_finite()
        || !height.is_finite()
        || !(0.0..=1.0).contains(&u)
        || !(0.0..=1.0).contains(&v)
    {
        return None;
    }
    let inverse = matrix.inverse();
    if !inverse.is_finite() {
        return None;
    }
    let near = inverse.project_point3(Vec3::new(u * 2.0 - 1.0, 1.0 - v * 2.0, 0.0));
    let far = inverse.project_point3(Vec3::new(u * 2.0 - 1.0, 1.0 - v * 2.0, 1.0));
    let direction = far - near;
    if !near.is_finite() || !direction.is_finite() || direction.y.abs() < 1e-6 {
        return None;
    }
    let t = (height - near.y) / direction.y;
    let point = near + direction * t;
    (t >= 0.0 && point.is_finite()).then_some(point)
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct MirrorPlane {
    pub normal: Vec3,
    pub distance: f32,
}
impl MirrorPlane {
    pub fn new(normal: Vec3, distance: f32) -> Option<Self> {
        let length = normal.length();
        if !normal.is_finite() || !distance.is_finite() || length < 1e-6 {
            return None;
        }
        Some(Self {
            normal: normal / length,
            distance: distance / length,
        })
    }
    pub fn matrix(self) -> Mat4 {
        let n = self.normal;
        Mat4::from_cols(
            (Vec3::X - 2.0 * n.x * n).extend(0.0),
            (Vec3::Y - 2.0 * n.y * n).extend(0.0),
            (Vec3::Z - 2.0 * n.z * n).extend(0.0),
            (-2.0 * self.distance * n).extend(1.0),
        )
    }
    pub fn clip_plane(self, camera: Vec3) -> Vec4 {
        let plane = self.normal.extend(self.distance);
        if self.normal.dot(camera) + self.distance < 0.0 {
            -plane
        } else {
            plane
        }
    }
}
pub fn shadow_view_projection(position: Vec3) -> Mat4 {
    let center = Vec3::new(0.0, -0.5, 0.0);
    let target = if center.distance_squared(position) < 1e-8 {
        position + Vec3::NEG_Z
    } else {
        center
    };
    let direction = (target - position).normalize_or_zero();
    let up = if direction.dot(Vec3::Y).abs() > 0.99 {
        Vec3::Z
    } else {
        Vec3::Y
    };
    glam::camera::lh::proj::directx::perspective(1.5, 1.0, 0.1, 30.0)
        * glam::camera::lh::view::look_at_mat4(position, target, up)
}
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn pointer_projection_matches_visible_camera_and_rejects_invalid_rays() {
        let mut camera = crate::input::camera::Camera::new(1.5);
        assert!(camera.set_view(Vec3::new(5., 6., 7.), Vec3::new(0., 1., 0.)));
        let matrix = camera.matrix();
        let p = screen_to_horizontal_plane(matrix, 0.5, 0.5, 1.0).unwrap();
        assert!(p.length().is_finite());
        assert!(p.distance(Vec3::Y) < 1e-3);
        let visible = matrix.project_point3(p);
        assert!(visible.x.abs() < 1e-4 && visible.y.abs() < 1e-4);
        assert!(screen_to_horizontal_plane(matrix, -0.1, 0.5, 0.).is_none());
        assert!(screen_to_horizontal_plane(Mat4::ZERO, 0.5, 0.5, 0.).is_none());
        assert!(screen_to_horizontal_plane(Mat4::IDENTITY, 0.5, 0.5, 0.).is_none());
    }
    #[test]
    fn mirror_reflects_camera_and_preserves_surface_points() {
        let p = MirrorPlane::new(Vec3::Z * 2.0, 6.0).unwrap();
        let r = p.matrix();
        assert!(
            (r.transform_point3(Vec3::new(1.0, 2.0, 5.0)) - Vec3::new(1.0, 2.0, -11.0)).length()
                < 1e-5
        );
        let surface = Vec3::new(1.0, 2.0, -3.0);
        assert!((r.transform_point3(surface) - surface).length() < 1e-5);
        assert!((r * r - Mat4::IDENTITY)
            .to_cols_array()
            .iter()
            .all(|v| v.abs() < 1e-5));
        assert!(r.determinant() < 0.0);
        assert!(p.clip_plane(Vec3::ZERO).dot(Vec3::ZERO.extend(1.0)) > 0.0);
        assert!(MirrorPlane::new(Vec3::ZERO, 0.0).is_none());
    }
    #[test]

        let light = Vec3::new(-3.0, 7.0, 4.0);
        let f = crate::visibility::Frustum::from_view_projection(shadow_view_projection(light));
        assert!(f.intersects_aabb(Vec3::ZERO, Vec3::splat(0.5)));
        assert!(!f.intersects_aabb(light * 2.0, Vec3::splat(0.1)));
    }
}

/// WebXR uses OpenGL [-1,1] depth; wgpu render views use [0,1].
pub fn xr_view(projection: &[f32], world: &[f32]) -> Option<(Mat4, Vec3)> {
    let projection: &[f32; 16] = projection.try_into().ok()?;
    let world: &[f32; 16] = world.try_into().ok()?;
    let projection = Mat4::from_cols_array(projection);
    let world = Mat4::from_cols_array(world);
    if !projection.is_finite() || !world.is_finite() || world.determinant().abs() < 1e-8 {
        return None;
    }
    let depth = Mat4::from_cols(
        Vec4::X,
        Vec4::Y,
        Vec4::new(0., 0., 0.5, 0.),
        Vec4::new(0., 0., 0.5, 1.),
    );
    Some((
        depth * projection * world.inverse(),
        world.transform_point3(Vec3::ZERO),
    ))
}

/// WebGPU-compatible XR sessions already supply zero-to-one clip depth.
pub fn xr_gpu_view(projection: &[f32], world: &[f32]) -> Option<(Mat4, Vec3)> {
    let projection = Mat4::from_cols_array(projection.try_into().ok()?);
    let world = Mat4::from_cols_array(world.try_into().ok()?);
    if !projection.is_finite() || !world.is_finite() || world.determinant().abs() < 1e-8 {
        return None;
    }
    Some((
        projection * world.inverse(),
        world.transform_point3(Vec3::ZERO),
    ))
}

#[cfg(test)]

        let world = Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(0.032, 1.6, 0.));
        let (vp, eye) = xr_gpu_view(&p.to_cols_array(), &world.to_cols_array()).unwrap();
        assert!(vp.project_point3(eye - Vec3::Z * 0.1).z.abs() < 1e-5);
        assert!((vp.project_point3(eye - Vec3::Z * 100.).z - 1.).abs() < 1e-5);
        assert!(xr_gpu_view(&[0.; 15], &[0.; 16]).is_none());
        assert!(xr_gpu_view(&[f32::NAN; 16], &[0.; 16]).is_none());
        assert!(xr_gpu_view(&p.to_cols_array(), &[0.; 16]).is_none());
    }

        assert!(xr_view(&[0.; 15], &[0.; 16]).is_none());
        assert!(xr_view(&[f32::NAN; 16], &[0.; 16]).is_none());
        assert!(xr_view(&p.to_cols_array(), &[0.; 16]).is_none());
    }

# File: src/render_overlap.rs
//! Append-only exact overlap queries for one ordered, disjoint batching run.
//! Tree topology follows insertion order; it never reorders scene objects.
use glam::Vec3;

type Bounds = (Vec3, Vec3);
const LEAF: u32 = u32::MAX;
const LINEAR_LIMIT: usize = 16;
const TREE_LIMIT: usize = 8192;
const QUERY_LIMIT: u64 = 64;
const EXHAUSTION_LIMIT: u8 = 8;

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct Node {
    bounds: Bounds,
    left: u32,
    right: u32,
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct Root {
    node: u32,
    height: u8,
}
#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct OrderedBounds {
    leaves: Vec<Bounds>,
    nodes: Vec<Node>,
    roots: Vec<Root>,
    invalid: bool,
    budget_exhaustions: u8,
    linear_only: bool,
}
#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct Probe {
    pub overlap: bool,
    pub leaf_tests: u64,
    pub node_tests: u64,
    pub fallback: bool,
}
fn valid((min, max): Bounds) -> bool {
    min.is_finite() && max.is_finite() && min.cmple(max).all()
}
fn disjoint(a: Bounds, b: Bounds) -> bool {
    (a.1.cmplt(b.0) | b.1.cmplt(a.0)).any()
}
/// Reject an unknown or malformed primitive before combining it with valid ones.
pub(crate) fn union_bounds(bounds: impl Iterator<Item = Option<Bounds>>) -> Option<Bounds> {
    let mut result: Option<Bounds> = None;
    for next in bounds {
        let next = next?;
        if !valid(next) {
            return None;
        }
        result = Some(match result {
            Some(prior) => (prior.0.min(next.0), prior.1.max(next.1)),
            None => next,
        });
    }
    result
}
impl OrderedBounds {
    pub fn clear(&mut self) {
        self.leaves.clear();
        self.nodes.clear();
        self.roots.clear();
        self.invalid = false;
        self.budget_exhaustions = 0;
        self.linear_only = false;
    }
    pub fn capacity(&self) -> usize {
        self.leaves.capacity() + self.nodes.capacity() + self.roots.capacity()
    }
    pub fn bytes(&self) -> usize {
        self.leaves.capacity() * std::mem::size_of::<Bounds>()
            + self.nodes.capacity() * std::mem::size_of::<Node>()
            + self.roots.capacity() * std::mem::size_of::<Root>()
    }
    pub fn push(&mut self, bounds: Bounds) {
        if !valid(bounds) || self.nodes.len() >= LEAF as usize - 64 {
            self.invalid = true;
            return;
        }
        self.leaves.push(bounds);
        if self.linear_only || self.leaves.len() <= LINEAR_LIMIT || self.leaves.len() > TREE_LIMIT {
            return;
        }
        if self.nodes.is_empty() {
            for index in 0..self.leaves.len() {
                self.insert_node(self.leaves[index]);
            }
        } else {
            self.insert_node(bounds);
        }
    }
    fn insert_node(&mut self, bounds: Bounds) {
        let mut root = Root {
            node: self.nodes.len() as u32,
            height: 0,
        };
        self.nodes.push(Node {
            bounds,
            left: LEAF,
            right: LEAF,
        });
        while self
            .roots
            .last()
            .is_some_and(|prior| prior.height == root.height)
        {
            let prior = self.roots.pop().unwrap();
            let a = self.nodes[prior.node as usize].bounds;
            let b = self.nodes[root.node as usize].bounds;
            let parent = self.nodes.len() as u32;
            self.nodes.push(Node {
                bounds: (a.0.min(b.0), a.1.max(b.1)),
                left: prior.node,
                right: root.node,
            });
            root = Root {
                node: parent,
                height: root.height + 1,
            };
        }
        self.roots.push(root);
    }
    pub fn probe(&mut self, bounds: Bounds) -> Probe {
        let mut result = Probe::default();
        if self.invalid || !valid(bounds) {
            result.overlap = true;
            return result;
        }
        if self.linear_only || self.leaves.len() <= LINEAR_LIMIT || self.leaves.len() > TREE_LIMIT {
            result.overlap = self.linear_probe(bounds, &mut result);
            return result;
        }
        for root in &self.roots {
            match self.visit(root.node, bounds, &mut result) {
                Some(true) => {
                    result.overlap = true;
                    break;
                }
                Some(false) => {}
                None => {
                    result.fallback = true;
                    result.overlap = self.linear_probe(bounds, &mut result);
                    // Poor spatial locality can make every query traverse the
                    // full budget. Stop paying for an unhelpful index in this
                    // run only; all leaves remain available to the exact scan.
                    self.budget_exhaustions += 1;
                    self.linear_only = self.budget_exhaustions >= EXHAUSTION_LIMIT;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        result
    }
    fn linear_probe(&self, bounds: Bounds, result: &mut Probe) -> bool {
        // Keep counter/index writes out of the hot predicate. any consumes the
        // first hit too, so the remaining length gives the exact examined count.
        let mut remaining = self.leaves.iter();
        let overlap = remaining.any(|&prior| !disjoint(prior, bounds));
        let tested = (self.leaves.len() - remaining.len()) as u64;
        result.leaf_tests += tested;
        result.node_tests += tested;
        overlap
    }
    fn visit(&self, index: u32, bounds: Bounds, result: &mut Probe) -> Option<bool> {
        if result.node_tests >= QUERY_LIMIT {
            return None;
        }
        let node = self.nodes[index as usize];
        result.node_tests += 1;
        if node.left == LEAF {
            result.leaf_tests += 1;
        }
        if disjoint(node.bounds, bounds) {
            return Some(false);
        }
        if node.left == LEAF {
            return Some(true);
        }
        if self.visit(node.left, bounds, result)? {
            return Some(true);
        }
        self.visit(node.right, bounds, result)
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    fn bounds(x: f32, y: f32, z: f32, extent: f32) -> Bounds {
        let p = Vec3::new(x, y, z);
        (p - Vec3::splat(extent), p + Vec3::splat(extent))
    }
    fn grouping(boxes: &[Bounds], accelerated: bool) -> Vec<std::ops::Range<usize>> {
        let mut result = Vec::new();
        let mut tree = OrderedBounds::default();
        let mut start = 0;
        while start < boxes.len() {
            tree.clear();
            tree.push(boxes[start]);
            let mut end = start + 1;
            while end < boxes.len() {
                let conflict = if accelerated {
                    tree.probe(boxes[end]).overlap
                } else {
                    boxes[start..end].iter().any(|&a| !disjoint(a, boxes[end]))
                };
                if conflict {
                    break;
                }
                tree.push(boxes[end]);
                end += 1;
            }
            result.push(start..end);
            start = end;
        }
        result
    }
    #[test]
    fn linear_fallback_counts_first_last_miss_and_prior_tree_work_exactly() {
        let mut tree = OrderedBounds::default();
        let check = |tree: &OrderedBounds, query, expected_hit, expected_tests: u64| {
            let mut probe = Probe {
                leaf_tests: 7,
                node_tests: 9,
                ..Probe::default()
            };
            assert_eq!(tree.linear_probe(query, &mut probe), expected_hit);
            assert_eq!(probe.leaf_tests, 7 + expected_tests);
            assert_eq!(probe.node_tests, 9 + expected_tests);
        };
        check(&tree, bounds(9., 0., 0., 0.1), false, 0);
        for x in [0., 2., 4.] {
            tree.push(bounds(x, 0., 0., 0.1));
        }
        check(&tree, bounds(0., 0., 0., 0.1), true, 1);
        check(&tree, bounds(4., 0., 0., 0.1), true, 3);
        check(&tree, bounds(9., 0., 0., 0.1), false, 3);
        tree.clear();
        let count = 4096usize;
        for i in 0..count {
            let logical = if i % 2 == 0 { i / 2 } else { count - 1 - i / 2 };
            tree.push(bounds(logical as f32 * 2., 0., 0., 0.1));
        }
        let probe = tree.probe(bounds(count as f32 - 0.5, 0., 0., 0.1));
        assert!(probe.fallback && !probe.overlap);
        assert!(probe.leaf_tests >= count as u64 && probe.leaf_tests <= count as u64 + QUERY_LIMIT);
        assert_eq!(probe.node_tests, count as u64 + QUERY_LIMIT);
    }
    #[test]
    fn repeated_budget_exhaustion_uses_exact_scan_until_clear_and_keeps_late_leaves() {
        let mut tree = OrderedBounds::default();
        let count = 4096usize;
        for i in 0..count {
            let logical = if i % 2 == 0 { i / 2 } else { count - 1 - i / 2 };
            tree.push(bounds(logical as f32 * 2., 0., 0., 0.1));
        }
        for _ in 0..EXHAUSTION_LIMIT {
            let probe = tree.probe(bounds(count as f32 - 0.5, 0., 0., 0.1));
            assert!(probe.fallback && !probe.overlap);
        }
        assert!(tree.linear_only);
        let nodes = tree.nodes.len();
        tree.push(bounds(10000., 0., 0., 0.1));
        assert_eq!(
            tree.nodes.len(),
            nodes,
            "disabled index stops constructing nodes"
        );
        let probe = tree.probe(bounds(10000., 0., 0., 0.1));
        assert!(probe.overlap && !probe.fallback);
        assert_eq!(probe.leaf_tests, count as u64 + 1);
        tree.clear();
        assert!(!tree.linear_only && tree.budget_exhaustions == 0);
        for i in 0..count {
            tree.push(bounds(i as f32 * 2., 0., 0., 0.1));
        }
        let probe = tree.probe(bounds(10000., 0., 0., 0.1));
        assert!(!probe.overlap && !probe.fallback);
        assert_eq!(probe.leaf_tests, 0);
        assert_eq!(probe.node_tests, 1);
    }
    #[test]
    fn ordered_bounds_preserves_every_greedy_group_against_independent_pairs() {
        let mut seed = 0x6a09e667u32;
        let mut rand = || {
            seed ^= seed << 13;
            seed ^= seed >> 17;
            seed ^= seed << 5;
            seed as f64 / u32::MAX as f64
        };
        for count in [1, 2, 3, 31, 128, 1025] {
            for mode in 0..12 {
                let boxes: Vec<_> = (0..count)
                    .map(|i| {
                        let x = if mode % 3 == 0 {
                            i as f32 * 0.4
                        } else {
                            (rand() * 12.) as f32
                        };
                        bounds(
                            x,
                            (rand() * 12.) as f32,
                            (rand() * 3.) as f32,
                            if mode % 4 == 0 { 1.2 } else { 0.1 },
                        )
                    })
                    .collect();
                assert_eq!(
                    grouping(&boxes, true),
                    grouping(&boxes, false),
                    "count{count} mode{mode}"
                );
            }
        }
    }
    #[test]
    fn ordered_bounds_keeps_touching_overlap_and_conservative_invalid_inputs() {
        let mut tree = OrderedBounds::default();
        tree.push(bounds(0., 0., 0., 1.));
        assert!(tree.probe(bounds(2., 0., 0., 1.)).overlap);
        assert!(
            !tree
                .probe(bounds(f32::from_bits(2f32.to_bits() + 1), 0., 0., 1.))
                .overlap
        );
        assert!(tree.probe((Vec3::splat(f32::NAN), Vec3::ONE)).overlap);
        assert!(tree.probe((Vec3::ONE, Vec3::ZERO)).overlap);
        tree.push((Vec3::ZERO, Vec3::splat(f32::INFINITY)));
        assert!(tree.probe(bounds(100., 0., 0., 0.1)).overlap);
        tree.clear();
        assert!(!tree.probe(bounds(100., 0., 0., 0.1)).overlap);
    }
    #[test]
    fn union_rejects_invalid_primitive_before_nan_can_be_hidden() {
        let good = bounds(0., 0., 0., 1.);
        for bad in [
            None,
            Some((Vec3::splat(f32::NAN), Vec3::ONE)),
            Some((Vec3::ONE, Vec3::ZERO)),
            Some((Vec3::ZERO, Vec3::splat(f32::INFINITY))),
        ] {
            assert!(union_bounds([Some(good), bad].into_iter()).is_none());
        }
        assert_eq!(
            union_bounds([Some(good), Some(bounds(4., 0., 0., 1.))].into_iter()),
            Some((Vec3::new(-1., -1., -1.), Vec3::new(5., 1., 1.)))
        );
        assert!(union_bounds(std::iter::empty()).is_none());
    }
    #[test]
    fn ordered_bounds_past_tree_limit_keeps_every_leaf_and_reuses_after_clear() {
        let mut tree = OrderedBounds::default();
        for i in 0..TREE_LIMIT + 2 {
            tree.push(bounds(i as f32 * 2., 0., 0., 0.1));
        }
        assert!(
            tree.probe(bounds((TREE_LIMIT + 1) as f32 * 2., 0., 0., 0.1))
                .overlap
        );
        assert!(!tree.probe(bounds(-10., 0., 0., 0.1)).overlap);
        tree.clear();
        tree.push(bounds(0., 0., 0., 0.1));
        assert!(tree.probe(bounds(0., 0., 0., 0.1)).overlap);
        assert!(!tree.probe(bounds(5., 0., 0., 0.1)).overlap);
    }
    #[test]
    fn ordered_bounds_grid_prunes_real_work_and_reuses_storage() {
        let mut tree = OrderedBounds::default();
        let mut nodes = 0;
        let mut leaves = 0;
        let boxes: Vec<_> = (0..4096)
            .map(|i| bounds((i % 64) as f32, (i / 64) as f32, 0., 0.1))
            .collect();
        for &b in &boxes {
            let p = tree.probe(b);
            assert!(!p.overlap);
            nodes += p.node_tests;
            leaves += p.leaf_tests;
            tree.push(b);
        }
        assert!(nodes < (4096 * 4095 / 2) / 20, "node tests{nodes}");
        assert!(leaves < 8192, "leaf tests{leaves}");
        let mut shuffled = boxes.clone();
        let mut seed = 0x9e3779b9u32;
        for i in (1..shuffled.len()).rev() {
            seed ^= seed << 13;
            seed ^= seed >> 17;
            seed ^= seed << 5;
            let j = seed as usize % (i + 1);
            shuffled.swap(i, j);
        }
        assert_eq!(grouping(&shuffled, true), grouping(&shuffled, false));
        let alternating: Vec<_> = (0..boxes.len())
            .map(|i| {
                boxes[if i % 2 == 0 {
                    i / 2
                } else {
                    boxes.len() - 1 - i / 2
                }]
            })
            .collect();
        assert_eq!(grouping(&alternating, true), grouping(&alternating, false));
        let dense = vec![bounds(0., 0., 0., 0.2); 4096];
        assert_eq!(grouping(&dense, true), grouping(&dense, false));
        let bytes = tree.bytes();
        tree.clear();
        for b in boxes {
            tree.push(b);
        }
        assert_eq!(bytes, tree.bytes());
        assert!(tree.capacity() > 0);
        tree = OrderedBounds::default();
        assert_eq!(tree.bytes(), 0);
    }
}


# File: src/rim_cut.rs
//! Binary, worker-safe clipping of the actual posed GLB triangles. No scene/GPU access.
use glam::Vec3;
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct Vertex {
    p: Vec3,
    n: Vec3,
    c: Vec3,
}
impl Vertex {
    fn lerp(self, b: Self, t: f32) -> Self {
        Self {
            p: self.p.lerp(b.p, t),
            n: self.n.lerp(b.n, t).normalize_or_zero(),
            c: self.c.lerp(b.c, t),
        }
    }
}
fn push(out: &mut Vec<f32>, v: Vertex) {
    out.extend_from_slice(&[
        v.p.x, v.p.y, v.p.z, v.n.x, v.n.y, v.n.z, v.c.x, v.c.y, v.c.z,
    ]);
}
/// Input words: token, triangleCount, normal.xyz, point.xyz, then 27 floats per triangle.
/// Output words: token, positiveVertexCount, negativeVertexCount, then both flat streams.
pub fn split(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
    if bytes.len() < 32 || bytes.len() > 32 + 100_000 * 108 || !bytes.len().is_multiple_of(4) {
        return Err("Invalid cut job".into());
    }
    let words: Vec<f32> = bytes
        .as_chunks::<4>()
        .0
        .iter()
        .map(|b| f32::from_le_bytes(*b))
        .collect();
    let token = words[0].to_bits();
    let count = words[1].to_bits() as usize;
    if count > 100_000 || words.len() != 8 + count * 27 || words[2..].iter().any(|v| !v.is_finite())
    {
        return Err("Invalid cut geometry".into());
    }
    let normal = Vec3::from_slice(&words[2..5]).normalize_or_zero();
    let point = Vec3::from_slice(&words[5..8]);
    if normal.length_squared() < 0.5 {
        return Err("Invalid cut plane".into());
    }
    let mut halves = [Vec::new(), Vec::new()];
    for triangle in words[8..].as_chunks::<27>().0.iter() {
        let vertices = std::array::from_fn::<_, 3, _>(|i| {
            let v = &triangle[i * 9..];
            Vertex {
                p: Vec3::from_slice(v),
                n: Vec3::from_slice(&v[3..]),
                c: Vec3::from_slice(&v[6..]),
            }
        });
        for (side, out) in halves.iter_mut().enumerate() {
            let sign = if side == 0 { 1. } else { -1. };
            let mut polygon = Vec::with_capacity(4);
            for i in 0..3 {
                let a = vertices[i];
                let b = vertices[(i + 1) % 3];
                let da = normal.dot(a.p - point) * sign;
                let db = normal.dot(b.p - point) * sign;
                if da >= 0. {
                    polygon.push(a);
                }
                if (da >= 0.) != (db >= 0.) {
                    polygon.push(a.lerp(b, da / (da - db)));
                }
            }
            for i in 1..polygon.len().saturating_sub(1) {
                let tri = [polygon[0], polygon[i], polygon[i + 1]];
                if (tri[1].p - tri[0].p)
                    .cross(tri[2].p - tri[0].p)
                    .length_squared()
                    > 1e-16
                {
                    for v in tri {
                        push(out, v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let mut output = Vec::with_capacity(12 + (halves[0].len() + halves[1].len()) * 4);
    for value in [
        token,
        (halves[0].len() / 9) as u32,
        (halves[1].len() / 9) as u32,
    ] {
        output.extend_from_slice(&value.to_le_bytes());
    }
    for side in halves {
        for value in side {
            output.extend_from_slice(&value.to_le_bytes());
        }
    }
    Ok(output)
}
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn clips_actual_crossing_triangle_and_preserves_normals() {
        let mut b = Vec::new();
        for x in [7u32, 1] {
            b.extend_from_slice(&x.to_le_bytes());
        }
        for x in [1f32, 0., 0., 0., 0., 0.] {
            b.extend_from_slice(&x.to_le_bytes());
        }
        for p in [[-1f32, 0., 0.], [1., 0., 0.], [0., 1., 0.]] {
            for x in p.into_iter().chain([0., 0., 1., 0.2, 0.4, 0.6]) {
                b.extend_from_slice(&x.to_le_bytes());
            }
        }
        let r = split(&b).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(u32::from_le_bytes(r[0..4].try_into().unwrap()), 7);
        assert_eq!(u32::from_le_bytes(r[4..8].try_into().unwrap()), 3);
        assert_eq!(u32::from_le_bytes(r[8..12].try_into().unwrap()), 3);
        for (i, c) in r[12..].as_chunks::<36>().0.iter().enumerate() {
            let x = f32::from_le_bytes(c[0..4].try_into().unwrap());
            assert!(if i < 3 { x >= 0. } else { x <= 0. });
        }
    }
    #[test]
    fn rejects_truncated_and_nonfinite_jobs() {
        assert!(split(&[]).is_err());
        let mut b = vec![0u8; 32];
        b[8..12].copy_from_slice(&f32::NAN.to_le_bytes());
        assert!(split(&b).is_err());
    }
}


# File: src/rim_game.rs
//! Aurelia encounter and equipment simulation. Browser code only supplies input and worker messages.
use crate::{
    rim_movement::{Player, Shape, World},
    scene::SceneManager,
};
use glam::{Mat4, Quat, Vec2, Vec3};
use serde::Deserialize;
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet, VecDeque};
pub const MAX_STRESS_MODELS: u32 = 2048;
const HIDDEN: Vec3 = Vec3::new(0., -10000., 0.);
#[derive(Deserialize)]
pub struct EnemySpec {
    pub id: u32,
    pub kind: String,
    pub height: f32,
    pub offset: [f32; 3],
    pub scale: [f32; 3],
}
#[derive(Deserialize)]
pub struct Config {
    pub enemies: Vec<EnemySpec>,
    pub swords: [u32; 2],
    pub bolts: Vec<u32>,
    pub beams: Vec<u32>,
    pub charges: Vec<u32>,
    #[serde(default, rename = "healthBars")]
    pub health_bars: Vec<[u32; 2]>,
    #[serde(default, rename = "blobShadows")]
    pub blob_shadows: Vec<u32>,
    pub hud: Vec<u32>,
    pub marker: u32,
    pub shapes: Vec<Shape>,
    pub obstacles: Vec<[f32; 4]>,
}
#[derive(Deserialize, Default)]
#[serde(default)]
pub struct Input {
    pub start: bool,
    pub pause: Option<bool>,
    pub reset: bool,
    pub movement: Option<[f32; 2]>,
    pub sprint: Option<bool>,
    pub aim: Option<bool>,
    pub dash: bool,
    pub slash: Option<usize>,
    pub look: Option<[f32; 2]>,
    pub teleport: Option<[f32; 3]>,
    pub death_mode: Option<String>,
    pub stress_count: Option<u32>,
}
struct Enemy {
    spec: EnemySpec,
    position: Vec3,
    yaw: f32,
    phase: u8,
    age: f32,
    cut_idle: f32,
    shot: f32,
    salvos: u32,
    beam_age: f32,
    beam_from: Vec3,
    beam_target: Vec3,
    waypoint: Option<Vec2>,
    nav_age: f32,
    serial: u32,
    hp: f32,
    max_hp: f32,
    contacts: [bool; 2],
    cooldowns: [f32; 2],
    last_strikes: [u64; 2],
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]

}
const PREPARE_TRIANGLES: usize = 3500;
const INSTALL_VERTICES: usize = 9000;
struct CompletedCut {

}

type ConfigIds = ([u32; 2], Vec<u32>, Vec<u32>, Vec<u32>, Vec<u32>, u32);

pub struct Game {
    pub player: Player,
    world: World,
    config_ids: ConfigIds,
    enemies: Vec<Enemy>,

    blob_shadows: Vec<u32>,
    shadow_options: Vec<(u32, crate::scene::RenderOptions)>,
    obstacles: Vec<[f32; 4]>,
    corners: Vec<Vec2>,
    edges: Vec<Vec<f32>>,
    active: bool,
    paused: bool,
    wave: usize,
    health: f32,
    kills: u32,
    deaths: u32,
    hits: u32,
    dead_age: f32,
    age: f32,
    axis: [f32; 2],
    sprint: bool,
    aim: bool,
    dash: bool,
    swing: [f32; 2],

    blades: [Option<Blade>; 2],
    bolts: Vec<Bolt>,
    fired: u32,
    reflected: u32,
    returned: u32,
    blocked: u32,
    frame: u64,
    visual_frame: u64,
    death_mode: String,
    stress_count: u32,
    tasks: VecDeque<CutTask>,
    pending: BTreeMap<u32, Pending>,
    completed: VecDeque<CompletedCut>,
    staged: Vec<StagedCut>,
    abandoned: Vec<u32>,
    prepared_triangles: usize,
    staged_vertices: usize,
    commits: u32,
    stage_ms: f64,
    stage_max_ms: f64,
    token: u32,
    pieces: Vec<u32>,
    piece_motion: BTreeMap<u32, PieceMotion>,
    cut_errors: u32,
    blade_contacts: u64,
    blade_hits: u64,
    blade_slow: u64,
    blade_breaks: u64,
    blade_speed: f32,
