use super::*;
use std::sync::{Arc, OnceLock};

fn fixture() -> (Game, SceneManager) {
    fixture_with_playing_pool(false)
}
fn fixture_with_playing_pool(playing: bool) -> (Game, SceneManager) {
    fixture_with_shadow_pool(playing, false)
}
fn fixture_with_shadow_pool(playing: bool, blobs: bool) -> (Game, SceneManager) {
    static ASSETS: OnceLock<Vec<Arc<crate::gltf_model::ModelAsset>>> = OnceLock::new();
    let assets = ASSETS.get_or_init(|| {
        [
            include_bytes!("../assets/models/rim/drone-orbiter.glb").as_slice(),
            include_bytes!("../assets/models/rim/core-tank.glb").as_slice(),
            include_bytes!("../assets/models/rim/blade-wraith.glb").as_slice(),
        ]
        .iter()
        .map(|bytes| Arc::new(crate::gltf_loader::parse_model(bytes, &[], &[]).unwrap()))
        .collect()
    });
    let layout: Value =
        serde_json::from_str(include_str!("../assets/models/rim/layout.json")).unwrap();
    let collision: Value =
        serde_json::from_str(include_str!("../assets/models/rim/collisions.json")).unwrap();
    let mut scene = SceneManager::default();
    let mut enemies = Vec::new();
    for (index, kind) in ["drone-orbiter", "core-tank", "blade-wraith"]
        .into_iter()
        .enumerate()
    {
        let spec = layout["models"]
            .as_array()
            .unwrap()
            .iter()
            .find(|s| s["slug"] == kind)
            .unwrap();
        for _ in 0..if index == 0 { 8 } else { 3 } {
            let id = scene.add_model(assets[index].clone()).unwrap();
            let offset: [f32; 3] =
                serde_json::from_value(spec["root"]["position"].clone()).unwrap();
            let scale: [f32; 3] = serde_json::from_value(spec["root"]["scale"].clone()).unwrap();
            scene.set_object_transform(
                id,
                Vec3::from_array(offset),
                Vec3::ZERO,
                Vec3::from_array(scale),
            );
            if playing {
                let name = if kind == "blade-wraith" {
                    "Run"
                } else {
                    "Idle"
                };
                let clip = assets[index]
                    .animations
                    .iter()
                    .position(|clip| clip.name.as_deref() == Some(name))
                    .unwrap();
                scene.play_model_animation(id, clip, true, 1.).unwrap();
            }
            enemies.push(EnemySpec {
                id,
                kind: kind.into(),
                height: spec["height"].as_f64().unwrap() as f32,
                offset,
                scale,
            });
        }
    }
    let swords = std::array::from_fn(|_| scene.add_cube(HIDDEN));
    let bolts = (0..32).map(|_| scene.add_cube(HIDDEN)).collect();
    let beams = (0..14).map(|_| scene.add_cube(HIDDEN)).collect();
    let charges = (0..14).map(|_| scene.add_cube(HIDDEN)).collect();
    let health_bars = (0..14)
        .map(|_| [scene.add_cube(HIDDEN), scene.add_cube(HIDDEN)])
        .collect();
    let hud = (0..5).map(|_| scene.add_cube(HIDDEN)).collect();
    let marker = scene.add_cube(HIDDEN);
    let shapes = serde_json::from_value(collision["shapes"].clone()).unwrap();
    let obstacles = collision["obstacles"]
        .as_array()
        .unwrap()
        .iter()
        .map(|r| {
            [
                r["minX"].as_f64().unwrap() as f32,
                r["maxX"].as_f64().unwrap() as f32,
                r["minZ"].as_f64().unwrap() as f32,
                r["maxZ"].as_f64().unwrap() as f32,
            ]
        })
        .collect();
    let game = Game::new(
        Config {
            enemies,
            swords,
            bolts,
            beams,
            charges,
            health_bars,
            blob_shadows: if blobs {
                (0..14).map(|_| scene.add_cube(HIDDEN)).collect()
            } else {
                Vec::new()
            },
            hud,
            marker,
            shapes,
            obstacles,
        },
        &mut scene,
    )
    .unwrap();
    (game, scene)
}
fn start(game: &mut Game, scene: &mut SceneManager) {
    game.input(
        Input {
            start: true,
            ..Default::default()
        },
        scene,
    )
    .unwrap();
}

#[test]
fn original_models_normalize_and_wave_waits_for_every_orbiter() {
    let (mut game, mut scene) = fixture();
    for e in &game.enemies {
        let model = scene.model(e.spec.id).unwrap();
        let (min, max) = crate::gltf_animation::model_bounds(&model.asset, &model.pose).unwrap();
        assert!(((max.y - min.y) * e.spec.scale[1] - e.spec.height).abs() < 0.01);
    }
    start(&mut game, &mut scene);
    assert_eq!(game.enemies.iter().filter(|e| e.phase == 1).count(), 6);
    assert!(game
        .enemies
        .iter()
        .filter(|e| e.phase == 1)
        .all(|e| e.spec.kind == "drone-orbiter"));
    let serial = game.enemies[0].serial;
    for i in 0..5 {
        game.defeat(&mut scene, i, Vec3::X);
        game.enemies[i].age = 3.21;
    }
    game.tick(&mut scene, 0.01, None, [None; 2]);
    assert_eq!(game.wave, 0);
    assert_eq!(game.kills, 5);
    assert_eq!(game.enemies[0].serial, serial);
    assert_eq!(game.enemies[5].phase, 1);
    game.defeat(&mut scene, 5, Vec3::Y);
    game.enemies[5].age = 3.21;
    game.cut_failed(); // This test retires deaths without a worker.
    game.tick(&mut scene, 0.01, None, [None; 2]);
    assert_eq!(game.wave, 1);
    assert_eq!(game.kills, 6);
    assert!(game.enemies.iter().all(|e| e.serial == serial + 1));
    let active: Vec<_> = game.enemies.iter().filter(|e| e.phase == 1).collect();
    assert_eq!(active.len(), 2);
    assert_eq!(active[0].spec.kind, "core-tank");
}

#[test]
fn swept_bolt_reflects_and_returns_to_original_enemy() {
    let (mut game, mut scene) = fixture();
    start(&mut game, &mut scene);
    game.enemies[0].position = Vec3::new(0., 1.04, 36.);
    let head = Vec3::new(0., 1.7, 42.);
    game.shoot(0, Vec3::new(0., 1.45, 39.5), head - Vec3::Y * 0.25);
    let blade = Blade {
        a: Vec3::new(-0.4, 1.45, 40.2),
        b: Vec3::new(0.4, 1.45, 40.2),
        grip: Vec3::new(-0.4, 1.45, 40.2),
        rotation: Quat::IDENTITY,
    };
    game.update_bolts(&mut scene, 0.5, head, &[Some((blade, blade, true)), None]);
    assert_eq!(game.reflected, 1);
    assert_eq!(game.health, 100.);
    assert_eq!(game.bolts.len(), 1);
    assert!(game.bolts[0].friendly && game.bolts[0].velocity.z < 0.);
    game.update_bolts(&mut scene, 1., head, &[None; 2]);
    assert_eq!(game.returned, 1);
    assert_eq!(game.kills, 1);
    assert_eq!(game.enemies[0].phase, 3);
    assert!(game.bolts.is_empty());
}

#[test]
fn imported_city_roof_blocks_fast_projectiles_and_supports_body() {
    let (mut game, mut scene) = fixture();
    start(&mut game, &mut scene);
    let from = Vec3::new(4., 25., -40.);
    let below = Vec3::new(4., 8., -40.);
    let roof = game.world.cast(from, below).expect("original temple roof");
    assert!(roof.normal.y > 0.55 && roof.normal.x.abs() > 0.1);
    assert!(roof.point.y > 14. && roof.point.y < 16.5);
    let landing = game.world.move_body(from, below - from, 1.7);
    assert!(landing.grounded);
    assert!(landing.position.y > roof.point.y);
    assert!(game.world.clear(landing.position, 1.7));
    game.shoot(0, from, below);
    game.bolts[0].velocity = (below - from) * 10.;
    game.update_bolts(&mut scene, 0.1, game.player.head(1.7), &[None; 2]);
    assert_eq!(game.blocked, 1);
    assert!(game.bolts.is_empty());
    assert_eq!(game.health, 100.);
}

#[test]
fn death_respawns_after_three_real_seconds() {
    let (mut game, mut scene) = fixture();
    start(&mut game, &mut scene);
    let serial = game.enemies[0].serial;
    for _ in 0..4 {
        game.damage(25.);
    }
    assert_eq!(game.health, 0.);
    assert_eq!(game.deaths, 1);
    assert_eq!(game.hits, 4);
    game.damage(25.);
    assert_eq!(game.deaths, 1);
    game.dead_age = 2.9;
    game.tick(&mut scene, 0.05, None, [None; 2]);
    assert_eq!(game.health, 0.);
    game.dead_age = 2.99;
    game.tick(&mut scene, 0.02, None, [None; 2]);
    assert_eq!(game.health, 100.);
    assert_eq!(game.enemies[0].serial, serial + 1);
    assert_eq!(game.enemies.iter().filter(|e| e.phase == 1).count(), 6);
}

#[test]
fn xr_tracking_discontinuity_does_not_sweep_through_enemy() {
    let (mut game, mut scene) = fixture();
    start(&mut game, &mut scene);
    game.set_xr(true);
    game.sim_dt = 0.01;
    let e = &mut game.enemies[0];
    e.position = Vec3::new(0., 1.04, 38.);
    e.beam_age = 0.;
    let head = Mat4::from_translation(game.player.head(1.7));
    let left = Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(-2., 1.45, 38.5));
    let right = Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(2., 1.45, 38.5));
    game.tick(&mut scene, 0.01, Some(head), [Some(left), None]);
    game.tick(&mut scene, 0.01, Some(head), [Some(right), None]);
    assert_eq!(game.kills, 0);
    assert_eq!(game.enemies[0].phase, 1);
    // Returning after tracking loss must initialize a fresh sample too.
    game.xr_move(None, None, [0.; 3], false, 0.01);
    game.tick(&mut scene, 0.01, Some(head), [Some(left), None]);
    assert_eq!(game.kills, 0);
}

#[test]
fn worker_batches_cover_full_original_mesh_and_ignore_late_serials() {
    let (mut game, mut scene) = fixture();
    game.wave = 2;
    start(&mut game, &mut scene);
    let owner = 11;
    assert_eq!(game.enemies[owner].phase, 1);
    game.defeat(&mut scene, owner, Vec3::X);
    let task = game.tasks.front().unwrap();
    let expected: usize = task
        .parts
        .iter()
        .map(|&(_, p)| {
            let p = &task.model.asset.primitives[p];
            if p.mode == crate::gltf_model::PrimitiveMode::Triangles {
                p.indices.len() / 3
            } else {
                0
            }
        })
        .sum();
    assert!(
        expected > 3500,
        "fixture must exercise multiple worker batches"
    );
    let mut triangle_count = 0;
    let mut results = Vec::new();
    loop {
        let bytes = game.take_cut_job().unwrap();
        if bytes.is_empty() {
            break;
        }
        let count = u32::from_le_bytes(bytes[4..8].try_into().unwrap()) as usize;
        assert!(count <= PREPARE_TRIANGLES);
        triangle_count += count;
        results.push(crate::rim_cut::split(&bytes).unwrap());
    }
    assert_eq!(triangle_count, expected);
    assert!(results.len() > 1);
    let last = results.pop().unwrap();
    for result in &results {
        game.accept_cut(&mut scene, result).unwrap();
        assert!(game.pieces.is_empty());
    }
    game.accept_cut(&mut scene, &last).unwrap();
    assert!(game.pending.is_empty());
    assert!(game.pieces.is_empty());
    finish_cut_staging(&mut game, &mut scene);
    assert!(game.completed.is_empty());
    assert!(!game.pieces.is_empty());
    assert_eq!(
        scene.objects()[&game.enemies[owner].spec.id]
            .transform
            .position,
        HIDDEN
    );
    // Reuse the real task encoder, then respawn before its worker reply arrives.
    game.enemies[owner].phase = 1;
    game.defeat(&mut scene, owner, Vec3::Y);
    let late = crate::rim_cut::split(&game.take_cut_job().unwrap()).unwrap();
    let old_serial = game.enemies[owner].serial;
    game.spawn(&mut scene);
    assert_ne!(game.enemies[owner].serial, old_serial);
    assert!(game.pieces.is_empty());
    let objects = scene.objects().len();
    game.accept_cut(&mut scene, &late).unwrap();
    assert!(game.pieces.is_empty());
    assert_eq!(scene.objects().len(), objects);
}

#[test]
fn actual_game_input_and_xr_stick_advance_the_city_player() {
    let (mut game, mut scene) = fixture();
    start(&mut game, &mut scene);
    game.input(
        Input {
            movement: Some([0., 1.]),
            ..Default::default()
        },
        &mut scene,
    )
    .unwrap();
    for _ in 0..30 {
        game.tick(&mut scene, 1. / 60., None, [None; 2]);
    }
    assert!(
        (game.player.position.z - 40.75).abs() < 0.002,
        "{}",
        game.state()
    );
    assert!((game.player.position.y).abs() < 0.001, "{}", game.state());

    let (mut game, mut scene) = fixture();
    start(&mut game, &mut scene);
    game.set_xr(true);
    let physical_head = Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(0., 1.7, 0.));
    for _ in 0..15 {
        game.xr_move(Some(physical_head), None, [0., -1., 0.], false, 1. / 72.);
        let world_head = game.xr_origin * physical_head;
        game.tick(&mut scene, 1. / 72., Some(world_head), [None; 2]);
    }
    assert!(
        (game.player.position.z - (42. - 1.8 * 15. / 72.)).abs() < 0.002,
        "{}",
        game.state()
    );
    assert!(game.player.position.y.abs() < 0.001, "{}", game.state());
}

#[test]
fn plasma_integrates_only_original_damage_window_and_dead_xr_cannot_dash() {
    let (mut game, mut scene) = fixture();
    start(&mut game, &mut scene);
    for e in &mut game.enemies {
        e.shot = 100.;
    }
    game.enemies[0].beam_from = Vec3::new(0., 1.4, 38.);
    game.enemies[0].beam_target = Vec3::new(0., 1.4, 56.);
    game.enemies[0].beam_age = 0.84;
    game.tick(&mut scene, 0.05, None, [None; 2]);
    assert!((game.health - 95.).abs() < 0.002, "{}", game.state());
    game.enemies[0].beam_age = 2.84;
    game.tick(&mut scene, 0.05, None, [None; 2]);
    assert!((game.health - 93.75).abs() < 0.002, "{}", game.state());
    game.health = 0.;
    game.set_xr(true);
    game.xr_buttons(false, false);
    game.xr_buttons(false, true);
    let before = game.player.position;
    let stamina = game.player.stamina;
    game.xr_move(
        Some(Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::Y * 1.7)),
        None,
        [0., -1., 0.],
        false,
        0.05,
    );
    assert!(game.player.position.distance(before) < 0.001);
    assert_eq!(game.player.dash_count, 0);
    assert_eq!(game.player.stamina, stamina);
    assert!(!game.player.teleport(&game.world, Vec3::new(100., 0., 0.)));
}

fn assert_pool_frozen(game: &Game, scene: &mut SceneManager) {
    let snapshots: Vec<_> = game
        .enemies
        .iter()
        .filter(|e| e.phase == 0)
        .map(|e| {
            let model = scene.model(e.spec.id).unwrap();
            assert!(!model.playback.as_ref().is_some_and(|p| p.playing));
            (
                e.spec.id,
                model.revision,
                model.playback.as_ref().map(|p| p.time),
            )
        })
        .collect();
    assert!(!snapshots.is_empty());
    scene.update(0.03);
    for (id, revision, time) in snapshots {
        let model = scene.model(id).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(model.revision, revision);
        assert_eq!(model.playback.as_ref().map(|p| p.time), time);
        assert_eq!(scene.objects()[&id].transform.position, HIDDEN);
    }
}

#[test]
fn pooled_animations_freeze_and_spawn_restarts_each_kind() {
    let (mut game, mut scene) = fixture_with_playing_pool(true);
    assert_pool_frozen(&game, &mut scene);
    for (wave, name) in [(0, "Idle"), (1, "Idle"), (2, "Run"), (3, "Idle")] {
        game.wave = wave;
        game.spawn(&mut scene);
        for e in game.enemies.iter().filter(|e| e.phase == 1) {
            let model = scene.model(e.spec.id).unwrap();
            let playback = model.playback.as_ref().unwrap();
            assert!(playback.playing && playback.looping);
            assert_eq!(playback.time, 0.);
            assert_eq!(
                model.asset.animations[playback.clip].name.as_deref(),
                Some(name)
            );
        }
        assert_pool_frozen(&game, &mut scene);
        // Visibility alone must not freeze an active enemy outside the camera view.
        let id = game.enemies.iter().find(|e| e.phase == 1).unwrap().spec.id;
        scene.set_object_position(id, HIDDEN);
        let before = scene.model(id).unwrap().playback.as_ref().unwrap().time;
        scene.update(0.03);
        assert!(scene.model(id).unwrap().playback.as_ref().unwrap().time > before);
    }
}

#[test]
fn death_impact_pose_stays_intact_until_atomic_cut_publication() {
    for mode in ["cut", "dissolve"] {
        let (mut game, mut scene) = fixture_with_playing_pool(true);
        start(&mut game, &mut scene);
        game.death_mode = mode.into();
        let id = game.enemies[0].spec.id;
        let impact_pose = scene.model(id).unwrap().revision;
        game.defeat(&mut scene, 0, Vec3::X);
        assert!(!scene.model(id).unwrap().playback.as_ref().unwrap().playing);
        scene.update(0.03);
        assert_eq!(scene.model(id).unwrap().revision, impact_pose);
        let mut results = Vec::new();
        loop {
            let bytes = game.take_cut_job().unwrap();
            if bytes.is_empty() {
                break;
            }
            results.push(crate::rim_cut::split(&bytes).unwrap());
        }
        let last = results.pop().unwrap();
        for bytes in results {
            game.accept_cut(&mut scene, &bytes).unwrap();
        }
        assert!(!scene.model(id).unwrap().playback.as_ref().unwrap().playing);
        assert_ne!(scene.objects()[&id].transform.position, HIDDEN);
        game.accept_cut(&mut scene, &last).unwrap();
        assert!(game.pieces.is_empty());
        finish_cut_staging(&mut game, &mut scene);
        assert_eq!(game.enemies[0].phase, 3);
        assert!(!scene.model(id).unwrap().playback.as_ref().unwrap().playing);
        let frozen = scene.model(id).unwrap().revision;
        assert!(!game.pieces.is_empty());
        scene.update(3.);
        assert_eq!(scene.model(id).unwrap().revision, frozen);
        assert!(game.pieces.iter().all(|id| !scene.object_exists(*id)));
        game.enemies[0].age = 3.21;
        game.tick(&mut scene, 0.01, None, [None; 2]);
        assert_eq!(game.enemies[0].phase, 0);
        assert_pool_frozen(&game, &mut scene);
    }
}

#[test]
fn death_timeout_and_teardown_pause_pool_and_reject_late_cut_results() {
    let (mut game, mut scene) = fixture_with_playing_pool(true);
    start(&mut game, &mut scene);
    game.defeat(&mut scene, 0, Vec3::Y);
    game.enemies[0].age = 3.21;
    game.cut_failed(); // Explicit failure releases a stalled cut; timeout then retires the enemy.
    game.tick(&mut scene, 0.01, None, [None; 2]);
    assert_eq!(game.enemies[0].phase, 0);
    assert_pool_frozen(&game, &mut scene);
    game.defeat(&mut scene, 1, Vec3::Y);
    let late = crate::rim_cut::split(&game.take_cut_job().unwrap()).unwrap();
    game.teardown(&mut scene);
    assert!(!game.playing());
    assert!(game.tasks.is_empty() && game.pending.is_empty() && game.completed.is_empty());
    game.accept_cut(&mut scene, &late).unwrap();
    assert!(game.pieces.is_empty());
    assert_pool_frozen(&game, &mut scene);
    start(&mut game, &mut scene);
    assert_eq!(game.enemies.iter().filter(|e| e.phase == 1).count(), 6);
    assert!(game.enemies.iter().filter(|e| e.phase == 1).all(|e| {
        scene
            .model(e.spec.id)
            .unwrap()
            .playback
            .as_ref()
            .unwrap()
            .playing
    }));
}

#[test]
fn health_damage_is_nonfatal_until_zero_and_resets_for_all_six_waves() {
    let (mut game, mut scene) = fixture();
    start(&mut game, &mut scene);
    for (wave, kind, count, hp) in [
        (0, "drone-orbiter", 6, 100.),
        (1, "core-tank", 2, 200.),
        (2, "blade-wraith", 2, 150.),
        (3, "drone-orbiter", 8, 100.),
        (4, "core-tank", 3, 200.),
        (5, "blade-wraith", 3, 150.),
    ] {
        game.wave = wave;
        game.spawn(&mut scene);
        let active: Vec<_> = game
            .enemies
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
            .filter(|(_, e)| e.phase == 1)
            .map(|(i, _)| i)
            .collect();
        assert_eq!(active.len(), count);
        for &i in &active {
            assert_eq!(game.enemies[i].spec.kind, kind);
            assert_eq!(game.enemies[i].hp, hp);
            assert_eq!(game.enemies[i].max_hp, hp);
        }
        let i = active[0];
        let kills = game.kills;
        game.hurt_enemy(&mut scene, i, 50., Vec3::Y);
        assert_eq!(game.enemies[i].hp, hp - 50.);
        assert_eq!(game.enemies[i].phase, 1);
        assert_eq!(game.kills, kills);
        assert!(game.tasks.is_empty());
        assert_eq!(game.wave, wave);
        game.hurt_enemy(&mut scene, i, 1000., Vec3::Y);
        assert_eq!(game.enemies[i].hp, 0.);
        assert_eq!(game.enemies[i].phase, 3);
        assert_eq!(game.kills, kills + 1);
        assert!(!game.tasks.is_empty());
        game.hurt_enemy(&mut scene, i, 50., Vec3::Y);
        assert_eq!(game.kills, kills + 1);
        game.spawn(&mut scene);
        assert_eq!(game.enemies[i].hp, hp);
        assert_eq!(game.enemies[i].contacts, [false; 2]);
        assert_eq!(game.enemies[i].cooldowns, [0.; 2]);
        assert_eq!(game.state()["enemies"][0]["maxHp"], hp);
    }
}

#[test]
fn blade_entry_cooldown_two_hands_and_desktop_strike_identity() {
    let (mut game, mut scene) = fixture();
    start(&mut game, &mut scene);
    let e = &mut game.enemies[0];
    assert!(!blade_damage_allowed(e, 0, true, false, None));
    assert!(
        !e.contacts[0],
        "stationary initial touch must not consume the hit"
    );
    assert!(blade_damage_allowed(e, 0, true, true, None));
    e.cooldowns[0] = 0.; // Staying inside cannot damage even after cooldown expires.
    assert!(!blade_damage_allowed(e, 0, true, true, None));
    assert!(blade_damage_allowed(e, 1, true, true, None));
    assert!(!blade_damage_allowed(e, 0, false, true, None));
    e.cooldowns[0] = 0.1;
    assert!(!blade_damage_allowed(e, 0, true, true, None));
    e.cooldowns[0] = 0.;
    assert!(blade_damage_allowed(e, 0, true, true, None));
    blade_damage_allowed(e, 0, false, false, None);
    e.cooldowns[0] = 0.;
    assert!(blade_damage_allowed(e, 0, true, true, Some(1)));
    e.cooldowns[0] = 0.;
    blade_damage_allowed(e, 0, false, false, Some(1));
    assert!(
        !blade_damage_allowed(e, 0, true, true, Some(1)),
        "return stroke of same desktop swing"
    );
    blade_damage_allowed(e, 0, false, false, Some(2));
    assert!(blade_damage_allowed(e, 0, true, true, Some(2)));
}

#[test]
fn health_bars_follow_head_yaw_shrink_from_left_and_hide_on_death_teardown() {
    let (mut game, mut scene) = fixture();
    start(&mut game, &mut scene);
    let [background, fill] = game.health_bars[0];
    let head = Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(3., 2., 42.));
    game.sync(&mut scene, Some(head));
    let full = scene.objects()[&fill].transform.position;
    let width = scene.objects()[&fill].transform.scale.x;
    game.hurt_enemy(&mut scene, 0, 50., Vec3::Y);
    game.sync(&mut scene, Some(head));
    let t = &scene.objects()[&fill].transform;
    assert!((t.scale.x - width * 0.5).abs() < 1e-5);
    let left = Quat::from_rotation_y(t.rotation.y) * Vec3::X;
    assert!((t.position - left * t.scale.x * 0.5).distance(full - left * width * 0.5) < 1e-5);
    assert!(
        scene.objects()[&background].transform.position.y
            > game.enemies[0].position.y + game.enemies[0].spec.height
    );
    game.hurt_enemy(&mut scene, 0, 50., Vec3::Y);
    game.sync(&mut scene, Some(head));
    assert_eq!(scene.objects()[&fill].transform.position, HIDDEN);
    assert_eq!(scene.objects()[&background].transform.position, HIDDEN);
    game.teardown(&mut scene);
    assert!(game
        .health_bars
        .iter()
        .flatten()
        .all(|id| scene.objects()[id].transform.position == HIDDEN));
}

#[test]
fn tracked_blade_pause_inside_never_rearms_and_real_time_allows_separate_return() {
    let (mut game, mut scene) = fixture();
    start(&mut game, &mut scene);
    game.set_xr(true);
    game.sim_dt = 0.001; // Slow simulation must not lengthen the real-time hit cooldown.
    game.enemies[0].position = Vec3::new(0., 1.04, 38.);
    game.enemies[0].beam_age = 0.;
    let head = Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(0., 1.7, 42.));
    let step = |game: &mut Game, scene: &mut SceneManager, x| {
        game.tick(
            scene,
            0.01,
            Some(head),
            [None, Some(Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(x, 1.45, 38.5)))],
        );
    };
    for x in [0.9, 0.75, 0.6, 0.45, 0.3, 0.15, 0.] {
        step(&mut game, &mut scene, x);
    }
    assert_eq!(game.enemies[0].hp, 50.);
    for _ in 0..30 {
        step(&mut game, &mut scene, 0.);
    }
    step(&mut game, &mut scene, 0.1);
    assert_eq!(
        game.enemies[0].hp, 50.,
        "stationary blade inside must remain latched"
    );
    for x in [
        0.25, 0.4, 0.55, 0.7, 0.85, 1., 0.85, 0.7, 0.55, 0.4, 0.25, 0.1,
    ] {
        step(&mut game, &mut scene, x);
    }
    assert_eq!(game.enemies[0].hp, 0.);
    assert_eq!(game.kills, 1);
    assert!(game.sim_dt < 0.002);
}

#[test]
fn xr_aim_cancel_and_tracking_loss_do_not_launch_but_trigger_release_does() {
    let head = Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::Y * 1.7);
    let ray = head * Mat4::from_rotation_x(-std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_4);
    for (reason, next_ray, cancel) in [
        ("B or source replacement", Some(ray), true),
        ("right tracking loss", None, false),
    ] {
        let (mut game, mut scene) = fixture();
        start(&mut game, &mut scene);
        game.set_xr(true);
        game.xr_buttons(true, false);
        game.xr_move(Some(head), Some(ray), [0.; 3], false, 0.01);
        assert!(
            game.player.aiming && game.player.target.is_some(),
            "{reason}"
        );
        let stamina = game.player.stamina;
        // Tracking loss reports an unpressed trigger; B/source changes may
        // cancel while it remains held. Neither is an intentional release.
        game.xr_buttons(cancel, false);
        game.xr_move(Some(head), next_ray, [0.; 3], cancel, 0.01);
        assert!(!game.player.aiming, "{reason}");
        assert!(game.player.target.is_none(), "{reason}");
        assert_eq!(game.player.jump_count, 0, "{reason}");
        assert_eq!(game.player.stamina, stamina, "{reason}");
        assert_eq!(game.state()["player"]["stamina"]["spent"], 0, "{reason}");
        // A recovered ray with the trigger already up must not launch later.
        game.xr_buttons(false, false);
        game.xr_move(Some(head), Some(ray), [0.; 3], false, 0.01);
        assert_eq!(game.player.jump_count, 0, "{reason}");
    }

    let (mut game, mut scene) = fixture();
    start(&mut game, &mut scene);
    game.set_xr(true);
    game.xr_buttons(true, false);
    game.xr_move(Some(head), Some(ray), [0.; 3], false, 0.01);
    assert!(game.player.aiming && game.player.target.is_some());
    game.xr_buttons(false, false);
    game.xr_move(Some(head), Some(ray), [0.; 3], false, 0.01);
    assert_eq!(game.player.jump_count, 1);
    assert_eq!(game.player.stamina, 3.);
    assert_eq!(game.state()["player"]["stamina"]["spent"], 1);
}

fn finish_cut_staging(game: &mut Game, scene: &mut SceneManager) {
    let initial_commits = game.commits;
    for _ in 0..200 {
        let ids: Vec<_> = game.staged_cut_ids().collect();
        game.ack_cut_uploads(&ids);
        game.tick(scene, 0.001, None, [None; 2]);
        assert!(game.staged_vertices <= INSTALL_VERTICES);
        if game.commits != initial_commits {
            assert!(game
                .pieces
                .iter()
                .all(|id| game.piece_motion.contains_key(id)));
            assert!(
                game.pieces.iter().all(|id| {
                    !scene.is_cuttable(*id)
                        && scene.triangle_meshes()[id].mesh.contact_shape().is_none()
                }),
                "dead fragments never bake collision proxies"
            );
            return;
        }
        assert!(game.pieces.is_empty(), "no partial publication");
        for id in game.staged_cut_ids() {
            assert_eq!(scene.objects()[&id].transform.position, HIDDEN);
        }
    }
    panic!("cut staging did not finish");
}

#[test]
fn cut_staging_waits_for_gpu_ack_and_cleans_up_on_failure() {
    let (mut game, mut scene) = fixture();
    start(&mut game, &mut scene);
    game.defeat(&mut scene, 0, Vec3::Y);
    loop {
        let bytes = game.take_cut_job().unwrap();
        if bytes.is_empty() {
            break;
        }
        game.accept_cut(&mut scene, &crate::rim_cut::split(&bytes).unwrap())
            .unwrap();
    }
    assert!(
        game.staged_cut_ids().next().is_none(),
        "onmessage does no scene installation"
    );
    for _ in 0..30 {
        game.tick(&mut scene, 0.001, None, [None; 2]);
    }
    assert!(game.completed.is_empty());
    assert!(game.pieces.is_empty());
    assert_ne!(
        scene.objects()[&game.enemies[0].spec.id].transform.position,
        HIDDEN
    );
    let ids: Vec<_> = game.staged_cut_ids().collect();
    assert!(!ids.is_empty());
    game.cut_failed();
    game.tick(&mut scene, 0.001, None, [None; 2]);
    assert!(ids.iter().all(|id| !scene.object_exists(*id)));
    assert!(game.staged.is_empty());
}

#[test]
fn single_huge_primitive_prepares_only_requested_triangles() {
    let (mut game, mut scene) = fixture();
    start(&mut game, &mut scene);
    game.defeat(&mut scene, 0, Vec3::X);
    let task = game.tasks.front_mut().unwrap();
    let (node, primitive) = *task
        .parts
        .iter()
        .find(|&&(_, p)| {
            let p = &task.model.asset.primitives[p];
            p.mode == crate::gltf_model::PrimitiveMode::Triangles && p.vertices.len() > 6
        })
        .unwrap();
    let p = &task.model.asset.primitives[primitive];
    let triangle = p.indices[..3].to_vec();
    let full = crate::gltf_animation::deformed_vertices(
        &task.model.asset,
        &task.model.pose,
        node,
        primitive,
    )
    .unwrap();
    let subset = crate::gltf_animation::deformed_vertex_subset(
        &task.model.asset,
        &task.model.pose,
        node,
        primitive,
        triangle.iter().copied(),
    )
    .unwrap();
    for (v, &index) in subset.iter().zip(&triangle) {
        assert_eq!(v.position, full[index as usize].position);
        assert_eq!(v.normal, full[index as usize].normal);
        assert_eq!(v.tangent, full[index as usize].tangent);
    }
    let unused = (0..p.vertices.len())
        .find(|i| !triangle.contains(&(*i as u32)))
        .unwrap();
    let first_vertex = p.vertices.start;
    let asset = Arc::make_mut(&mut task.model.asset);
    asset.primitives[primitive].indices = triangle.repeat(10_001);
    // Whole-primitive deformation now fails: bounded subset must never touch this vertex.
    asset.vertices[first_vertex + unused].position = [f32::NAN; 3];
    task.parts = vec![(node, primitive)];
    let mut counts = Vec::new();
    let mut first_triangle = Vec::new();
    loop {
        let bytes = game.take_cut_job().unwrap();
        if bytes.is_empty() {
            break;
        }
        counts.push(u32::from_le_bytes(bytes[4..8].try_into().unwrap()));
        if first_triangle.is_empty() {
            first_triangle = bytes[32..140].to_vec();
        }
        for tri in bytes[32..].as_chunks::<108>().0 {
            assert_eq!(tri.as_slice(), first_triangle);
        }
    }
    assert_eq!(counts, [3500, 3500, 3001]);
}

#[test]
fn staged_reset_and_nonfinite_result_leave_no_partial_pieces() {
    let (mut game, mut scene) = fixture();
    start(&mut game, &mut scene);
    for fail in [false, true] {
        game.defeat(&mut scene, 0, Vec3::Y);
        let mut results = Vec::new();
        loop {
            let bytes = game.take_cut_job().unwrap();
            if bytes.is_empty() {
                break;
            }
            results.push(crate::rim_cut::split(&bytes).unwrap());
        }
        for result in &results {
            game.accept_cut(&mut scene, result).unwrap();
        }
        game.tick(&mut scene, 0.001, None, [None; 2]);
        let ids: Vec<_> = game.staged_cut_ids().collect();
        assert!(!ids.is_empty());
        assert!(game.pieces.is_empty());
        assert!(ids
            .iter()
            .all(|id| scene.projectile_velocity(*id).is_none()));
        if fail {
            let result = game.completed.front_mut().unwrap();
            // Poison a remaining vertex, after the first bounded chunk was staged.
            let start = 12
                + (if result.side == 1 {
                    result.counts[0]
                } else {
                    0
                } + result.offset)
                    * 36;
            result.bytes[start..start + 4].copy_from_slice(&f32::NAN.to_le_bytes());
            game.tick(&mut scene, 0.001, None, [None; 2]);
            assert!(game.staged.is_empty());
            assert_eq!(game.cut_errors, 1);
        } else {
            game.spawn(&mut scene);
        }
        assert!(ids.iter().all(|id| !scene.object_exists(*id)));
        assert!(game.pieces.is_empty());
    }
}

#[test]
fn published_halves_separate_before_dissolve_then_evaporate() {
    let (mut game, mut scene) = fixture_with_playing_pool(true);
    start(&mut game, &mut scene);
    game.defeat(&mut scene, 0, Vec3::X);
    loop {
        let job = game.take_cut_job().unwrap();
        if job.is_empty() {
            break;
        }
        game.accept_cut(&mut scene, &crate::rim_cut::split(&job).unwrap())
            .unwrap();
    }
    finish_cut_staging(&mut game, &mut scene);
    let ids = game.pieces.clone();
    assert!(ids.iter().any(|id| game.piece_motion[id].direction.x > 0.));
    assert!(ids.iter().any(|id| game.piece_motion[id].direction.x < 0.));
    for _ in 0..20 {
        game.tick(&mut scene, 0.05, None, [None; 2]);
        scene.update(0.05);
    }
    for id in &ids {
        let object = &scene.objects()[id];
        let direction = game.piece_motion[id].direction.x;
        assert!(
            object.transform.position.x * direction > 0.5,
            "half must visibly separate despite being a fading piece"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            object.visual_fade, 1.,
            "full silhouette must survive the first second"
        );
        assert!(object.visual_dissolve);
    }
    for _ in 0..20 {
        game.tick(&mut scene, 0.05, None, [None; 2]);
        scene.update(0.05);
    }
    for id in &ids {
        let object = &scene.objects()[id];
        assert!((object.transform.position.x.abs() - 0.65).abs() < 1e-5);
        assert!(object.visual_fade > 0. && object.visual_fade < 1.);
    }
    for _ in 0..21 {
        game.tick(&mut scene, 0.05, None, [None; 2]);
        scene.update(0.05);
    }
    assert!(ids.iter().all(|id| !scene.object_exists(*id)));
    // Scene removes dissolved meshes after gameplay; prune its IDs next frame.
    game.tick(&mut scene, 0.05, None, [None; 2]);
    assert!(game.pieces.is_empty());
}

#[test]
fn lost_worker_and_upload_ack_expire_only_the_stalled_enemy_in_real_time() {
    let (mut game, mut scene) = fixture();
    start(&mut game, &mut scene);
    game.defeat(&mut scene, 0, Vec3::X);
    let stale = crate::rim_cut::split(&game.take_cut_job().unwrap()).unwrap();
    game.defeat(&mut scene, 1, Vec3::Y);
    let other_serial = game.enemies[1].serial;
    // A stale transaction must not cancel its neighbour or require aim-time progress.
    game.enemies[0].cut_idle = 10.01;
    game.enemies[0].age = 3.21;
    game.tick(&mut scene, 0.01, None, [None; 2]);
    assert_eq!(game.enemies[0].phase, 0);
    assert_eq!(game.cut_errors, 1);
    assert!(game
        .tasks
        .iter()
        .any(|t| t.owner == 1 && t.serial == other_serial));
    game.accept_cut(&mut scene, &stale).unwrap();
    assert!(
        game.completed.is_empty(),
        "expired reply cannot resurrect a death"
    );
    while !game.tasks.is_empty() {
        let result = crate::rim_cut::split(&game.take_cut_job().unwrap()).unwrap();
        game.accept_cut(&mut scene, &result).unwrap();
    }
    for _ in 0..100 {
        game.tick(&mut scene, 0.001, None, [None; 2]);
        if game.completed.is_empty() {
            break;
        }
    }
    let hidden: Vec<_> = game.staged_cut_ids().collect();
    assert!(!hidden.is_empty());
    assert!(game.pieces.is_empty());
    game.enemies[1].cut_idle = 10.01;
    game.enemies[1].age = 3.21;
    game.tick(&mut scene, 0.01, None, [None; 2]);
    assert_eq!(game.enemies[1].phase, 0);
    assert_eq!(game.cut_errors, 2);
    assert!(hidden.iter().all(|id| !scene.object_exists(*id)));
    assert!(game.staged.is_empty());
}

#[test]
fn every_kill_finishes_real_slicing_then_advances_the_wave() {
    let (mut game, mut scene) = fixture();
    start(&mut game, &mut scene);
    for i in 0..6 {
        game.defeat(&mut scene, i, Vec3::X);
    }
    while !game.tasks.is_empty() {
        let result = crate::rim_cut::split(&game.take_cut_job().unwrap()).unwrap();
        game.accept_cut(&mut scene, &result).unwrap();
    }
    for _ in 0..200 {
        let ids: Vec<_> = game.staged_cut_ids().collect();
        game.ack_cut_uploads(&ids);
        game.tick(&mut scene, 0.001, None, [None; 2]);
        if game.commits == 6 {
            break;
        }
    }
    assert_eq!(game.commits, 6);
    assert!(!game.pieces.is_empty());
    assert_eq!(game.wave, 0);
    for e in game.enemies.iter_mut().filter(|e| e.phase == 3) {
        e.age = 3.21;
    }
    game.tick(&mut scene, 0.01, None, [None; 2]);
    assert_eq!(game.kills, 6);
    assert_eq!(game.wave, 1);
    assert_eq!(game.enemies.iter().filter(|e| e.phase == 1).count(), 2);
    assert!(game
        .enemies
        .iter()
        .filter(|e| e.phase == 1)
        .all(|e| e.spec.kind == "core-tank"));
}

#[test]
fn failed_cuts_cannot_block_wave_during_continuous_bullet_time() {
    let (mut game, mut scene) = fixture();
    start(&mut game, &mut scene);
    for i in 0..6 {
        game.defeat(&mut scene, i, Vec3::Y);
    }
    game.set_xr(true);
    game.sim_dt = 0.0001;
    let head = Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(0., 1.7, 42.));
    for _ in 0..202 {
        game.tick(&mut scene, 0.05, Some(head), [None; 2]);
    }
    assert_eq!(

        "real-time inactivity retires deaths even when sim time barely advances"

    assert_eq!(game.enemies.iter().filter(|e| e.phase == 1).count(), 2);
}

#[test]
fn same_physical_vr_swings_hit_at_72_90_and_120_hz() {
    for hz in [72., 90., 120.] {
        let (mut game, mut scene) = fixture();
        start(&mut game, &mut scene);
        game.set_xr(true);
        game.sim_dt = 0.; // Hold the target still; hand motion uses real tracking dt.
        game.enemies[0].position = Vec3::new(0., 1.04, 40.95);
        let head = Some(Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(0., 1.7, 42.)));
        let dt = 1. / hz;
        let sweep = |game: &mut Game, scene: &mut SceneManager, start: f32, sign: f32| {
            for frame in 0..=(0.8_f32 * hz).ceil() as usize {
                let x = start + sign * 1.5 * (frame as f32 * dt).min(0.8);
                game.tick(
                    scene,
                    dt,
                    head,
                    [None, Some(Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(x, 1.4, 41.6)))],
                );
            }
        };
        sweep(&mut game, &mut scene, 0.6, -1.);
        assert_eq!(
            game.enemies[0].hp, 50.,
            "same 1.5m/s swing must hit at {hz} Hz"
        );
        for _ in 0..(hz * 0.35) as usize {
            game.tick(
                &mut scene,
                dt,
                head,
                [
                    None,
                    Some(Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(-0.6, 1.4, 41.6))),
                ],
            );
        }
        sweep(&mut game, &mut scene, -0.6, 1.);
        assert_eq!(game.enemies[0].hp, 0., "return swing kills at {hz} Hz");
        assert_eq!(game.enemies[0].phase, 3);
        assert!(
            !game.tasks.is_empty(),
            "HP zero queues actual worker geometry at {hz} Hz"
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn blob_shadows_follow_living_npcs_without_invalidating_shadow_maps() {
    let (mut game, mut scene) = fixture_with_shadow_pool(false, true);
    assert!(game
        .enemies
        .iter()
        .all(|e| !scene.objects()[&e.spec.id].render_options.casts_shadow));
    // Match the authored encounter's non-casters; retain one unrelated caster in
    // each layer to catch accidental broad invalidation during NPC movement.
    let ids: Vec<_> = scene.objects().keys().copied().collect();
    for id in ids {
        scene.set_render_options(
            id,
            crate::scene::RenderOptions {
                casts_shadow: false,
                ..Default::default()
            },
        );
    }
    let city = scene.add_cube(Vec3::new(5., 0., 5.));
    scene.set_render_options(
        city,
        crate::scene::RenderOptions {
            is_static: true,
            ..Default::default()
        },
    );
    let dynamic = scene.add_cube(Vec3::new(-5., 0., 5.));
    start(&mut game, &mut scene);
    let revisions = (scene.shadow_revision(true), scene.shadow_revision(false));
    game.enemies[0].position = Vec3::new(3., 2., -7.);
    game.sync(&mut scene, None);
    let id = game.blob_shadows[0];
    let t = &scene.objects()[&id].transform;
    assert_eq!(t.position, Vec3::new(3., 0.136, -7.));
    assert!(t.scale.x > 0. && t.scale.x <= 0.9);
    assert_eq!(
        revisions,
        (scene.shadow_revision(true), scene.shadow_revision(false))
    );
    game.hurt_enemy(&mut scene, 0, 50., Vec3::Y);
    game.sync(&mut scene, None);
    assert_ne!(scene.objects()[&id].transform.position, HIDDEN);
    game.hurt_enemy(&mut scene, 0, 50., Vec3::Y);
    game.sync(&mut scene, None);
    assert_eq!(scene.objects()[&id].transform.position, HIDDEN);
    game.teardown(&mut scene);
    assert!(game
        .blob_shadows
        .iter()
        .all(|id| scene.objects()[id].transform.position == HIDDEN));
    assert!(game
        .enemies
        .iter()
        .all(|e| scene.objects()[&e.spec.id].render_options.casts_shadow));
    assert!(game
        .blob_shadows
        .iter()
        .all(|id| scene.objects()[id].render_options.casts_shadow));
    // The generic dynamic shadow path still invalidates independently.
    let revisions = (scene.shadow_revision(true), scene.shadow_revision(false));
    scene.set_object_position(dynamic, Vec3::new(-4., 0., 5.));
    assert_eq!(scene.shadow_revision(true), revisions.0);
    assert!(scene.shadow_revision(false) > revisions.1);
}

#[test]
fn stress_count_is_bounded_preserves_combat_reset_and_clears_on_teardown() {
    let (mut game, mut scene) = fixture();
    assert_eq!(game.state()["stressModels"], 0);
    game.input(
        Input {
            stress_count: Some(128),
            ..Default::default()
        },
        &mut scene,
    )
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(game.stress_count(), 128);
    assert!(game
        .input(
            Input {
                stress_count: Some(MAX_STRESS_MODELS + 1),
                reset: true,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            &mut scene
        )
        .is_err());
    assert_eq!(game.stress_count(), 128);
    start(&mut game, &mut scene);
    game.input(
        Input {
            reset: true,
            ..Default::default()
        },
        &mut scene,
    )
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(game.stress_count(), 128);
    game.teardown(&mut scene);
    assert_eq!(game.stress_count(), 0);
}


# File: src/rim_movement.rs
//! Aurelia's static convex world and real-time input / scaled-time locomotion.
use glam::Vec3;
use serde::Deserialize;

const EPS: f32 = 1e-6;
const SUPPORT: f32 = 1e-4;
const RADIUS: f32 = 0.32;
const GRAVITY: f32 = 9.8;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct Bounds {
    pub min_x: f32,
    pub max_x: f32,
    pub min_y: f32,
    pub max_y: f32,
    pub min_z: f32,
    pub max_z: f32,
}
impl Bounds {
    fn min(self) -> Vec3 {
        Vec3::new(self.min_x, self.min_y, self.min_z)
    }
    fn max(self) -> Vec3 {
        Vec3::new(self.max_x, self.max_y, self.max_z)
    }
    fn points(a: Vec3, b: Vec3, pad: Vec3) -> Self {
        let lo = a.min(b) - pad;
        let hi = a.max(b) + pad;
        Self {
            min_x: lo.x,
            max_x: hi.x,
            min_y: lo.y,
            max_y: hi.y,
            min_z: lo.z,
            max_z: hi.z,
        }
    }
    fn overlaps(self, b: Self) -> bool {
        self.min().cmple(b.max()).all() && self.max().cmpge(b.min()).all()
    }
    fn union(self, b: Self) -> Self {
        Self::points(self.min().min(b.min()), self.max().max(b.max()), Vec3::ZERO)
    }
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Deserialize)]
pub struct Plane {
    pub x: f32,
    pub y: f32,
    pub z: f32,
    pub d: f32,
}
impl Plane {
    fn normal(self) -> Vec3 {
        Vec3::new(self.x, self.y, self.z)
    }
}
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Deserialize)]
pub struct Shape {
    pub bounds: Bounds,
    pub planes: Vec<Plane>,
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct Hit {
    pub fraction: f32,
    pub point: Vec3,
    pub normal: Vec3,
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct MoveResult {
    pub position: Vec3,
    pub grounded: bool,
    pub hit_ceiling: bool,
}
struct Node {
    bounds: Bounds,
    start: usize,
    end: usize,
    children: Option<(usize, usize)>,
}
/// Cached median-split BVH. Queries visit leaves directly, with no heap allocation.
pub struct World {
    shapes: Vec<Shape>,
    indices: Vec<usize>,
    nodes: Vec<Node>,
}
impl World {
    pub fn new(mut shapes: Vec<Shape>) -> Result<Self, String> {
        for (i, s) in shapes.iter_mut().enumerate() {
            if !s.bounds.min().is_finite()
                || !s.bounds.max().is_finite()
                || !s.bounds.min().cmple(s.bounds.max()).all()
                || s.planes.len() < 4
            {
                return Err(format!("Invalid convex shape {i}"));
            }
            for p in &mut s.planes {
                let length = p.normal().length();
                if !length.is_finite() || length < EPS || !p.d.is_finite() {
                    return Err(format!("Invalid plane in shape {i}"));
                }
                p.x /= length;
                p.y /= length;
                p.z /= length;
                p.d /= length;
                // A supplied AABB must intersect each halfspace; otherwise it
                // cannot conservatively represent this convex object.
                let n = p.normal();
                let low = Vec3::new(
                    if n.x >= 0. {
                        s.bounds.min_x
                    } else {
                        s.bounds.max_x
                    },
                    if n.y >= 0. {
                        s.bounds.min_y
                    } else {
                        s.bounds.max_y
                    },
                    if n.z >= 0. {
                        s.bounds.min_z
                    } else {
                        s.bounds.max_z
                    },
                );
                if n.dot(low) > p.d + 1e-3 {
                    return Err(format!("Inconsistent bounds in shape {i}"));
                }
            }
        }
        let mut world = Self {
            indices: (0..shapes.len()).collect(),
            nodes: Vec::new(),
            shapes,
        };
        if !world.shapes.is_empty() {
            world.build(0, world.shapes.len());
        }
        Ok(world)
    }
    fn build(&mut self, start: usize, end: usize) -> usize {
        let bounds = self.indices[start + 1..end]
            .iter()
            .fold(self.shapes[self.indices[start]].bounds, |b, &i| {
                b.union(self.shapes[i].bounds)
            });
        let id = self.nodes.len();
        self.nodes.push(Node {
            bounds,
            start,
            end,
            children: None,
        });
        if end - start > 4 {
            let extent = bounds.max() - bounds.min();
            let axis = if extent.x >= extent.y && extent.x >= extent.z {
                0
            } else if extent.y >= extent.z {
                1
            } else {
                2
            };
            let shapes = &self.shapes;
            self.indices[start..end].sort_unstable_by(|&a, &b| {
                let aa = shapes[a].bounds;
                let bb = shapes[b].bounds;
                (aa.min()[axis] + aa.max()[axis]).total_cmp(&(bb.min()[axis] + bb.max()[axis]))
            });
            let mid = (start + end) / 2;
            let left = self.build(start, mid);
            let right = self.build(mid, end);
            self.nodes[id].children = Some((left, right));
        }
        id
    }
    fn visit(&self, id: usize, bounds: Bounds, f: &mut impl FnMut(&Shape)) {
        let node = &self.nodes[id];
        if !node.bounds.overlaps(bounds) {
            return;
        }
        if let Some((a, b)) = node.children {
            self.visit(a, bounds, f);
            self.visit(b, bounds, f);
        } else {
            for &i in &self.indices[node.start..node.end] {
                let shape = &self.shapes[i];
                if shape.bounds.overlaps(bounds) {
                    f(shape);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    fn query(&self, bounds: Bounds, mut f: impl FnMut(&Shape)) {
        if !self.nodes.is_empty() {
            self.visit(0, bounds, &mut f);
        }
    }
    fn sweep(
        &self,
        center: Vec3,
        delta: Vec3,
        height: f32,
        radius: f32,
        body: bool,
    ) -> Option<Hit> {
        let bounds = Bounds::points(
            center,
            center + delta,
            Vec3::new(radius + EPS, height / 2. + EPS, radius + EPS),
        );
        let mut nearest: Option<Hit> = None;
        self.query(bounds, |shape| {
            if let Some(hit) = clip(center, delta, shape, height, radius, body) {
                if nearest.is_none_or(|n| hit.fraction < n.fraction) {
                    nearest = Some(hit);
                }
            }
        });
        nearest
    }
    pub fn cast(&self, from: Vec3, to: Vec3) -> Option<Hit> {
        if !from.is_finite() || !to.is_finite() {
            return None;
        }
        self.sweep(from, to - from, 0., 0., false)
    }
    pub fn clear(&self, feet: Vec3, height: f32) -> bool {
        if !feet.is_finite()
            || !height.is_finite()
            || height <= 0.
            || feet.x <= -78.
            || feet.x >= 78.
            || feet.z <= -82.
            || feet.z >= 60.
        {
            return false;
        }
        let center = feet + Vec3::Y * height / 2.;
        let bounds = Bounds::points(center, center, Vec3::new(RADIUS, height / 2., RADIUS));
        let mut clear = true;
        self.query(bounds, |s| {
            if s.planes.iter().all(|p| {
                p.normal().dot(center)
                    < p.d + RADIUS * (p.x.abs() + p.z.abs()) + height / 2. * p.y.abs() - EPS
            }) {
                clear = false;
            }
        });
        clear
    }
    pub fn move_body(&self, feet: Vec3, delta: Vec3, height: f32) -> MoveResult {
        if !feet.is_finite() || !delta.is_finite() || !height.is_finite() || height <= 0. {
            return MoveResult {
                position: feet,
                grounded: false,
                hit_ceiling: false,
            };
        }
        let mut center = feet + Vec3::Y * height / 2.;
        let mut remaining = delta;
        let mut ceiling = false;
        for _ in 0..4 {
            if remaining.length() < EPS {
                break;
            }
            let Some(hit) = self.sweep(center, remaining, height, RADIUS, true) else {
                center += remaining;
                break;
            };
            center += remaining * hit.fraction;
            ceiling |= hit.normal.y < -0.5;
            remaining *= 1. - hit.fraction;
            if hit.normal.y > 0.5
                && remaining.y <= 0.
                && remaining.x.abs() + remaining.z.abs() < EPS
            {
                break;
            }
            let inward = remaining.dot(hit.normal);
            if inward < 0. {
                remaining -= hit.normal * inward;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        let support = self
            .sweep(center, -Vec3::Y * SUPPORT, height, RADIUS, true)
            .filter(|h| h.normal.y > 0.5);
        if let Some(hit) = support {
            if delta.y <= 0. {
                center.y -= SUPPORT * hit.fraction;
            }
        }
        MoveResult {
            position: center - Vec3::Y * height / 2.,
            grounded: support.is_some(),
            hit_ceiling: ceiling,
        }
    }
}
fn clip(
    start: Vec3,
    delta: Vec3,
    shape: &Shape,
    height: f32,
    radius: f32,
    body: bool,
) -> Option<Hit> {
    let mut enter: f32 = 0.;
    let mut exit: f32 = 1.;
    let mut normal = None;
    let mut inside = true;
    let mut closest = f32::NEG_INFINITY;
    let mut closest_normal = Vec3::Y;
    for p in &shape.planes {
        let n = p.normal();
        let distance =
            n.dot(start) - p.d - radius * (p.x.abs() + p.z.abs()) - height / 2. * p.y.abs();
        let speed = n.dot(delta);
        if distance >= -EPS {
            inside = false;
        }
        if distance > closest {
            closest = distance;
            closest_normal = n;
        }
        if speed.abs() < EPS {
            if distance > EPS || (body && distance >= -EPS) {
                return None;
            }
            continue;
        }
        // At f32 precision a resting contact may lie either side of its
        // plane by less than EPS. Treat that entire band as time zero,
        // avoiding a gap between the inside and entering cases.
        let t = if distance.abs() <= EPS {
            0.
        } else {
            -distance / speed
        };
        if speed < 0. {
            if t >= enter - EPS {
                enter = enter.max(t);
                normal = Some(n);
            }
        } else {
            exit = exit.min(t);
        }
        if enter > exit + EPS {
            return None;
        }
    }
    if inside {
        return Some(Hit {
            fraction: 0.,
            point: start,
            normal: closest_normal,
        });
    }
    let normal = normal?;
    if enter < -EPS || enter > 1. + EPS || exit < 0. || (body && exit <= enter.max(0.) + EPS) {
        return None;
    }
    let fraction = enter.clamp(0., 1.);
    Some(Hit {
        fraction,
        point: start + delta * fraction,
        normal,
    })
}

pub struct Player {
    pub position: Vec3,
    pub yaw: f32,
    pub pitch: f32,
    pub stamina: f32,
    pub aiming: bool,
    pub target: Option<Vec3>,
    pub jump_count: u32,
    pub dash_count: u32,
    velocity: Vec3,
    airborne: bool,
    regen_delay: f32,
    spent: u32,
    dash_remaining: f32,
    dash_direction: Vec3,
    dash_distance: f32,
    body_height: f32,
}
impl Player {
    pub fn new(position: Vec3) -> Self {
        Self {
            position,
            yaw: 0.,
            pitch: 0.,
            stamina: 4.,
            aiming: false,
            target: None,
            jump_count: 0,
            dash_count: 0,
            velocity: Vec3::ZERO,
            airborne: false,
            regen_delay: 0.,
            spent: 0,
            dash_remaining: 0.,
            dash_direction: Vec3::ZERO,
            dash_distance: 0.,
            body_height: 1.7,
        }
    }
    pub fn forward(&self) -> Vec3 {
        Vec3::new(
            -self.yaw.sin() * self.pitch.cos(),
            self.pitch.sin(),
            -self.yaw.cos() * self.pitch.cos(),
        )
    }
    pub fn head(&self, height: f32) -> Vec3 {
        self.position + Vec3::Y * height
    }
    fn spend(&mut self) -> bool {
        if self.stamina < 1. - EPS {
            return false;
        }
        self.stamina = (self.stamina - 1.).max(0.);
        self.regen_delay = 2.;
        self.spent += 1;
        true
    }
    pub fn reset_input(&mut self) {
        self.aiming = false;
        self.target = None;
        self.dash_remaining = 0.;
    }
    pub fn teleport(&mut self, world: &World, target: Vec3) -> bool {
        if !world.clear(target, self.body_height) {
            return false;
        }
        self.position = target;
        self.velocity = Vec3::ZERO;
        self.airborne = false;
        self.reset_input();
        true
    }
    fn aim_target(&self, world: &World, height: f32, ray: Option<(Vec3, Vec3)>) -> Option<Vec3> {
        let (origin, direction) = ray.unwrap_or((self.head(height), self.forward()));
        if !origin.is_finite()
            || !direction.is_finite()
            || direction.length_squared() < EPS
            || origin.y <= self.position.y + 0.15
        {
            return None;
        }
        if origin.distance_squared(self.head(height)) > EPS
            && world.cast(self.head(height), origin).is_some()
        {
            return None;
        }
        let velocity = direction.normalize() * 22.;
        let mut previous = origin;
        for i in 1..=720 {
            let time = i as f32 / 120.;
            let next = origin + velocity * time - Vec3::Y * (0.5 * GRAVITY * time * time);
            if let Some(hit) = world.cast(previous, next) {
                let impact_time = (i as f32 - 1. + hit.fraction) / 120.;
                if hit.normal.y > 0.55 && velocity.y - GRAVITY * impact_time < 0. {
                    let target = hit.point
                        + Vec3::Y
                            * (RADIUS * (hit.normal.x.abs() + hit.normal.z.abs()) / hit.normal.y
                                + 1e-4);
                    if Vec3::new(target.x - self.position.x, 0., target.z - self.position.z)
                        .length()
                        <= 35.
                        && world.clear(target, height)
                    {
                        return Some(target);
                    }
                }
                return None;
            }
            previous = next;
            if next.y < -0.5 {
                break;
            }
        }
        None
    }
    fn launch(&mut self, target: Vec3) {
        let height = self.position.y.max(0.);
        let target_height = target.y.max(0.);
        let distance =
            Vec3::new(target.x - self.position.x, 0., target.z - self.position.z).length();
        let rise = (distance * 0.16).clamp(0.8, 2.2) + (target_height - height).max(0.) * 0.8;
        let apex = height.max(target_height) + rise;
        let vy = (2. * GRAVITY * (apex - height)).sqrt();
        let duration = vy / GRAVITY + (2. * (apex - target_height) / GRAVITY).sqrt();
        self.velocity = Vec3::new(
            (target.x - self.position.x) / duration,
            vy,
            (target.z - self.position.z) / duration,
        );
        self.airborne = true;
        self.dash_remaining = 0.;
        self.jump_count += 1;
    }
    /// Input and stamina use real time; movement, gravity and dash use scaled time.
    // Explicit independent controls shared by desktop and tracked VR input.
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn step(
        &mut self,
        world: &World,
        dt: f32,
        axis: [f32; 2],
        sprint: bool,
        aim: bool,
        dash: bool,
        head_height: f32,
        aim_ray: Option<(Vec3, Vec3)>,
    ) -> f32 {
        if !dt.is_finite() || dt <= 0. {
            return 0.;
        }
        let height = if head_height.is_finite() {
            head_height.clamp(0.6, 2.5)
        } else {
            1.7
        };
        let before = self.position;
        self.body_height = height;
        let was_aiming = self.aiming;
        self.aiming = aim && self.stamina >= 1. - EPS;
        if self.aiming || was_aiming {
            self.target = self.aim_target(world, height, aim_ray);
        } else {
            self.target = None;
        }
        if was_aiming && !aim {
            if let Some(target) = self.target {
                if self.spend() {
                    self.launch(target);
                }
            }
            self.target = None;
        }
        let forward = Vec3::new(-self.yaw.sin(), 0., -self.yaw.cos());
        let right = Vec3::new(-forward.z, 0., forward.x);
        let axis = if axis[0].is_finite() && axis[1].is_finite() {
            axis
        } else {
            [0., 0.]
        };
        let wish = right * axis[0] + forward * axis[1];
        if dash && self.dash_remaining <= 0. && self.spend() {
            self.dash_direction = if wish.length() > 0.2 {
                wish.normalize()
            } else {
                forward
            };
            self.dash_remaining = 0.2;
            self.dash_distance = 0.;
            self.dash_count += 1;
            self.aiming = false;
            self.target = None;
            self.velocity.x = 0.;
            self.velocity.z = 0.;
        }
        let simdt = dt.min(0.05) * if self.aiming { 0.12 } else { 1. };
        if !self.airborne && self.dash_remaining <= 0. && wish.length_squared() > EPS {
            self.position = world
                .move_body(
                    self.position,
                    wish / wish.length().max(1.) * (if sprint { 6. } else { 2.5 }) * simdt,
                    height,
                )
                .position;
        }
        if self.dash_remaining > 0. {
            let time = simdt.min(self.dash_remaining);
            let distance = time * 25.;
            let before = self.position;
            self.position = world
                .move_body(self.position, self.dash_direction * distance, height)
                .position;
            self.dash_remaining = (self.dash_remaining - time).max(0.);
            self.dash_distance += distance;
            if self.position.distance(before) < distance * 0.1 {
                self.dash_remaining = 0.;
            }
        }
        let mut remaining = simdt;
        while remaining > EPS {
            let h = remaining.min(1. / 120.);
            remaining -= h;
            let delta = Vec3::new(
                if self.airborne {
                    self.velocity.x * h
                } else {
                    0.
                },
                self.velocity.y * h - 0.5 * GRAVITY * h * h,
                if self.airborne {
                    self.velocity.z * h
                } else {
                    0.
                },
            );
            let hit = world.move_body(self.position, delta, height);
            self.position = hit.position;
            self.velocity.y -= GRAVITY * h;
            if hit.hit_ceiling && self.velocity.y > 0. {
                self.velocity.y = 0.;
            }
            if hit.grounded && self.velocity.y <= 0. {
                self.airborne = false;
                self.velocity = Vec3::ZERO;
            } else {
                self.airborne = true;
            }
        }
        if self.position.x <= -78.
            || self.position.x >= 78.
            || self.position.z <= -82.
            || self.position.z >= 60.
        {
            self.position.x = before.x;
            self.position.z = before.z;
        }
        let recovery = (dt - self.regen_delay).max(0.);
        self.regen_delay = (self.regen_delay - dt).max(0.);
        self.stamina = (self.stamina + recovery).min(4.);
        simdt
    }
    pub fn describe(&self) -> serde_json::Value {
        serde_json::json!({"position":{"x":self.position.x,"y":self.position.y,"z":self.position.z},"yaw":self.yaw,"pitch":self.pitch,"aiming":self.aiming,"target":self.target.map(|p|serde_json::json!({"x":p.x,"y":p.y,"z":p.z})),"jump":{"active":self.airborne,"count":self.jump_count,"velocity":{"x":self.velocity.x,"y":self.velocity.y,"z":self.velocity.z}},"dash":{"active":self.dash_remaining>0.,"remaining":self.dash_remaining,"distance":self.dash_distance,"count":self.dash_count},"stamina":{"value":self.stamina,"max":4,"available":(self.stamina+EPS).floor(),"regenDelay":self.regen_delay,"spent":self.spent}})
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    fn box_shape(min: Vec3, max: Vec3) -> Shape {
        Shape {
            bounds: Bounds::points(min, max, Vec3::ZERO),
            planes: vec![
                Plane {
                    x: 1.,
                    y: 0.,
                    z: 0.,
                    d: max.x,
                },
                Plane {
                    x: -1.,
                    y: 0.,
                    z: 0.,
                    d: -min.x,
                },
                Plane {
                    x: 0.,
                    y: 1.,
                    z: 0.,
                    d: max.y,
                },
                Plane {
                    x: 0.,
                    y: -1.,
                    z: 0.,
                    d: -min.y,
                },
                Plane {
                    x: 0.,
                    y: 0.,
                    z: 1.,
                    d: max.z,
                },
                Plane {
                    x: 0.,
                    y: 0.,
                    z: -1.,
                    d: -min.z,
                },
            ],
        }
    }
    fn ground() -> Shape {
        box_shape(Vec3::new(-100., -1., -100.), Vec3::new(100., 0., 100.))
    }
    #[test]
    fn wall_slide_and_thin_wall_dash() {
        let world = World::new(vec![
            ground(),
            box_shape(Vec3::new(2., 0., -10.), Vec3::new(2.05, 5., 10.)),
        ])
        .unwrap();
        let hit = world.move_body(Vec3::ZERO, Vec3::new(10., 0., 3.), 1.7);
        assert!((hit.position.x - 1.68).abs() < 1e-4);
        assert!((hit.position.z - 3.).abs() < 1e-4);
        let mut p = Player::new(Vec3::ZERO);
        p.step(&world, 0.05, [1., 0.], false, false, true, 1.7, None);
        for _ in 0..8 {
            p.step(&world, 0.05, [0., 0.], false, false, false, 1.7, None);
        }
        assert!(p.position.x <= 1.681 && p.position.x > 1.67);
        assert_eq!(p.dash_count, 1);
    }
    #[test]
    fn roof_support_and_open_space_below() {
        let roof = Shape {
            bounds: Bounds::points(Vec3::new(-2., 3., -2.), Vec3::new(2., 5., 2.), Vec3::ZERO),
            planes: vec![
                Plane {
                    x: 1.,
                    y: 1.,
                    z: 0.,
                    d: 5.,
                },
                Plane {
                    x: -1.,
                    y: 1.,
                    z: 0.,
                    d: 5.,
                },
                Plane {
                    x: 0.,
                    y: -1.,
                    z: 0.,
                    d: -3.,
                },
                Plane {
                    x: 0.,
                    y: 0.,
                    z: 1.,
                    d: 2.,
                },
                Plane {
                    x: 0.,
                    y: 0.,
                    z: -1.,
                    d: 2.,
                },
            ],
        };
        let world = World::new(vec![ground(), roof]).unwrap();
        assert!(world.clear(Vec3::ZERO, 1.7));
        let hit = world.move_body(Vec3::new(0.8, 8., 0.), Vec3::new(0., -5., 0.), 1.7);
        assert!(hit.grounded);
        assert!((hit.position.y - 4.52).abs() < 1e-3);
        let mut position = hit.position;
        for _ in 0..120 {
            let hit = world.move_body(position, Vec3::new(0., -0.01, 0.), 1.7);
            assert!(hit.grounded, "roof at {position:?} -> {hit:?}");
            assert!((hit.position.x - 0.8).abs() < 1e-4);
            position = hit.position;
        }
    }
    #[test]
    fn aim_release_ballistic_landing_and_stamina_clock() {
        let world = World::new(vec![ground()]).unwrap();
        let mut p = Player::new(Vec3::ZERO);
        assert!(
            (p.step(&world, 0.05, [0., 0.], false, true, false, 1.7, None) - 0.006).abs() < EPS
        );
        let target = p.target.expect("forward arc lands on ground");
        assert!(target.z < -10. && target.z > -35.);
        p.step(&world, 0.05, [0., 0.], false, false, false, 1.7, None);
        assert_eq!(p.jump_count, 1);
        assert_eq!(p.stamina, 3.);
        for _ in 0..100 {
            p.step(&world, 0.02, [0., 0.], false, false, false, 1.7, None);
        }
        assert!(
            (p.position.z - target.z).abs() < 0.1,
            "land {:?}, target {:?}, velocity {:?}",
            p.position,
            target,
            p.velocity
        );
        assert!(p.position.y.abs() < 0.001);
        p.step(&world, 0.5, [0., 0.], false, true, false, 1.7, None);
        assert!((p.stamina - 3.55).abs() < 0.02);
    }
    #[test]
    fn dash_five_metres_and_ceiling() {
        let world = World::new(vec![ground()]).unwrap();
        let mut p = Player::new(Vec3::ZERO);
        for i in 0..4 {
            p.step(&world, 0.05, [0., 0.], false, false, i == 0, 1.7, None);
        }
        assert!((p.position.z + 5.).abs() < 1e-4);
        let ceiling = World::new(vec![box_shape(
            Vec3::new(-5., 2., -5.),
            Vec3::new(5., 3., 5.),
        )])
        .unwrap();
        let hit = ceiling.move_body(Vec3::ZERO, Vec3::Y * 10., 1.7);
        assert!(hit.hit_ceiling);
        assert!((hit.position.y - 0.3).abs() < 1e-4);
    }
    #[test]
    fn arch_passage_stays_open_and_bvh_finds_crown() {
        let mut shapes = vec![ground()];
        for i in 0..16 {
            let a = (i as f32 + 0.5) * std::f32::consts::PI / 16.;
            let center = Vec3::new(3. * a.cos(), 3. * a.sin() + 1., 0.);
            let axes = [
                Vec3::new(a.cos(), a.sin(), 0.),
                Vec3::new(-a.sin(), a.cos(), 0.),
                Vec3::Z,
            ];
            let half = std::f32::consts::PI / 32.;
            let radial = 0.2 + 3. * (1. - half.cos());
            let sizes = [
                radial,
                ((3. + radial) * half.tan()).max(3. * half.sin() + 0.2) + 1e-5,
                0.2,
            ];
            let mut lo = Vec3::splat(f32::INFINITY);
            let mut hi = Vec3::splat(f32::NEG_INFINITY);
            for x in [-1., 1.] {
                for y in [-1., 1.] {
                    for z in [-1., 1.] {
                        let p = center
                            + axes[0] * sizes[0] * x
                            + axes[1] * sizes[1] * y
                            + axes[2] * sizes[2] * z;
                        lo = lo.min(p);
                        hi = hi.max(p);
                    }
                }
            }
            let mut planes = Vec::new();
            for j in 0..3 {
                for sign in [-1., 1.] {
                    let n = axes[j] * sign;
                    planes.push(Plane {
                        x: n.x,
                        y: n.y,
                        z: n.z,
                        d: n.dot(center) + sizes[j],
                    });
                }
            }
            shapes.push(Shape {
                bounds: Bounds::points(lo, hi, Vec3::ZERO),
                planes,
            });
        }
        let world = World::new(shapes).unwrap();
        assert!(world
            .cast(Vec3::new(0., 1.5, 2.), Vec3::new(0., 1.5, -2.))
            .is_none());
        let crossing = world.move_body(Vec3::new(0., 0., 2.), Vec3::new(0., 0., -4.), 1.7);
        assert!((crossing.position.z + 2.).abs() < 1e-4);
        let crown = world
            .cast(Vec3::new(0., 8., 0.), Vec3::new(0., 0., 0.))
            .unwrap();
        assert!(crown.point.y > 4. && crown.normal.y > 0.9);
    }
    #[test]
    fn stamina_recovery_uses_real_time_through_slow_aim() {
        let world = World::new(vec![ground()]).unwrap();
        let mut p = Player::new(Vec3::ZERO);
        p.step(&world, 0.05, [0., 0.], false, false, true, 1.7, None);
        for _ in 0..40 {
            assert!(
                (p.step(&world, 0.05, [0., 0.], false, true, false, 1.7, None) - 0.006).abs() < EPS
            );
        }
        assert!((p.stamina - 3.05).abs() < 0.001);
        for _ in 0..10 {
            p.step(&world, 0.05, [0., 0.], false, true, false, 1.7, None);
        }
        assert!((p.stamina - 3.55).abs() < 0.001);
    }
    #[test]
    fn original_city_spawn_walks_forward_and_keeps_support() {
        let collision: serde_json::Value =
            serde_json::from_str(include_str!("../assets/models/rim/collisions.json")).unwrap();
        let shapes = serde_json::from_value(collision["shapes"].clone()).unwrap();
        let world = World::new(shapes).unwrap();
        let mut player = Player::new(Vec3::new(0., 0., 42.));
        for frame in 0..30 {
            player.step(&world, 1. / 60., [0., 1.], false, false, false, 1.7, None);
            assert!(!player.airborne, "frame {frame}: {}", player.describe());
            assert!(
                world.move_body(player.position, Vec3::ZERO, 1.7).grounded,
                "frame {frame}: {}",
                player.describe()
            );
        }
        assert!(player.position.z < 41.5, "{}", player.describe());
        assert!(player.position.x.abs() < 0.001 && player.position.y.abs() < 0.001);
    }
    #[test]
    fn invalid_shapes_are_rejected() {
        let mut shape = ground();
        shape.planes[0].x = f32::NAN;
        assert!(World::new(vec![shape]).is_err());
        let mut shape = ground();
        shape.bounds.max_x = f32::INFINITY;
        assert!(World::new(vec![shape]).is_err());
        let mut shape = ground();
        shape.planes.clear();
        assert!(World::new(vec![shape]).is_err());
    }
}

//! CPU scene state and simulation. No browser, JavaScript or GPU dependencies.

pub(crate) struct MeshVariants {
    pub variants: Vec<crate::cutting_mesh::MeshData>,
    #[cfg_attr(not(target_arch = "wasm32"), allow(dead_code))]
    pub colors: Vec<[f32; 4]>,
    pub registered: bool,
    pub varying_triangles: Vec<usize>,
}
impl MeshVariants {
    /// Only the specialized shared GPU buffer gets negative red slot markers.
    /// CPU topology/colors remain untouched for glow extraction and cutting.
    #[cfg(any(test, target_arch = "wasm32"))]
    pub(crate) fn gpu_mesh(&self) -> crate::gltf_loader::ImportedMesh {
        let mut mesh = self.variants[0]
            .ready_cpu()
            .expect("CPU mesh asset base")
            .render_mesh();
        for (slot, &triangle) in self.varying_triangles.iter().enumerate() {
            for vertex in &mut mesh.vertices[triangle * 3..triangle * 3 + 3] {
                vertex.color[0] = -(slot as f32 + 1.0);
            }
        }
        mesh
    }
    #[cfg(any(test, target_arch = "wasm32"))]
    pub(crate) fn gpu_colors(&self) -> Vec<[f32; 4]> {
        self.colors
            .chunks_exact(self.variants[0].triangle_count())
            .flat_map(|variant| {
                self.varying_triangles
                    .iter()
                    .map(|&triangle| variant[triangle])
            })
            .collect()
    }
}

/// Owned immutable inputs; safe to retain while the GPU request is pending.
pub struct ResidentCandidate {
    pub id: u32,
    pub mesh: crate::cutting_mesh::MeshData,
    pub a: Vec3,
    pub b: Vec3,
    pub motion: Vec3,
    pub color: Vec3,
    pub transform: Transform,
    pub options: RenderOptions,
    pub direction: Vec3,
    pub angular: [Vec3; 2],
}
impl ResidentCandidate {
    pub fn support_dirs(&self) -> [[f32; 4]; 128] {
        std::array::from_fn(|i| {
            let matrix = Transform::new(
                Vec3::ZERO,
                self.transform.rotation + self.angular[i / 64] * ((i % 64) as f32 / 63.),
                self.transform.scale,
            )
            .model();
            matrix
                .transpose()
                .transform_vector3(Vec3::Y)
                .extend(0.)
                .to_array()
        })
    }
}

/// World-space normals must remain perpendicular to transformed tangents.
pub(crate) fn normal_matrix(model: Mat4) -> Mat4 {
    model.inverse().transpose()
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum MeshKind {
    Cube,
    Plane,
    Sphere,
    Imported(u32),
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct Transform {
    pub position: Vec3,
    pub rotation: Vec3,
    pub scale: Vec3,
}

impl Transform {
    pub fn new(position: Vec3, rotation: Vec3, scale: Vec3) -> Self {
        Self {
            position,
            rotation,
            scale,
        }
    }
    pub fn model(&self) -> Mat4 {
        // Compose the affine columns directly, as in Three's Matrix4.compose,
        // while preserving our Euler convention T * Ry * Rx * Rz * S.
        // Keep the products grouped like the original rotation matrices.
        let (sx, cx) = self.rotation.x.sin_cos();
        let (sy, cy) = self.rotation.y.sin_cos();
        let (sz, cz) = self.rotation.z.sin_cos();
        let ys = sy * sx;
        let yc = cy * sx;
        Mat4::from_cols(
            (Vec3::new(cy * cz + ys * sz, cx * sz, -sy * cz + yc * sz) * self.scale.x).extend(0.0),
            (Vec3::new(-cy * sz + ys * cz, cx * cz, sy * sz + yc * cz) * self.scale.y).extend(0.0),
            (Vec3::new(sy * cx, -sx, cy * cx) * self.scale.z).extend(0.0),
            self.position.extend(1.0),
        )
    }
    fn is_valid(&self) -> bool {
        self.position.is_finite()
            && self.rotation.is_finite()
            && self.scale.is_finite()
            && self.scale.abs().min_element() > 0.0
    }
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct ShadowRevisions {
    static_casters: u64,
    dynamic_casters: u64,
}
impl ShadowRevisions {
    fn changed(&mut self, options: RenderOptions) {
        if options.casts_shadow {
            let revision = if options.is_static {
                &mut self.static_casters
            } else {
                &mut self.dynamic_casters
            };
            *revision = revision.wrapping_add(1);
        }
    }
    fn clear(&mut self) {
        self.static_casters = self.static_casters.wrapping_add(1);
        self.dynamic_casters = self.dynamic_casters.wrapping_add(1);
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct RenderOptions {
    pub is_static: bool,
    pub casts_shadow: bool,
    pub receives_shadow: bool,
    pub reflectivity: f32,
    /// Author guarantees opaque parts have no inter-root coplanar/order dependency.
    /// Independent of mobility: moving instances can share immutable geometry.
    pub opaque_reorderable: bool,
}
impl Default for RenderOptions {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            is_static: false,
            casts_shadow: true,
            receives_shadow: true,
            reflectivity: 0.0,
            opaque_reorderable: false,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct PieceFade {
    elapsed: f32,
    delay: f32,
    duration: f32,
    start: f32,
}

pub struct SceneObject {
    pub transform: Transform,
    pub mesh: MeshKind,
    pub render_options: RenderOptions,
    pub emission: f32,
    pub color_cutout: f32,
    pub visual_fade: f32,
    pub visual_dissolve: bool,
    pub opacity: f32,
    pub opaque_above: f32,
    pub opacity_variation: f32,
    pub opacity_coverage: f32,
    cut_assist: f32,
    blade_contact_response: bool,
    local_bounds: Option<(Vec3, Vec3)>,
    pub(crate) render_data: crate::visibility::ObjectRenderData,
}
impl SceneObject {
    fn refresh_render_data(&mut self) {
        self.render_data = if let Some((min, max)) = self.local_bounds {
            crate::visibility::ObjectRenderData::with_bounds(self.transform, min, max)
        } else {
            crate::visibility::ObjectRenderData::new(self.mesh, self.transform)
        };
    }
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct Light {
