    }
    return 1.0;
}

// Select resources and occupied layers once; preserve all nine ordered PCF taps.
fn filter_shadow_3(uv:vec2<f32>,depth:f32,texel:vec2<f32>,layers:u32)->f32 {
    if(layers==1u) {
        var visibility=0.0;
        for(var y=-1;y<=1;y++) {for(var x=-1;x<=1;x++) {
            let sample_uv=uv+vec2<f32>(f32(x),f32(y))*texel;
            visibility+=textureSampleCompareLevel(static_shadow_3,shadow_sampler,sample_uv,depth);
        }}
        return visibility/9.0;
    }
    if(layers==2u) {
        var visibility=0.0;
        for(var y=-1;y<=1;y++) {for(var x=-1;x<=1;x++) {
            let sample_uv=uv+vec2<f32>(f32(x),f32(y))*texel;
            visibility+=min(1.0,textureSampleCompareLevel(dynamic_shadow_3,shadow_sampler,sample_uv,depth));
        }}
        return visibility/9.0;
    }
    if(layers==3u) {
        var visibility=0.0;
        for(var y=-1;y<=1;y++) {for(var x=-1;x<=1;x++) {
            let sample_uv=uv+vec2<f32>(f32(x),f32(y))*texel;
            visibility+=min(textureSampleCompareLevel(static_shadow_3,shadow_sampler,sample_uv,depth),textureSampleCompareLevel(dynamic_shadow_3,shadow_sampler,sample_uv,depth));
        }}
        return visibility/9.0;
    }
    return 1.0;
}
fn shadow_visibility(index:u32,world:vec3<f32>,normal:vec3<f32>,light_direction:vec3<f32>)->f32 {
    if(effects.shadow_layers[index]==0u) { return 1.0; }
    // Receiver normal offset follows the authored shadow profile; zero for legacy scenes.
    let shadow_world=world+normal*scene.appearance_ground.w;
    let clip=effects.shadow_matrices[index]*vec4(shadow_world,1.0);
    let ndc=clip.xyz/clip.w;
    if (clip.w<=0.0 || ndc.z<=0.0 || ndc.z>=1.0 || any(abs(ndc.xy)>vec2(1.0))) {return 1.0;}
    let uv=ndc.xy*vec2(0.5,-0.5)+vec2(0.5);
    let bias=effects.params.w*(1.0+2.0*(1.0-max(dot(normal,light_direction),0.0)));
    let depth=ndc.z-bias;
    let texel=1.0/vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(static_shadow));
    let layers=effects.shadow_layers[index];
    switch index {
        case 0u: { return filter_shadow_0(uv,depth,texel,layers); }
        case 1u: { return filter_shadow_1(uv,depth,texel,layers); }
        case 2u: { return filter_shadow_2(uv,depth,texel,layers); }
        case 3u: { return filter_shadow_3(uv,depth,texel,layers); }
        default: { return 1.0; }
    }
}

// Keep identical in the surface and edge-glow shaders. Mesh-local cells stay
// attached during motion; two scales make connected angular clusters, with
// slanted fronts inside the small cells rather than whole-face popping.
fn dissolve_hash(cell: vec3<f32>) -> f32 {
    let seed = fract(cell * vec3<f32>(0.1031, 0.1030, 0.0973));
    let mixed = seed + dot(seed, seed.yzx + vec3<f32>(33.33));
    return fract((mixed.x + mixed.y) * mixed.z);
}
fn dissolve_field(local_pos: vec3<f32>) -> f32 {
    let grid = local_pos * 5.0;
    let coarse = dissolve_hash(floor(grid * 0.5));
    let fine = dissolve_hash(floor(grid));
    let slope = dot(fract(grid), vec3<f32>(0.43, 0.35, 0.22));
    return 0.02 + 0.96 * (coarse * 0.58 + fine * 0.27 + slope * 0.15);
}
fn visual_remaining(raw: f32) -> f32 {
    if (raw < 0.0) { return clamp(-raw - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0); }
    return raw;
}

fn authored_surface_translucent(input: VertexOutput) -> bool {
    return input.transparency.x < 1.0 && max(max(input.color.r, input.color.g), input.color.b) < input.transparency.y;
}
fn surface_translucent(input: VertexOutput) -> bool {
    return visual_remaining(input.visual_fade) < 1.0 || authored_surface_translucent(input);
}
fn opaque_surface(input: VertexOutput) -> vec4<f32> {
    if (surface_translucent(input)) { discard; }
    let color=shade_surface(input);
    return vec4(appearance_color(color.rgb,1.0/input.pos.w),color.a);
}
fn shade_surface(input: VertexOutput) -> vec4<f32> {
    var rim = 0.0;
    if (input.visual_fade < 0.0) {
        let progress = sqrt(clamp(2.0 + input.visual_fade, 0.0, 1.0));
        if (progress >= 1.0) { discard; }
        if (progress > 0.0) {
            let frontier = dissolve_field(input.local_pos) - progress;
            if (frontier <= 0.0) { discard; }
            rim = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.075, frontier);
        }
    }
    let surface = shade_surface_base(input);
    if (rim <= 0.0) { return surface; }
    let peak = max(max(input.color.r, input.color.g), input.color.b);
    let hue = max(input.color, vec3<f32>(0.0)) / max(peak, 0.001);
    let rim_color = mix(vec3<f32>(0.015, 0.75, 1.0), hue, 0.12);
    let radiance = rim_color * rim * 3.5 + vec3<f32>(1.0) * pow(rim, 4.0) * 2.8;
    return vec4<f32>(surface.rgb + radiance, surface.a);
}
fn shade_surface_base(input: VertexOutput) -> vec4<f32> {
    if (max(max(input.color.r, input.color.g), input.color.b) < input.color_cutout) { discard; }
    if (effects.params.z>0.5 && dot(effects.clip_plane,vec4(input.world_pos,1.0)) < -0.001) { discard; }
    // Numeric tubes radiate continuously across their smooth surface. Build the
    // hot core per fragment from view angle, not baked facet colors or lights.
    if (input.material.w < -1.5) {
        let normal = normalize(input.world_normal);
        let view = normalize(scene.camera_pos-input.world_pos);
        let axis = normalize(input.numeric_axis);
        let across = view-axis*dot(view,axis);
        // A neon tube emits along its whole axis. Project the view into its
        // cross section so oblique/horizontal strokes cannot lose their core.
        let fallback_basis = select(vec3<f32>(0.0,0.0,1.0),vec3<f32>(0.0,1.0,0.0),abs(axis.z)>0.9);
        var cross_view = normalize(cross(axis,fallback_basis));
        if dot(across,across)>0.000001 { cross_view = normalize(across); }
        let facing = clamp(dot(normal,cross_view),0.0,1.0);
        let drive = clamp(log2(1.0+max(input.emission,0.0))/3.0,0.0,1.25);
        let tube = vec3<f32>(0.0135,0.165,0.975)*(0.12+0.88*sqrt(facing));
        let core = vec3<f32>(0.86,0.96,1.0)*4.5*pow(facing,32.0);
        let radiance = (tube+core)*drive;
        // Exponential exposure rolls HDR energy smoothly into display range;
        // broad blue emission stays saturated while only the narrow core pales.
        return vec4<f32>(vec3<f32>(1.0)-exp(-radiance),0.0);
    }
    // World-space text keeps its palette and normal depth/clip behavior.
    // Alpha is postprocessing metadata; zero excludes surface lighting effects.
    if (input.material.w < -0.5) { return vec4<f32>(input.color, 0.0); }
    let normal = normalize(input.world_normal);
    let view_dir = normalize(scene.camera_pos - input.world_pos);
    var result = input.color * select(vec3(0.1),appearance_ambient(normal),scene.appearance_sky.w>0.5);

    for (var i: u32 = 0u; i < LIGHT_COUNT; i = i + 1u) {
        let light = scene.lights[i];
        if (all(light.color == vec3<f32>(0.0))) {
            continue;
        }
        let light_delta = light.position - input.world_pos;
        let l_dir = select(light_delta / max(length(light_delta), 0.00001),scene.appearance_sun.xyz,scene.appearance_sky.w>0.5 && i==0u);
        let diff = max(dot(normal, l_dir), 0.0);
        // Blinn-Phong: an unlit/back-facing surface cannot reflect this light.
        var spec = 0.0;
        if (diff > 0.0 && dot(normal, view_dir) > 0.0) {
            let half_vector = l_dir + view_dir;
            let halfway = half_vector / max(length(half_vector), 0.00001);
            spec = pow(max(dot(normal, halfway), 0.0), 32.0);
        }
        var visibility=1.0;
        if(diff>0.0 && i<u32(effects.params.x) && input.material.y>0.5) {
            visibility=shadow_visibility(i,input.world_pos,normal,l_dir);
        }
        result += (diff * input.color + spec) * light.color * visibility;
    }

    result += input.color * input.emission;

    if(effects.params.y>0.5 && input.material.z>0.5 && input.material.x>0.0) {
        let reflected=effects.reflection_matrix*vec4(input.world_pos,1.0);
        let uv=reflected.xy/reflected.w*vec2(0.5,-0.5)+vec2(0.5);
        if(reflected.w>0.0 && all(uv>=vec2(0.0)) && all(uv<=vec2(1.0))) {
            result=mix(result,textureSampleLevel(reflection_texture,reflection_sampler,uv,0.0).rgb,input.material.x);
        }
    }
    // Intersect the same finite blade sweep with actual visible cuttable surfaces.
    // Regular depth testing keeps hidden fruit hidden; no duplicate contour mesh.
    let along = dot(input.world_pos - scene.guide_origin.xyz, scene.guide_axis.xyz);
    let distance = abs(dot(vec4(input.world_pos, 1.0), scene.guide_plane));
    if (input.material.w > 0.5 && scene.guide_axis.w > 0.0
        && abs(along) <= scene.guide_axis.w
        && input.world_pos.y >= scene.guide_origin.w
        && input.world_pos.y <= scene.guide_origin.y) {
        let band = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.022, 0.042, distance);
        result = mix(result, vec3<f32>(0.08, 1.0, 0.025), band);
    }
    return vec4<f32>(result, input.material.x);
}

@fragment
fn fs_color(input: VertexOutput) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    return vec4<f32>(input.color, 1.0);
}

// Alpha is material metadata only in the offscreen postprocessing path.
@fragment fn fs_main(input: VertexOutput) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    return vec4(opaque_surface(input).rgb, 1.0);
}
@fragment fn fs_material_mask(input: VertexOutput) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    return opaque_surface(input);
}
struct PostSurface {
    @location(0) color: vec4<f32>,
    @location(1) depth: vec4<f32>,
};
@fragment fn fs_postprocess(input: VertexOutput) -> PostSurface {
    var output: PostSurface;
    output.color = opaque_surface(input);
    var encoded = fract(min(input.pos.z, 0.9999999) * vec3(1.0, 255.0, 65025.0));
    encoded -= encoded.yzz * vec3(1.0 / 255.0, 1.0 / 255.0, 0.0);
    output.depth = vec4(encoded, 1.0);
    return output;
}

// Straight alpha blends linear lighting into the final target (sRGB encoding is hardware-owned).
@fragment fn fs_translucent(input: VertexOutput, @builtin(front_facing) _front: bool) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    if (!surface_translucent(input) || visual_remaining(input.visual_fade) <= 0.0) { discard; }
    let authored_translucent = authored_surface_translucent(input);
    if (authored_translucent && input.transparency.x <= 0.0 && input.opacity_controls.x <= 0.0) { discard; }
    var surface = input;
    // LH projection reverses winding; light the inside of the rear surface too.
    surface.world_normal = select(-input.world_normal, input.world_normal, dot(input.world_normal, scene.camera_pos - input.world_pos) >= 0.0);
    // Local face orientation distinguishes equal colors. Baked facet brightness
    // supplies the authored random seed; both triangles of a quad share it.
    // Quantization removes tiny normal differences from coplanar triangulation.
    let authored = round(input.facet_key * vec4(4096.0, 4096.0, 4096.0, 65536.0)) / vec4(4096.0, 4096.0, 4096.0, 65536.0);
    let seed = fract(authored.xyz * vec3(0.1031, 0.1030, 0.0973) + vec3(authored.w * 17.37) + vec3(0.37, 0.61, 0.83));
    let mixed = seed + dot(seed, seed.yzx + vec3(33.33));
    let facet_hash = fract((mixed.x + mixed.y) * mixed.z);
    var weight = facet_hash;
    if (input.opacity_controls.y == 0.0) {
        weight = 0.0;
    } else if (input.opacity_controls.y == 1.0) {
        weight = 1.0;
    } else if (input.opacity_controls.y > 0.0) {
        let threshold = 1.0 - input.opacity_controls.y;
        weight = smoothstep(threshold - 0.06, threshold + 0.06, facet_hash);
    }
    let alpha = clamp(input.transparency.x + (1.0 - input.transparency.x) * input.opacity_controls.x * weight, 0.0, 1.0);
    // Originally opaque seams keep their full authored alpha until object fade.
    let fade_alpha = select(input.visual_fade, 1.0, input.visual_fade < 0.0);
    let faded_alpha = select(1.0, alpha, authored_translucent) * fade_alpha;
    var output_alpha = faded_alpha;
    if (input.visual_fade > -2.0 && input.visual_fade < -1.0) {
        // Glass must not hide the luminous dissolution frontier behind its
        // authored low facet opacity; boost only this narrow surviving band.
        let progress = sqrt(clamp(2.0 + input.visual_fade, 0.0, 1.0));
        let frontier = dissolve_field(input.local_pos) - progress;
        let rim = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.075, max(frontier, 0.0));
        output_alpha = max(output_alpha, rim * 0.95);
    }
    return vec4(appearance_color(shade_surface(surface).rgb,1.0/input.pos.w), output_alpha);
}


# File: src/spatial.rs
//! Geometry-only median BVH. Bounds may be planar or even points.
use glam::Vec3;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub(crate) struct Bounds {
    pub center: Vec3,
    pub half_extent: Vec3,
}
impl Bounds {
    fn union(self, other: Self) -> Self {
        let min = (self.center - self.half_extent).min(other.center - other.half_extent);
        let max = (self.center + self.half_extent).max(other.center + other.half_extent);
        let center = (min + max) * 0.5;
        let half_extent = (max - min) * 0.5;
        // Parent bounds must not shrink due to floating-point reconstruction.
        Self {
            center,
            half_extent: half_extent + (center.abs() + half_extent) * (2.0 * f32::EPSILON),
        }
    }
}

struct Node {
    bounds: Bounds,
    kind: NodeKind,
}
enum NodeKind {
    Leaf(u32),
    Branch(usize, usize),
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct Bvh {
    nodes: Vec<Node>,
    ids: Vec<u32>,
}
impl Bvh {
    /// IDs in input must be unique and ascending. Returns true for a topology rebuild;
    /// unchanged membership only refits bounds, including all internal nodes.
    pub fn update(&mut self, entries: &[(u32, Bounds)], force_rebuild: bool) -> bool {
        let same_ids = self.ids.len() == entries.len()
            && self
                .ids
                .iter()
                .zip(entries)
                .all(|(id, entry)| *id == entry.0);
        if !force_rebuild && same_ids {
            for index in (0..self.nodes.len()).rev() {
                self.nodes[index].bounds = match self.nodes[index].kind {
                    NodeKind::Leaf(id) => {
                        entries[entries.binary_search_by_key(&id, |e| e.0).unwrap()].1
                    }
                    NodeKind::Branch(left, right) => {
                        self.nodes[left].bounds.union(self.nodes[right].bounds)
                    }
                };
            }
            return false;
        }
        self.ids = entries.iter().map(|e| e.0).collect();
        self.nodes.clear();
        if !entries.is_empty() {
            self.build(&mut entries.to_vec());
        }
        true
    }
    fn build(&mut self, entries: &mut [(u32, Bounds)]) -> usize {
        let bounds = entries
            .iter()
            .skip(1)
            .fold(entries[0].1, |b, e| b.union(e.1));
        let index = self.nodes.len();
        self.nodes.push(Node {
            bounds,
            kind: NodeKind::Leaf(entries[0].0),
        });
        if entries.len() > 1 {
            let axis = if bounds.half_extent.x >= bounds.half_extent.y
                && bounds.half_extent.x >= bounds.half_extent.z
            {
                0
            } else if bounds.half_extent.y >= bounds.half_extent.z {
                1
            } else {
                2
            };
            let middle = entries.len() / 2;
            entries.select_nth_unstable_by(middle, |a, b| {
                a.1.center[axis]
                    .total_cmp(&b.1.center[axis])
                    .then(a.0.cmp(&b.0))
            });
            let (left, right) = entries.split_at_mut(middle);
            let left = self.build(left);
            let right = self.build(right);
            self.nodes[index].kind = NodeKind::Branch(left, right);
        }
        index
    }
    /// Internal bounds and eligible object bounds are counted separately.
    pub fn query<const TRACK: bool>(
        &self,
        intersects: &impl Fn(Bounds) -> bool,
        eligible: &impl Fn(u32) -> bool,
        output: &mut Vec<u32>,
        nodes_visited: &mut usize,
        object_tests: &mut usize,
    ) {
        if !self.nodes.is_empty() {
            self.query_node::<TRACK>(0, intersects, eligible, output, nodes_visited, object_tests);
        }
    }
    fn query_node<const TRACK: bool>(
        &self,
        index: usize,
        intersects: &impl Fn(Bounds) -> bool,
        eligible: &impl Fn(u32) -> bool,
        output: &mut Vec<u32>,
        nodes_visited: &mut usize,
        object_tests: &mut usize,
    ) {
        let node = &self.nodes[index];
        if TRACK {
            *nodes_visited += 1;
        }
        match node.kind {
            NodeKind::Leaf(id) => {
                if eligible(id) {
                    if TRACK {
                        *object_tests += 1;
                    }
                    if intersects(node.bounds) {
                        output.push(id);
                    }
                }
            }
            NodeKind::Branch(left, right) => {
                if intersects(node.bounds) {
                    self.query_node::<TRACK>(
                        left,
                        intersects,
                        eligible,
                        output,
                        nodes_visited,
                        object_tests,
                    );
                    self.query_node::<TRACK>(
                        right,
                        intersects,
                        eligible,
                        output,
                        nodes_visited,
                        object_tests,
                    );
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn planar_and_point_bounds_survive_refit_and_membership_changes() {
        let mut tree = Bvh::default();
        let bounds = |x| Bounds {
            center: Vec3::new(x, 0.0, 0.0),
            half_extent: Vec3::ZERO,
        };
        let mut entries = [
            (2, bounds(0.0)),
            (
                7,
                Bounds {
                    center: Vec3::new(10.0, 0.0, 0.0),
                    half_extent: Vec3::new(1.0, 0.0, 1.0),
                },
            ),
        ];
        assert!(tree.update(&entries, false));
        let query = |tree: &Bvh| {
            let mut output = Vec::new();
            let (mut nodes, mut objects) = (0, 0);
            tree.query::<true>(
                &|b| b.center.x - b.half_extent.x <= 1.0 && b.center.x + b.half_extent.x >= -1.0,
                &|_| true,
                &mut output,
                &mut nodes,
                &mut objects,
            );
            output.sort_unstable();
            output
        };
        assert_eq!(query(&tree), vec![2]);
        entries[0].1 = bounds(20.0);
        entries[1].1.center.x = 0.0;
        assert!(!tree.update(&entries, false));
        assert_eq!(query(&tree), vec![7]);
        assert!(tree.update(&entries[1..], false));
        assert_eq!(query(&tree), vec![7]);
        assert!(tree.update(&[], false));
        assert!(query(&tree).is_empty());
    }
}


# File: src/table_tennis.rs
//! Native table tennis: physical moving-surface impacts, spin, rules and free practice.
use crate::{
    scene::SceneManager,
    table_tennis_contact::{self as contact, Contact, Motion, Pose},
};
use glam::{EulerRot, Quat, Vec3};
use serde_json::{json, Value};
const STEP: f32 = 1. / 240.;
const RADIUS: f32 = 0.02;
const SURFACE: f32 = 0.76 + RADIUS;
const NET_Z: f32 = -2.2;
const PADDLE_RADIUS: f32 = 0.085;
const PADDLE_HALF: f32 = 0.006;
// WebXR: shaft -Z, face normal X. The grip stays at the handle's centre.
const PADDLE_FACE_OFFSET: Vec3 = Vec3::new(0., 0., -0.135);
#[cfg(test)]
const DESKTOP_FACE_OFFSET: Vec3 = Vec3::new(0., 0.135, 0.);
const DESKTOP_ROTATION: Vec3 =
    Vec3::new(std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2, 0., std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2);
const PRACTICE_ROTATION: Vec3 = Vec3::new(0., 0., std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2);
fn rotation(v: Vec3) -> Quat {
    Quat::from_euler(EulerRot::YXZ, v.y, v.x, v.z)
}
fn pose_lerp(a: Pose, b: Pose, t: f32) -> Pose {
    Pose {
        center: a.center.lerp(b.center, t),
        orientation: a.orientation.slerp(b.orientation, t).normalize(),
    }
}

pub struct Game {
    pub score_panel: Option<u32>,
    ids: [u32; 3],
    position: Vec3,
    velocity: Vec3,
    spin: Vec3,
    ball_rotation: Quat,
    paddles: [Vec3; 2],
    orientations: [Quat; 2],
    paddle_velocity: [Vec3; 2],
    command: Option<Vec3>,
    player_target: Vec3,
    player_orientation: Quat,
    tracking_ready: bool,
    accumulator: f64,
    score: [u32; 2],
    server: usize,
    last_hit: usize,
    own_bounce: bool,
    bounces: u32,
    rally_hits: u32,
    phase: &'static str,
    event: &'static str,
    delay: f32,
    sequence: u32,
    winner: Option<usize>,
    practice: bool,
    drop_pending: bool,
    time: f32,
    last_contact: [f32; 2],
}
impl Game {
    pub fn new(ball: u32, player: u32, opponent: u32) -> Self {
        let q = rotation(DESKTOP_ROTATION);
        Self {
            score_panel: None,
            ids: [ball, player, opponent],
            position: Vec3::new(0., 1.1, -1.08),
            velocity: Vec3::ZERO,
            spin: Vec3::ZERO,
            ball_rotation: Quat::IDENTITY,
            paddles: [Vec3::new(0., 1., -0.65), Vec3::new(0., 1., -3.75)],
            orientations: [q; 2],
            paddle_velocity: [Vec3::ZERO; 2],
            command: None,
            player_target: Vec3::new(0., 1., -0.65),
            player_orientation: q,
            tracking_ready: false,
            accumulator: 0.,
            score: [0; 2],
            server: 0,
            last_hit: 0,
            own_bounce: true,
            bounces: 0,
            rally_hits: 0,
            phase: "ready",
            event: "ready",
            delay: 0.7,
            sequence: 0,
            winner: None,
            practice: false,
            drop_pending: false,
            time: 0.,
            last_contact: [-10.; 2],
        }
    }
    pub fn reset_tracking(&mut self) {
        self.tracking_ready = false;
        self.accumulator = 0.;
        self.paddle_velocity = [Vec3::ZERO; 2];
    }
    pub fn reset(&mut self) {
        let panel = self.score_panel;
        let practice = self.practice;
        *self = Self::new(self.ids[0], self.ids[1], self.ids[2]);
        self.score_panel = panel;
        self.practice = practice;
    }
    pub fn set_practice(&mut self, enabled: bool) {
        self.practice = enabled;
        self.reset();
    }
    pub fn move_player(&mut self, x: f32, y: f32) {
        if x.is_finite() && y.is_finite() {
            self.command = Some(Vec3::new(x.clamp(-1.1, 1.1), y.clamp(0.82, 1.8), -0.65));
        }
    }
    pub fn serve(&mut self) {
        if self.practice {
            self.drop_pending = true;
            return;
        }
        if self.phase == "rally" || self.winner.is_some() {
            return;
        }
        self.sequence += 1;
        let direction = if self.server == 0 { -1. } else { 1. };
        let x = match self.sequence % 3 {
            0 => -0.28,
            1 => 0.,
            _ => 0.28,
        };
        self.position = Vec3::new(x, 1.1, NET_Z - direction * 1.12);
        self.velocity = Vec3::new(-x * 0.5, -1.5, direction * 3.5);
        self.spin = Vec3::ZERO;
        self.last_hit = self.server;
        self.own_bounce = true;
        self.bounces = 0;
        self.rally_hits = 0;
        self.phase = "rally";
        self.event = "serve";
    }
    pub fn state(&self) -> Value {
        json!({"score":self.score,"server":self.server,"winner":self.winner,"phase":self.phase,"event":self.event,
        "rallyHits":self.rally_hits,"ballPosition":self.position.to_array(),"ballVelocity":self.velocity.to_array(),"ballSpin":self.spin.to_array(),
        "practice":self.practice,"paddleVelocity":self.paddle_velocity[0].to_array(),"ballRadius":RADIUS,"paddleFacePosition":self.paddles[0].to_array(),"paddleNormal":(self.orientations[0]*Vec3::X).to_array()})
    }
    pub fn tick(&mut self, scene: &mut SceneManager, dt: f32) {
        if !dt.is_finite() || dt <= 0. || self.ids.iter().any(|id| !scene.object_exists(*id)) {
            return;
        }
        let old = Pose {
            center: self.paddles[0],
            orientation: self.orientations[0],
        };
        let target = if let Some(p) = self.command.take() {
            let q = rotation(if self.practice {
                PRACTICE_ROTATION
            } else {
                DESKTOP_ROTATION
            });
            let grip = p - q * PADDLE_FACE_OFFSET;
            let (y, x, z) = q.to_euler(EulerRot::YXZ);
            scene.set_object_transform(self.ids[1], grip, Vec3::new(x, y, z), Vec3::ONE);
            Pose {
                center: p,
                orientation: q,
            }
        } else {
            let t = scene.objects()[&self.ids[1]].transform;
            Pose {
                center: t.model().transform_point3(PADDLE_FACE_OFFSET),
                orientation: rotation(t.rotation),
            }
        };
        let valid = target.center.abs().max_element() < 100.;
        let continuous = valid
            && self.tracking_ready
            && dt <= 0.1
            && old.center.distance(target.center) <= 1.
            && old.orientation.angle_between(target.orientation) < 2.4;
        let start = if continuous { old } else { target };
        self.tracking_ready = valid;
        self.player_target = target.center;
        self.player_orientation = target.orientation;
        self.paddles[0] = start.center;
        self.orientations[0] = start.orientation;
        if self.drop_pending && valid {
            self.drop_pending = false;
            self.position = target.center + Vec3::Y * 0.42;
            self.velocity = Vec3::ZERO;
            self.spin = Vec3::ZERO;
            self.rally_hits = 0;
            self.phase = "rally";
            self.event = "drop";
            self.last_contact = [-10.; 2];
        }
        if !continuous {
            self.accumulator = 0.;
        }
        self.accumulator += f64::from(dt.min(0.1));
        let horizon = self.accumulator as f32;
        let steps = (self.accumulator / f64::from(STEP) + 1e-7).floor() as u32;
        for i in 0..steps {
            let alpha = (((i + 1) as f32 * STEP) / horizon).min(1.);
            let orientation = start
                .orientation
                .slerp(target.orientation, alpha)
                .normalize();
            let grip_start = start.center - start.orientation * PADDLE_FACE_OFFSET;
            let grip_end = target.center - target.orientation * PADDLE_FACE_OFFSET;
            let end = Pose {
                center: grip_start.lerp(grip_end, alpha) + orientation * PADDLE_FACE_OFFSET,
                orientation,
            };
            self.step_to(STEP, end);
            self.accumulator -= f64::from(STEP);
        }
        // Render exactly the integrated orientation, including the visible spin marks.
        let (y, x, z) = self.ball_rotation.to_euler(EulerRot::YXZ);
        scene.set_object_position(self.ids[0], self.position);
        scene.set_object_rotation(self.ids[0], Vec3::new(x, y, z));
        let ai = self.orientations[1];
        let (y, x, z) = ai.to_euler(EulerRot::YXZ);
        scene.set_object_transform(
            self.ids[2],
            if self.practice {
                Vec3::splat(-10000.)
            } else {
                self.paddles[1] - ai * PADDLE_FACE_OFFSET
            },
            Vec3::new(x, y, z),
            Vec3::ONE,
        );
        if let Some(p) = self
            .score_panel
            .and_then(|id| scene.info_panels.get_mut(&id))
        {
            p.update(vec![(
                "",
                if self.practice {
                    format!("ODRAZY {}", self.rally_hits)
                } else {
                    format!("{} : {}", self.score[0], self.score[1])
                },
            )]);
        }
    }
    fn point(&mut self, winner: usize, reason: &'static str) {
        if self.practice || self.phase != "rally" {
            return;
        }
        self.score[winner] += 1;
        self.event = reason;
        self.velocity = Vec3::ZERO;
        if self.score[winner] >= 11 && self.score[winner] >= self.score[1 - winner] + 2 {
            self.winner = Some(winner);
            self.phase = "finished";
        } else {
            self.phase = "point";
            self.delay = 1.15;
            let total = self.score[0] + self.score[1];
            self.server = if total >= 20 {
                (total % 2) as usize
            } else {
                ((total / 2) % 2) as usize
            };
        }
    }
    fn bounce(&mut self) {
        if self.practice {
            return;
        }
        let side = if self.position.z > NET_Z { 0 } else { 1 };
        if self.own_bounce {
            if side != self.last_hit {
                self.point(1 - self.last_hit, "serve_fault");
                return;
            }
            self.own_bounce = false;
        } else if side == self.last_hit {
            self.point(1 - self.last_hit, "wrong_side");
        } else {
            self.bounces += 1;
            if self.bounces >= 2 {
                self.point(self.last_hit, "double_bounce");
            }
        }
    }
    fn ai_pose(&self, dt: f32) -> Pose {
        if self.practice {
            return Pose {
                center: self.paddles[1],
                orientation: self.orientations[1],
            };
        }
        let travel = if self.velocity.z < -0.1 {
            ((-3.7 - self.position.z) / self.velocity.z).clamp(0., 0.45)
        } else {
            0.
        };
        let striking = self.velocity.z < -0.1 && (self.position.z - self.paddles[1].z).abs() < 0.45;
        let target = Vec3::new(
            (self.position.x + self.velocity.x * travel).clamp(-0.9, 0.9),
            (self.position.y + self.velocity.y * travel - 4.905 * travel * travel).clamp(0.8, 1.6),
            if striking { -3.35 } else { -3.75 },
        );
        let center = self.paddles[1]
            + (target - self.paddles[1]).clamp_length_max(if striking {
                1.3 * dt
            } else {
                2.2 * dt
            });
        let desired = Vec3::new(
            (-self.position.x / 0.65).clamp(-1., 1.),
            (SURFACE - self.position.y) / 0.65 + 4.905 * 0.65,
            (-1.35 - self.position.z) / 0.65,
        );
        let n = if self.velocity.z < -0.1 {
            (desired - self.velocity).normalize_or_zero()
        } else {
            Vec3::Z
        };
        let q =
            Quat::from_rotation_arc(Vec3::X, if n.length_squared() > 0.5 { n } else { Vec3::Z });
        let max_angle = 6. * dt;
        let angle = self.orientations[1].angle_between(q);
        Pose {
            center,
            orientation: self.orientations[1]
                .slerp(
                    q,
                    if angle > max_angle {
                        max_angle / angle
                    } else {
                        1.
                    },
                )
                .normalize(),
        }
    }
    #[cfg(test)]
    fn step(&mut self, dt: f32) {
        self.step_to(
            dt,
            Pose {
                center: self.paddles[0],
                orientation: self.orientations[0],
            },
        );
    }
    fn step_to(&mut self, dt: f32, human_end: Pose) {
        self.time += dt;
        let motions = [
            Motion {
                start: Pose {
                    center: self.paddles[0],
                    orientation: self.orientations[0],
                },
                end: human_end,
                duration: dt,
            },
            Motion {
                start: Pose {
                    center: self.paddles[1],
                    orientation: self.orientations[1],
                },
                end: self.ai_pose(dt),
                duration: dt,
            },
        ];
        for (i, m) in motions.iter().enumerate() {
            self.paddles[i] = m.end.center;
            self.orientations[i] = m.end.orientation;
            self.paddle_velocity[i] = (m.end.center - m.start.center) / dt;
        }
        if self.phase != "rally" {
            if !self.practice && self.winner.is_none() {
                self.delay -= dt;
                if self.delay <= 0. {
                    self.serve();
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        // Approximate quadratic air drag and Magnus lift; coefficients are exposed here for calibration.
        let acceleration = -Vec3::Y * 9.81 - self.velocity * self.velocity.length() * 0.14
            + self.spin.cross(self.velocity) * 0.0008;
        self.velocity += acceleration * dt;
        self.spin *= (-0.35 * dt).exp();
        self.ball_rotation =
            (Quat::from_scaled_axis(self.spin * dt) * self.ball_rotation).normalize();
        let mut remaining = dt;
        for _ in 0..8 {
            if remaining < 1e-7 || self.phase != "rally" {
                break;
            }
            let start = self.position;
            let end = start + self.velocity * remaining;
            let elapsed = dt - remaining;
            let mut hit = 0;
            let mut fraction = 1.;
            let mut paddle_contact = None;
            if self.velocity.y < 0. {
                for (plane, kind) in [(SURFACE, 1), (RADIUS, 2)] {
                    if start.y >= plane && end.y <= plane {
                        let t = (start.y - plane) / (start.y - end.y);
                        let p = start.lerp(end, t);
                        if t <= fraction
                            && (kind == 2 || (p.x.abs() <= 0.7625 && p.z >= -3.57 && p.z <= -0.83))
                        {
                            fraction = t;
                            hit = kind;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if self.velocity.z.abs() > 1e-6 {
                let face = NET_Z - self.velocity.z.signum() * (RADIUS + 0.008);
                let t = (face - start.z) / (end.z - start.z);
                if t >= 0. && t <= fraction {
                    let p = start.lerp(end, t);
                    if p.x.abs() <= 0.78 + RADIUS && p.y <= 0.9125 + RADIUS && p.y >= 0.76 - RADIUS
                    {
                        fraction = t;
                        hit = 3;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (i, motion) in motions.iter().enumerate() {
                if (i == 0 && !self.tracking_ready) || (i == 1 && self.practice) {
                    continue;
                }
                let slice = Motion {
                    start: pose_lerp(motion.start, motion.end, elapsed / dt),
                    end: motion.end,
                    duration: remaining,
                };
                if let Some(c) =
                    contact::sweep_ball(start, end, RADIUS, slice, PADDLE_RADIUS, PADDLE_HALF)
                {
                    if c.fraction <= fraction {
                        fraction = c.fraction;
                        hit = 4 + i;
                        paddle_contact = Some(c);
                    }
                }
            }
            self.position = start.lerp(end, fraction);
            remaining *= 1. - fraction;
            match hit {
                0 => break,
                1 | 2 => {
                    if hit == 1 {
                        self.bounce();
                    } else if !self.practice {
                        let winner = if !self.own_bounce && self.bounces > 0 {
                            self.last_hit
                        } else {
                            1 - self.last_hit
                        };
                        self.point(winner, "floor");
                    }
                    if self.phase == "rally" {
                        let c = Contact {
                            fraction,
                            normal: Vec3::Y,
                            point: self.position - Vec3::Y * RADIUS,
                            surface_velocity: Vec3::ZERO,
                            corrected_center: self.position + Vec3::Y * 0.00001,
                        };
                        let e = if self.velocity.y.abs() < 0.25 {
                            0.
                        } else if hit == 1 {
                            0.89
                        } else {
                            0.55
                        };
                        (self.velocity, self.spin) =
                            contact::resolve(self.velocity, self.spin, &c, RADIUS, e, 0.16);
                        self.position = c.corrected_center;
                        self.event = if hit == 1 { "bounce" } else { "floor" };
                    }
                }
                3 => {
                    if self.practice {
                        self.velocity.z = -self.velocity.z * 0.25;
                        self.position.z += self.velocity.z.signum() * 0.0001;
                        self.event = "net";
                    } else {
                        self.point(1 - self.last_hit, "net");
                    }
                }
                _ => {
                    let i = hit - 4;
                    let c = paddle_contact.unwrap();
                    let closing = -(self.velocity - c.surface_velocity).dot(c.normal);
                    self.position = c.corrected_center;
                    let e = if closing < 0.25 { 0. } else { 0.85 };
                    (self.velocity, self.spin) =
                        contact::resolve(self.velocity, self.spin, &c, RADIUS, e, 0.22);
                    if closing > 0.25 && self.time - self.last_contact[i] > 0.08 {
                        self.last_contact[i] = self.time;
                        if !self.practice
                            && (i == self.last_hit || self.own_bounce || self.bounces == 0)
                        {
                            self.point(1 - i, "volley");
                            break;
                        }
                        self.last_hit = i;
                        self.bounces = 0;
                        self.rally_hits += 1;
                        self.event = "paddle";
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if self.phase == "rally"
            && (self.position.y < -0.1
                || self.position.z < -6.
                || self.position.z > 2.
                || self.position.x.abs() > 4.)
        {
            if self.practice {
                self.phase = "ready";
                self.velocity = Vec3::ZERO;
                self.event = "out";
            } else {
                let w = if !self.own_bounce && self.bounces > 0 {
                    self.last_hit
                } else {
                    1 - self.last_hit
                };
                self.point(w, "out");
            }
        }
    }
}

mod tests {

    fn rally() -> Game {
        let mut g = Game::new(1, 2, 3);
        g.tracking_ready = true;
        g.serve();
        g
    }
    #[test]
    fn serve_bounces_on_both_sides() {
        let mut g = rally();
        for _ in 0..170 {
            g.step(STEP);
        }
        assert!(!g.own_bounce);
        assert!(g.bounces > 0 || g.rally_hits > 0);

    }

        g.position = Vec3::new(0., 1., -3.);
        g.velocity = Vec3::new(0., -150., 0.);
        g.step(STEP);
        assert!(g.velocity.y > 0.);
        assert_eq!(g.bounces, 1);
        let mut g = rally();
        g.position = Vec3::new(0., 0.86, -2.);
        g.velocity = Vec3::new(0., 0., -150.);
        g.step(STEP);
        assert_eq!(g.score, [0, 1]);
        assert_eq!(g.event, "net");
    }

        let mut g = rally();
        g.last_hit = 1;
        g.own_bounce = false;
        g.bounces = 1;
        g.position = Vec3::new(0., 1., -0.95);
        g.velocity = Vec3::new(0., 0., 150.);

        assert_eq!(g.last_hit, 0);
        assert!(g.velocity.z < 0.);
        let mut g = rally();

        g.own_bounce = false;
        g.bounces = 1;
        g.position = Vec3::new(0.6, 1., -0.95);
        g.velocity = Vec3::new(0., 0., 150.);
        g.step(STEP);
        assert_eq!(g.last_hit, 1);
    }
    #[test]
    fn legality_scoring_and_win_by_two() {
        let mut g = rally();
        g.own_bounce = false;
        g.position.z = -3.;
        g.bounce();
        g.bounce();
        assert_eq!(g.score, [1, 0]);
        g.score = [10, 10];
        g.phase = "rally";
        g.point(0, "out");
        assert!(g.winner.is_none());
        g.phase = "rally";
        g.point(0, "out");
        assert_eq!(g.winner, Some(0));
        g.reset();
        assert_eq!(g.score, [0, 0]);
        assert_eq!(g.phase, "ready");
        assert_eq!(g.ids, [1, 2, 3]);
    }
    #[test]
    fn frame_splitting_is_stable() {
        let mut a = rally();
        let mut b = rally();
        // Same fixed-step accumulator path as tick, without scene fixtures.
        for _ in 0..60 {
            a.accumulator += 1. / 60.;
            while a.accumulator + 1e-10 >= f64::from(STEP) {
                a.step(STEP);
                a.accumulator -= f64::from(STEP);
            }
        }
        for _ in 0..120 {
            b.accumulator += 1. / 120.;
            while b.accumulator + 1e-10 >= f64::from(STEP) {
                b.step(STEP);
                b.accumulator -= f64::from(STEP);
            }
        }
        assert_eq!(a.score, b.score);
        assert!((a.position - b.position).length() < 1e-6);
    }
    fn scene_game() -> (SceneManager, Game) {

        scene.set_object_rotation(player, DESKTOP_ROTATION);

        game.paddles[0] = Vec3::new(0., 1., -0.4);
        game.serve();
        game.last_hit = 1;
        game.own_bounce = false;
        game.bounces = 1;
        game.position = Vec3::new(0., 1., -0.7);
        game.velocity = Vec3::ZERO;
        (scene, game)
    }
    #[test]
    fn actual_tick_sweeps_moving_paddle_at_30_and_120_hz() {
        for hz in [30, 120] {
            let (mut scene, mut game) = scene_game();
            for frame in 1..=hz / 10 {
                scene.set_object_position(
                    game.ids[1],

                );

            }
            assert_eq!(game.last_hit, 0, "rate {hz}");
            assert_eq!(game.rally_hits, 1);
        }
    }

        // Ball crosses the face at a point outside a hypothetical disk at the hand.

    }

    }

    }

        g.practice = true;

            "height {}",
            apex - SURFACE
        );
    }

# File: src/table_tennis_contact.rs
//! Sphere CCD against a translating/rotating finite paddle, with physical impulses.
//! The pose is the centre of the blade (not the grip); local X is its normal.
use glam::{Quat, Vec3};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct Pose {
    pub center: Vec3,
    pub orientation: Quat,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct Motion {
    pub start: Pose,
    pub end: Pose,
    pub duration: f32,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct Contact {
    pub fraction: f32,
    pub normal: Vec3,
    /// Point on the actual blade, before the sphere-radius expansion.
    pub point: Vec3,
    pub surface_velocity: Vec3,
    pub corrected_center: Vec3,
}

// Exact signed distance and nearest surface point for a solid finite cylinder.
// Expanding this distance by the ball radius gives the rounded rim, rather than
// treating an infinite plane (or the blade's bounding sphere) as the collider.
fn cylinder(p: Vec3, radius: f32, half: f32) -> (f32, Vec3, Vec3) {
    let radial = Vec3::new(0., p.y, p.z);
    let length = radial.length();
    let radial_normal = if length > 1e-12 {
        radial / length
    } else {
        Vec3::Y
    };
    let axial_normal = Vec3::X * if p.x < 0. { -1. } else { 1. };
    let axial_gap = p.x.abs() - half;
    let radial_gap = length - radius;
    if axial_gap > 0. || radial_gap > 0. {
        let point = Vec3::X * p.x.clamp(-half, half) + radial_normal * length.min(radius);
        let delta = p - point;
        let distance = delta.length();
        (distance, delta / distance, point)
    } else if axial_gap >= radial_gap {
        (axial_gap, axial_normal, p - axial_normal * axial_gap)
    } else {
        (radial_gap, radial_normal, p - radial_normal * radial_gap)
    }
}

pub fn sweep_ball(
    start: Vec3,
    end: Vec3,
    ball_radius: f32,
    motion: Motion,
    paddle_radius: f32,
    half_thickness: f32,
) -> Option<Contact> {
    if !start.is_finite()
        || !end.is_finite()
        || !motion.start.center.is_finite()
        || !motion.end.center.is_finite()
        || !motion.start.orientation.is_finite()
        || !motion.end.orientation.is_finite()
        || motion.start.orientation.length_squared() < 1e-12
        || motion.end.orientation.length_squared() < 1e-12
        || !motion.duration.is_finite()
        || motion.duration <= 0.
        || !ball_radius.is_finite()
        || ball_radius <= 0.
        || !paddle_radius.is_finite()
        || paddle_radius <= 0.
        || !half_thickness.is_finite()
        || half_thickness < 0.
    {
        return None;
    }
    let q0 = motion.start.orientation.normalize();
    let mut q1 = motion.end.orientation.normalize();
    if q0.dot(q1) < 0. {
        q1 = -q1;
    }
    let rotation = (q1 * q0.conjugate()).normalize();
    let (axis, angle) = rotation.to_axis_angle();
    let omega = axis * (angle / motion.duration);
    let translation = motion.end.center - motion.start.center;
    let linear_velocity = translation / motion.duration;
    // A global bound on how fast the distance to any point of the blade can
    // decrease, per unit fraction. This remains valid when the rim rotates into
    // a stationary ball, and avoids time sampling that tunnels at high speed.
    let bound =
        (end - start - translation).length() + angle.abs() * paddle_radius.hypot(half_thickness);
    // Include the interpolation arithmetic's absolute error at large travel or
    // world coordinates. Otherwise a 200 m sweep can stall one fraction-ulp
    // before impact even though its residual gap is just a few micrometres.
    let coordinate_scale = start
        .abs()
        .max(end.abs())
        .max(motion.start.center.abs())
        .max(motion.end.center.abs())
        .max_element();
    let tolerance = 1e-6_f32
        .max(ball_radius * 1e-5)
        .max(coordinate_scale * (4. * f32::EPSILON));
    let mut fraction = 0.;
    for _ in 0..512 {
        let orientation = q0.slerp(q1, fraction).normalize();
        let center = motion.start.center + translation * fraction;
        let ball = start.lerp(end, fraction);
        let (distance, local_normal, local_point) = cylinder(
            orientation.conjugate() * (ball - center),
            paddle_radius,
            half_thickness,
        );
        let separation = distance - ball_radius;
        if separation <= tolerance {
            let normal = orientation * local_normal;
            let offset = orientation * local_point;
            let point = center + offset;
            return Some(Contact {
                fraction,
                normal,
                point,
                surface_velocity: linear_velocity + omega.cross(offset),
                corrected_center: point + normal * (ball_radius + 2. * tolerance),
            });
        }
        if bound <= 1e-12 || fraction >= 1. {
            return None;
        }
        let next = fraction + separation / bound;
        if next > 1. {
            return None;
        }
        // Floating point stagnation can only occur within sub-ulp distance of
        // a grazing configuration; never jump an arbitrary time interval.
        if next <= fraction {
            return None;
        }
        fraction = next;
    }
    None
}

/// Unit-mass impulse response for a thin hollow ball: I/m = 2 R² / 3.
/// Restitution acts on relative normal speed; Coulomb friction couples spin and
/// translation. A separating overlap is corrected by CCD but gets no impulse.
pub fn resolve(
    velocity: Vec3,
    spin: Vec3,
    contact: &Contact,
    ball_radius: f32,
    restitution: f32,
    friction: f32,
) -> (Vec3, Vec3) {
    if ball_radius <= 0. || !ball_radius.is_finite() {
        return (velocity, spin);
    }
    let normal = contact.normal;
    let arm = -normal * ball_radius;
    let relative = velocity + spin.cross(arm) - contact.surface_velocity;
    let normal_speed = relative.dot(normal);
    if normal_speed >= 0. {
        return (velocity, spin);
    }
    let normal_impulse = -(1. + restitution.clamp(0., 1.)) * normal_speed;
    let slip = relative - normal * normal_speed;
    // 1/m + R²/I = 5/(2m), so a unit-mass no-slip impulse is slip / 2.5.
    let mut tangent_impulse = -slip / 2.5;
    let limit = friction.max(0.) * normal_impulse;
    let tangent_length = tangent_impulse.length();
    if tangent_length > limit {
        tangent_impulse *= limit / tangent_length;
    }
    let new_velocity = velocity + normal * normal_impulse + tangent_impulse;
    let new_spin = spin + arm.cross(tangent_impulse) * (1.5 / (ball_radius * ball_radius));
    (new_velocity, new_spin)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn motion(q: Quat) -> Motion {
        let pose = Pose {
            center: Vec3::ZERO,
            orientation: q,
        };
        Motion {
            start: pose,
            end: pose,
            duration: 0.01,
        }
    }
    fn hit(start: Vec3, end: Vec3, motion: Motion) -> Contact {
        sweep_ball(start, end, 0.02, motion, 0.085, 0.005).unwrap()
    }

    #[test]
    fn falling_ball_rebounds_from_horizontal_paddle() {
        let m = motion(Quat::from_rotation_z(std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2));
        let c = hit(Vec3::Y * 0.05, Vec3::Y * -0.05, m);
        let (v, w) = resolve(-Vec3::Y * 10., Vec3::ZERO, &c, 0.02, 0.8, 0.5);
        assert!((v - Vec3::Y * 8.).length() < 1e-4);
        assert!(w.length() < 1e-3);
        assert!((c.fraction - 0.25).abs() < 1e-4);
    }

    #[test]
    fn tilted_face_reflects_about_actual_normal() {
        let q = Quat::from_rotation_z(0.6);
        let n = q * Vec3::X;
        let c = hit(n * 0.1, -n * 0.1, motion(q));
        let (v, _) = resolve(-n * 5., Vec3::ZERO, &c, 0.02, 1., 0.);
        assert!((v - n * 5.).length() < 1e-4);
    }

    #[test]
    fn faster_paddle_produces_stronger_rebound() {
        let still = motion(Quat::IDENTITY);
        let mut moving = still;
        moving.end.center.x = 0.02;
        let c0 = hit(Vec3::X * 0.08, -Vec3::X * 0.02, still);
        let c1 = hit(Vec3::X * 0.08, -Vec3::X * 0.02, moving);
        let (v0, _) = resolve(-Vec3::X * 10., Vec3::ZERO, &c0, 0.02, 0.8, 0.);
        let (v1, _) = resolve(-Vec3::X * 10., Vec3::ZERO, &c1, 0.02, 0.8, 0.);
        assert!((v1.x - v0.x - 3.6).abs() < 1e-4);
    }

    #[test]
    fn tangential_brush_transfers_spin_without_increasing_energy() {
        let c = hit(Vec3::X * 0.1, -Vec3::X * 0.1, motion(Quat::IDENTITY));
        let input = Vec3::new(-5., 4., 0.);
        let (v, w) = resolve(input, Vec3::ZERO, &c, 0.02, 1., 0.5);
        assert!(v.y > 0. && v.y < input.y);
        assert!(w.z > 0.);
        let energy = v.length_squared() + 2. / 3. * 0.02_f32.powi(2) * w.length_squared();
        assert!(energy <= input.length_squared() + 1e-4);
        assert!((v + w.cross(-Vec3::X * 0.02)).y.abs() < 1e-4);
    }

    #[test]
    fn high_speed_sweep_and_rounded_edge() {
        let m = motion(Quat::IDENTITY);
        let c = hit(Vec3::new(100., 0.095, 0.), Vec3::new(-100., 0.095, 0.), m);
        assert!(c.normal.x > 0.8 && c.normal.y > 0.45);
        assert!((c.point.y - 0.085).abs() < 1e-5);
        assert!(sweep_ball(
            Vec3::new(100., 0.106, 0.),
            Vec3::new(-100., 0.106, 0.),
            0.02,
            m,
            0.085,
            0.005
        )
        .is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn fast_rotating_edge_hits_stationary_ball() {
        let mut m = motion(Quat::IDENTITY);
        m.end.orientation = Quat::from_rotation_z(2.8);
        let ball = Vec3::new(0.075, 0., 0.);
        let c = hit(ball, ball, m);
        assert!(c.fraction > 0. && c.fraction < 1.);
        assert!(c.surface_velocity.length() > 10.);
        let (v, _) = resolve(Vec3::ZERO, Vec3::ZERO, &c, 0.02, 0.8, 0.3);
        assert!(v.length() > 1.);
    }

    #[test]
    fn separating_overlap_does_not_bounce_again() {
        let c = hit(Vec3::X * 0.024, Vec3::X * 0.04, motion(Quat::IDENTITY));
        let input = Vec3::X * 2.;
        let spin = Vec3::Y * 30.;
        assert_eq!(resolve(input, spin, &c, 0.02, 0.9, 0.5), (input, spin));
        assert!(c.corrected_center.x > 0.025);
    }
}

//! Native test fixtures only. Browser examples live in examples/<name>/scene.js.

impl SceneManager {
    pub fn load_culling_demo(&mut self) {
        self.clear();
        for x in 0..20 {
            for y in 0..25 {
                for z in 0..20 {
                    let position = Vec3::new(
                        (x as f32 - 9.5) * 3.0,
                        (y as f32 - 12.0) * 1.8,
                        (z as f32 - 9.5) * 3.0,
                    );
                    self.add_object(
                        MeshKind::Cube,
                        Transform::new(position, Vec3::ZERO, Vec3::splat(0.65)),
                    );
                }
            }
        }
        for position in [
            Vec3::new(-20.0, 20.0, -20.0),
            Vec3::new(20.0, 20.0, 20.0),
            Vec3::new(-20.0, -20.0, 20.0),
            Vec3::new(20.0, -20.0, -20.0),
        ] {
            self.add_light(position, Vec3::splat(0.35));
        }
    }
    pub fn load_effects_demo(&mut self) {
        self.clear();
        self.paused = false;
        let static_options = RenderOptions {
            is_static: true,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let floor = self.add_object(

                casts_shadow: false,

            },
        );

            mirror,

                reflectivity: 0.94,
                ..static_options
            },
        );
        for position in [
            Vec3::new(-2.3, -0.3, 0.0),

        ] {
            let id = self.add_cube(position);
            self.set_render_options(id, static_options);
        }
        // Thin frame makes the finite mirror surface easy to identify.
        for (position, scale) in [
            (Vec3::new(0.0, 2.08, -3.0), Vec3::new(5.8, 0.16, 0.18)),
            (Vec3::new(0.0, -1.08, -3.0), Vec3::new(5.8, 0.16, 0.18)),
            (Vec3::new(-2.83, 0.5, -3.0), Vec3::new(0.16, 3.3, 0.18)),
