        ] {
            let id = self.add_object(MeshKind::Cube, Transform::new(position, Vec3::ZERO, scale));
            self.set_render_options(id, static_options);
        }
        let cube = self.add_object(
            MeshKind::Cube,
            Transform::new(
                Vec3::new(0.0, 0.1, 0.0),
                Vec3::ZERO,
                Vec3::new(1.2, 1.5, 1.0),
            ),
        );
        self.set_object_spin(cube, Vec3::new(0.25, 0.8, 0.1));
        let sphere = self.add_object(
            MeshKind::Sphere,
            Transform::new(
                Vec3::new(1.8, 0.5, -1.2),
                Vec3::ZERO,
                Vec3::new(0.5, 1.0, 0.5),
            ),
        );
        self.set_object_spin(sphere, Vec3::new(0.0, 0.0, 0.55));
        // Warm key light and blue fill; both illuminate the scene and its reflection.
        self.add_light(Vec3::new(-2.5, 3.0, -1.5), Vec3::new(0.8, 0.224, 0.056));
        self.add_light(Vec3::new(2.5, 2.0, 2.0), Vec3::new(0.052, 0.234, 0.65));
    }
    pub fn load_example(&mut self) {
        self.clear();
        self.add_object(
            MeshKind::Plane,
            Transform::new(
                Vec3::new(0.0, -0.6, 0.0),
                Vec3::ZERO,
                Vec3::new(8.0, 1.0, 8.0),
            ),
        );
        self.add_cube(Vec3::ZERO);
        self.add_object(
            MeshKind::Sphere,
            Transform::new(Vec3::new(1.8, 0.4, 0.2), Vec3::ZERO, Vec3::splat(0.6)),
        );
        self.add_light(Vec3::new(2.5, 3.0, 2.5), Vec3::ONE);
        self.add_light(Vec3::new(-2.0, 1.5, -1.5), Vec3::new(0.2, 0.6, 1.0));
    }
}


# File: src/translucency.rs
//! Conservative triangle filtering in the original GPU vertex/index address space.
use crate::gltf_loader::ImportedMesh;

pub(crate) fn alpha_indices(mesh: &ImportedMesh, opaque_above: f32) -> Option<Vec<u32>> {
    if !opaque_above.is_finite() || !mesh.indices.len().is_multiple_of(3) {
        return None;
    }
    let mut indices = Vec::new();
    for triangle in mesh.indices.as_chunks::<3>().0 {
        let colors = [
            mesh.vertices.get(triangle[0] as usize)?.color,
            mesh.vertices.get(triangle[1] as usize)?.color,
            mesh.vertices.get(triangle[2] as usize)?.color,
        ];
        // A common channel above the cutoff stays opaque under perspective
        // interpolation. Different bright channels alone do not prove opacity.
        let opaque = (0..3).any(|channel| {
            colors
                .iter()
                .all(|color| color[channel].is_finite() && color[channel] >= opaque_above)
        });
        if !opaque {
            indices.extend_from_slice(triangle);
        }
    }
    Some(indices)
}

/// Union in the shared face-expanded index space: any variant may need a facet.
pub(crate) fn variant_alpha_indices(
    colors: &[[f32; 4]],
    triangles: usize,
    threshold: f32,
) -> Vec<u32> {
    let mut needed = vec![false; triangles];
    for colors in colors.chunks_exact(triangles) {
        for (triangle, color) in colors.iter().enumerate() {
            needed[triangle] |= color[..3].iter().all(|channel| *channel < threshold);
        }
    }
    needed
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .filter(|(_, needed)| **needed)
        .flat_map(|(triangle, _)| {
            [
                triangle as u32 * 3,
                triangle as u32 * 3 + 1,
                triangle as u32 * 3 + 2,
            ]
        })
        .collect()
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::gltf_loader::ImportedVertex;

    #[test]
    fn shared_variants_alpha_subset_is_conservative_union() {
        let table = [
            [0.9, 0., 0., 1.],
            [0.1, 0., 0., 1.],
            [0.1, 0., 0., 1.],
            [0.9, 0., 0., 1.],
        ];
        assert_eq!(
            variant_alpha_indices(&table, 2, 0.25),
            vec![0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
        );
        assert_eq!(variant_alpha_indices(&table, 2, 0.05), Vec::<u32>::new());
        let same = [
            [0.9, 0., 0., 1.],
            [0.1, 0., 0., 1.],
            [0.9, 0., 0., 1.],
            [0.2, 0., 0., 1.],
        ];
        assert_eq!(variant_alpha_indices(&same, 2, 0.25), vec![3, 4, 5]);
    }
    #[test]
    fn alpha_subset_preserves_gradient_cutoff_and_original_indices() {
        let colors = [
            [1., 0., 0.],
            [0., 1., 0.],
            [0., 0., 1.],
            [0.5, 0., 0.],
            [0.5, 0.1, 0.],
            [0.5, 0., 0.1],
            [0.49, 0., 0.],
        ];
        let mesh = ImportedMesh {
            vertices: colors
                .into_iter()
                .map(|color| ImportedVertex {
                    color,
                    position: [0.; 3],
                    normal: [0.; 3],
                })
                .collect(),
            indices: vec![2, 0, 1, 5, 3, 4, 3, 6, 5],
            bounds_min: [0.; 3],
            bounds_max: [0.; 3],
            warnings: vec![],
        };
        assert_eq!(alpha_indices(&mesh, 0.5), Some(vec![2, 0, 1, 3, 6, 5]));
        assert_eq!(alpha_indices(&mesh, 0.), Some(vec![]));
        assert_eq!(alpha_indices(&mesh, f32::NAN), None);
        let mut invalid = mesh;
        invalid.indices.push(0);
        assert_eq!(alpha_indices(&invalid, 0.5), None);
        invalid.indices = vec![0, 1, 99];
        assert_eq!(alpha_indices(&invalid, 0.5), None);
    }
}


# File: src/visibility.rs
//! CPU visibility and render extraction; shared by native tests and WASM.
use crate::scene::{MeshKind, SceneManager, Transform};
use glam::{Mat4, Vec3, Vec4};

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, bytemuck::Pod, bytemuck::Zeroable)]
pub struct InstanceData {
    pub model: [[f32; 4]; 4],
    pub normal_matrix: [[f32; 4]; 4],
    pub material: [f32; 4],
    pub emission: [f32; 4],
    pub surface_params: [f32; 4],
}

impl InstanceData {
    /// Per-object visual fade packed into the homogeneous normal-matrix element.
    /// Normal directions use w=0, so this never changes their transformed xyz.
    pub fn visual_fade(&self) -> f32 {
        let packed = self.normal_matrix[3][3];
        if packed < 0.0 {
            -packed - 1.0
        } else {
            packed
        }
    }

    /// Fading opaque surfaces join the existing transparent overlay as well.
    pub fn needs_translucent_overlay(&self) -> bool {
        self.visual_fade() > 0.0
            && (self.visual_fade() < 1.0
                || (self.emission[2] < 1.0
                    && (self.emission[2] > 0.0 || self.surface_params[0] > 0.0)))
    }
}

pub(crate) struct ObjectRenderData {
    instance: InstanceData,
    center: Vec3,
    half_extent: Vec3,
}
impl ObjectRenderData {
    /// Reuse the same published root transform for glTF and primitive rendering.
    #[cfg(any(target_arch = "wasm32", test))]
    pub(crate) fn model(&self) -> Mat4 {
        Mat4::from_cols_array_2d(&self.instance.model)
    }
    pub(crate) fn plane_normal(&self) -> Vec3 {
        Mat4::from_cols_array_2d(&self.instance.normal_matrix)
            .transform_vector3(Vec3::Y)
            .normalize()
    }
    pub(crate) fn intersects(&self, frustum: &Frustum) -> bool {
        frustum.intersects_aabb(self.center, self.half_extent)
    }
    pub(crate) fn new(mesh: MeshKind, transform: Transform) -> Self {
        let local = match mesh {
            MeshKind::Cube => Vec3::splat(0.5),
            MeshKind::Plane => Vec3::new(0.5, 0.0, 0.5),
            MeshKind::Sphere => Vec3::ONE,
            MeshKind::Imported(_) => Vec3::ZERO,
        };
        Self::with_bounds(transform, -local, local)
    }
    pub(crate) fn with_bounds(transform: Transform, min: Vec3, max: Vec3) -> Self {
        let model = transform.model();
        let local = (max - min) * 0.5;
        let mut normal_matrix = crate::scene::normal_matrix(model).to_cols_array_2d();
        // This slot stores fade metadata. An affine inverse can round its w
        // element away from one; never let that imply unintended translucency.
        // Normal directions use w=0, so their transformation stays unchanged.
        normal_matrix[3][3] = 1.0;
        Self {
            instance: InstanceData {
                model: model.to_cols_array_2d(),
                normal_matrix,
                material: [0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0],
                emission: [0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 8.0],
                surface_params: [0.0, -1.0, 0.0, 0.0],
            },
            center: model.transform_point3((max + min) * 0.5),
            half_extent: model.x_axis.truncate().abs() * local.x
                + model.y_axis.truncate().abs() * local.y
                + model.z_axis.truncate().abs() * local.z,
        }
    }
}

pub struct Frustum {
    planes: [Vec4; 6],
    tolerance: [f32; 6],
}
impl Frustum {
    pub fn from_view_projection(matrix: Mat4) -> Self {
        let rows = matrix.transpose();
        let (x, y, z, w) = (rows.x_axis, rows.y_axis, rows.z_axis, rows.w_axis);
        // WebGPU clip volume: -w <= x,y <= w; 0 <= z <= w.
        let planes = [w + x, w - x, w + y, w - y, z, w - z];
        Self {
            tolerance: planes.map(|p| 1e-5 * p.truncate().length()),
            planes,
        }
    }
    /// Strict containment is a proof that every child AABB is also visible.
    /// Touching/partial/invalid bounds must retain the individual test path.
    #[cfg(any(test, target_arch = "wasm32"))]
    pub(crate) fn fully_contains_aabb(&self, center: Vec3, half_extent: Vec3) -> bool {
        center.is_finite()
            && half_extent.is_finite()
            && half_extent.cmpge(Vec3::ZERO).all()
            && self
                .planes
                .iter()
                .zip(self.tolerance)
                .all(|(plane, tolerance)| {
                    let normal = plane.truncate();
                    normal.dot(center) + plane.w - normal.abs().dot(half_extent) > tolerance
                })
    }
    pub fn intersects_aabb(&self, center: Vec3, half_extent: Vec3) -> bool {
        self.planes
            .iter()
            .zip(self.tolerance)
            .all(|(plane, tolerance)| {
                let normal = plane.truncate();
                let distance = normal.dot(center) + plane.w;
                let radius = normal.abs().dot(half_extent);
                // Conservative tolerance, scaled for unnormalized planes.
                distance + radius >= -tolerance
            })
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum RenderPassKind {
    Main,
    Reflection,
    ShadowStatic,
    ShadowDynamic,
    Environment,
}
impl RenderPassKind {
    pub fn index(self) -> usize {
        self as usize
    }
}

/// Query work is per extraction; rebuild counters include only tracked synchronizations.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Default, Debug)]
pub struct CullingStats {
    pub nodes_visited: usize,
    pub object_tests: usize,
    pub static_rebuilds: usize,
    pub dynamic_rebuilds: usize,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct VisibilityIndex {
    static_tree: crate::spatial::Bvh,
    dynamic_tree: crate::spatial::Bvh,
    static_revision: Option<u64>,
    render_revision: Option<u64>,
    totals: [usize; 5],
    static_rebuilds: usize,
    dynamic_rebuilds: usize,
}
impl VisibilityIndex {
    pub(crate) fn sync(&mut self, scene: &SceneManager, collect_stats: bool) {
        if self.render_revision == Some(scene.render_revision()) {
            return;
        }
        let rebuild_static = self.static_revision != Some(scene.static_revision());
        let mut statics = Vec::new();
        let mut dynamics = Vec::new();
        self.totals = [0; 5];
        for (&id, object) in scene.objects() {
            for pass in [
                RenderPassKind::Main,
                RenderPassKind::Reflection,
                RenderPassKind::ShadowStatic,
                RenderPassKind::ShadowDynamic,
                RenderPassKind::Environment,
            ] {
                self.totals[pass.index()] += usize::from(included(scene, id, object, pass));
            }
            let data = &object.render_data;
            let entry = (
                id,
                crate::spatial::Bounds {
                    center: data.center,
                    half_extent: data.half_extent,
                },
            );
            if object.render_options.is_static {
                if rebuild_static {
                    statics.push(entry);
                }
            } else {
                dynamics.push(entry);
            }
        }
        if rebuild_static {
            self.static_tree.update(&statics, true);
            if collect_stats {
                self.static_rebuilds += 1;
            }
            self.static_revision = Some(scene.static_revision());
        }
        let rebuilt = self.dynamic_tree.update(&dynamics, false);
        if collect_stats && rebuilt {
            self.dynamic_rebuilds += 1;
        }
        self.render_revision = Some(scene.render_revision());
    }
    fn query<const TRACK: bool>(
        &self,
        scene: &SceneManager,
        frustum: &Frustum,
        pass: RenderPassKind,
        output: &mut Vec<u32>,
    ) -> CullingStats {
        let mut stats = CullingStats {
            static_rebuilds: self.static_rebuilds,
            dynamic_rebuilds: self.dynamic_rebuilds,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let intersects =
            |b: crate::spatial::Bounds| frustum.intersects_aabb(b.center, b.half_extent);
        let eligible = |id| included(scene, id, &scene.objects()[&id], pass);
        if pass != RenderPassKind::ShadowDynamic {
            self.static_tree.query::<TRACK>(
                &intersects,
                &eligible,
                output,
                &mut stats.nodes_visited,
                &mut stats.object_tests,
            );
        }
        if pass != RenderPassKind::ShadowStatic && pass != RenderPassKind::Environment {
            self.dynamic_tree.query::<TRACK>(
                &intersects,
                &eligible,
                output,
                &mut stats.nodes_visited,
                &mut stats.object_tests,
            );
        }
        output.sort_unstable();
        stats
    }
}

fn included(
    scene: &SceneManager,
    id: u32,
    object: &crate::scene::SceneObject,
    pass: RenderPassKind,
) -> bool {
    if scene.is_numeric_panel(id) {
        return false;
    }
    let options = object.render_options;
    match pass {
        RenderPassKind::Main => true,
        RenderPassKind::Environment => options.is_static && Some(id) != scene.mirror_object,
        RenderPassKind::Reflection => Some(id) != scene.mirror_object,
        RenderPassKind::ShadowStatic => options.casts_shadow && options.is_static,
        RenderPassKind::ShadowDynamic => options.casts_shadow && !options.is_static,
    }
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct RenderQueue {
    pub batches: [Vec<InstanceData>; 3],
    pub imported: std::collections::BTreeMap<u32, Vec<InstanceData>>,
    pub total: usize,
    pub visible: usize,
    pub culling_stats: CullingStats,
    pub collect_stats: bool,
}
impl RenderQueue {
    pub fn extract(&mut self, scene: &SceneManager, view_projection: Mat4, culling: bool) {
        self.extract_pass(scene, view_projection, culling, RenderPassKind::Main);
    }
    pub fn extract_pass(
        &mut self,
        scene: &SceneManager,
        view_projection: Mat4,
        culling: bool,
        pass: RenderPassKind,
    ) {
        for batch in &mut self.batches {
            batch.clear();
        }
        self.imported.retain(|id, _| scene.mesh_exists(*id));
        for batch in self.imported.values_mut() {
            batch.clear();
        }
        self.total = 0;
        self.visible = 0;
        let frustum = Frustum::from_view_projection(view_projection);
        let mut candidates = Vec::new();
        self.culling_stats = CullingStats::default();
        if culling {
            let index = scene.visibility_index(self.collect_stats);
            self.total = if pass == RenderPassKind::Reflection {
                index.totals[RenderPassKind::Main.index()]
                    - usize::from(
                        scene
                            .mirror_object
                            .is_some_and(|id| scene.object_exists(id)),
                    )
            } else {
                index.totals[pass.index()]
            };
            self.culling_stats = if self.collect_stats {
                index.query::<true>(scene, &frustum, pass, &mut candidates)
            } else {
                index.query::<false>(scene, &frustum, pass, &mut candidates)
            };
        } else {
            candidates.extend(
                scene
                    .objects()
                    .iter()
                    .filter_map(|(&id, object)| included(scene, id, object, pass).then_some(id)),
            );
            self.total = candidates.len();
        }
        for id in &candidates {
            let object = &scene.objects()[id];
            let options = object.render_options;
            let data = &object.render_data;
            let index = match object.mesh {
                MeshKind::Cube => 0,
                MeshKind::Plane => 1,
                MeshKind::Sphere => 2,
                MeshKind::Imported(_) => 3,
            };
            let mut instance = data.instance;
            instance.normal_matrix[3][3] = if object.visual_dissolve {
                -(1.0 + object.visual_fade)
            } else {
                object.visual_fade
            };
            instance.emission[0] = object.emission;
            instance.emission[1] = object.color_cutout;
            instance.emission[2] = object.opacity;
            instance.emission[3] = object.opaque_above;
            instance.surface_params[0] = object.opacity_variation;
            instance.surface_params[1] = object.opacity_coverage;
            if let Some(&(handle, variant)) = scene.variant_instances.get(id) {
                instance.surface_params[2] = variant as f32;
                instance.surface_params[3] =
                    scene.mesh_variants[&handle].varying_triangles.len() as f32;
            }
            instance.material = [
                options.reflectivity,
                if options.receives_shadow { 1.0 } else { 0.0 },
                if Some(*id) == scene.mirror_object {
                    1.0
                } else {
                    0.0
                },
                // Negative material flag selects text; numeric tubes use their own profile.
                if scene.is_numeric_glyph(*id) {
                    -2.0
                } else if scene.is_text_object(*id) {
                    -1.0
                } else if scene.is_cuttable(*id) {
                    1.0
                } else {
                    0.0
                },
            ];
            if let MeshKind::Imported(mesh_id) = object.mesh {
                self.imported.entry(mesh_id).or_default().push(instance);
            } else {
                self.batches[index].push(instance);
            }
            self.visible += 1;
        }
    }
    /// Retained allocations are not proof of visibility in the current pass/eye.
    pub fn visible_imported_ids(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &u32> {
        self.imported
            .iter()
            .filter(|(_, instances)| !instances.is_empty())
            .map(|(id, _)| id)
    }
    pub fn draw_calls(&self) -> usize {
        self.batches
            .iter()
            .filter(|batch| !batch.is_empty())
            .count()
            + self
                .imported
                .values()
                .filter(|batch| !batch.is_empty())
                .count()
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    fn assert_brute_force(scene: &SceneManager, matrix: Mat4, pass: RenderPassKind, culling: bool) {
        let frustum = Frustum::from_view_projection(matrix);
        let mut expected = RenderQueue::default();
        for (&id, object) in scene.objects() {
            let options = object.render_options;
            let eligible = !scene.is_numeric_panel(id)
                && match pass {
                    RenderPassKind::Main => true,
                    RenderPassKind::Environment => {
                        options.is_static && Some(id) != scene.mirror_object
                    }
                    RenderPassKind::Reflection => Some(id) != scene.mirror_object,
                    RenderPassKind::ShadowStatic => options.is_static && options.casts_shadow,
                    RenderPassKind::ShadowDynamic => !options.is_static && options.casts_shadow,
                };
            if !eligible {
                continue;
            }
            expected.total += 1;
            if culling && !object.render_data.intersects(&frustum) {
                continue;
            }
            expected.visible += 1;
            let mut instance = object.render_data.instance;
            let options = object.render_options;
            instance.material = [
                options.reflectivity,
                if options.receives_shadow { 1.0 } else { 0.0 },
                if Some(id) == scene.mirror_object {
                    1.0
                } else {
                    0.0
                },
                if scene.is_numeric_glyph(id) {
                    -2.0
                } else if scene.is_text_object(id) {
                    -1.0
                } else if scene.is_cuttable(id) {
                    1.0
                } else {
                    0.0
                },
            ];
            match object.mesh {
                MeshKind::Cube => expected.batches[0].push(instance),
                MeshKind::Plane => expected.batches[1].push(instance),
                MeshKind::Sphere => expected.batches[2].push(instance),
                MeshKind::Imported(mesh) => {
                    expected.imported.entry(mesh).or_default().push(instance)
                }
            }
        }
        for track in [false, true] {
            let mut actual = RenderQueue {
                collect_stats: track,
                ..Default::default()
            };
            actual.extract_pass(scene, matrix, culling, pass);
            assert_eq!(
                (actual.total, actual.visible),
                (expected.total, expected.visible)
            );
            for (a, b) in actual.batches.iter().zip(&expected.batches) {
                assert_instances(a, b);
            }
            assert_eq!(
                actual.imported.values().filter(|v| !v.is_empty()).count(),
                expected.imported.len()
            );
            for (id, batch) in &expected.imported {
                assert_instances(&actual.imported[id], batch);
            }
            if !track || !culling {
                assert_eq!(
                    (
                        actual.culling_stats.nodes_visited,
                        actual.culling_stats.object_tests
                    ),
                    (0, 0)
                );
            }
        }
    }
    fn assert_instances(actual: &[InstanceData], expected: &[InstanceData]) {
        assert_eq!(actual.len(), expected.len());
        for (a, b) in actual.iter().zip(expected) {
            assert_eq!(a.model, b.model);
            assert_eq!(a.normal_matrix, b.normal_matrix);
            assert_eq!(a.material, b.material);
        }
    }
    fn compare_passes(scene: &SceneManager) {
        let reflected_view = Mat4::from_scale(Vec3::new(1.0, -1.0, 1.0))
            * Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(-2.0, -1.0, 0.0));
        for matrix in [
            camera(),
            camera() * reflected_view,
            crate::render_math::shadow_view_projection(Vec3::new(-3.0, 7.0, 4.0)),
            camera() * Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(-200.0, 0.0, 0.0)),
        ] {
            for pass in [
                RenderPassKind::Main,
                RenderPassKind::Reflection,
                RenderPassKind::ShadowStatic,
                RenderPassKind::ShadowDynamic,
                RenderPassKind::Environment,
            ] {
                for culling in [false, true] {
                    assert_brute_force(scene, matrix, pass, culling);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    #[test]
    fn environment_includes_static_neon_without_shadow_and_excludes_dynamic() {
        let mut scene = SceneManager::default();
        let neon = scene.add_cube(Vec3::ZERO);
        scene.set_render_options(
            neon,
            crate::scene::RenderOptions {
                is_static: true,
                casts_shadow: false,
                ..Default::default()
            },
        );
        let dynamic = scene.add_cube(Vec3::ZERO);
        let revision = scene.static_revision();
        assert!(scene.set_emission(neon, 1.5));
        assert!(scene.static_revision() > revision);
        assert!(!scene.set_emission(neon, f32::NAN));
        assert!(!scene.set_emission(neon, -1.0));
        let mut queue = RenderQueue::default();
        queue.extract_pass(&scene, Mat4::IDENTITY, false, RenderPassKind::Environment);
        assert_eq!(queue.visible, 1);
        assert_eq!(queue.batches[0][0].emission[0], 1.5);
        assert!(scene.set_emission(dynamic, 1.0));
        assert_eq!(scene.static_revision(), revision + 1);
    }
    #[test]
    fn bvh_matches_brute_force_across_passes_mutations_and_planar_imports() {
        let mut scene = SceneManager::default();
        let floor = scene.add_plane(Vec3::new(0.0, 0.0, 2.0));
        scene.set_render_options(
            floor,
            crate::scene::RenderOptions {
                reflectivity: 0.8,
                is_static: true,
                ..Default::default()
            },
        );
        scene.configure_mirror(floor);
        for i in 0..180 {
            let mesh = [MeshKind::Cube, MeshKind::Plane, MeshKind::Sphere][i % 3];
            let id = scene.add_object(
                mesh,
                Transform::new(
                    Vec3::new(
                        (i % 19) as f32 - 9.0,
                        (i % 7) as f32 - 3.0,
                        (i % 23) as f32 - 5.0,
                    ),
                    Vec3::new(0.3, 0.7, -0.2),
                    Vec3::new(-1.5, 0.2, 2.0),
                ),
            );
            scene.set_render_options(
                id,
                crate::scene::RenderOptions {
                    is_static: i % 2 == 0,
                    casts_shadow: i % 5 != 0,
                    receives_shadow: i % 3 == 0,
                    reflectivity: 0.25,
                    ..Default::default()
                },
            );
        }
        let imported = scene.add_imported(Vec3::new(2.0, 0.0, 1.0), Vec3::new(4.0, 0.0, 3.0));
        // Multiple object IDs share one imported batch; spatial traversal order
        // must not reorder its instances or change mirrored winding matrices.
        scene.add_object(
            MeshKind::Imported(imported),
            Transform::new(
                Vec3::new(0.0, 0.0, 2.0),
                Vec3::ZERO,
                Vec3::new(-1.0, 1.0, 1.0),
            ),
        );
        scene.add_object(
            MeshKind::Imported(imported),
            Transform::new(Vec3::new(1.0, 0.0, 3.0), Vec3::ZERO, Vec3::ONE),
        );
        scene.set_object_transform(
            imported,
            Vec3::new(-2.0, 0.0, 1.0),
            Vec3::new(0.3, 0.2, 0.8),
            Vec3::new(-2.0, 1.0, 0.5),
        );
        compare_passes(&scene);
        scene.set_object_position(imported, Vec3::new(100.0, 0.0, 0.0));
        compare_passes(&scene);
        scene.set_render_options(
            imported,
            crate::scene::RenderOptions {
                is_static: true,
                casts_shadow: false,
                receives_shadow: false,
                reflectivity: 0.6,
                ..Default::default()
            },
        );
        compare_passes(&scene);
        scene.set_render_options(imported, crate::scene::RenderOptions::default());
        scene.mirror_object = None;
        compare_passes(&scene);
        scene.remove_object(imported);
        scene.remove_object(floor);
        compare_passes(&scene);
        scene.clear_scene();
        compare_passes(&scene);
        scene.add_cube(Vec3::new(0.0, 0.0, 2.0));
        compare_passes(&scene);
    }
    #[test]
    fn sparse_bvh_prunes_objects_and_refits_without_static_rebuilds() {
        let mut scene = SceneManager::default();
        scene.load_culling_demo();
        let static_id = *scene.objects().keys().next().unwrap();
        scene.set_render_options(
            static_id,
            crate::scene::RenderOptions {
                is_static: true,
                ..Default::default()
            },
        );
        let dynamic_id = *scene.objects().keys().nth(1).unwrap();
        let mut queue = RenderQueue {
            collect_stats: true,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        queue.extract(&scene, camera(), true);
        let stats = queue.culling_stats;
        assert!(stats.object_tests < 1000, "{:?}", stats);
        assert!(stats.nodes_visited > 0);
        for matrix in [
            camera(),
            camera() * Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(-100.0, 0.0, 0.0)),
        ] {
            queue.extract(&scene, matrix, true);
            assert_eq!(queue.culling_stats.static_rebuilds, stats.static_rebuilds);
            assert_eq!(queue.culling_stats.dynamic_rebuilds, stats.dynamic_rebuilds);
        }
        scene.set_object_position(dynamic_id, Vec3::new(0.0, 0.0, 2.0));
        queue.extract(&scene, camera(), true);
        assert_eq!(queue.culling_stats.static_rebuilds, stats.static_rebuilds);
        assert_eq!(queue.culling_stats.dynamic_rebuilds, stats.dynamic_rebuilds);
        assert_brute_force(&scene, camera(), RenderPassKind::Main, true);
        scene.set_object_position(static_id, Vec3::new(0.0, 0.0, 2.0));
        queue.extract(&scene, camera(), true);
        assert_eq!(
            queue.culling_stats.static_rebuilds,
            stats.static_rebuilds + 1
        );
        scene.remove_object(dynamic_id);
        queue.extract(&scene, camera(), true);
        assert_eq!(
            queue.culling_stats.dynamic_rebuilds,
            stats.dynamic_rebuilds + 1
        );
        queue.extract(&scene, camera(), false);
        assert_eq!((queue.total, queue.visible), (9999, 9999));
        assert_eq!(
            (
                queue.culling_stats.nodes_visited,
                queue.culling_stats.object_tests
            ),
            (0, 0)
        );
    }
    #[test]
    fn disabled_diagnostics_do_not_count_rebuilds_or_queries() {
        let mut scene = SceneManager::default();
        let id = scene.add_cube(Vec3::ZERO);
        scene.set_render_options(
            id,
            crate::scene::RenderOptions {
                is_static: true,
                ..Default::default()
            },
        );
        let mut queue = RenderQueue::default();
        queue.extract(&scene, camera(), true);
        scene.set_object_position(id, Vec3::X);
        queue.extract(&scene, camera(), true);
        {
            let index = scene.visibility_index(false);
            assert_eq!((index.static_rebuilds, index.dynamic_rebuilds), (0, 0));
        }
        assert_eq!(
            (
                queue.culling_stats.nodes_visited,
                queue.culling_stats.object_tests
            ),
            (0, 0)
        );
        queue.collect_stats = true;
        scene.set_object_position(id, Vec3::ZERO);
        queue.extract(&scene, camera(), true);
        assert_eq!(queue.culling_stats.static_rebuilds, 1);
        queue.collect_stats = false;
        scene.set_object_position(id, Vec3::X);
        queue.extract(&scene, camera(), true);
        assert_eq!(scene.visibility_index(false).static_rebuilds, 1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn ssr_reflectivity_is_independent_of_planar_mirror_registration() {
        let mut scene = SceneManager::default();
        let floor = scene.add_plane(Vec3::ZERO);
        let cube = scene.add_cube(Vec3::ZERO);
        for id in [floor, cube] {
            assert!(scene.set_render_options(
                id,
                crate::scene::RenderOptions {
                    reflectivity: 0.85,
                    ..Default::default()
                }
            ));
        }
        let mut queue = RenderQueue::default();
        queue.extract(&scene, Mat4::IDENTITY, false);
        for batch in &queue.batches[..2] {
            assert_eq!(batch[0].material[0], 0.85);
            assert_eq!(batch[0].material[2], 0.0);
        }
        assert!(scene.configure_mirror(floor));
        queue.extract(&scene, Mat4::IDENTITY, false);
        assert_eq!(queue.batches[1][0].material[2], 1.0);
        assert_eq!(queue.batches[0][0].material[2], 0.0);
    }
    #[test]
    fn pass_filtering_partitions_casters_and_excludes_mirror_feedback() {
        let mut scene = SceneManager::default();
        scene.load_effects_demo();
        let mut queue = RenderQueue::default();
        queue.extract_pass(&scene, Mat4::IDENTITY, false, RenderPassKind::ShadowStatic);
        assert_eq!(queue.visible, 7);
        queue.extract_pass(&scene, Mat4::IDENTITY, false, RenderPassKind::ShadowDynamic);
        assert_eq!(queue.visible, 2);
        queue.extract_pass(&scene, Mat4::IDENTITY, false, RenderPassKind::Reflection);
        assert_eq!(queue.visible, 10);
        queue.extract(&scene, Mat4::IDENTITY, false);
        assert_eq!(queue.visible, 11);
        // A caster outside the main frustum remains eligible in the light frustum.
        let id = scene.add_cube(Vec3::new(5.0, 0.0, 0.0));
        let main = Frustum::from_view_projection(camera());
        assert!(!scene.objects()[&id].render_data.intersects(&main));
        let light = Frustum::from_view_projection(crate::render_math::shadow_view_projection(
            Vec3::new(-3.0, 7.0, 4.0),
        ));
        assert!(scene.objects()[&id].render_data.intersects(&light));
    }
    #[test]
    fn spatial_demo_spans_the_world_and_camera_can_leave_it() {
        let mut scene = SceneManager::default();
        scene.load_culling_demo();
        assert_eq!(scene.objects().len(), 10000);
        assert_eq!(scene.lights().len(), 4);
        let mut queue = RenderQueue::default();
        queue.extract(&scene, camera(), true);
        assert!(queue.visible > 0 && queue.visible < queue.total);
        let outside = glam::camera::lh::view::look_at_mat4(
            Vec3::new(100.0, 0.0, 0.0),
            Vec3::new(200.0, 0.0, 0.0),
            Vec3::Y,
        );
        queue.extract(&scene, camera() * outside, true);
        assert_eq!(queue.visible, 0);
        queue.extract(&scene, camera() * outside, false);
        assert_eq!((queue.visible, queue.draw_calls()), (10000, 1));
    }
    #[test]
    fn moving_camera_and_intersecting_bounds_do_not_lose_visible_objects() {
        let projection = camera();
        let view = glam::camera::lh::view::look_at_mat4(
            Vec3::new(5.0, 2.0, -3.0),
            Vec3::new(5.0, 2.0, 0.0),
            Vec3::Y,
        );
        let f = Frustum::from_view_projection(projection * view);
        assert!(f.intersects_aabb(Vec3::new(5.0, 2.0, 0.0), Vec3::splat(0.1)));
        assert!(!f.intersects_aabb(Vec3::new(5.0, 2.0, -5.0), Vec3::splat(0.1)));
        // The center is outside, but the large object's bounds intersect the view.
        assert!(Frustum::from_view_projection(projection)
            .intersects_aabb(Vec3::new(2.0, 0.0, 1.0), Vec3::new(2.0, 0.1, 0.1),));
    }
    #[test]
    fn cached_instances_keep_default_fade_exact_across_affine_transforms() {
        for index in 0..512 {
            let step = index as f32;
            let transform = Transform::new(
                Vec3::new(3.1, -2.3, 4.7),
                Vec3::new(0.013 * step, 0.021 * step, -0.017 * step),
                Vec3::new(-1.3 - 0.001 * step, 0.51 + 0.003 * step, 2.1 + 0.007 * step),
            );
            let data = ObjectRenderData::new(MeshKind::Cube, transform);
            let mut expected = crate::scene::normal_matrix(transform.model()).to_cols_array_2d();
            // This element stores presentation metadata, not an inverse result.
            // All other entries must retain the exact normal transformation.
            expected[3][3] = 1.0;
            assert_eq!(data.instance.normal_matrix, expected, "case {index}");
            assert_eq!(data.instance.visual_fade(), 1.0, "case {index}");
            assert!(!data.instance.needs_translucent_overlay(), "case {index}");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn visual_fade_packing_preserves_direction_normals_and_instance_layout() {
        let transform = Transform::new(
            Vec3::new(3.0, -2.0, 4.0),
            Vec3::new(0.2, 0.7, -0.3),
            Vec3::new(-2.0, 0.5, 3.0),
        );
        let mut data = ObjectRenderData::new(MeshKind::Cube, transform);
        let normal = Vec3::new(0.3, 0.7, -0.2).normalize();
        let expected = crate::scene::normal_matrix(transform.model()).transform_vector3(normal);
        assert_eq!(data.instance.visual_fade(), 1.0);
        assert!(!data.instance.needs_translucent_overlay());
        for fade in [0.75, 0.2, 0.0] {
            data.instance.normal_matrix[3][3] = fade;
            assert_eq!(data.instance.visual_fade(), fade);
            assert_eq!(data.instance.needs_translucent_overlay(), fade > 0.0);
            let transformed =
                Mat4::from_cols_array_2d(&data.instance.normal_matrix).transform_vector3(normal);
            assert!(transformed.abs_diff_eq(expected, 1e-6));
        }
        for fade in [1.0, 0.75, 0.0] {
            data.instance.normal_matrix[3][3] = -(1.0 + fade);
            assert_eq!(data.instance.visual_fade(), fade);
            assert_eq!(
                data.instance.needs_translucent_overlay(),
                fade > 0.0 && fade < 1.0
            );
            let transformed =
                Mat4::from_cols_array_2d(&data.instance.normal_matrix).transform_vector3(normal);
            assert!(transformed.abs_diff_eq(expected, 1e-6));
        }
        // Existing glass alpha and coverage still control its overlay at full fade.
        data.instance.normal_matrix[3][3] = 1.0;
        data.instance.emission[2] = 0.06;
        assert!(data.instance.needs_translucent_overlay());
        data.instance.emission[2] = 0.0;
        assert!(!data.instance.needs_translucent_overlay());
        data.instance.surface_params[0] = 1.0;
        assert!(data.instance.needs_translucent_overlay());
        assert_eq!(std::mem::size_of::<InstanceData>(), 176);
        assert_eq!(std::mem::offset_of!(InstanceData, surface_params), 160);
    }

    #[test]
    fn extraction_defaults_visual_fade_to_one_without_changing_normals() {
        let mut scene = SceneManager::default();
        let id = scene.add_cube(Vec3::new(0.0, 0.0, 2.0));

            crate::scene::normal_matrix(scene.objects()[&id].transform.model()).to_cols_array_2d();
        expected[3][3] = 1.0; // Packed default fade, independent of inverse rounding.
        assert_eq!(instance.normal_matrix, expected);
    }

    #[test]
    fn cached_gltf_root_model_tracks_commands_motion_and_pose_updates() {
        let asset = crate::gltf_loader::parse_model(
            include_bytes!("../assets/models/fox/Fox.glb"),
            &[],
            &[],
        )
        .unwrap();
        let mut scene = SceneManager::default();
        let clip = asset
            .animations
            .iter()
            .position(|clip| clip.name.as_deref() == Some("Walk"))
            .unwrap();
        let id = scene.add_model(std::sync::Arc::new(asset)).unwrap();
        let check = |scene: &SceneManager| {
            let object = &scene.objects()[&id];
            assert_eq!(object.render_data.model(), object.transform.model());
        };
        check(&scene);
        assert!(scene.set_object_position(id, Vec3::new(1.0, 3.0, -2.0)));
        check(&scene);
        assert!(scene.set_object_rotation(id, Vec3::new(0.4, -0.7, 1.2)));
        check(&scene);
        assert!(scene.set_object_scale(id, Vec3::new(-0.5, 0.2, 1.5)));
        check(&scene);
        assert!(scene.set_object_spin(id, Vec3::new(0.2, 0.3, -0.4)));
        assert!(scene.set_projectile(id, Vec3::new(0.5, 0.1, 0.2), 0.0, 0.0));
        scene.play_model_animation(id, clip, true, 1.0).unwrap();
        let old = scene.objects()[&id].render_data.model();
        scene.update(1.0 / 72.0);
        check(&scene);
        assert_ne!(old, scene.objects()[&id].render_data.model());
        scene.seek_model_animation(id, 0.25).unwrap();
        check(&scene);
    }

    #[test]
    fn render_revision_invalidates_on_commands_and_animation_but_not_idle_frames() {
        let mut scene = SceneManager::default();
        let id = scene.add_cube(Vec3::ZERO);
        let mut previous = scene.render_revision();
        scene.update(1.0);
        assert_eq!(previous, scene.render_revision());
        scene.set_object_position(id, Vec3::ONE);
        assert_ne!(previous, scene.render_revision());
        previous = scene.render_revision();
        scene.set_object_scale(id, Vec3::splat(2.0));
        assert_ne!(previous, scene.render_revision());
        previous = scene.render_revision();
        scene.set_object_rotation(id, Vec3::ONE);
        assert_ne!(previous, scene.render_revision());
        previous = scene.render_revision();
        scene.set_object_transform(id, Vec3::ZERO, Vec3::ZERO, Vec3::ONE);
        assert_ne!(previous, scene.render_revision());
        previous = scene.render_revision();
        scene.schedule_rotate(id, 0.0, 90.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
        scene.update(0.5);
        assert_ne!(previous, scene.render_revision());
        previous = scene.render_revision();
        scene.remove_object(id);
        assert_ne!(previous, scene.render_revision());
        previous = scene.render_revision();
        scene.clear_scene();
        assert_ne!(previous, scene.render_revision());
    }

    #[test]
    fn bounds_are_conservative_for_rotated_scaled_and_flat_geometry() {
        for mesh in [MeshKind::Cube, MeshKind::Plane, MeshKind::Sphere] {
            let t = Transform::new(
                Vec3::new(2.0, 0.0, 2.0),
                Vec3::new(0.4, 0.7, 0.3),
                Vec3::new(-3.0, 0.4, 2.0),
            );
            let data = ObjectRenderData::new(mesh, t);
            let ext = match mesh {
                MeshKind::Cube => Vec3::splat(0.5),
                MeshKind::Plane => Vec3::new(0.5, 0.0, 0.5),
                MeshKind::Sphere => Vec3::ONE,
                MeshKind::Imported(_) => Vec3::ZERO,
            };
            for x in [-1.0, 1.0] {
                for y in [-1.0, 1.0] {
                    for z in [-1.0, 1.0] {
                        let point = t.model().transform_point3(Vec3::new(x, y, z) * ext);
                        assert!(
                            ((point - data.center).abs() - data.half_extent).max_element() < 1e-5
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    #[test]
    fn imported_bounds_follow_transforms_and_pass_filters() {
        let mut scene = SceneManager::default();
        let id = scene.add_imported(Vec3::new(99.9, -0.1, 0.9), Vec3::new(100.1, 0.1, 1.1));

    #[test]
    fn visible_imported_ids_exclude_retained_pass_and_view_allocations() {
        let mut scene = SceneManager::default();
        let id = scene.add_imported(Vec3::new(-0.1, -0.1, 0.9), Vec3::new(0.1, 0.1, 1.1));
        let mut queue = RenderQueue::default();
        queue.extract(&scene, camera(), false);
        assert_eq!(
            queue.visible_imported_ids().copied().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
            [id]
        );
        let capacity = queue.imported[&id].capacity();

        // The same allocation survives a pass where this dynamic mesh is absent.
        queue.extract_pass(&scene, camera(), false, RenderPassKind::ShadowStatic);
        assert!(queue.imported.contains_key(&id));
        assert_eq!(queue.imported[&id].capacity(), capacity);
        assert_eq!(queue.visible_imported_ids().count(), 0);
        queue.extract_pass(&scene, camera(), false, RenderPassKind::ShadowDynamic);
        assert_eq!(
            queue.visible_imported_ids().copied().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
            [id]
        );

        // Independent eye queues must not inherit the other eye's visible IDs.
        let mut other_eye = RenderQueue::default();
        other_eye.extract(&scene, camera(), false);
        let shifted_view = camera() * Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(-100.0, 0.0, 0.0));
        queue.extract(&scene, shifted_view, true);
        assert_eq!(queue.visible_imported_ids().count(), 0);
        assert_eq!(
            other_eye
                .visible_imported_ids()
                .copied()
                .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
            [id]
        );
        queue.extract(&scene, camera(), true);
        assert_eq!(
            queue.visible_imported_ids().copied().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
            [id]
        );
    }

        }
    }
    #[test]
    fn culling_never_stops_simulation_and_reuses_queue_capacity() {
        let mut scene = SceneManager::default();
        let id = scene.add_cube(Vec3::new(100.0, 0.0, 1.0));
        let mut q = RenderQueue::default();
        q.extract(&scene, camera(), true);
        assert_eq!((q.total, q.visible, q.draw_calls()), (1, 0, 0));
        scene.set_object_position(id, Vec3::new(0.0, 0.0, 1.0));
        q.extract(&scene, camera(), true);
        assert_eq!((q.visible, q.draw_calls()), (1, 1));
        let capacity = q.batches[0].capacity();
        scene.set_object_scale(id, Vec3::splat(2.0));
        scene.schedule_remove_object(id, 0.1);
        scene.update(0.2);
        q.extract(&scene, camera(), true);
        assert_eq!((q.total, q.visible), (0, 0));
        assert_eq!(capacity, q.batches[0].capacity());
    }
    #[test]
    fn numeric_glyph_material_stays_distinct_from_bitmap_and_lit_meshes() {
        let mut scene = SceneManager::default();
        let numeric = scene.add_numeric_text("0", 0.5, 0.5).unwrap();
        let bitmap = scene.add_info_panel("scene", 0.5, 0.5).unwrap();
        scene.add_cube(Vec3::ZERO);
        scene.set_object_position(numeric, Vec3::new(0., 0., 0.5));
        scene.set_object_position(bitmap, Vec3::new(0., 0., 0.5));
        scene.sync_numeric_font();
        let children: Vec<_> = scene
            .objects()
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|(&id, object)| scene.is_numeric_glyph(id).then_some((id, object.mesh)))
            .collect();
        assert_eq!(children.len(), 1);
        let MeshKind::Imported(handle) = children[0].1 else {
            panic!("numeric glyph needs shared imported mesh")
        };
        for culling in [false, true] {
            for pass in [RenderPassKind::Main, RenderPassKind::Reflection] {
                let mut queue = RenderQueue::default();
                queue.extract_pass(&scene, Mat4::IDENTITY, culling, pass);
                assert_eq!(queue.imported[&handle][0].material[3], -2.);
                assert_eq!(queue.imported[&bitmap][0].material[3], -1.);
                assert_eq!(queue.batches[0][0].material[3], 0.);
                assert!(!queue.imported.contains_key(&numeric));
                assert_brute_force(&scene, Mat4::IDENTITY, pass, culling);
            }
        }
        compare_passes(&scene);
    }
    #[test]
    fn info_panel_unlit_flag_survives_all_visibility_paths() {
        let mut scene = SceneManager::default();
        let panel = scene.add_info_panel("scene", 0.5, 0.5).unwrap();
        let cube = scene.add_cube(Vec3::ZERO);
        scene.set_object_position(panel, Vec3::new(0., 0., 0.5));
        for culling in [false, true] {
            for pass in [RenderPassKind::Main, RenderPassKind::Reflection] {
                let mut queue = RenderQueue::default();
                queue.extract_pass(&scene, Mat4::IDENTITY, culling, pass);
                assert_eq!(queue.imported[&panel][0].material, [0., 0., 0., -1.]);
                assert_eq!(queue.batches[0][0].material[3], 0.);
                assert_brute_force(&scene, Mat4::IDENTITY, pass, culling);
            }
        }
        assert!(!scene.is_cuttable(panel));
        assert!(scene.object_exists(cube));
        compare_passes(&scene);
    }
}


# File: src/web.rs
#![cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]

use std::{cell::RefCell, rc::Rc};
use wasm_bindgen::prelude::*;
use wasm_bindgen::{closure::Closure, JsCast};

use crate::input::active_camera::{ActiveCamera, CameraType};
use crate::input::camera::CameraController;
use crate::input::{keyboard, mouse};
use crate::render::state::State;

type ImportedResources = (Vec<Vec<u8>>, Vec<Vec<u8>>);
type AnimationFrameCallback = Rc<RefCell<Option<Closure<dyn FnMut()>>>>;

thread_local! {
    static RUNTIME: RefCell<Option<Runtime>> = const { RefCell::new(None) };
    static STATE: RefCell<Option<Rc<RefCell<State>>>> = const { RefCell::new(None) };
    static STARTING: std::cell::Cell<Option<u64>> = const { std::cell::Cell::new(None) };
    static GENERATION: std::cell::Cell<u64> = const { std::cell::Cell::new(0) };
    static RIM: RefCell<Option<crate::rim_game::Game>> = const { RefCell::new(None) };
    static MELEE: RefCell<Option<crate::melee_encounter::Encounter>> = const { RefCell::new(None) };
    static MELEE_TRACKING_DT: std::cell::Cell<f32> = const { std::cell::Cell::new(0.) };
    static MELEE_DT: std::cell::Cell<f32> = const { std::cell::Cell::new(0.) };
    static RIM_REAL_DT: std::cell::Cell<f32> = const { std::cell::Cell::new(0.) };
    static XR_PLAYER: RefCell<crate::xr_player::XrPlayer> = RefCell::new(Default::default());
    static RESET_FRAME_CLOCK: std::cell::Cell<bool> = const { std::cell::Cell::new(false) };
    static XR_ACTIVE: std::cell::Cell<bool> = const { std::cell::Cell::new(false) };
    static CAMERA: RefCell<Option<Rc<RefCell<ActiveCamera>>>> = const { RefCell::new(None) };
}

struct Runtime {
    window: web_sys::Window,
    frame: Rc<std::cell::Cell<Option<i32>>>,
    _callback: AnimationFrameCallback,
    _listeners: Vec<keyboard::Listener>,
}
impl Drop for Runtime {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if let Some(id) = self.frame.take() {
            let _ = self.window.cancel_animation_frame(id);
        }
        self._callback.borrow_mut().take();
    }
}

/// Release the frame loop, input listeners, camera and GPU scene resources.
#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn dispose() {
    RIM.with(|slot| slot.borrow_mut().take());
    MELEE.with(|slot| slot.borrow_mut().take());
    crate::render::profiler::reset();
    XR_ACTIVE.with(|active| active.set(false));
    XR_PLAYER.with(|player| *player.borrow_mut() = Default::default());
    GENERATION.with(|generation| generation.set(generation.get().wrapping_add(1)));
    STARTING.with(|starting| starting.set(None));
    RUNTIME.with(|runtime| runtime.borrow_mut().take());
    CAMERA.with(|camera| camera.borrow_mut().take());
    STATE.with(|state| state.borrow_mut().take());
}

#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn gltf_buffer_uris(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<js_sys::Array, JsValue> {
    let uris = crate::gltf_loader::buffer_uris(bytes).map_err(|e| JsValue::from_str(&e))?;
    Ok(uris.iter().map(|uri| JsValue::from_str(uri)).collect())
}
#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn load_gltf(bytes: &[u8], buffers: js_sys::Array) -> Result<u32, JsValue> {
    let mut external = Vec::new();
    let mut total_bytes = bytes.len();
    if total_bytes > 128 * 1024 * 1024 || buffers.length() > 1024 {
        return Err(JsValue::from_str(
            "glTF překračuje limit velikosti nebo počtu bufferů",
        ));
    }
    for value in buffers.iter() {
        if !value.is_instance_of::<js_sys::Uint8Array>() {
            return Err(JsValue::from_str("glTF buffers musí být Uint8Array"));
        }
        let buffer = value.unchecked_into::<js_sys::Uint8Array>();
        total_bytes = total_bytes.saturating_add(buffer.length() as usize);
        if total_bytes > 128 * 1024 * 1024 {
            return Err(JsValue::from_str("glTF překračuje limit 128 MiB"));
        }
        external.push(buffer.to_vec());
    }
    let model = crate::gltf_loader::parse(bytes, &external).map_err(|e| JsValue::from_str(&e))?;
    for warning in &model.warnings {
        web_sys::console::warn_1(&JsValue::from_str(warning));
    }
    STATE.with(|state| {
        let state = state.borrow();
        let engine = state
            .as_ref()
            .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("Engine není inicializován"))?;
        let result = engine
            .borrow_mut()
            .import_model(&model)
            .map_err(|e| JsValue::from_str(&e));
        result
    })
}

#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn gltf_resource_uris(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<String, JsValue> {
    let resources = crate::gltf_loader::resource_uris(bytes).map_err(|e| JsValue::from_str(&e))?;
    Ok(serde_json::json!({"buffers":resources.buffers,"images":resources.images}).to_string())
}

fn model_resources(
    bytes: &[u8],
    buffers: js_sys::Array,
    images: js_sys::Array,
) -> Result<ImportedResources, JsValue> {
    let mut total = bytes.len();
    if total > 128 * 1024 * 1024 || buffers.length() + images.length() > 1024 {
        return Err(JsValue::from_str("glTF překračuje limity zdrojů"));
    }
    let mut convert = |array: js_sys::Array| -> Result<Vec<Vec<u8>>, JsValue> {
        array
            .iter()
            .map(|value| {
                if !value.is_instance_of::<js_sys::Uint8Array>() {
                    return Err(JsValue::from_str("glTF zdroje musí být Uint8Array"));
                }
                let value = value.unchecked_into::<js_sys::Uint8Array>();
                total = total.saturating_add(value.length() as usize);
                if total > 128 * 1024 * 1024 {
                    return Err(JsValue::from_str("glTF překračuje 128 MiB"));
                }
                Ok(value.to_vec())
            })
            .collect()
    };
    Ok((convert(buffers)?, convert(images)?))
}
#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn load_gltf_model(
    bytes: &[u8],
    buffers: js_sys::Array,
    images: js_sys::Array,
) -> Result<u32, JsValue> {
    let (buffers, images) = model_resources(bytes, buffers, images)?;
    let asset = crate::gltf_loader::parse_model(bytes, &buffers, &images)
        .map_err(|e| JsValue::from_str(&e))?;
    for warning in &asset.warnings {
        web_sys::console::warn_1(&JsValue::from_str(warning));
    }
    STATE.with(|s| {
        let s = s.borrow();
        let engine = s
            .as_ref()
            .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("Engine není inicializován"))?;
        let result = engine
            .borrow_mut()
            .import_gltf_model(std::sync::Arc::new(asset))
            .map_err(|e| JsValue::from_str(&e));
        result
    })
}
/// New independent pose/root referencing the existing immutable model asset.
#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn instantiate_model(id: u32) -> Result<u32, JsValue> {
    STATE.with(|slot| {
        let slot = slot.borrow();
        let state = slot
            .as_ref()
            .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("Engine není inicializován"))?;
        let mut state = state.borrow_mut();
        let asset = state
            .scene
            .model(id)
            .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("Model neexistuje"))?
            .asset
            .clone();
        state
            .import_gltf_model(asset)
            .map_err(|error| JsValue::from_str(&error))
    })
}
#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn model_info(id: u32) -> Result<String, JsValue> {
    STATE.with(|s| {
        let state=s.borrow();
        let engine=state.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("Engine není inicializován"))?;
        let engine=engine.borrow();
        let model=engine.scene.model(id).ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("Model neexistuje"))?;
        let asset=&model.asset;
        let animations:Vec<_>=asset.animations.iter().enumerate().map(|(i,a)| serde_json::json!({"name":a.name.clone().unwrap_or_else(||format!("Animation {i}")),"duration":a.duration})).collect();
        let nodes:Vec<_>=asset.nodes.iter().enumerate().map(|(i,n)| serde_json::json!({"name":n.name.clone().unwrap_or_else(||format!("Node {i}")),"mesh":n.mesh,"camera":n.camera,"morphTargets":n.mesh.and_then(|m|asset.meshes[m].primitives.first()).map(|p|asset.primitives[*p].morph_targets.len()).unwrap_or(0)})).collect();
        let scenes:Vec<_>=asset.scenes.iter().enumerate().map(|(i,s)|serde_json::json!({"name":s.name.clone().unwrap_or_else(||format!("Scene {i}"))})).collect();
        let playback=model.playback.as_ref().map(|p|serde_json::json!({"clip":p.clip,"time":p.time,"speed":p.speed,"looping":p.looping,"playing":p.playing}));
        Ok(serde_json::json!({"animations":animations,"nodes":nodes,"scenes":scenes,"scene":model.scene,"playback":playback,"primitives":asset.primitives.len(),"materials":asset.materials.len(),"textures":asset.textures.len(),"skins":asset.skins.len(),"lastError":model.last_error}).to_string())
    })
}

/// Maintained GPU acceptance probe: execute a compiled storage-buffer graph.
#[wasm_bindgen]
pub async fn verify_frame_graph_resources() -> Result<String, JsValue> {
    let (device, queue) = STATE.with(|slot| {
        let state = slot.borrow();
        let state = state
            .as_ref()
            .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("Engine unavailable"))?
            .borrow();
        Ok::<_, JsValue>(state.graph_probe_handles())
    })?;
    crate::render::graph_probe::run(device, queue)
        .await
        .map(|report| report.to_string())
        .map_err(|e| JsValue::from_str(&e))
}

#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn configure_ssr_region(bounds: &[f32]) -> bool {
    if !bounds.is_empty() && bounds.len() != 6 {
        return false;
    }
    let (min, max, enabled) = if bounds.len() == 6 {
        (
            glam::Vec3::from_slice(&bounds[..3]),
            glam::Vec3::from_slice(&bounds[3..]),
            true,
        )
    } else {
        (glam::Vec3::ZERO, glam::Vec3::ZERO, false)
    };
    STATE.with(|state| {
        state
            .borrow()
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|s| s.borrow_mut().configure_ssr_region(min, max, enabled))
    })
}

/// Deterministic bitmap fixture input. Only opt-in debug-text panels; never
/// replaces automatic gameplay/diagnostics text or changes its refresh rate.
#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn diagnostic_panel_text(id: u32, value: &str) -> Result<(), JsValue> {
    if value.len() > 64 || !value.is_ascii() || value.chars().any(char::is_control) {
        return Err(JsValue::from_str(
            "Diagnostic panel text needs 0..64 printable ASCII characters",
        ));
    }
    cutting_command(|scene| {
        let panel = scene
            .info_panels
            .get_mut(&id)
            .filter(|p| p.kind == crate::info_panel::PanelKind::DebugText && !p.font3d_bound)
            .ok_or_else(|| "Diagnostic text requires an unbound debug-text panel".to_string())?;
        panel.update(vec![("", value.into())]);
        Ok(())
    })
}

// Reset scene-specific gameplay before either clear entry point removes objects.
// The XR session and equipment bindings retain their established lifecycle.
fn reset_scene_gameplay(scene: &mut crate::scene::SceneManager) {
    RIM.with(|slot| slot.borrow_mut().take());
    MELEE.with(|slot| slot.borrow_mut().take());
    XR_PLAYER.with(|player| {
        let mut player = player.borrow_mut();
        player.locomotion = Default::default();
        player.set_reference(glam::Mat4::IDENTITY);
        player.reset_tracking(scene);
    });
}

#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn clear_all() {
    STATE.with(|state| {
        if let Some(state) = state.borrow().as_ref() {
            let mut state = state.borrow_mut();
            reset_scene_gameplay(&mut state.scene);
            state.scene.clear();
        }
    });
}

#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn set_camera_view(px: f32, py: f32, pz: f32, tx: f32, ty: f32, tz: f32) -> bool {
    let accepted = CAMERA.with(|camera| {
        camera.borrow().as_ref().is_some_and(|c| {
            c.borrow_mut()
                .set_view(glam::Vec3::new(px, py, pz), glam::Vec3::new(tx, ty, tz))
        })
    });
    if accepted {
        STATE.with(|s| {
            if let Some(s) = s.borrow().as_ref() {
                s.borrow_mut().clear_model_camera();
            }
        });
    }
    accepted
}

#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn screen_to_plane(u: f32, v: f32, height: f32) -> Result<Vec<f32>, JsValue> {
    STATE.with(|state| {
        let state = state.borrow();
        let engine = state
            .as_ref()
            .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("Engine is not initialized"))?;
        let result = engine
            .borrow()
            .screen_to_plane(u, v, height)
            .map(|p| p.to_array().to_vec())
            .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("Pointer ray does not intersect plane"));
        result
    })
}

#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn set_camera_mode(mode: &str) {
    if mode == "free" || mode == "orbit" {
        STATE.with(|s| {
            if let Some(s) = s.borrow().as_ref() {
                s.borrow_mut().clear_model_camera();
            }
        });
    }
    CAMERA.with(|c| {
        if let Some(cam) = &*c.borrow() {
            let mut cam = cam.borrow_mut();
            match mode {
                "free" => cam.set_type(CameraType::Free),
                "orbit" => cam.set_type(CameraType::Orbit),
                _ => {}
            }
        }
    });
}

/// Attach input and a chase camera to an existing glTF root, never spawn a scene.
#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn control_character(
    id: u32,
    speed: f32,
    run_speed: f32,
    model_yaw: f32,
    idle: i32,
    walk: i32,
    run: i32,
) -> bool {
    STATE.with(|state| {
        let state = state.borrow();
        let Some(state) = state.as_ref() else {
            return false;
        };
        let mut state = state.borrow_mut();
        let Some(model) = state.scene.model(id) else {
            return false;
        };
        let indices = [idle, walk, run];
        if indices.iter().any(|index| {
            *index < -1 || (*index >= 0 && *index as usize >= model.asset.animations.len())
        }) {
            return false;
        }
        let Some(object) = state.scene.objects().get(&id) else {
            return false;
        };
        let position = object.transform.position;
        let clips = indices.map(|index| (index >= 0).then_some(index as usize));
        let accepted = CAMERA.with(|camera| {
            camera.borrow().as_ref().is_some_and(|camera| {
                camera
                    .borrow_mut()
                    .follow_object(id, position, speed, run_speed, model_yaw, clips)
            })
        });
        if accepted {
            state.clear_model_camera();
        }
        accepted
    })
}

#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn character_state() -> String {
    CAMERA.with(|camera| {
        camera
            .borrow()
            .as_ref()
            .and_then(|camera| {
                let camera = camera.borrow();
                camera.character_state().map(|state| (state, camera.character_physics_state()))
            })
            .map(|((id, position, moving, running), physics)| {
                let (grounded, vertical_velocity, candidates) = physics.unwrap_or((false, 0.0, 0));
                serde_json::json!({
                    "id": id, "position": position.to_array(), "moving": moving, "running": running,
                    "grounded": grounded, "verticalVelocity": vertical_velocity, "collisionCandidates": candidates
                })
                .to_string()
            })
            .unwrap_or_else(|| "null".into())
    })
}

#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn set_box_collider(id: u32, hx: f32, hy: f32, hz: f32, ox: f32, oy: f32, oz: f32) -> bool {
    STATE.with(|state| {
        state.borrow().as_ref().is_some_and(|state| {
            state.borrow_mut().scene.set_box_collider(
                id,
                glam::Vec3::new(hx, hy, hz),
                glam::Vec3::new(ox, oy, oz),
            )
        })
    })
}

#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn set_box_colliders(id: u32, packed: &[f32]) -> bool {
    if packed.is_empty() || !packed.len().is_multiple_of(6) || packed.len() > 2048 * 6 {
        return false;
    }
    let boxes: Vec<_> = packed
        .as_chunks::<6>()
        .0
        .iter()
        .map(|b| {
            (
                glam::Vec3::from_slice(&b[..3]),
                glam::Vec3::from_slice(&b[3..]),
            )
        })
        .collect();
    STATE.with(|state| {
        state
            .borrow()
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|state| state.borrow_mut().scene.set_box_colliders(id, &boxes))
    })
}

    })

#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn configure_character_physics(
    hx: f32,
    hy: f32,
    hz: f32,
    gravity: f32,
    jump_speed: f32,
) -> bool {
    let physics = crate::input::character::CharacterPhysics {
        half_extents: glam::Vec3::new(hx, hy, hz),
        gravity,
        jump_speed,
    };
    CAMERA.with(|camera| {
        camera
            .borrow()
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|camera| camera.borrow_mut().set_character_physics(physics))
    })
}

#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn resize(width: u32, height: u32) {
    if width == 0 || height == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let aspect = STATE.with(|s| {
        s.borrow().as_ref().map(|st| {
            let mut state = st.borrow_mut();
            state.resize(width, height);
            state.aspect
        })
    });
    if let Some(aspect) = aspect {
        CAMERA.with(|c| {
            if let Some(cam) = &*c.borrow() {
                cam.borrow_mut().set_aspect(aspect);
            }
        });
    }
}

#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn clear_scene() {
    STATE.with(|s| {
        if let Some(st) = &*s.borrow() {
            let mut state = st.borrow_mut();
            reset_scene_gameplay(&mut state.scene);
            state.clear_combo_display();
            state.scene.clear_scene();
            state.combo_score = Default::default();
            state.clear_combo_indicators();
        }
    });
}

/// Static bitmap inscription with no backing rectangle.
#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn add_text_panel(
    title: &str,
    lines_json: &str,
    width: f32,
    height: f32,
) -> Result<u32, JsValue> {
    if lines_json.len() > 8192 || title.len() > 192 {
        return Err(JsValue::from_str("Text panel input exceeds limits"));
    }
    let lines: Vec<String> =
        serde_json::from_str(lines_json).map_err(|e| JsValue::from_str(&e.to_string()))?;
    STATE.with(|slot| {
        let slot = slot.borrow();
        let state = slot
            .as_ref()
            .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("Engine is not initialized"))?;
        let result = state
            .borrow_mut()
            .scene
            .add_text_panel(title, &lines, width, height)
            .map_err(|e| JsValue::from_str(&e));
        result
    })
}

#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn add_cube(x: f32, y: f32, z: f32) -> u32 {
    let mut id = crate::scene::INVALID_ID;
    STATE.with(|s| {
        if let Some(st) = &*s.borrow() {
            id = st.borrow_mut().scene.add_cube(glam::Vec3::new(x, y, z));
        }
    });
    id
}

fn cutting_command<T>(
    command: impl FnOnce(&mut crate::scene::SceneManager) -> Result<T, String>,
) -> Result<T, JsValue> {
    STATE.with(|state| {
        let state = state.borrow();
        let engine = state
            .as_ref()
            .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("Engine není inicializován"))?;
        let result = command(&mut engine.borrow_mut().scene).map_err(|e| JsValue::from_str(&e));
        result
    })
}

#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn add_triangle_mesh(
    positions: &[f32],
    indices: &[u32],
    r: f32,
    g: f32,
    b: f32,
    smooth: bool,
) -> Result<u32, JsValue> {
    if !positions.len().is_multiple_of(3)
        || positions.len() > crate::cutting::MAX_TRIANGLES * 9
        || indices.len() > crate::cutting::MAX_TRIANGLES * 3
    {
        return Err(JsValue::from_str("Invalid triangle mesh buffers"));
    }
    let positions = positions
        .as_chunks::<3>()
        .0
        .iter()
        .map(|&p| glam::Vec3::from_array(p))
        .collect();
    let mut mesh = crate::cutting::CutMesh::new(positions, indices, glam::Vec3::new(r, g, b))
        .map_err(|e| JsValue::from_str(&e))?;
    if smooth {
        mesh.smooth_normals();
    }
    cutting_command(|scene| scene.add_triangle_mesh(mesh))
}

#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn register_mesh_variants(
    positions: &[f32],
    indices: &[u32],
    colors: &[f32],
    smooth: bool,
) -> u32 {
    cutting_command(|scene| scene.register_mesh_variants(positions, indices, colors, smooth))
        .unwrap_or_else(|error| {
            web_sys::console::error_1(&error);
            crate::scene::INVALID_ID
        })
}
#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn add_mesh_variant(handle: u32, variant: u32) -> u32 {
    cutting_command(|scene| scene.add_mesh_variant(handle, variant)).unwrap_or_else(|error| {
        web_sys::console::error_1(&error);
        crate::scene::INVALID_ID
    })
}
#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn remove_mesh_variants(handle: u32) -> bool {
    cutting_command(|scene| Ok(scene.remove_mesh_variants(handle))).unwrap_or(false)
}

#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn set_cuttable(id: u32, enabled: bool, r: f32, g: f32, b: f32) -> Result<(), JsValue> {
    cutting_command(|scene| scene.set_cuttable(id, enabled, glam::Vec3::new(r, g, b)))
}

#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn add_colored_triangle_mesh(
    positions: &[f32],
    indices: &[u32],
    colors: &[f32],
    smooth: bool,
) -> Result<u32, JsValue> {
    if positions.len() > crate::cutting::MAX_TRIANGLES * 9
        || !positions.len().is_multiple_of(3)
        || indices.len() > crate::cutting::MAX_TRIANGLES * 3
        || colors.len() != indices.len()
        || colors
            .iter()
            .any(|c| !c.is_finite() || !(0.0..=1.0).contains(c))
    {
        return Err(JsValue::from_str("Invalid triangle colors or mesh budget"));
    }
    let positions = positions
        .as_chunks::<3>()
        .0
        .iter()
        .map(|&p| glam::Vec3::from_array(p))
        .collect();
    let mut mesh = crate::cutting::CutMesh::new(positions, indices, glam::Vec3::ONE)
        .map_err(|e| JsValue::from_str(&e))?;
    for (triangle, &color) in mesh.triangles.iter_mut().zip(colors.as_chunks::<3>().0) {
        triangle.color = glam::Vec3::from_array(color);
    }
    if smooth {
        mesh.smooth_normals();
    }
    cutting_command(|scene| scene.add_triangle_mesh(mesh))
}

#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn aim_cutter(
    id: u32,
    guides: &[u32],
    center: &[f32],
    settings: &[f32],
) -> Result<Vec<f32>, JsValue> {
    if center.len() != 3 || settings.len() != 4 {
        return Err(JsValue::from_str("Invalid cutting aim arguments"));
    }
    cutting_command(|scene| {
        scene
            .aim_cutter(
                id,
                guides,
                crate::cutting_tool::ToolAim {
                    center: glam::Vec3::from_slice(center),
                    yaw: settings[0],
                    tilt: settings[1],
                    height: settings[2],
                    floor: settings[3],
                },
            )
            .map(|p| p.to_array().to_vec())
    })
}

#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn set_cutter(id: u32, enabled: bool, endpoints: &[f32]) -> Result<(), JsValue> {
    let blade = if enabled {
        if endpoints.len() != 6 {
            return Err(JsValue::from_str("Cutter requires two local endpoints"));
        }
        Some([
            glam::Vec3::from_slice(&endpoints[..3]),
            glam::Vec3::from_slice(&endpoints[3..]),
        ])
    } else {
        None
    };
    cutting_command(|scene| scene.set_cutter(id, blade))
}

pub fn set_blade_contact_response(id: u32, enabled: bool) -> Result<(), JsValue> {
    cutting_command(|scene| scene.set_blade_contact_response(id, enabled))
}

#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn play_cut_feedback(pieces: &[u32]) -> Result<String, JsValue> {
    cutting_command(|scene| {
        let objects = scene.play_cut_feedback(pieces)?;
        Ok(serde_json::json!({"objects":objects,"duration":0.65}).to_string())
    })
}
#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn play_cut_feedback_facing(
    pieces: &[u32],
    mirror_text: bool,
    size: Option<f32>,
    score_label: Option<String>,
) -> Result<String, JsValue> {
    let rewards = if matches!(score_label.as_deref(), Some("hit-points" | "stock-total")) {
        Some(
            STATE
                .with(|slot| {
                    slot.borrow().as_ref().map(|state| {
                        state
                            .borrow()
                            .xr_cut_rewards()
                            .iter()
                            .map(|reward| {
                                (
                                    reward.original,
                                    if score_label.as_deref() == Some("stock-total") {
                                        reward.total_points
                                    } else {
                                        reward.points
                                    },
                                )
                            })
                            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                    })
                })
                .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("Engine neni inicializovan"))?,
        )
    } else {
        None
    };
    let label = match score_label.as_deref() {
        None => None,
        Some("pending-bonus") => Some(
            STATE
                .with(|slot| {
                    slot.borrow()
                        .as_ref()
                        .map(|state| format!("BONUS {}", state.borrow().xr_pending_bonus()))
                })
                .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("Engine neni inicializovan"))?,
        ),
        Some("hit-points" | "stock-total") => None,
        Some(_) => return Err(JsValue::from_str("Unknown cut feedback score label")),
    };
    cutting_command(|scene| {
        let objects = if let Some(rewards) = &rewards {
            scene.play_cut_feedback_scored(pieces, mirror_text, size.unwrap_or(1.), rewards)?
        } else {
            scene.play_cut_feedback_labeled(
                pieces,
                mirror_text,
                size.unwrap_or(1.),
                label.as_deref(),
            )?
        };
        Ok(serde_json::json!({"objects":objects,"duration":0.65}).to_string())
    })
}
#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn clear_cut_feedback() -> Result<(), JsValue> {
    cutting_command(|scene| {
        scene.clear_cut_feedback();
        Ok(())
    })
}
