            .is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn xr_input_rejects_nonrigid_and_invalid_pose_hides_and_clears_anchor() {
        let (mut scene, mut c, target, sword) = setup();
        for invalid in [
            Mat4::from_scale(Vec3::splat(2.)),
            Mat4::from_scale(Vec3::new(-1., 1., 1.)),
            Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::splat(f32::NAN)),
            Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::X * 101.),
        ] {
            c.reset(&mut scene);
            c.update(&mut scene, Some(pose(-0.3)), true).unwrap();
            assert!(c.update(&mut scene, Some(invalid), true).is_err());
            assert_eq!(scene.objects()[&sword].transform.position, HIDDEN);
            assert!(c
                .update(&mut scene, Some(pose(0.3)), true)
                .unwrap()
                .removed
                .is_empty());
        }
        assert!(scene.object_exists(target));
    }

    #[test]
    fn xr_input_preserves_scale_and_full_grip_orientation_rebind_hides_old() {
        let (mut scene, mut c, _, sword) = setup();
        let scale = Vec3::new(0.2, 0.3, 0.4);
        scene.set_object_scale(sword, scale);
        c.bind(&mut scene, Some(sword), true).unwrap();
        let rotation = Quat::from_euler(EulerRot::YXZ, 1.1, 0.7, -0.4);
        let grip = Mat4::from_rotation_translation(rotation, Vec3::new(1., 2., 3.));
        c.update(&mut scene, Some(grip), false).unwrap();
        let transform = scene.objects()[&sword].transform;
        assert_eq!(transform.scale, scale);
        assert!(
            (transform.model().transform_point3(-Vec3::Z)
                - grip.transform_point3(-Vec3::Z * scale))
            .length()
                < 1e-5
        );
        let other = scene.add_cube(Vec3::ZERO);
        c.bind(&mut scene, Some(other), false).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(scene.objects()[&sword].transform.position, HIDDEN);
        assert!(c
            .update(&mut scene, Some(pose(0.3)), true)
            .unwrap()
            .removed
            .is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn xr_input_removed_binding_unbinds_before_pose_and_can_rebind() {
        for missing_pose in [false, true] {
            let (mut scene, mut c, target, sword) = setup();
            c.update(&mut scene, Some(pose(-0.3)), true).unwrap();
            c.update(&mut scene, Some(pose(-0.1)), true).unwrap();
            assert!(scene.remove_object(sword));
            let next_pose = if missing_pose { None } else { Some(pose(0.3)) };
            assert!(c
                .update(&mut scene, next_pose, true)
                .unwrap()
                .removed
                .is_empty());
            assert!(c.id.is_none() && c.anchor.is_none() && c.previous.is_none());
            c.reset(&mut scene);
            assert!(c
                .update(&mut scene, Some(pose(0.3)), true)
                .unwrap()
                .removed
                .is_empty());
            assert!(scene.object_exists(target));
            let replacement = scene.add_cube(Vec3::ZERO);
            scene
                .set_cutter(replacement, Some([Vec3::ZERO, -Vec3::Z]))
                .unwrap();
            c.bind(&mut scene, Some(replacement), true).unwrap();
            assert!(c
                .update(&mut scene, Some(pose(0.3)), true)
                .unwrap()
                .removed
                .is_empty());
            assert!(scene.object_exists(target));
            scene.clear();
            assert!(c.update(&mut scene, None, true).unwrap().removed.is_empty());
            assert!(c.id.is_none());
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn xr_input_large_rotation_and_direction_reversal_restart_stroke() {
        let (mut scene, mut c, target, _) = setup();
        c.update(&mut scene, Some(pose(-0.3)), true).unwrap();
        c.update(&mut scene, Some(pose(-0.1)), true).unwrap();
        c.update(&mut scene, Some(pose(-0.2)), true).unwrap();
        let rotation =
            Mat4::from_rotation_translation(Quat::from_rotation_z(1.), Vec3::new(0., 0.3, 0.5));
        assert!(c
            .update(&mut scene, Some(rotation), true)
            .unwrap()
            .removed
            .is_empty());
        assert!(scene.object_exists(target));
    }
}


# File: src/xr_locomotion.rs
//! Opt-in XR locomotion with optional shared scene collision surfaces. Platform poses stay in local-floor space;
//! one Rust-owned rigid origin transforms both eyes, head and equipment together.
use glam::{Mat4, Vec2, Vec3};

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct LocomotionConfig {
    /// Walkable head-centre bounds; callers inset these from authored walls.
    pub bounds: [f32; 4],
    /// Solid floor footprints, inflated here by the player's clearance radius.
    pub obstacles: Vec<[f32; 4]>,
    pub scene_collisions: bool,
    pub teleport_speed: f32,
    pub speed: f32,
    pub teleport_range: f32,
    pub slow_scale: f32,
    pub marker: u32,
}
impl LocomotionConfig {
    pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<(), String> {
        fn rect(r: &[f32; 4]) -> bool {
            r.iter().all(|v| v.is_finite() && v.abs() <= 90.) && r[0] < r[1] && r[2] < r[3]
        }
        if !rect(&self.bounds)
            || self.obstacles.len() > 128
            || !self.obstacles.iter().all(rect)
            || !self.teleport_speed.is_finite()
            || !(1. ..=30.).contains(&self.teleport_speed)
            || !self.speed.is_finite()
            || !(0.1..=6.).contains(&self.speed)
            || !self.teleport_range.is_finite()
            || !(1. ..=30.).contains(&self.teleport_range)
            || !self.slow_scale.is_finite()
            || !(0.01..=1.).contains(&self.slow_scale)
        {
            return Err("Invalid locomotion bounds, obstacles, speed, range or time scale".into());
        }
        if !self.walkable(Vec2::ZERO) {
            return Err("Locomotion spawn must be walkable".into());
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    fn walkable(&self, p: Vec2) -> bool {
        let b = self.bounds;
        p.x >= b[0]
            && p.x <= b[1]
            && p.y >= b[2]
            && p.y <= b[3]
            && (self.scene_collisions || !self.obstacles.iter().any(|r| inside(p, expanded(*r))))
    }
    fn clear_segment(&self, a: Vec2, b: Vec2) -> bool {
        self.walkable(b)
            && !self
                .obstacles
                .iter()
                .any(|r| segment_hits(a, b, expanded(*r)))
    }
}
fn expanded(r: [f32; 4]) -> [f32; 4] {
    [r[0] - 0.4, r[1] + 0.4, r[2] - 0.4, r[3] + 0.4]
}
fn inside(p: Vec2, r: [f32; 4]) -> bool {
    p.x >= r[0] && p.x <= r[1] && p.y >= r[2] && p.y <= r[3]
}
fn flat(p: Vec3) -> Vec2 {
    Vec2::new(p.x, p.z)
}
fn segment_hits(a: Vec2, b: Vec2, r: [f32; 4]) -> bool {
    let mut lo: f32 = 0.;
    let mut hi: f32 = 1.;
    for (start, delta, min, max) in [(a.x, b.x - a.x, r[0], r[1]), (a.y, b.y - a.y, r[2], r[3])] {
        if delta.abs() < 1e-6 {
            if start < min || start > max {
                return false;
            }
        } else {
            let x = (min - start) / delta;
            let y = (max - start) / delta;
            lo = lo.max(x.min(y));
            hi = hi.min(x.max(y));
            if lo > hi {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    true
}
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct XrLocomotion {
    pub config: Option<LocomotionConfig>,
    offset: Vec3,
    yaw: f32,
    pub aiming: bool,
    pub target: Option<Vec3>,
    held: bool,
    armed: bool,
    turn_latched: bool,
    vertical_speed: f32,
    previous_head: Option<Vec3>,
}
impl XrLocomotion {
    pub fn configure(&mut self, config: Option<LocomotionConfig>) -> Result<(), String> {
        if let Some(config) = &config {
            config.validate()?;
        }
        *self = Self {
            config,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        Ok(())
    }
    pub fn origin(&self) -> Mat4 {
        Mat4::from_translation(self.offset) * Mat4::from_rotation_y(self.yaw)
    }
    pub fn world(&self, pose: Mat4) -> Mat4 {
        self.origin() * pose
    }
    pub fn time_scale(&self) -> f32 {
        if self.aiming {
            self.config.as_ref().map_or(1., |c| c.slow_scale)
        } else {
            1.
        }
    }
    /// Cancellation requires a fresh release before A can arm again.
    pub fn cancel(&mut self) {
        self.aiming = false;
        self.target = None;
        self.held = false;
        self.armed = false;
        self.turn_latched = false;
        self.previous_head = None;
    }
    pub fn reset(&mut self) {
        self.cancel();
        self.offset = Vec3::ZERO;
        self.yaw = 0.;
        self.vertical_speed = 0.;
    }
    /// Returns true for a discontinuity, so equipment cannot sweep across a teleport/snap.
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn step(
        &mut self,
        head: Option<Mat4>,
        ray: Option<Mat4>,
        axes: [f32; 3],
        held: bool,
        cancel: bool,
        dt: f32,
    ) -> bool {
        self.step_with_world(head, ray, axes, held, cancel, dt, None)
    }
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn step_with_world(
        &mut self,
        head: Option<Mat4>,
        ray: Option<Mat4>,
        axes: [f32; 3],
        held: bool,
        cancel: bool,
        dt: f32,
        world: Option<&crate::collision::CollisionWorld>,
    ) -> bool {
        let Some(config) = self.config.clone() else {
            return false;
        };
        let Some(head) = head.filter(|m| crate::xr_input::valid_pose(*m)) else {
            self.cancel();
            return false;
        };
        if !dt.is_finite() || !(0. ..=0.25).contains(&dt) || !axes.iter().all(|a| a.is_finite()) {
            self.cancel();
            return false;
        }
        let ray = ray.filter(|m| crate::xr_input::valid_pose(*m));
        let scene_world = world.filter(|_| config.scene_collisions);
        if (ray.is_none() || cancel) && scene_world.is_none() {
            self.cancel();
            return false;
        }
        let held = held && ray.is_some() && !cancel;
        if ray.is_none() || cancel {
            self.cancel();
        }
        if !held {
            self.armed = true;
        }
        let mut jumped = false;
        let mut world_head = self.world(head).w_axis.truncate();
        let height = head.w_axis.y.clamp(0.6, 2.5);
        let half = Vec3::new(0.4, height * 0.5, 0.4);
        if let Some(world) = scene_world {
            if let Some(previous) = self.previous_head {
                let previous = self.origin().transform_point3(previous);
                let feet = Vec3::new(previous.x, self.offset.y, previous.z);
                let delta = Vec3::new(world_head.x - previous.x, 0., world_head.z - previous.z);
                let moved = world.move_character(feet, half, delta, None);
                let resolved = if config.walkable(flat(moved.position)) {
                    moved.position
                } else {
                    feet
                };
                self.offset += resolved - feet - delta;
                world_head = self.world(head).w_axis.truncate();
            }
        }
        self.previous_head = Some(head.w_axis.truncate());
        if axes[2].abs() < 0.25 {
            self.turn_latched = false;
        }
        if !held && axes[2].abs() > 0.7 && !self.turn_latched {
            self.yaw -= axes[2].signum() * std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_6;
            // Turn about the physical head, not the reference-space origin.
            self.offset += world_head - self.world(head).w_axis.truncate();
            self.turn_latched = true;
            jumped = true;
        }
        if !held {
            let stick = Vec2::new(axes[0], axes[1]).clamp_length_max(1.);
            if stick.length() > 0.18 {
                let forward = self.world(head).transform_vector3(Vec3::NEG_Z);
                let forward = Vec3::new(forward.x, 0., forward.z)
                    .try_normalize()
                    .unwrap_or(Vec3::NEG_Z);
                let right = forward.cross(Vec3::Y);
                let delta = (right * stick.x - forward * stick.y) * config.speed * dt.min(0.05);
                if let Some(world) = scene_world {
                    let feet = Vec3::new(world_head.x, self.offset.y, world_head.z);
                    let moved = world.move_character(feet, half, delta, None);
                    if config.walkable(flat(moved.position)) {
                        self.offset += moved.position - feet;
                        world_head = self.world(head).w_axis.truncate();
                    }
                } else {
                    // Axis sliding plus swept footprint tests prevent tunnelling at low FPS.
                    for step in [Vec3::new(delta.x, 0., 0.), Vec3::new(0., 0., delta.z)] {
                        if config.clear_segment(flat(world_head), flat(world_head + step)) {
                            self.offset += step;
                            world_head += step;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if let Some(world) = scene_world {
            // Use real elapsed time (not the aiming slow-motion scale), in bounded substeps.
            let steps = (dt / (1. / 72.)).ceil().max(1.) as usize;
            let h = dt / steps as f32;
            for _ in 0..steps {
                self.vertical_speed = (self.vertical_speed - 9.8 * h).max(-30.);
                let feet = Vec3::new(world_head.x, self.offset.y, world_head.z);
                let moved =
                    world.move_character(feet, half, Vec3::Y * self.vertical_speed * h, None);
                self.offset.y = moved.position.y;
                if moved.grounded || moved.hit_ceiling {
                    self.vertical_speed = 0.;
                }
            }
            world_head = self.world(head).w_axis.truncate();
        }
        self.aiming = held && self.armed;
        if self.aiming {
            self.target = if let Some(world) = scene_world {
                self.surface_landing(self.world(ray.unwrap()), world_head, half, &config, world)
            } else {
                self.landing(self.world(ray.unwrap()), world_head, &config)
            };
        } else {
            if self.held && !held {
                if let Some(target) = self.target.filter(|t| config.walkable(flat(*t))) {
                    if scene_world.is_none_or(|w| {
                        w.character_clear(target, half)
                            && w.cast_segment(target + Vec3::Y * 0.005, target - Vec3::Y * 0.005)
                                .is_some_and(|hit| {
                                    hit.normal.y > 0.9 && hit.position.distance(target) < 0.006
                                })
                    }) {
                        self.offset +=
                            Vec3::new(target.x - world_head.x, 0., target.z - world_head.z);
                        if scene_world.is_some() {
                            self.offset.y = target.y;
                            self.vertical_speed = 0.;
                        }
                        jumped = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            self.target = None;
        }
        self.held = self.aiming;
        jumped
    }
    fn surface_landing(
        &self,
        ray: Mat4,
        head: Vec3,
        half: Vec3,
        config: &LocomotionConfig,
        world: &crate::collision::CollisionWorld,
    ) -> Option<Vec3> {
        let start = ray.w_axis.truncate();
        // A controller behind a wall cannot author a path through it.
        if world.cast_segment(head, start).is_some() {
            return None;
        }
        let velocity = ray.transform_vector3(Vec3::NEG_Z) * config.teleport_speed;
        let mut previous = start;
        for n in 1..=360 {
            let t = n as f32 / 60.;
            let point = start + velocity * t - Vec3::Y * (4.9 * t * t);
            if let Some(hit) = world.cast_segment(previous, point) {
                let target = hit.position;
                return (hit.normal.y > 0.9
                    && velocity.y - 9.8 * t < 0.
                    && flat(target).distance(flat(head)) <= config.teleport_range
                    && config.walkable(flat(target))
                    && world.character_clear(target, half))
                .then_some(target);
            }
            previous = point;
            if point.y < -100. {
                break;
            }
        }
        None
    }
    fn landing(&self, ray: Mat4, head: Vec3, config: &LocomotionConfig) -> Option<Vec3> {
        let start = ray.w_axis.truncate();
        if start.y <= 0. || start.y > 6.5 {
            return None;
        }
        let velocity = ray.transform_vector3(Vec3::NEG_Z) * 9.;
        // Solve y(t)=0 analytically, sample only the collision path, not the endpoint.
        let time = (velocity.y + (velocity.y * velocity.y + 19.6 * start.y).sqrt()) / 9.8;
        let target = start + velocity * time - Vec3::Y * (4.9 * time * time);
        if flat(target).distance(flat(head)) > config.teleport_range
            || !config.walkable(flat(target))
        {
            return None;
        }
        let mut previous = flat(head);
        for n in 0..=48 {
            let t = time * n as f32 / 48.;
            let point = start + velocity * t - Vec3::Y * (4.9 * t * t);
            if point.y > 6.5 || !config.clear_segment(previous, flat(point)) {
                return None;
            }
            previous = flat(point);
        }
        Some(Vec3::new(target.x, 0., target.z))
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    fn setup() -> XrLocomotion {
        let mut l = XrLocomotion::default();
        l.configure(Some(LocomotionConfig {
            bounds: [-11., 11., -23., 7.],
            obstacles: vec![],
            scene_collisions: false,
            teleport_speed: 9.,
            speed: 2.5,
            teleport_range: 10.,
            slow_scale: 0.15,
            marker: 1,
        }))
        .unwrap();
        l
    }
    fn head() -> Option<Mat4> {
        Some(Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(0., 1.6, 0.)))
    }
    fn ray() -> Option<Mat4> {
        Some(Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(0.3, 1.1, -0.2)))
    }
    fn tick(l: &mut XrLocomotion, axes: [f32; 3], held: bool) -> bool {
        l.step(head(), ray(), axes, held, false, 1. / 72.)
    }
    fn surface_world() -> crate::collision::CollisionWorld {
        use crate::collision::{Aabb, Collider, CollisionWorld};
        let mut world = CollisionWorld::default();
        world.rebuild(vec![
            Collider {
                id: 1,
                bounds: Aabb::new(Vec3::new(-20., -1., -30.), Vec3::new(20., 0., 10.)).unwrap(),
            },
            Collider {
                id: 2,
                bounds: Aabb::new(Vec3::new(-3., 1.7, -9.), Vec3::new(3., 2., -3.)).unwrap(),
            },
        ]);
        world
    }
    fn aimed_ray(target: Vec3) -> Mat4 {
        let start = Vec3::new(0., 1.1, 0.);
        let d = -target.z;
        let y = target.y - start.y;
        let v: f32 = 9.;
        let pitch = ((v * v + (v.powi(4) - 9.8 * (9.8 * d * d + 2. * y * v * v)).sqrt())
            / (9.8 * d))
            .atan();
        Mat4::from_translation(start) * Mat4::from_rotation_x(pitch)
    }
    #[test]
    fn xr_locomotion_surface_teleport_stand_walk_off_and_land() {
        let mut l = setup();
        l.config.as_mut().unwrap().scene_collisions = true;
        let world = surface_world();
        let ray = Some(aimed_ray(Vec3::new(0., 2., -6.)));
        l.step_with_world(head(), ray, [0.; 3], false, false, 1. / 72., Some(&world));
        l.step_with_world(head(), ray, [0.; 3], true, false, 1. / 72., Some(&world));
        assert!(
            (l.target.unwrap() - Vec3::new(0., 2., -6.)).length() < 0.05,
            "{:?}",
            l.target
        );
        assert!(l.step_with_world(head(), ray, [0.; 3], false, false, 1. / 72., Some(&world)));
        assert!((l.offset.y - 2.).abs() < 1e-5);
        for _ in 0..120 {
            l.step_with_world(head(), ray, [0.; 3], false, false, 1. / 72., Some(&world));
        }
        assert!((l.world(head().unwrap()).w_axis.y - 3.6).abs() < 1e-5);
        for _ in 0..120 {
            l.step_with_world(
                head(),
                ray,
                [1., 0., 0.],
                false,
                false,
                1. / 72.,
                Some(&world),
            );
        }
        assert!(l.offset.x > 3.4 && l.offset.y < 1.9, "{:?}", l.offset);
        for _ in 0..120 {
            l.step_with_world(head(), None, [0.; 3], false, false, 1. / 72., Some(&world));
        }
        assert!(
            l.offset.y.abs() < 1e-5,
            "must land on street even without controller tracking"
        );
    }
    #[test]
    fn xr_locomotion_surface_room_scale_edge_and_under_bridge() {
        let mut l = setup();
        l.config.as_mut().unwrap().scene_collisions = true;
        let world = surface_world();
        l.offset = Vec3::new(0., 2., -6.);
        l.step_with_world(head(), ray(), [0.; 3], false, false, 1. / 72., Some(&world));
        let moved = Some(Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(4., 1.6, 0.)));
        for _ in 0..120 {
            l.step_with_world(moved, ray(), [0.; 3], false, false, 1. / 72., Some(&world));
        }
        assert!(
            l.offset.y.abs() < 1e-5,
            "physical walking beyond edge falls"
        );
        l.reset();
        l.offset.z = -6.;
        l.step_with_world(
            head(),
            ray(),
            [1., 0., 0.],
            false,
            false,
            1. / 72.,
            Some(&world),
        );
        assert!(
            l.offset.x > 0. && l.offset.y.abs() < 1e-5,
            "bridge must leave space below it"
        );
    }
    #[test]
    fn xr_locomotion_surface_rejects_insufficient_headroom_and_sides() {
        use crate::collision::{Aabb, Collider};
        let mut l = setup();
        l.config.as_mut().unwrap().scene_collisions = true;
        let mut world = surface_world();
        let mut boxes = world.query(
            Aabb::new(Vec3::splat(-50.), Vec3::splat(50.)).unwrap(),
            None,
        );
        boxes.push(Collider {
            id: 3,
            bounds: Aabb::new(Vec3::new(-3., 3., -9.), Vec3::new(3., 3.2, -3.)).unwrap(),
        });
        world.rebuild(boxes);
        let half = Vec3::new(0.4, 0.8, 0.4);
        assert!(!world.character_clear(Vec3::new(0., 2., -6.), half));
        let side = Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(0., 1.8, 0.)) * Mat4::from_rotation_x(0.2);
        assert!(l
            .surface_landing(
                side,
                Vec3::new(0., 1.6, 0.),
                half,
                l.config.as_ref().unwrap(),
                &world
            )
            .is_none());
    }
    #[test]
    fn xr_locomotion_walk_deadzone_and_bounds() {
        let mut l = setup();
        tick(&mut l, [0.1, 0., 0.], false);
        assert_eq!(l.offset, Vec3::ZERO);
        for _ in 0..1500 {
            tick(&mut l, [0., -1., 0.], false);
        }
        assert!(l.offset.z >= -23. && l.offset.z < -22.9);
    }
    #[test]
    fn xr_locomotion_teleport_slow_release_and_real_head_offset() {
        let mut l = setup();
        let head_transform = Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(1., 1.7, 0.5));
        let h = Some(head_transform);
        l.step(h, ray(), [0.; 3], false, false, 0.01);
        l.step(h, ray(), [0.; 3], true, false, 0.01);
        assert_eq!(l.time_scale(), 0.15);
        let target = l.target.unwrap();
        assert!(l.step(h, ray(), [0.; 3], false, false, 0.01));
        let new_head = l.world(head_transform).w_axis.truncate();
        assert!(flat(new_head).distance(flat(target)) < 1e-5);
        assert!((new_head.y - 1.7).abs() < 1e-5);
        assert_eq!(l.time_scale(), 1.);
    }
    #[test]
    fn xr_locomotion_tracking_loss_and_cancel_never_teleport() {
        let mut l = setup();
        tick(&mut l, [0.; 3], false);
        tick(&mut l, [0.; 3], true);
        l.step(None, None, [0.; 3], true, false, 0.01);
        tick(&mut l, [0.; 3], true);
        tick(&mut l, [0.; 3], false);
        assert_eq!(l.offset, Vec3::ZERO);
        assert_eq!(l.time_scale(), 1.);
        tick(&mut l, [0.; 3], true);
        l.step(head(), ray(), [0.; 3], true, true, 0.01);
        tick(&mut l, [0.; 3], false);
        assert_eq!(l.offset, Vec3::ZERO);
    }
    #[test]
    fn xr_locomotion_snap_pivots_at_head_and_latches() {
        let mut l = setup();
        let head_transform = Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(1., 1.6, 0.5));
        let h = Some(head_transform);
        assert!(l.step(h, ray(), [0., 0., 1.], false, false, 0.01));
        let origin = l.origin();
        assert!(
            l.world(head_transform)
                .w_axis
                .truncate()
                .distance(head_transform.w_axis.truncate())
                < 1e-5
        );
        l.step(h, ray(), [0., 0., 1.], false, false, 0.01);
        assert_eq!(origin, l.origin());
    }
    #[test]
    fn xr_locomotion_blocked_arc_and_swept_walk() {
        let mut l = setup();
        l.config
            .as_mut()
            .unwrap()
            .obstacles
            .push([-2., 2., -2., -1.5]);
        tick(&mut l, [0.; 3], false);
        tick(&mut l, [0.; 3], true);
        assert!(l.target.is_none());
        tick(&mut l, [0.; 3], false);
        for _ in 0..200 {
            tick(&mut l, [0., -1., 0.], false);
        }
        assert!(l.offset.z > -1.1);
        assert!(segment_hits(
            Vec2::new(0., 0.),
            Vec2::new(0., -10.),
            [-1., 1., -5., -4.9]
        ));
    }
    #[test]
    fn xr_locomotion_invalid_input_and_range() {
        let mut l = setup();
        l.config.as_mut().unwrap().teleport_range = 1.;
        tick(&mut l, [0.; 3], false);
        tick(&mut l, [0.; 3], true);
        assert!(l.target.is_none());
        assert!(!l.step(head(), ray(), [f32::NAN, 0., 0.], false, false, 0.01));
        assert!(l.origin().is_finite());
        l.reset();
        assert_eq!(l.origin(), Mat4::IDENTITY);
        assert_eq!(l.time_scale(), 1.);
    }
}


# File: src/xr_player.rs
//! Generic Rust-owned XR tracking, independent of optional scene-object bindings.
use crate::scene::{CutReport, SceneManager};
use crate::xr_input::{valid_pose, TrackedController};
use glam::{EulerRot, Mat4, Quat, Vec3};
use std::collections::{BTreeSet, VecDeque};

const HIDDEN: Vec3 = Vec3::new(0., -10_000., 0.);

/// Net grip displacement over ~60ms, not the amplified velocity of a remote blade tip.
#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct GripSpeed {
    time: f32,
    samples: VecDeque<(f32, Vec3)>,
}
impl GripSpeed {
    pub(crate) fn sample(&mut self, from: Vec3, to: Vec3, dt: f32) -> f32 {
        if self.samples.is_empty() {
            self.samples.push_back((self.time, from));
        }
        self.time += dt;
        self.samples.push_back((self.time, to));
        while self.samples.len() > 2
            && (self.samples[1].0 <= self.time - 0.06 || self.samples.len() > 10)
        {
            self.samples.pop_front();
        }
        let (start, position) = self.samples[0];
        to.distance(position) / (self.time - start).max(0.001)
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct TrackedPoseState {
    pub matrix: Mat4,
    /// Net translation in meters per second; head tracking currently reports zero.
    pub speed: f32,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct XrPlayer {
    pub locomotion: crate::xr_locomotion::XrLocomotion,
    pub controllers: [TrackedController; 2],
    head: Option<TrackedPoseState>,
    hands: [Option<TrackedPoseState>; 2],
    head_binding: Option<(u32, Vec3, Vec3, bool)>,
    reference: Mat4,
    hand_speeds: [GripSpeed; 2],
    inventory: BTreeSet<u32>,
}

impl XrPlayer {
    pub fn head(&self) -> Option<TrackedPoseState> {
        self.head
    }

    pub fn hand(&self, hand: usize) -> Option<TrackedPoseState> {
        self.hands.get(hand).copied().flatten()
    }

    pub fn head_object(&self) -> Option<u32> {
        self.head_binding.map(|(id, _, _, _)| id)
    }

    /// Registered scene objects, independent of their optional hand equipment slots.
    pub fn inventory(&self) -> Vec<u32> {
        self.inventory.iter().copied().collect()
    }

    pub fn add_item(&mut self, scene: &SceneManager, id: u32) -> Result<(), String> {
        self.validate_item(scene, id)?;
        self.prune_inventory(scene);
        self.inventory.insert(id);
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Remove ownership and hide held equipment; scene objects remain caller-owned.
    pub fn remove_item(&mut self, scene: &mut SceneManager, id: u32) -> Result<(), String> {
        for controller in &mut self.controllers {
            if controller.object_id() == Some(id) {
                controller.bind(scene, None, false)?;
            }
        }
        self.inventory.remove(&id);
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn bind_hand(
        &mut self,
        scene: &mut SceneManager,
        hand: usize,
        id: Option<u32>,
        cutting: bool,
    ) -> Result<(), String> {
        if hand >= self.controllers.len() {
            return Err("Tracked hand index must be 0 or 1".into());
        }
        if let Some(id) = id {
            self.validate_item(scene, id)?;
            if self.controllers[1 - hand].object_id() == Some(id) || self.head_object() == Some(id)
            {
                return Err("Tracked object is already equipped in another slot".into());
            }
        }
        // Controller binding validates cutter configuration before changing its old binding.
        self.controllers[hand].bind(scene, id, cutting)?;
        self.prune_inventory(scene);
        if let Some(id) = id {
            self.inventory.insert(id);
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn validate_item(&self, scene: &SceneManager, id: u32) -> Result<(), String> {
        if !scene.object_exists(id) {
            return Err("Inventory object does not exist".into());
        }
        let live_count = self
            .inventory
            .iter()
            .filter(|&&id| scene.object_exists(id))
            .count();
        if !self.inventory.contains(&id) && live_count >= 64 {
            return Err("XR player inventory is full (64 objects)".into());
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn prune_inventory(&mut self, scene: &SceneManager) {
        self.inventory.retain(|&id| scene.object_exists(id));
    }

    pub fn bind_head(&mut self, scene: &mut SceneManager, id: Option<u32>) -> Result<(), String> {
        self.bind_head_offset(scene, id, Vec3::ZERO, false)
    }

    pub fn set_reference(&mut self, reference: Mat4) {
        if valid_pose(reference) {
            self.reference = reference;
        }
    }

    pub fn bind_head_offset(
        &mut self,
        scene: &mut SceneManager,
        id: Option<u32>,
        offset: Vec3,
        feet: bool,
    ) -> Result<(), String> {
        if !offset.is_finite() || offset.abs().max_element() > 10. {
            return Err("Tracked attachment offset must be finite within 10m".into());
        }
        if id.is_some_and(|id| self.controllers.iter().any(|c| c.object_id() == Some(id))) {
            return Err("Tracked object is already equipped in a hand".into());
        }
        let binding = id
            .map(|id| {
                scene
                    .objects()
                    .get(&id)
                    .map(|object| (id, object.transform.scale, offset, feet))
                    .ok_or_else(|| "Tracked head object does not exist".to_string())
            })
            .transpose()?;
        if let Some((old, _, _, _)) = self.head_binding {
            scene.set_object_position(old, HIDDEN);
        }
        self.head_binding = binding;
        if let Some((id, _, _, _)) = binding {
            scene.set_object_position(id, HIDDEN);
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn update_head(
        &mut self,
        scene: &mut SceneManager,
        pose: Option<Mat4>,
    ) -> Result<(), String> {
        self.prune_inventory(scene);
        if self
            .head_object()
            .is_some_and(|id| !scene.object_exists(id))
        {
            self.head_binding = None;
        }
        let invalid = pose.is_some_and(|pose| !valid_pose(pose));
        self.head = pose
            .filter(|_| !invalid)
            .map(|matrix| TrackedPoseState { matrix, speed: 0. });
        if let Some((id, scale, offset, feet)) = self.head_binding {
            if let Some(state) = self.head {
                let (y, x, z) = Quat::from_mat4(&state.matrix)
                    .normalize()
                    .to_euler(EulerRot::YXZ);
                let head = state.matrix.w_axis.truncate();
                let (position, rotation) = if feet {
                    let floor = Vec3::new(head.x, self.reference.w_axis.y, head.z);
                    let position = floor + self.reference.transform_vector3(offset);
                    let toward = head - position;
                    (
                        position,
                        Vec3::new(
                            -toward.y.atan2(toward.x.hypot(toward.z)),
                            toward.x.atan2(toward.z),
                            0.,
                        ),
                    )
                } else {
                    (state.matrix.transform_point3(offset), Vec3::new(x, y, z))
                };
                scene.set_object_transform(id, position, rotation, scale);
            } else {
                scene.set_object_position(id, HIDDEN);
            }
        }
        if invalid {
            Err("Tracked pose must be a finite rigid transform within 100m".into())
        } else {
            Ok(())
        }
    }

    pub fn update_hand(
        &mut self,
        scene: &mut SceneManager,
        hand: usize,
        pose: Option<Mat4>,
        pressed: bool,
        dt: f32,
    ) -> Result<CutReport, String> {
        if hand >= self.hands.len() {
            return Err("Tracked hand index must be 0 or 1".into());
        }
        self.prune_inventory(scene);
        if pose.is_some_and(|pose| !valid_pose(pose)) {
            self.hands[hand] = None;
            self.hand_speeds[hand] = GripSpeed::default();
            self.controllers[hand].reset(scene);
            return Err("Tracked pose must be a finite rigid transform within 100m".into());
        }
        let speed = if let Some(matrix) = pose {
            let speed = self.hands[hand].and_then(|previous| {
                let from = previous.matrix.w_axis.truncate();
                let to = matrix.w_axis.truncate();
                let distance = from.distance(to);
                let angle = Quat::from_mat4(&matrix)
                    .angle_between(Quat::from_mat4(&previous.matrix))
                    .abs();
                (dt.is_finite()
                    && dt > 0.
                    && dt <= 0.05
                    && distance <= 1.
                    && distance <= 15. * dt + 0.025
                    && angle <= 1.5
                    && angle <= 45. * dt + 0.03)
                    .then(|| self.hand_speeds[hand].sample(from, to, dt))
            });
            if speed.is_none() {
                self.hand_speeds[hand] = GripSpeed::default();
            }
            let speed = speed.unwrap_or(0.);
            self.hands[hand] = Some(TrackedPoseState { matrix, speed });
            speed
        } else {
            self.hands[hand] = None;
            self.hand_speeds[hand] = GripSpeed::default();
            0.
        };
        self.controllers[hand].update_timed_with_speed(scene, pose, pressed, dt, Some(speed))
    }

    /// Clear poses and motion history while preserving optional object bindings.
    pub fn reset_tracking(&mut self, scene: &mut SceneManager) {
        self.head = None;
        self.hands = [None; 2];
        self.hand_speeds = Default::default();
        if let Some((id, _, _, _)) = self.head_binding {
            scene.set_object_position(id, HIDDEN);
        }
        for controller in &mut self.controllers {
            controller.reset(scene);
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn xr_player_tracks_unbound_head_and_hands_without_spawning() {
        let mut scene = SceneManager::default();
        let mut player = XrPlayer::default();
        let pose = Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::new(1., 2., 3.));
        player.update_head(&mut scene, Some(pose)).unwrap();
        for hand in 0..2 {
            player
                .update_hand(&mut scene, hand, Some(pose), false, 0.01)
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(player.hand(hand).unwrap().matrix, pose);
        }
        assert_eq!(player.head().unwrap().matrix, pose);
        assert!(scene.objects().is_empty());
        assert!(player.hand(2).is_none());
        assert!(player
            .update_hand(&mut scene, 2, Some(pose), false, 0.01)
            .is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn feet_attachment_ignores_gaze_but_follows_reference_and_floor() {
        let mut scene = SceneManager::default();
        let mut player = XrPlayer::default();
        let panel = scene.add_cube(Vec3::ZERO);
        let offset = Vec3::new(0.9, 0.35, -1.);
        player
            .bind_head_offset(&mut scene, Some(panel), offset, true)
            .unwrap();
        let head = Vec3::new(2., 1.7, 3.);
        player
            .update_head(&mut scene, Some(Mat4::from_translation(head)))
            .unwrap();
        let position = scene.objects()[&panel].transform.position;
        for yaw in [0.5, 1.5, -1.] {
            player
                .update_head(
                    &mut scene,
                    Some(Mat4::from_rotation_translation(
                        Quat::from_rotation_y(yaw),
                        head,
                    )),
                )
                .unwrap();
            assert!(scene.objects()[&panel]
                .transform
                .position
                .abs_diff_eq(position, 1e-6));
        }
        let reference =
            Mat4::from_rotation_translation(Quat::from_rotation_y(1.), Vec3::new(0., 0.4, 0.));
        player.set_reference(reference);
        player
            .update_head(&mut scene, Some(Mat4::from_translation(head)))
            .unwrap();
        assert!(scene.objects()[&panel].transform.position.abs_diff_eq(
            Vec3::new(head.x, 0.4, head.z) + reference.transform_vector3(offset),
            1e-6
        ));
        player.update_head(&mut scene, None).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(scene.objects()[&panel].transform.position, HIDDEN);
        assert!(player
            .bind_head_offset(&mut scene, Some(panel), Vec3::splat(f32::NAN), true)
            .is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn xr_player_bindings_preserve_scale_orientation_and_hide_on_loss() {
        let mut scene = SceneManager::default();
        let mut player = XrPlayer::default();
        let head = scene.add_cube(Vec3::ZERO);
        let hand = scene.add_cube(Vec3::ZERO);
        let scale = Vec3::new(0.2, 0.3, 0.4);
        for id in [head, hand] {
            scene.set_object_scale(id, scale);
        }
        player.bind_head(&mut scene, Some(head)).unwrap();
        player.bind_hand(&mut scene, 0, Some(hand), false).unwrap();
        let pose = Mat4::from_rotation_translation(
            Quat::from_euler(EulerRot::YXZ, 1.1, 0.7, -0.4),
            Vec3::new(1., 2., 3.),
        );
        player.update_head(&mut scene, Some(pose)).unwrap();
        player
            .update_hand(&mut scene, 0, Some(pose), false, 0.01)
            .unwrap();
        for id in [head, hand] {
            let transform = scene.objects()[&id].transform;
            assert_eq!(transform.scale, scale);
            assert!(transform
                .model()
                .abs_diff_eq(pose * Mat4::from_scale(scale), 1e-5));
        }
        player.reset_tracking(&mut scene);
        assert!(player.head().is_none() && player.hand(0).is_none());
        assert_eq!(player.head_object(), Some(head));
        assert_eq!(player.controllers[0].object_id(), Some(hand));
        for id in [head, hand] {
            assert_eq!(scene.objects()[&id].transform.position, HIDDEN);
        }
        player.update_head(&mut scene, Some(pose)).unwrap();
        player.update_head(&mut scene, None).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(scene.objects()[&head].transform.position, HIDDEN);
        player.bind_head(&mut scene, None).unwrap();
        assert!(scene.object_exists(head));
    }

    #[test]
    fn xr_player_hand_speed_uses_grip_time_and_resets_after_loss_or_invalid_motion() {
        let mut scene = SceneManager::default();
        let mut player = XrPlayer::default();
        for i in 0..10 {
            player
                .update_hand(
                    &mut scene,
                    0,
                    Some(Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::X * i as f32 * 0.01)),
                    false,
                    0.01,
                )
                .unwrap();
            if i > 0 {
                assert!((player.hand(0).unwrap().speed - 1.).abs() < 1e-5);
            }
        }
        player
            .update_hand(&mut scene, 0, None, false, 0.01)
            .unwrap();
        assert!(player.hand(0).is_none());
        for (pose, dt) in [
            (Mat4::IDENTITY, 0.01),
            (Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::X), 0.01),
            (Mat4::IDENTITY, f32::NAN),
        ] {
            player
                .update_hand(&mut scene, 0, Some(pose), false, dt)
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(player.hand(0).unwrap().speed, 0.);
        }
        assert!(player
            .update_hand(
                &mut scene,
                0,
                Some(Mat4::from_scale(Vec3::splat(2.))),
                false,
                0.01
            )
            .is_err());
        assert!(player.hand(0).is_none());
        assert!(player
            .update_head(
                &mut scene,
                Some(Mat4::from_translation(Vec3::splat(f32::NAN)))
            )
            .is_err());
        assert!(player.head().is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn xr_player_inventory_equipment_transfer_and_removal_keep_scene_objects() {
        let mut scene = SceneManager::default();
        let mut player = XrPlayer::default();
        let first = scene.add_cube(Vec3::ZERO);
        let second = scene.add_cube(Vec3::ONE);
        player.add_item(&scene, first).unwrap();
        player.add_item(&scene, first).unwrap();
        player.bind_hand(&mut scene, 0, Some(first), false).unwrap();
        player.bind_hand(&mut scene, 0, None, false).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(player.inventory(), vec![first]);
        assert_eq!(scene.objects()[&first].transform.position, HIDDEN);
        player.bind_hand(&mut scene, 1, Some(first), false).unwrap();
        player
            .bind_hand(&mut scene, 0, Some(second), false)
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(player.inventory(), vec![first, second]);
        player.reset_tracking(&mut scene);
        assert_eq!(player.inventory(), vec![first, second]);
        assert_eq!(player.controllers[1].object_id(), Some(first));
        player.remove_item(&mut scene, first).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(player.controllers[1].object_id(), None);
        assert_eq!(player.inventory(), vec![second]);
        assert_eq!(scene.objects()[&first].transform.position, HIDDEN);
        player.bind_hand(&mut scene, 0, None, false).unwrap();
        scene.set_object_position(second, Vec3::ONE);
        player.remove_item(&mut scene, second).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(scene.objects()[&second].transform.position, Vec3::ONE);
        assert!(player.inventory().is_empty());
        assert_eq!(scene.objects().len(), 2);
    }

    #[test]
    fn xr_player_equipment_conflicts_and_failed_validation_are_atomic() {
        let mut scene = SceneManager::default();
        let mut player = XrPlayer::default();
        let first = scene.add_cube(Vec3::ZERO);
        let second = scene.add_cube(Vec3::ZERO);
        let third = scene.add_cube(Vec3::ZERO);
        player.bind_hand(&mut scene, 0, Some(first), false).unwrap();
        player
            .bind_hand(&mut scene, 1, Some(second), false)
            .unwrap();
        player
            .update_hand(&mut scene, 1, Some(Mat4::IDENTITY), false, 0.01)
            .unwrap();
        for (hand, id, cutting) in [
            (1, first, false),
            (2, third, false),
            (1, u32::MAX, false),
            (1, third, true),
        ] {
            assert!(player
                .bind_hand(&mut scene, hand, Some(id), cutting)
                .is_err());
            assert_eq!(player.controllers[0].object_id(), Some(first));
            assert_eq!(player.controllers[1].object_id(), Some(second));
            assert_eq!(player.inventory(), vec![first, second]);
            assert_eq!(scene.objects()[&second].transform.position, Vec3::ZERO);
        }
        assert!(player.bind_head(&mut scene, Some(first)).is_err());
        assert_eq!(player.head_object(), None);
        player.bind_head(&mut scene, Some(third)).unwrap();
        assert!(player.bind_hand(&mut scene, 0, Some(third), false).is_err());
        assert_eq!(player.head_object(), Some(third));
        assert_eq!(player.controllers[0].object_id(), Some(first));
    }

    #[test]
    fn xr_player_inventory_limit_prunes_removed_objects_on_tracking_updates() {
        let mut scene = SceneManager::default();
        let mut player = XrPlayer::default();
        let ids: Vec<_> = (0..65).map(|_| scene.add_cube(Vec3::ZERO)).collect();
        for &id in &ids[..64] {
            player.add_item(&scene, id).unwrap();
        }
        player.add_item(&scene, ids[0]).unwrap();
        assert!(player.add_item(&scene, ids[64]).is_err());
        assert!(player
            .bind_hand(&mut scene, 0, Some(ids[64]), false)
            .is_err());
        assert_eq!(player.controllers[0].object_id(), None);
        assert_eq!(player.inventory().len(), 64);
        scene.remove_object(ids[0]);
        player
            .update_hand(&mut scene, 0, None, false, 0.01)
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(player.inventory().len(), 63);
        player
            .bind_hand(&mut scene, 0, Some(ids[64]), false)
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(player.inventory().len(), 64);
        assert!(!player.inventory().contains(&ids[0]));
    }
}


# File: src/xr_round.rs
/// Generic opt-in XR round timer, advanced once per platform frame.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct RoundClock {
    pub duration: f32,
    pub remaining: f32,
}
impl RoundClock {
    pub fn new(seconds: f32) -> Option<Self> {
        (seconds.is_finite() && (1.0..=3600.0).contains(&seconds)).then_some(Self {
            duration: seconds,
            remaining: seconds,
        })
    }
    pub fn advance(&mut self, dt: f32) {
        if dt.is_finite() && dt > 0.0 {
            self.remaining = (self.remaining - dt).max(0.0);
        }
    }
    pub fn finished(&self) -> bool {
        self.remaining <= 0.0
    }
}

/// Guaranteed reward for each registered original cut in chain mode.
pub const CHAIN_HIT_POINTS: u64 = 10;

/// Pending bonus; guaranteed hit points are already in ComboScore::score.
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct FruitChain {
    pub kind: String,
    pub count: u32,
    pub points: u32,
}
impl FruitChain {
    /// Total earned by the stored fruit: guaranteed hits and chain bonus.
    pub fn total_points(&self) -> u64 {
        u64::from(self.count)
            .saturating_mul(CHAIN_HIT_POINTS)
            .saturating_add(self.value())
    }
    pub fn value(&self) -> u64 {
        if self.count < 3 {
            return 0;
        }
        let n = u64::from(self.count);
        // The triangular factor fits u64 for every u32 count. Divide before
        // multiplying by points so only the final reward saturates.
        ((n - 2) * (n - 1) / 2).saturating_mul(u64::from(self.points))
    }
}

/// Optional object-tagged scoring. Only original targets can award points;
/// fragments never inherit a target registration.
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct ComboScore {
    pub enabled: bool,
    pub chain_mode: bool,
    pub chains: [Option<FruitChain>; 2],
    pub rejected: u32,
    pub last_lost_bonus: u64,
    pub score: u64,
    pub triples: u32,
    pub streak: u32,
    pub kind: String,
    pub targets: std::collections::BTreeMap<u32, (String, u32, bool)>,
    streak_points: u32,
    display_kind: String,
    display_count: u32,
    chain_wild: [bool; 2],
    last_chain_index: Option<usize>,
    // Relative creation order: 0 = vacant, 1 = older, 2 = newer.
    // Bounded ranks avoid counter overflow during arbitrarily long rounds.
    chain_age: [u8; 2],
}
impl ComboScore {
    pub fn register(&mut self, id: u32, kind: &str, points: u32, wild: bool) -> bool {
        if kind.is_empty()
            || kind.len() > 16
            || !kind.bytes().all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == b' ')
            || !(1..=1_000_000).contains(&points)
            || self
                .targets
                .values()
                .any(|(k, p, _)| k == kind && *p != points)
        {
            return false;
        }
        self.enabled = true;
        self.targets.insert(id, (kind.into(), points, wild));
        true
    }
    pub fn reset(&mut self) {
        *self = Self {
            enabled: self.enabled,
            chain_mode: self.chain_mode,
            targets: std::mem::take(&mut self.targets),
            ..Self::default()
        };
    }
    pub fn set_chain_mode(&mut self, enabled: bool) {
        if self.chain_mode == enabled {
            return;
        }
        self.chain_mode = enabled;
        self.reset();
    }
    /// Consume an original target once. A third ordinary kind replaces the
    /// oldest chain; its previously earned reward remains in the score.
    pub fn hit_chain(&mut self, id: u32) -> Option<bool> {
        let (kind, points, wild) = self.targets.remove(&id)?;
        // Only registered originals get the guaranteed reward, exactly once.
        self.score = self.score.saturating_add(CHAIN_HIT_POINTS);
        self.last_lost_bonus = 0;
        let slot = if wild {
            self.chains
                .iter()
                .enumerate()
                .filter_map(|(index, chain)| chain.as_ref().map(|c| (index, c.count)))
                .min_by_key(|&(index, count)| (count, index))
                .map(|(index, _)| index)
                .or(Some(0))
        } else {
            self.chains
                .iter()
                .position(|chain| chain.as_ref().is_some_and(|c| c.kind == kind))
                .or_else(|| {
                    self.chain_wild
                        .iter()
                        .enumerate()
                        .position(|(index, wild)| *wild && self.chains[index].is_some())
                })
                .or_else(|| self.chains.iter().position(Option::is_none))
                .or_else(|| (0..self.chains.len()).min_by_key(|&index| self.chain_age[index]))
        };
        let index = slot?;
        if !wild
            && !self.chain_wild[index]
            && self.chains[index]
                .as_ref()
                .is_some_and(|chain| chain.kind != kind)
        {
            // Chain growth is credited immediately, so replacing its display
            // row cannot remove points already earned.
            self.last_lost_bonus = 0;
            self.chains[index] = None;
        }
        let old_value = self.chains[index].as_ref().map_or(0, FruitChain::value);
        let old_count = self.chains[index].as_ref().map_or(0, |chain| chain.count);
        if let Some(chain) = self.chains[index].as_mut() {
            if !wild && self.chain_wild[index] {
                chain.kind = kind;
                chain.points = points;
                self.chain_wild[index] = false;
            }
            chain.count = chain.count.saturating_add(1);
        } else {
            let other = 1 - index;
            self.chain_age[other] = u8::from(self.chains[other].is_some());
            self.chain_age[index] = 2;
            self.chains[index] = Some(FruitChain {
                kind: if wild { "ZOLIK".into() } else { kind },
                count: 1,
                points,
            });
            self.chain_wild[index] = wild;
        }
        let chain = self.chains[index]
            .as_ref()
            .expect("chain was inserted or grown");
        let new_value = chain.value();
        self.score = self
            .score
            .saturating_add(new_value.saturating_sub(old_value));
        let new_triples = chain.count / 3;
        self.triples = self
            .triples
            .saturating_add(new_triples.saturating_sub(old_count / 3));
        self.last_chain_index = Some(index);
        Some(true)
    }
    pub fn last_chain_total_points(&self) -> u64 {
        self.last_chain_index
            .and_then(|index| self.chains[index].as_ref())
            .map_or(0, FruitChain::total_points)
    }
    pub fn bank_chain(&mut self, index: usize) -> Option<u64> {
        let chain = self.chains.get_mut(index)?.take()?;
        self.chain_wild[index] = false;
        self.chain_age[index] = 0;
        Some(chain.value())
    }
    pub fn pending_bonus(&self) -> u64 {
        self.chains
            .iter()
            .flatten()
            .fold(0_u64, |sum, chain| sum.saturating_add(chain.value()))
    }
    pub fn bank_all(&mut self) -> u64 {
        (0..self.chains.len()).fold(0_u64, |total, index| {
            total.saturating_add(self.bank_chain(index).unwrap_or(0))
        })
    }
    /// Kind and number of matching icons to highlight in the combo display.
    /// The completed triple remains visible until the next registered hit.
    pub fn display_progress(&self) -> (&str, u32) {
        (&self.display_kind, self.display_count)
    }
    pub fn hit(&mut self, id: u32) {
        self.hit_event(id);
    }
    pub fn hit_event(&mut self, id: u32) -> Option<ComboEvent> {
        let (kind, points, wild) = self.targets.remove(&id)?;
        let previous = (self.display_kind.clone(), self.streak);
        let mismatch = !wild && !self.kind.is_empty() && self.kind != kind;
        if self.streak == 0 {
            self.display_kind = kind.clone();
            self.display_count = 0;
        }
        if !wild {
            if !self.kind.is_empty() && self.kind != kind {
                self.streak = 0;
            }
            self.kind = kind;
            self.display_kind = self.kind.clone();
            self.streak_points = points;
        } else if self.kind.is_empty() {
            // Until ordinary fruit fixes the kind, an all-wild triple uses
            // the wildcard target's configured reward.
            self.streak_points = points;
        }
        self.streak += 1;
        self.display_count = self.streak;
        let completed = self.streak == 3;
        let award = self.streak_points;
        if completed {
            self.score = self.score.saturating_add(u64::from(self.streak_points));
            self.triples = self.triples.saturating_add(1);
            self.display_count = 3;
            if !self.kind.is_empty() {
                self.display_kind = self.kind.clone();
            }
            self.streak = 0;
            self.kind.clear();
            self.streak_points = 0;
        }
        Some(ComboEvent {
            failed: mismatch.then_some(previous),
            kind: self.display_kind.clone(),
            count: self.display_count,
            success: completed,
            points: if completed { award } else { 0 },
        })
    }
}
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct ComboEvent {
    pub failed: Option<(String, u32)>,
    pub kind: String,
    pub count: u32,
    pub success: bool,
    pub points: u32,
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    fn chain_hit(score: &mut ComboScore, id: u32, kind: &str, points: u32, wild: bool) -> bool {
        assert!(score.register(id, kind, points, wild));
        score.hit_chain(id).unwrap()
    }
    #[test]
    fn growing_chains_are_independent_and_credit_bonus_growth_immediately() {
        let mut score = ComboScore::default();
        score.set_chain_mode(true);
        for id in 0..5 {
            assert!(chain_hit(&mut score, id, "CHERRY", 10, false));
            if id < 4 {
                assert!(chain_hit(&mut score, id + 10, "MELON", 100, false));
            }
        }
        assert_eq!(score.score, 450);
        assert_eq!(score.triples, 2);
        assert_eq!(score.chains[0].as_ref().unwrap().count, 5);
        assert_eq!(score.chains[1].as_ref().unwrap().count, 4);
        assert_eq!(score.bank_chain(0), Some(60));
        assert_eq!(score.bank_chain(1), Some(300));
        assert_eq!((score.score, score.triples), (450, 2));
        assert_eq!(score.bank_all(), 0);
        assert_eq!(score.bank_chain(2), None);
        assert_eq!(score.hit_chain(0), None);
        assert_eq!(score.hit_chain(999), None);
    }
    #[test]
    fn chain_bonus_is_credited_on_each_hit_and_banking_never_repeats_it() {
        let mut score = ComboScore::default();
        score.set_chain_mode(true);
        for (id, expected_score, expected_triples) in
            [(1, 10, 0), (2, 20, 0), (3, 40, 1), (4, 70, 1), (5, 110, 1)]
        {
            chain_hit(&mut score, id, "A", 10, false);
            assert_eq!(
                (score.score, score.triples),
                (expected_score, expected_triples)
            );
            assert_eq!(score.last_chain_total_points(), expected_score);
        }
        assert_eq!(score.bank_chain(0), Some(60));
        assert_eq!((score.score, score.triples), (110, 1));
        assert_eq!(score.bank_all(), 0);
        assert_eq!((score.score, score.triples), (110, 1));
    }
    #[test]
    fn third_kind_replaces_oldest_creation_without_refreshing_on_matches() {
        let mut score = ComboScore::default();
        chain_hit(&mut score, 1, "A", 10, false);
        chain_hit(&mut score, 2, "B", 20, false);
        chain_hit(&mut score, 3, "A", 10, false);
        assert!(chain_hit(&mut score, 4, "C", 30, false));
        assert_eq!(score.rejected, 0);
        assert_eq!(score.hit_chain(4), None);
        assert_eq!(score.chains[0].as_ref().unwrap().kind, "C");
        assert_eq!(score.chains[0].as_ref().unwrap().count, 1);
        assert_eq!(score.chains[1].as_ref().unwrap().count, 1);
        chain_hit(&mut score, 5, "B", 20, false);
        assert!(chain_hit(&mut score, 6, "D", 40, false));
        assert_eq!(score.chains[0].as_ref().unwrap().kind, "C");
        assert_eq!(score.chains[1].as_ref().unwrap().kind, "D");
        assert_eq!(score.chains[1].as_ref().unwrap().count, 1);
    }
    #[test]
    fn replacement_preserves_earned_rewards_and_banking_refill_has_new_creation_age() {
        let mut score = ComboScore::default();
        for id in 0..3 {
            chain_hit(&mut score, id, "A", 10, false);
        }
        chain_hit(&mut score, 3, "B", 20, false);
        assert_eq!(score.chains[0].as_ref().unwrap().value(), 10);
        chain_hit(&mut score, 4, "C", 30, false);
        assert_eq!((score.score, score.triples), (60, 1));
        assert_eq!(score.last_chain_total_points(), 10);
        assert_eq!(score.bank_chain(0), Some(0));
        assert_eq!(score.chain_age[0], 0);
        chain_hit(&mut score, 5, "D", 40, false);
        chain_hit(&mut score, 6, "E", 50, false);
        assert_eq!(score.chains[0].as_ref().unwrap().kind, "D");
        assert_eq!(score.chains[1].as_ref().unwrap().kind, "E");
        assert_eq!(score.bank_all(), 0);
        assert_eq!(score.chain_age, [0, 0]);
        // Refilling slot 1 while slot 0 remains makes slot 0 the oldest.
        chain_hit(&mut score, 7, "A", 10, false);
        chain_hit(&mut score, 8, "B", 20, false);
        score.bank_chain(1);
        chain_hit(&mut score, 9, "C", 30, false);
        chain_hit(&mut score, 10, "D", 40, false);
        assert_eq!(score.chains[0].as_ref().unwrap().kind, "D");
        assert_eq!(score.chains[1].as_ref().unwrap().kind, "C");
    }
    #[test]
    fn wildcard_adoption_and_same_mode_keep_creation_age_until_reset() {
        let mut score = ComboScore::default();
        score.set_chain_mode(true);
        chain_hit(&mut score, 1, "WILD", 120, true);
        chain_hit(&mut score, 2, "A", 10, false);
        chain_hit(&mut score, 3, "B", 20, false);
        chain_hit(&mut score, 4, "WILD", 120, true);
        score.set_chain_mode(true);
        assert_eq!(score.chains[0].as_ref().unwrap().count, 2);
        assert_eq!(score.chains[1].as_ref().unwrap().count, 2);
        chain_hit(&mut score, 5, "C", 30, false);
        assert_eq!(score.chains[0].as_ref().unwrap().kind, "C");
        assert_eq!(score.chains[1].as_ref().unwrap().kind, "B");
        score.reset();
        assert_eq!(score.chain_age, [0, 0]);
        chain_hit(&mut score, 6, "D", 40, false);
        chain_hit(&mut score, 7, "E", 50, false);
        chain_hit(&mut score, 8, "F", 60, false);
        assert_eq!(score.chains[0].as_ref().unwrap().kind, "F");
        assert_eq!(score.chains[1].as_ref().unwrap().kind, "E");
    }
    #[test]
    fn chain_wildcards_choose_shortest_then_adopt_ordinary_kind() {
        let mut score = ComboScore::default();
        chain_hit(&mut score, 1, "WILD", 120, true);
        chain_hit(&mut score, 2, "WILD", 120, true);
        assert_eq!(score.chains[0].as_ref().unwrap().kind, "ZOLIK");
        chain_hit(&mut score, 3, "A", 10, false);
        assert_eq!(score.chains[0].as_ref().unwrap().kind, "A");
        assert_eq!(score.chains[0].as_ref().unwrap().value(), 10);
        chain_hit(&mut score, 4, "B", 20, false);
        chain_hit(&mut score, 5, "WILD", 120, true);
        chain_hit(&mut score, 6, "WILD", 120, true);
        // At a tie, slot zero wins deterministically.
        chain_hit(&mut score, 7, "WILD", 120, true);
        assert_eq!(score.chains[0].as_ref().unwrap().count, 4);
        assert_eq!(score.chains[1].as_ref().unwrap().count, 3);
        assert_eq!(score.bank_all(), 50);
        chain_hit(&mut score, 8, "WILD", 120, true);
        chain_hit(&mut score, 9, "WILD", 120, true);
        chain_hit(&mut score, 10, "WILD", 120, true);
        assert_eq!(score.bank_all(), 120);
    }
    #[test]
    fn chain_reset_mode_and_end_banking_are_idempotent_and_saturating() {
        let mut score = ComboScore::default();
        score.set_chain_mode(true);
        assert!(score.register(50, "A", 10, false));
        for id in 0..3 {
            chain_hit(&mut score, id, "A", 10, false);
        }
        assert_eq!(score.bank_all(), 10);
        assert_eq!(score.bank_all(), 0);
        assert_eq!(score.score, 40);
        score.reset();
        assert!(score.chain_mode && score.enabled && score.targets.contains_key(&50));
        assert!(score.chains.iter().all(Option::is_none));
        assert_eq!((score.score, score.triples, score.rejected), (0, 0, 0));
        let maximal = FruitChain {
            kind: "A".into(),
            count: u32::MAX,
            points: u32::MAX,
        };
        assert_eq!(maximal.value(), u64::MAX);
        score.chains = [Some(maximal.clone()), Some(maximal)];
        assert_eq!(score.pending_bonus(), u64::MAX);
        score.score = 1;
        score.triples = u32::MAX;
        assert_eq!(score.bank_all(), u64::MAX);
        assert_eq!((score.score, score.triples), (1, u32::MAX));
        assert_eq!(score.pending_bonus(), 0);
        score.set_chain_mode(false);
        assert!(!score.chain_mode);
        assert_eq!(score.score, 0);
        assert!(score.targets.contains_key(&50));
    }
    #[test]
    fn guaranteed_hits_survive_short_banks_eviction_and_duplicate_fragments() {
        let mut score = ComboScore::default();
        score.set_chain_mode(true);
        chain_hit(&mut score, 1, "A", 120, false);
        assert_eq!(score.score, 10);
        assert_eq!(score.bank_chain(0), Some(0));
        assert_eq!(score.score, 10);
        for id in 2..=6 {
            chain_hit(&mut score, id, "A", 120, false);
        }
        chain_hit(&mut score, 7, "B", 20, false);
        chain_hit(&mut score, 8, "C", 30, false);
        assert_eq!(score.last_lost_bonus, 0);
        assert_eq!(score.score, 800);
        assert_eq!(score.hit_chain(8), None);
        assert_eq!(score.hit_chain(99), None);
        assert_eq!(score.score, 800);
        assert_eq!(score.bank_all(), 0);
        chain_hit(&mut score, 9, "WILD", 120, true);
        assert_eq!(score.last_lost_bonus, 0);
        assert_eq!(score.score, 810);
        score.score = u64::MAX - 5;
        chain_hit(&mut score, 10, "WILD", 120, true);
        assert_eq!(score.score, u64::MAX);
    }
    #[test]
    fn saving_a_long_chain_beats_two_safe_triples_but_every_player_gets_hits() {
        let mut long = ComboScore::default();
        let mut safe = ComboScore::default();
        let mut beginner = ComboScore::default();
        for id in 0..6 {
            chain_hit(&mut long, id, "A", 10, false);
            chain_hit(&mut safe, id, "A", 10, false);
            if id % 3 == 2 {
                safe.bank_chain(0);
            }
            chain_hit(&mut beginner, id, &format!("K{id}"), 10, false);
        }
        long.bank_all();
        beginner.bank_all();
        assert_eq!((long.score, safe.score, beginner.score), (160, 80, 60));
    }
    #[test]
    fn combo_triples_require_consecutive_original_targets() {
        let mut score = ComboScore::default();
        for id in 1..=9 {
            assert!(score.register(id, "CHERRY", 10, false));
        }
        assert!(score.register(10, "MELON", 100, false));
        score.hit(1);
        score.hit(2);
        assert_eq!((score.score, score.streak), (0, 2));
        score.hit(10); // Wrong fruit starts its own streak.
        score.hit(3);
        score.hit(4);
        assert_eq!((score.score, score.streak), (0, 2));
        score.hit(5);
        assert_eq!((score.score, score.streak, score.triples), (10, 0, 1));
        score.hit(5);
        score.hit(999); // Repeated source / untagged fragments.
        assert_eq!((score.score, score.streak), (10, 0));
        score.hit(6);
        score.hit(7);
        score.hit(8);
        assert_eq!((score.score, score.triples), (20, 2));
        score.reset();
        assert!(score.enabled && score.targets.contains_key(&9));
        assert_eq!((score.score, score.streak, score.triples), (0, 0, 0));
        score.hit(9); // A live target's metadata survives the round restart.
        assert_eq!((score.score, score.streak), (0, 1));
    }
    #[test]
    fn combo_validates_tags() {
        let mut score = ComboScore::default();
        assert!(!score.register(1, "", 10, false));
        assert!(!score.register(1, "A", 0, false));
        assert!(!score.register(1, "A\n", 10, false));
        assert!(score.register(1, "A", 10, false));
        assert!(!score.register(2, "A", 20, false));
    }
    #[test]
    fn combo_wildcard_permutations_use_the_ordinary_fruit_reward() {
        for wild_mask in 0..7 {
            let mut score = ComboScore::default();
            for id in 0..3 {
                let wild = wild_mask & (1 << id) != 0;
                assert!(score.register(
                    id,
                    if wild { "WILD" } else { "CHERRY" },
                    if wild { 120 } else { 10 },
                    wild,
                ));
                score.hit(id);
                if id < 2 && wild_mask & ((1 << (id + 1)) - 1) == (1 << (id + 1)) - 1 {
                    assert!(score.kind.is_empty());
                }
            }
            assert_eq!((score.score, score.triples, score.streak), (10, 1, 0));
            assert!(score.kind.is_empty());
        }
    }
    #[test]
    fn combo_three_wildcards_pay_and_start_a_fresh_triple() {
        let mut score = ComboScore::default();
        for id in 0..3 {
            assert!(score.register(id, "WILD", 120, true));
            score.hit(id);
        }
        assert_eq!((score.score, score.triples, score.streak), (120, 1, 0));
        assert!(score.kind.is_empty());
        for (id, kind, points, wild) in [
            (3, "CHERRY", 10, false),
            (4, "WILD", 120, true),
            (5, "WILD", 120, true),
            (6, "WILD", 120, true),
            (7, "WILD", 120, true),
            (8, "MELON", 100, false),
        ] {
            assert!(score.register(id, kind, points, wild));
            score.hit(id);
        }
        assert_eq!((score.score, score.triples, score.streak), (230, 3, 0));
        assert!(score.kind.is_empty());
    }
    #[test]
    fn combo_wrong_fruit_breaks_a_wildcard_streak() {
        let mut score = ComboScore::default();
        for (id, kind, points, wild) in [
            (1, "CHERRY", 10, false),
            (2, "WILD", 120, true),
            (3, "MELON", 100, false),
            (4, "WILD", 120, true),
            (5, "MELON", 100, false),
        ] {
            assert!(score.register(id, kind, points, wild));
        }
        for id in 1..=3 {
            score.hit(id);
        }
        assert_eq!(
            (score.score, score.streak, score.kind.as_str()),
            (0, 1, "MELON")
        );
        score.hit(4);
        score.hit(5);
        assert_eq!((score.score, score.triples), (100, 1));
    }
    #[test]
    fn combo_reset_keeps_live_wildcards_and_ignores_duplicate_hits() {
        let mut score = ComboScore::default();
        for id in 0..5 {
            assert!(score.register(id, "WILD", 120, true));
        }
        for id in 0..3 {
            score.hit(id);
        }
        score.hit(3);
        score.hit(3);
        assert_eq!((score.score, score.triples, score.streak), (120, 1, 1));
        score.reset();
        assert_eq!((score.score, score.triples, score.streak), (0, 0, 0));
        assert!(score.enabled && score.kind.is_empty());
        assert_eq!(score.targets.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(score.targets.get(&4), Some(&("WILD".into(), 120, true)));
        score.hit(3);
        score.hit(4);
        score.hit(4);
        assert_eq!((score.score, score.triples, score.streak), (0, 0, 1));
    }
    #[test]
    fn combo_display_tracks_wildcards_payout_and_reset() {
        let mut score = ComboScore::default();
        for (id, kind, wild) in [
            (1, "ZOLIK", true),
            (2, "TRESEN", false),
            (3, "ZOLIK", true),
            (4, "MELOUN", false),
            (5, "ZOLIK", true),
            (6, "ZOLIK", true),
            (7, "ZOLIK", true),
            (8, "ZOLIK", true),
            (9, "ZOLIK", true),
            (10, "ZOLIK", true),
        ] {
            assert!(score.register(id, kind, 10, wild));
        }
        assert_eq!(score.display_progress(), ("", 0));
        score.hit(1);
        assert_eq!(score.display_progress(), ("ZOLIK", 1));
        score.hit(2);
        assert_eq!(score.display_progress(), ("TRESEN", 2));
        score.hit(3);
        assert_eq!(score.display_progress(), ("TRESEN", 3));
        // Payout remains visible through unregistered and duplicate hits.
        score.hit(999);
        score.hit(3);
        assert_eq!(score.display_progress(), ("TRESEN", 3));
        score.hit(4);
        assert_eq!(score.display_progress(), ("MELOUN", 1));
        score.hit(5);
        assert_eq!(score.display_progress(), ("MELOUN", 2));
        score.hit(6);
        assert_eq!(score.display_progress(), ("MELOUN", 3));
        score.hit(7);
        assert_eq!(score.display_progress(), ("ZOLIK", 1));
        let mut all_wild = ComboScore::default();
        for id in 20..23 {
            assert!(all_wild.register(id, "ZOLIK", 10, true));
            all_wild.hit(id);
        }
        assert_eq!(all_wild.display_progress(), ("ZOLIK", 3));
        score.reset();
        assert_eq!(score.display_progress(), ("", 0));
    }
    #[test]
    fn validates_duration() {
        for seconds in [f32::NAN, f32::INFINITY, -1.0, 0.0, 0.99, 3600.1] {
            assert!(RoundClock::new(seconds).is_none());
        }
        for seconds in [1.0, 30.0, 3600.0] {
            let round = RoundClock::new(seconds).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(round.remaining, seconds);
            assert!(!round.finished());
        }
    }
    #[test]
    fn counts_frames_clamps_finish_and_restarts() {
        let mut round = RoundClock::new(30.0).unwrap();
        round.advance(0.25);
        assert_eq!(round.remaining, 29.75);
        for dt in [-1.0, f32::NAN, f32::INFINITY] {
            round.advance(dt);
        }
        assert_eq!(round.remaining, 29.75);
        round.advance(29.75);
        assert!(round.finished());
        round.advance(10.0);
        assert_eq!(round.remaining, 0.0);
        let restarted = RoundClock::new(30.0).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(restarted.duration, 30.0);
        assert_eq!(restarted.remaining, 30.0);
        assert!(!restarted.finished());
    }
}
